Engagerad lärare i engelska och NO 4-6 eller teknik 7-9 sökes till Internationella Engelska Skolan Karlstad.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Karlstad är en skola för årskurs 4-9 med 400 elever och 50 anställda. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska, beroende på ämne. Hos oss sätts lärande och kunskap i första rummet. Vi är en skola med en stark och tydlig värdegrund som präglas av en trygg arbetsmiljö, god ordning och mycket omtanke. Vårt mål är att eleverna ska lära sig ta ett personligt ansvar för sin utveckling och sin arbetsmiljö, samt respektera sina skolkamrater, sina lärare och sig själva.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med start 2027-01-07. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna enligt gällande kollektivavtal.

Vi söker i första hand dig som har adekvat högskoleutbildning och svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i engelska och NO-ämnena eller teknik för de aktuella årskurserna. 

Din profil

- Du har svenska eller engelska som modersmål, samt goda kunskaper i båda språken för att kunna verka i vår tvåspråkiga miljö.
- Du har förmågan att utöva ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap i klassrummet.
- Du är en aktiv normsättare som kan upprätthålla den trygghet och studiero som vår skola står för. 

För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara kreativ, ansvarstagande och nytänkande. Du drivs av att ha en nära och regelbunden kontakt med vårdnadshavare. Vidare är du en lagspelare som uppskattar att samarbeta med kollegor i en stödjande och professionell miljö.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet och hur väl din pedagogiska profil matchar skolans värdegrund och arbetssätt. Ett aktuellt utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister är ett lagstadgat krav för anställning i skolan och måste uppvisas innan ett eventuellt erbjudande om anställning kan ges.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. För mer information om vår skola, se www.karlstad.engelska.se Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev, lärarlegitimation samt utdrag från polisregistret till applications.karlstad@engelska.se

jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in English with a Specialisation in Literature
jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.
 
 
Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?
 
 
Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.
 
 
The Faculty of Philosophy, conducts education and research in the humanities, social sciences and education, mathematics and natural sciences, as well as the arts. Our research and education are carried out in close dialogue with the wider community and contribute to critical knowledge development, intellectual growth, and a deeper understanding of complex societal issues. Education is offered at all levels and is grounded in scientific or artistic foundations and characterized by academic breadth. Together, we contribute to a sustainable, open, and knowledge-based society.  The Faculty comprises three departments, employing approximately 420 members of staff in total. Through our collaborative platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector, and industry to jointly advance knowledge development and address societal challenges.
 
 
The Department of Social Science and Humanities provides education in social sciences, behavioural sciences, and language and communication. Research focuses on societal issues such as democracy, migration, sustainable development and communication, and is conducted in close collaboration with the surrounding society.
Employment information
Employment: Permanent employment which begins with possible trial employment
 
Period of employment/Start date: 2027-08-01
 
Scope: Part-time 75 %
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-02
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
Department/Unit: Social Sciences and Humanities
For information and a detailed description of basic eligibility requirements and assessment criteria, that apply to a position of a senior lecturer, please consult the Appointment Regulations for Mälardalen University https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities
Position description
As a senior lecturer at MDU, your main tasks are teaching. Teaching also includes supervision, examination, course evaluation and course development. At MDU, research and education are closely intertwined and research forms the basis of our programmes. Collaboration is also an integral part of our research and education mission and as a senior lecturer you will actively contribute to the university's development work.
The tasks include:
teaching and examination in literature and literature didactics on the undergraduate and graduate levels, within the primary and subject teacher programmes as well as in other contexts
teaching and examination in English proficiency courses
course coordination and other administrative tasks
supervision and examination of degree projects
participation in pedagogical, scientific and collegial development
research and contributions to the department's research environments
general administration and competence development as well as participating in the daily activities, in the work of the subject and the department
additional tasks, such as work placement visits in the teacher programmes or teaching in research education, may be included

Qualification requirements

Som operatör i våra valsverkstäder kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i att säkerställa driften och effektiviteten av vår specialiserade utrustning samt leverera service och underhåll på kundens komponenter till de olika valsverken. English:
As an operator in our rolling mills, you will play a key role in ensuring the operation and efficiency of our specialized equipment and delivering service and maintenance on customer components to the various rolling mills. You will work with a range of different technical areas, giving you the opportunity to use and develop your skills in areas such as machining, assembly, quality control and measurement technology.
Din profil / Your profile

Arbetet innehåller både planerade och akuta service/underhållsåtgärder, vilket passar dig som tycker om att lösa problem och har en ”can do” inställning. Detta innebär även att du har ett öga för detaljer och en vilja att ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt och processer. Det är viktigt att du trivs med att både arbeta självständigt och som en del av ett lag.
Du kan uttrycka dig väl i svenska och eller engelska då arbetet till stor del sker i samarbete med dina kollegor.
Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom maskinbearbetning, gärna inom tung industri, samt innehar en gymnasieexamen eller likvärdig utbildning.
Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av:
Arbete i en valsverkstad
Maskinbearbetning
Kvalitetskontroller och tillhörande mätinstrument
Hantering av travers/kran i verkstadsmiljö

English:
The work includes both planned and urgent service/maintenance measures, which suits you who like to solve problems and have a "can do" attitude. This also means that you have an eye for detail and a desire to constantly improve our working methods and processes. It is important that you enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
You can express yourself well in Swedish and/or English as the work is largely done in collaboration with your colleagues.
We would like you to have a background in machining, preferably in heavy industry, and hold a high school diploma or equivalent education.
Experience in:
Working in a rolling mill
Machining
Quality controls and associated measuring instruments
Handling of overhead cranes/cranes in a workshop environment is an advantage

- Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Is highly organised and able to coordinate several tasks and events at the same time.
- Is creative and enjoys coming up with ideas for events, activities, and communication.
- Has an interest in social media, photography, content creation, or digital communication.
- Is flexible, solution-oriented, and happy to help wherever needed.
- Has excellent English and Swedish communication skills, both written and spoken.
- Swedish drivers licence is a plus What we offer

- A varied and creative role at a growing international school.
- A role where your ideas and initiative can make a real difference.
- A dynamic working environment where you will meet students, staff, parents, and visitors every day.
- Supportive and dedicated colleagues.
- The opportunity to help build and develop a growing school.
- A culture focused on learning, respect, community, and academic success.

The position is 100%

Interviews will be conducted continuously during the application period, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

You will be the guardian of our global Tone of Voice. You will balance visionary, high-level campaign ideation with hands-on creative execution, ensuring that Toca Boca sounds exactly like Toca Boca wherever we show up.

360° campaigns where you drove both the high-level concept and the final narrative arc.

Emotionally resonant work targeting tweens that feels authentic.

Examples proving you can define, adapt, and guard a distinct brand voice across digital, social, and physical touchpoints.

A strong mix of visionary thinking and sharp daily execution (social media content).

Flawless native English writing with the precision required for a sensitive audience.

About VAST
VAST is a geomorphic landform design consultancy. We design mine closure landforms that behave like natural landscapes, and we work directly with mining clients in Sweden, Australia and Canada.
The role
The main role is landform design, including conceptual and detailed design for mine closure and waste rock management. Other responsibilities include reference site investigations, landform monitoring (including sediment and hydrology monitoring), research and innovation, and technical reporting and writing. We will train the successful candidate in landform design. Prior design experience is welcome but not required.
Requirements
Education (required): A relevant degree of at least two years’ post-secondary study in one of: landscape architecture, geomorphology, geography, geology, mining or mine closure engineering, environmental or civil engineering, forestry, or a related discipline.
Essential experience: at least 2 years of relevant experience in GIS, fluvial or sediment monitoring, or applied research.
Essential skills:
Advanced GIS skills, for example ArcGIS, QGIS or Python.
Knowledge of fluvial geomorphology, sediment transport and erosion rates, and how to monitor them.
Clear technical writing in English.

Desirable: background in landform or geomorphic design, mine closure or waste rock; field survey and remote sensing skills (total station, GNSS, drone photogrammetry, LiDAR).
No prior landscape architecture experience is required.
Language: English, required.
Please include CV with your application.

Implement, maintain, and develop QHSE processes and management systems

- Engagerade kollegor och internationell miljö

We believe a safe and structured school is essential for the best possible social and academic development. We follow Swedish school law, teaching and setting grades according to Lgr 22 and we are proud of our diverse and engaged multicultural school.

We are looking for an Assistant Principal (AP) for grades 6-9 to join our leadership team, who will support the Principal in leading and creating the opportunity for every student to realise their own potential in an international environment. The AP position involves being a member of the Senior Management Team, and having staff responsibility, for instance managing both the Student Care Team functions and the Heads of Year. We are looking for candidates who can lead, manage and train their staff to ensure that students experience consistency, within a caring and supportive school environment.

The position:

- Collaborate with the Principal and other school leaders in the overall development of the school, its culture, strategy, structure and routines
- Monitor, follow up on and develop the quality of the planning, teaching, assessment and grading
- Lead and coach our team of Middle Leaders who in turn lead their teams
- Plan and lead professional development for staff
- Monitor, follow up on and develop our students’ learning and behavioral outcomes (Systematic Quality Work)
- Collaborate with other school leaders around academic and social support structures to ensure our resources are used effectively
- Lead development, appraisal and salary talks

About you:

- We are looking for someone who is passionate about education and creating a climate for learning and you have the ability to engage and inspire both students and staff
- You are a competent and enthusiastic role model and leader with a strong presence to help us continue to develop the teaching, learning & behavior

- You promote bilingualism, have an international mindset and approach, exercise cultural intelligence and good interpersonal skills

- You have a proven track record in student care and academics, and leadership experience including staff responsibility
- You are able to work professionally in both English and Swedish in meetings and presentations

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Behörig lärare i  svenska och svenska som andraspråk  sökes till åk 4-7

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerade och närvarande ledare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Din egen undervisning sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska/svenska. 

Vi söker nu en behörig lärare i svenska och svenska som andraspråk med svensk lärarlegitimation.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde HT 2026. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygghet, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans i team med lärarkollegor, stödpedagoger. Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. I teamet hjälps pedagogerna åt med planering, undervisning och elevernas skoldag.  Mentorskap för en klass kan ingå i tjänsten.

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med behörighet i svenska och svenska som andraspråk samt svensk lärarlegitimation för åk 4-7. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du har ett tydligt ledarskap och står starkt i dina elevgrupper. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll undervisar du på svenska, men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska i huvudsak men även svenska. Det gör att du behöver behärska båda språken flytande, både i tal och skrift. 

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Work in Sweden 2027 – Great Pay, Affordable Housing & Career Opportunities
Svedberga Plantskola AB is hiring 2–3 experienced and hardworking employees for the 2027 planting seasons in Sweden.
We welcome applicants from all countries, particularly Poland and Romania.
Svedberga is an established Swedish company specialising in the sale, delivery and planting of hedges, trees and other plants throughout Sweden.
We are looking for reliable, motivated and physically fit individuals who enjoy outdoor work, take responsibility and can maintain a consistently high working pace.
Employment Periods – 2027
Spring season: 15 March – 30 June 2027

Autumn season: 15 August – 31 October 2027

IMPORTANT: You MUST be available to work during BOTH periods. Applications from candidates who are only available for one season will NOT be considered.
For the right candidates, there is also an opportunity for continued employment and year-round work.
Work Location and Working Hours
Work is mainly carried out in southern Sweden at various customer locations.

Full-time employment during both seasonal periods.

Opportunities for overtime when required.

Travel and occasional overnight stays away from the main work location are part of the job.

Main Responsibilities
Planting hedges, trees and larger plants

Digging, ground preparation and landscaping work

Loading, unloading and handling plants

Practical work in nurseries and landscaping projects

Other duties related to the company's operations

Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for candidates with previous experience in physically demanding work, such as forestry planting, agriculture, nurseries, groundworks or landscaping.
Mandatory Requirements:
Very good physical fitness and stamina

Previous experience in physically demanding, practical work

Ability to maintain a high and consistent working pace throughout the working day

Ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team

Reliability, punctuality and a strong work ethic

Willingness to work outdoors in different weather conditions

English language skills – you must be able to understand work instructions and make yourself understood in English

Valid Category B driving licence

Availability during BOTH employment periods in 2027

Additional Qualifications – Highly Valued
Category BE driving licence (car with heavy trailer) – a major advantage

Experience driving with trailers and operating machinery

Knowledge of Polish or Romanian

Previous experience in planting and landscaping

Please note: This is physically demanding work. We are looking for people who are accustomed to hard physical labour and can maintain a high working pace throughout a full working day.
What We Offer
Attractive salary and employment conditions

Employment covered by a Swedish collective bargaining agreement through Gröna arbetsgivare (the Swedish Green Employers' Organisation)

Salary in accordance with the applicable collective agreement, taking experience and qualifications into account

Full-time employment with opportunities for overtime

Assistance in arranging accommodation in Sweden at a favourable price

Company-paid hotel accommodation when overnight stays are required for work at other locations

Employment with an established Swedish company and experienced colleagues

Opportunities for returning seasonal employment

For suitable candidates, the possibility of continued, year-round employment

How to Apply
Please send us a short introduction about yourself, including:
Your name and previous work experience

Experience in physically demanding work

Your level of English

Your driving licence categories (B/BE)

Any knowledge of Polish or Romanian

Explicit confirmation that you are available for BOTH periods: 15 March – 30 June AND 15 August – 31 October 2027

Are you an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with a background in heavy-duty vehicle development? Join Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB for a challenging two-year assignment focused on chassis integration for Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) solutions.

You will contribute to the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within BEV chassis platforms. Working closely with engineering teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders, you will develop practical design solutions that meet packaging, interface, installation, manufacturing, and functional requirements.
Experience in at least one of the specified technical areas is essential. Candidates with expertise across two or more areas will be particularly relevant.

Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for BEV chassis integration.
Work with sheet metal components, brackets, plastic components, and/or pneumatic installations.
Create and modify 3D models and 2D drawings using CATIA V5.
Manage component packaging, interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards and manufacturing requirements.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical documentation and provide production support when required.
Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the engineering team.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 3 years of professional design engineering experience.
Mandatory: Previous R&D experience within a leading heavy-duty vehicle manufacturer or its group.
Strong hands-on competence in one or more of the following:
Sheet metal design, brackets, and installation solutions.
Plastic components and installation design.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D drawing creation.
Experience with tolerance analysis.
Good understanding of component packaging, interfaces, and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturability, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Good command of English.

Highly Valued Experience
Previous chassis design and integration experience within heavy-duty vehicles.
Experience working on BEV platforms and electrified vehicle architecture.
Expertise across multiple technical areas, such as sheet metal, plastics, and pneumatics.
Experience collaborating with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Personal Attributes
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of independently driving design activities.
Practical and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges.
Ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders.
Willingness to share knowledge and contribute to team development.

Important Assignment Details
Duration: 2 years.

Location: Södertälje, Sweden.

SWEDEN RELOCATORS AB is an immigration and relocation consultancy based in Malmö, established in 2015. We help individuals, families and companies from all over the world with residence permits, work permits and relocation to Sweden, through our online client portal and our office in Malmö. We are now looking for experienced Immigration Consultants to join our team.
About the role
As an Immigration Consultant you will handle immigration cases from start to finish and be the client's main point of contact throughout the process. You will work closely with our senior consultants and our relocation team.
Responsibilities:
Assess each client's situation and identify the right permit route
Prepare, quality check and submit complete applications to Migrationsverket (the Swedish Migration Agency), for example work permits, EU Blue Card, family reunification, EU right of residence, long-term residence and citizenship
Follow up on ongoing cases and respond to requests for supplementary information within the deadlines
Communicate with clients through our online portal, by email, by phone and in meetings
Draft cover letters and written statements, and support our senior team with reconsideration requests and appeals
Keep case files and documentation accurate and up to date
Coordinate with our relocation partners when a client also needs relocation services

Requirements:
You are based in Sweden and have the right to work in Sweden
At least 3 years of documented experience in immigration case handling, for example as an immigration consultant, case officer or paralegal
Fluent English, written and spoken
A structured and accurate way of working, and the ability to handle many cases at the same time while meeting deadlines
Good IT skills and experience of working with digital case management systems

Experience from your home country or another country:
If you have worked in this profession in your home country or elsewhere outside Sweden, this experience counts towards the requirement. Please attach a reference (name, title and contact details of your former manager) and a written confirmation from the employer, for example an employment certificate, that shows your position, period of employment and main duties. Documents in languages other than English or Swedish should be accompanied by an English translation. Experience that cannot be confirmed will not be taken into account.
Students are welcome to apply for part-time:
Are you studying and do you have experience in immigration case handling? You are welcome to apply for a part-time position that can be combined with your studies. State in your application that you are applying for part-time and how many hours per week you are available.
Desirable qualifications:
Experience of other immigration systems, for example Canada, Australia, New Zealand or the UK
Knowledge of Utlänningslagen (2005:716), EU free movement rules and Migrationsverket's procedures
Knowledge of Swedish
Post-secondary education in law, political science, social science or similar

We offer:
An important role in a growing company with clients from all over the world
A full-time position, or part-time for students
An introduction to our working methods and our digital client portal
A workplace at our office at Amiralsgatan 86E in Malmö

How to apply:
Send your CV, a short cover letter, your references and employment certificates to jobs@swedenrelocators.se. Mark your application "Immigration Consultant" or "Immigration Consultant, part-time". We review applications continuously, so please send yours as soon as possible.

Är du den speciallärare med bred ämnesbehörighet som kan inspirera våra elever på IES Norrtälje?

Trivs du i en internationell skolmiljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas som både lärare och ledare? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!

Vi söker en legitimerad speciallärare, med planerad start i januari 2027. 

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Norrtälje öppnade 2024 och har idag omkring 520 elever i årskurs F–9. 

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi arbetar för att varje elev ska känna trygghet och trivsel i en lärande miljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga. Undervisningen i svenska sker på svenska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personal.

It is important to point out to professional applicants that IESN is no ordinary Swedish school, quite the opposite - discipline and good manners are the constant order of the day and our conservative, but hugely challenging task, is to create and develop ladies and gentlemen of the future.

The school is bilingual which means we utilise both English and Swedish in our class instruction and we endeavour to develop

students who quickly learn to line-up quietly and pay attention to the language that they implement.

Furthermore, we do not believe in 'lagom' and we encourage competition and winning.

In addition, IESN can only employ teachers with Swedish teaching accreditation ie. Lärarlegitimationen, but we are always open to applications which show initiative or the recognition that teaching is not a job but a 'calling', wherein going the extra mile is a given necessity to achieve the best for students.

Should you wish to pursue your interest in IESN further, then please do send us your individual CV's and Cover letters in English.Det här erbjuder vi

Hos oss får du:

- En internationell och inspirerande arbetsplats där svenska och engelska används parallellt.
- Kollegor som samarbetar, stöttar varandra och arbetar mot gemensamma mål.
- En skola med studiero, tydliga rutiner och en positiv kultur som gynnar både elever och personal.
- Möjligheten att ingå i en väletablerad organisation där din kompetens tas tillvara.
- Heltidstjänst.
- Ferieanställning med tillträde januari 2027 eller tidigare vid överenskommelse. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

*För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/norrtalje/

Vill du vara med och inspirera och samtidigt ta nästa steg i din karriär?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt fantastiska team!

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats eller till peter-john.fyles.norrtalje@engelska.se så snart som möjligt.

Would you like to spend two weeks teaching Science at a high-performing bilingual school?
Engelska Skolan Norr is looking for an engaged and responsible substitute Science teacher for Years 7-9 for a two-week period from the 11th of January to the 22nd of February, 2027.
This is a great opportunity to get to know our school, our students and our way of working. Whether you are currently looking for a teaching position, studying to become a teacher or simply interested in gaining experience in education, we would love to hear from you!
About our school
Engelska Skolan Norr is a high-performing bilingual school where strong academic results, motivated students and a collaborative staff culture create an environment where both teachers and learners thrive.
We follow the Swedish national curriculum (Lgr22) in a bilingual setting, with teaching in Science primarily conducted in English. We value high academic expectations, structured teaching and a strong focus on both subject knowledge and language development.
About the assignment
Teach Science (NO) in Years 7-9 in accordance with Lgr22.
Deliver structured and engaging lessons that maintain continuity in students' learning.
Support students with different learning needs and abilities.
Work collaboratively with colleagues and follow established plans and routines.
Contribute to a positive and focused learning environment.

We are looking for someone who:
Has a good knowledge of Science and an interest in teaching.
Is confident communicating in English and Swedish in a bilingual school environment.
Can create structure and engage students in their learning.
Is responsible, flexible and enjoys working with young people.
Values collaboration and a positive approach to education.

Teaching experience or relevant subject studies are an advantage.
Why join us?
This short-term assignment is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable classroom experience, develop your teaching skills and get to know our school and colleagues. It may also open doors to future opportunities at Engelska Skolan Norr.
Interested? Get in touch with us and tell us a little about yourself and your availability.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity 
  
 Are you about to graduate, or have you recently completed your university studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field? 
 Join Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks. 
 Our teams develop performance-critical software at the heart of 5G and future radio systems. As a Junior Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced developers and technical experts to learn how advanced wireless communication systems are designed, implemented, tested, and optimized. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited about solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative environment. 
  
 What you will do 
  
  Develop and maintain software in Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 platform.
 Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to support activities such as developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review.
 Work with modern C++ and performance-critical software components.
 Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work.
 Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities.
 Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams.
 Contribute to software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
 Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product, including prototyping, integration, testing, and evaluation together with experienced engineers.
 Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience. 
  
 
 The skills you bring 
  
  Programming experience in C/C++, Python, Julia.
 Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts.
 Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects.
 Experience with Linux development environments, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, or cloud-native technologies.
 Basic understanding of 5G, mobile networks, physical layer processing, or 3GPP concepts.
 Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications.
 Good communication skills in English.
 Curiosity, collaboration, ownership, and a strong willingness to learn. 
  
 
 You do not need previous professional telecom or Layer 1 experience. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, and the motivation to grow.
  
 Please send your CV in English.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics.
 
 
Subject description
 
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
 
 
Project description
 
RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects.
 
 
Duties
 
As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. - dokumentera, följa upp och utvärdera elevernas framsteg
- arbeta i enlighet med IES:s tre kärnvärden: Behärskning av det engelska språket, En trygg och ordnad miljö samt Höga akademiska förväntningar.

Du har förmågan att bygga starka och förtroendefulla relationer med elever i olika åldrar. Du ser möjligheterna och styrkorna i en mångkulturell skolmiljö och har höga förväntningar på alla elevers förmåga att utvecklas.

Du är organiserad, flexibel och analytisk. Du kan arbeta självständigt men trivs också med att samarbeta med kollegor kring elevernas utveckling och behov.

Vi söker dig som har SVA-kompetens och betydande erfarenhet av att undervisa i SVA.

Om du vill bli en del av en dynamisk skola med engagerade lärare, skicka in ditt CV och ditt personliga brev via vårt rekryteringssystem. Vi ser att du har:

- en lärarexamen och lärarbehörighet, helst med behörighet att undervisa i svenska som andraspråk
- kunskap om nyanlända elevers lärande och språkutveckling
- god förståelse för relevanta riktlinjer och bedömningsmaterial
- god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska, eftersom engelska är ett vanligt arbetsspråk på skolan
- goda digitala färdigheter och erfarenhet av pedagogisk dokumentation.
- erfarenhet av att undervisa elever i olika åldersgrupper
- erfarenhet av arbete med elever med särskilda behov, extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd

Svenska
Är du en erfaren underhållsledare med gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av tung industriell utrustning? SMS group söker en arbetsledare för mekaniskt underhåll som ska leda verkstadsarbetet och bidra till att kritisk utrustning i stålverket är driftsäker, säker och redo för produktion.
I rollen leder du ett team som ansvarar för reparation, renovering och översyn av utrustning såsom valslipmaskiner, fräsmaskiner, valslagerhus, lagerenheter samt annan verkstads- och stålverksutrustning. Du kombinerar ett närvarande och praktiskt ledarskap på verkstadsgolvet med planering, felsökning och kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete.
Du samordnar underhållsverkstadens dagliga arbete och ser till att prioriteringar, resurser och tekniska krav är tydliga. Du stöttar teamet i att lösa utrustningsproblem och bidrar till förbättringar som stärker säkerheten, kvaliteten och driftsäkerheten.
Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:
Planera och prioritera verkstadsarbetet utifrån produktionens behov
Ansvara för reparationer, inspektioner, precisionspassning och renovering av utrustning
Felsöka mekaniska, hydrauliska och pneumatiska problem
Utveckla förebyggande underhåll för verkstads- och stålverksutrustning
Stödja grundorsaksanalyser och följa upp korrigerande åtgärder
Följa upp underhållsresultat, bland annat efterlevnad av förebyggande underhåll, MTBF, MTTR och andelen effektivt underhållsarbete
Säkerställa korrekt underhållsdokumentation och effektiv användning av personal, utrustning och reservdelar

Du förväntas föregå med gott exempel och säkerställa att säkerhetsrutiner, inklusive Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), följs. Du har också mandat att stoppa arbetet om säkerhet, kvalitet eller regelefterlevnad riskeras.
English
Are you an experienced maintenance leader with a strong hands-on background in heavy industrial equipment? SMS group is looking for a Mechanical Maintenance Foreman to lead workshop activities and help keep critical steel mill machinery reliable, safe and ready for operation.
In this role, you will lead a team responsible for repairing, rebuilding and overhauling equipment such as roll grinding machines, milling machines, roll chocks, bearing assemblies and other workshop and mill equipment. You will combine practical shop-floor leadership with planning, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
You will coordinate the daily work of the maintenance workshop, making sure priorities, resources and technical requirements are clear. You will support the team in resolving equipment issues and contribute to improvements that strengthen safety, quality and reliability.
Your responsibilities will include:
Planning and prioritising workshop work in line with production needs
Overseeing repairs, inspections, precision fitting and equipment rebuilds
Troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic issues
Developing preventive maintenance practices for workshop and mill equipment
Supporting root cause analysis and following up on corrective actions
Monitoring maintenance performance, including preventive maintenance compliance, MTBF, MTTR and wrench time
Ensuring accurate maintenance documentation and effective use of people, equipment and spare parts

You are expected to lead by example and ensure that safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), are followed. You also have the authority to stop work if safety, quality or compliance may be at risk.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in Waste Science and Technology
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Department for Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is looking for a Senior Lecturer, who is driven by the interest to strengthen their expertise in advanced environmental technologies, particularly in addressing persistent contaminants such as PFAS, PAH, antibiotics, pesticides.
 
 
This position is intended for advancing ongoing research of the group of Waste Science and Technology in waste management, circular material flows, waste detoxification, and environmental remediation, all of which are essential for driving progress toward a sustainable and environmentally responsible society. The Senior lecturer will contribute to the development of research and education efforts by studying and developing advanced treatment methods and integrated treatment chains for waste, contaminated soils and groundwater.
 
 
This recruitment aligns with the university’s vision to position itself among leaders in environmental technology and establish robust international research collaborations, leveraging unique research and education environment.
 
 
Subject description
 
Waste Science and Technology incorporates all stages of society’s waste management – generation, collection, treatment and disposal of waste, including reuse and recycling, as well as soil and groundwater remediation. The research aims at the development of tools and processes that facilitate sustainable soil remediation and waste management.
 
 
Duties
 
Your duties will mainly consist of research and education. You will lead research projects and supervise Master and PhD students. Teaching and educational development work is included in the tasks, as well as writing and submitting new project proposals for external funding. You will co-author scientific articles to be published in international peer-reviewed journals and present research results at national and international conferences. You are also expected to contribute to the research environment at the Department through participation in meetings, events and cooperation.
 
 
Qualifications 
 
To meet the requirements for the appointment as a senior lecturer, the applicants: 
must have been awarded a doctoral degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or adjacent areas or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree.
must demonstrate pedagogical expertise by means of proven experience, teaching expertise and teaching development.
must have completed higher education pedagogy courses equivalent to 7.5 higher education credits or otherwise have acquired equivalent knowledge.

Assessment criteria
 
The following assessment criteria apply to this position:
- scientific expertise
- pedagogical skills
- other assessment criteria
 
 
Other assessment criteria (Ranked in descending order):
- experience in sample preparation and analytical methods for contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) (e.g., PFAS and pharmaceuticals) in soil, waste, and water
- Experience in the development and/or application of advanced degradation technologies for CECs (e.g., electrochemical oxidation, sonolysis, and plasma-based technologies, etc.)
- the ability to obtain external research and development funding
- the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in English
- the ability to communicate research and development work orally and in writing
- the ability to collaborate with the wider community and stakeholders.
 
 
Information
 
The position is a permanent, full-time appointment at Luleå University of Technology.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Jurate Kumpiene, +46 920-493020, mailto:jurate.kumpiene@ltu.se

Stockholm, Sweden

Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.

Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.

Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.

Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.

Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.

Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.

Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.

Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.

Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel

jobs.occupation: Loving and Experienced DAYTIME Nanny Wanted for a Wonderful Little Boy
jobs.description:
Ref. 4298Ö
We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced daytime nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine love for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has a permanent back injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. Having a nanny available whenever he is with his mother is therefore essential. The role involves supporting both the child and the family in everyday life.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Day Nanny – Responsibilities
The role combines childcare with light household support.
While he is at nursery, approximately 2–5 hours will generally be spent on household tasks. The nanny should remain available in case he is unwell, nursery is closed or plans change.
Responsibilities include:
Morning routines, breakfast and preparing meals and snacks.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing, engaging and supporting his interests and activities.
Preparing healthy meals for the family.
Laundry, ironing and making beds.
Keeping the child's areas tidy and cleaning up after him.
Wiping kitchen surfaces and general light household tasks.
Administering medication when required.

The family particularly appreciates someone who enjoys cooking and takes initiative in the kitchen. A weekly cleaner is employed.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.
Enjoys cooking and preparing family meals.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
The family is looking for someone who genuinely cares about his happiness and development and brings warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!
Location: Östermalm, Stockholm
Start date: November 2026 – January 2027 (TBC)
Schedule: Every other week
Working hours: 08:00–20:00 (±1 hour)
Child: One boy, 4.5 years old
Languages: English preferred
Position: Long-term, full-time employment

Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.

Om Nordic Light Nannies:
Vi söker nu en ny medarbetare som vill ha nanny som sitt yrke. Vi arbetar mot familjer som ställer höga krav på kvalitet när de väljer en nanny. De flesta av våra tjänster är på minst halvtid och vi tycker det är väldigt viktigt att även nannyn trivs bra ihop med familjen. Därför tar vi dina önskemål på stort allvar när vi presenterar familjer för dig.
Vi har Sveriges bästa villkor för nannies med bland annat sjuklön och semesterersättning.
Lönerna bestäms individuellt beroende på erfarenhet och utbildning och är jämförbara med förskollärare lön i Stockholm. Minimilön 150 kr/tim. Vi kan erbjuda högre lön upp till 210 kr/tim för nannies med mycket erfarenhet och/eller pedagogisk utbildning. Fasta månadslöner förekommer inom vissa tjänster.
Läs mer på https://nordiclightnannies.se/lediga-tjanster/

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer  BEV Chassis Integration
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration | CATIA V5
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Mechanical Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration
Specialisation: Mechanical Design | Chassis Integration | Sheet Metal Design | Pneumatic Systems | CATIA V5
Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience
Location: Södertälje, Sweden
Work Model: On-site (100%)
Assignment Period: 1 December 2026 – 29 December 2028
Language: English
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to contribute to the development and integration of components and systems for Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) chassis solutions.
You will work on mechanical design, component integration and installation solutions within heavy-duty vehicle platforms, with a particular focus on sheet metal components, brackets, pneumatic systems and chassis packaging.
The role involves working with advanced CAD tools, developing detailed 3D and 2D designs, coordinating with suppliers and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver technically robust and production-ready solutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Mechanical Design & Component Development
Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for BEV chassis applications.
Develop sheet metal components, brackets and mounting solutions.
Design and integrate pneumatic components and installation systems.
Create detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards and technical requirements.
Perform tolerance analysis and ensure dimensional accuracy.

2. Chassis Integration & Component Packaging
Work with component packaging, interfaces and installation requirements.
Ensure effective integration of mechanical and pneumatic components within vehicle chassis architectures.
Evaluate installation space, clearances, interfaces and mounting requirements.
Develop practical design solutions considering functionality, manufacturability and serviceability.
Support the integration of components within electric vehicle chassis platforms.

3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the design and development lifecycle.
Participate in technical discussions, design reviews and engineering coordination activities.
Support supplier interactions and resolve technical design-related challenges.
Coordinate design requirements and ensure alignment across relevant stakeholders.

4. Verification, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Support design reviews, validation activities and technical investigations.
Prepare and maintain engineering drawings, specifications and technical documentation.
Support manufacturing and production-related activities when required.
Contribute to design optimization, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant mechanical design engineering experience.
Previous R&D experience with Scania/Hero or the relevant TRATON organization is mandatory.
Strong practical experience in one or more of the following areas:
Sheet metal design and development.
Brackets and mechanical installation solutions.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Component packaging and chassis integration.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D engineering drawings.
Experience with tolerance analysis and dimensional engineering.
Good understanding of component interfaces, packaging and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturing and manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic and/or pneumatic components.
Ability to develop practical and technically sound mechanical design solutions.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience in the following areas will be highly advantageous:
Heavy-duty vehicle chassis design and integration.
Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) development.
Truck chassis component integration and installation.
Sheet metal component design and manufacturing.
Pneumatic system design and integration.
Supplier coordination and technical design reviews.
Vehicle packaging, mounting interfaces and tolerance management.
Production support and engineering documentation.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a proactive and technically capable Mechanical Design Engineer who can independently drive design activities and contribute to complex vehicle integration projects.
The ideal candidate should have practical experience in heavy-duty vehicle development, strong CATIA V5 capabilities and a solid understanding of mechanical design principles.
You should be comfortable collaborating with suppliers, engineering teams and other stakeholders while taking ownership of technical deliverables, solving design challenges and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
Important Information
Previous R&D experience with the specified heavy-duty vehicle OEM/group is mandatory.
The position is 100% on-site in Södertälje.
CV must be submitted in English.
A background check will be conducted before the start of the employment/assignment.
Candidate selection will take place continuously.
There may be opportunities for an extension beyond the stated period.

Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with CATIA V5 expertise and a background in heavy-duty vehicle development?
We would be happy to hear from you!
Apply directly through our careers page:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers

jobs.occupation: Mates and Masters to the Fleet Department
jobs.description:
Are you our new team member?
Our Fleet Department is growing! We are looking for Mates and Masters who want to be part of a close-knit team on board our survey vessels, delivering survey operations across Europe.
About us:
Njord Survey was founded in 2015 with a clear ambition: to challenge how offshore surveys are delivered. By combining state-of-the-art technology with innovative thinking, we deliver high-quality hydrographic and geophysical surveys more efficiently, for navigation, dredging, charting, marine construction for renewable energy and more.
We are in an exciting phase of growth, now with more than 120 dedicated employees delivering tailored solutions to meet each project’s and client’s needs.
Scope of work:
At Njord Survey, we use state-of-the-art technology to operate efficient survey vessels with a lower environmental footprint. Our vessels typically carry a crew of 2 to 8 people, depending on vessel size and project, which allows us to stay flexible and adapt quickly to our clients’ needs. Data is collected on board and processed by our onshore team at the Gothenburg office.
On board, we work as one team. The vessel operates independently in planning and executing survey operations, in close collaboration with the office and our onshore processing team. Together, the crew is responsible for the safe navigation, operation and maintenance of the vessel, including onboard planning, procurement, inventory and reporting to project management. On some vessels there is no dedicated engineer, so everyone contributes where needed. We are constantly developing how we operate, and your experience and ideas are part of that.
Masters carry overall responsibility for the vessel, crew and safety, while Mates support the Master and take operational responsibility during assigned watches. Both work closely with the survey team on board to ensure high-quality data acquisition.
Learn more about what it's like to work at Njord Survey from our colleague Axel here!
Who we are looking for:
You thrive in small teams and understand that it is the team that makes the vessel work. You enjoy new challenges, are comfortable adapting when plans change, and are always ready to lend a hand where it is needed. You have an interest in technology, and experience from smaller vessels is an advantage.
The organisational language is English, so you need professional proficiency in both spoken and written English.
Requirements and merits:

For applicants applying as Master:

Requirements:

EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden

B driving licence

Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent

Basic safety STCW

Restricted Operator’s Certificate (ROC)

Medical Care STCW VI/4.2

Deck Officer Class I (Master Mariner), or RYA/MCA and/or M200GT

Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS)

Merits:

General Operator’s Certificate (GOC)

For applicants applying as Mate:

Requirements:

EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden

B driving licence

Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent

Basic safety STCW

Restricted Operator’s Certificate (ROC)

Deck Officer Class V / VI or M200GT or RYA/MCA Master of yacht Limited

Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS)

Merits:

General Operator’s Certificate (GOC)

Location: Offshore
Working time: 2 weeks of work followed by 4 weeks off from work, with 12-hours workdays
Our offers to you:
We offer a workplace for you to grow and to stay. At Njord Survey you become part of an experienced team who have fun together and build on each other’s ideas. We invest in our personnel and believe that competence development should be a combination of gained experience from diverse projects together with courses, workshops and activities.
We offer a wide range of employee benefits such as a wellness benefit of 5000 SEK/year, private medical insurance, access to our personnel benefit’s portal, team activities and more.
Our recruitment process:
The recruitment process consists of several evaluation steps to ensure a qualitative process. First a phone interview for us to learn more about your ambitions and for you to get to know Njord Survey and our offers better, followed by online tests and a competence-based interview with the department manager. The aim of the process is for you to learn about the content of the role and for us to evaluate if you have the right profile for the position. You can read more about our recruitment process at the career page here.
Feel free to hand in your application in Swedish or English.
The application will be open until the 15th of November 2026
Candidate selection is ongoing, please hand in your application as soon as possible.
We are looking forward reading your application!
We kindly ask to not be contacted for external recruitment services.
The company is covered by the collective agreement Utveckling & Tjänster. A local trade union representing Sveriges Ingenjörer/Saco can be contacted at saco@njordsurvey.se.

jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for enthusiastic and committed hourly substitutes to join our Fritids Programme, primarily during afternoon hours.
If you enjoy working with children, creating meaningful activities and contributing to a positive and supportive learning environment, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM) is an IB Continuum School located in central Malmö. We offer the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 370 students representing a wide range of nationalities and cultures. We are proud to be part of a global network of IB World Schools.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation with a long tradition of academic excellence, we are committed to providing a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students are encouraged to become knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As an hourly substitute in our Fritids Programme, you will work alongside our Student Development Coaches (SDCs) to provide students with meaningful and engaging activities in a safe, inclusive and supportive environment.
You will help create a welcoming environment where children can develop social skills, build friendships and enjoy creative and play-based activities.
Key responsibilities include:
· Supporting and leading engaging and age-appropriate Fritids activities
· Creating a safe, inclusive and positive environment for students
· Encouraging play, creativity, cooperation and social development
· Building positive relationships with students and colleagues
· Collaborating with the Fritids team to support students' individual needs
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for reliable, flexible and committed individuals who enjoy working with children.
You are:
· Qualified through relevant education in after-school care, childcare or a related educational field
· Caring, responsible and skilled at building positive relationships with children
· Creative, energetic and interested in play-based learning
· Flexible, proactive and comfortable working as part of an international team
Previous experience working with children in an educational or after-school care setting is beneficial, but not essential. Experience within the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly the PYP, is also a plus. We place great importance on personal suitability.
Since English is the working language of the school, you must be able to communicate professionally in English.
Employment Information
Position: Fritids Substitute
Employment type: Hourly substitute, as needed
Working hours: Variable, primarily afternoons
Application
We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the position, please contact:
Filipe Ferraz, Fritids Coordinator Filipe.Ferraz@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming new colleagues who share our commitment to creating a positive, inclusive and engaging environment for our students.

Geometry Assurance Engineer
For our office in Västerås or/and Malmö, we are looking for a mechanical engineer with experience in tolerance analysis and geometry assurance. We want you to be familiar with geometrical tolerances and the ISO GPS standard. Experience with the Model Based Definition (MBD) concept is highly valued. We use modern tools such as CETOL 6Sigma for variation analyses and tolerance optimizations directly in the 3D CAD environment. At ARIADNE Engineering AB you will work in a dynamic team of sharp engineers who are experts in the use of Model Based Definition, tolerance analysis, FE simulation, innovation and technical calculation. Together we work with technical presentations, consulting projects and training for customers. We work in close dialogue with customers and help them develop innovative solutions in areas such as geometry assurance, dimensional management, robust design and FE analysis. When you are ready to take on the role, you will also run your own projects, of course with the support of your experienced colleagues.
Who are we?
We are a group of nine people located in Västerås or/and Malmö. Our corporate culture is characterized by flexibility, change, short communication paths and exiting challenges in interesting technology areas. Of course, we work with modern software such as CAD/CAM/CAE/CAI in our projects, so you will always work with the best software on the market.
Every year, we also host our Annual MBE Conference, a key event where companies from all over Europe and the U.S. participate. The conference brings together industry experts, customers, partners, and thought leaders to discuss the latest developments in Model Based Enterprise. It includes technical presentations, workshops, networking sessions, and opportunities to learn directly from specialists in the field.
Who are you?
You likely have an M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a similar field, and an interest in analytical methods such as FEM, CFD, and tolerance analysis.
However, we value personal drive, curiosity, and initiative just as much as formal experience. If you enjoy learning new things, like solving complex problems, and thrive in environments where you can take responsibility early, you will fit in well with us.
Since we work with international customers, fluency in English is essential. Swedish language skills are a strong advantage.
 We will be extra happy if you:
- Have worked with geometry assurance/tolerance analysis.
- Is familiar and can use geometric tolerances ISO GPS
- Has experience in FEM analysis and problem-solving methodology
- Experience with innovation methodology TRIZ is meritorious.
- Are structured, responsible and likes to solve problems.
- Master English unhindered, both in speech and writing. Good if you speak Swedish
It's important that you like to learn new things and find it easy. You enjoy working closely with customers and have great social skills. Initiative, creativity and analytical skills are qualities we value. You will work with consulting projects, technical presentations as well as training.

Internationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen söker för närvarande en behörig lärare i svenska och svenska som andraspråk i årskurs 6-7. Din profil

Du är en kvalificerad lärare för de angivna ämnena och åldersgrupperna. Vi hoppas att du inser vikten av att bygga och upprätthålla goda relationer med kollegor, elever och föräldrar. Du är motiverad att ha regelbunden kontakt med föräldrar, leda mentorstimmar enligt mentorprogrammet och arbeta tillsammans i en stödjande miljö. Alla Internationella Engelska skolor runt om i landet delar samma vision för utbildning, kallad IES Ethos. Spiideo is a fast growing sports technology company headquartered in Malmö. We provide software services to the world of sports in the areas of performance analysis and automated video production of games and practice in stadiums, arenas and training facilities.
Our camera systems combine hardware, AI and cloud technology to automate sports video production and analysis. Over the last few years Spiideo has grown quickly and we are now shipping thousands of cameras all over the world!

A key piece of our product line is our portfolio of network-connected camera systems to do the video capture. We run an in-house Camera System Production & Distribution Unit in Malmö, where we assemble and ship the camera systems that power Spiideo's platform for customers all over the world. As a Camera Assembly Assistant, you'll play a key role in ensuring our camera systems are assembled, tested and shipped with the quality our customers expect.

jobs.occupation: We are looking for welders for our workshop in Kalix
jobs.description:
At Nova Industri, we are committed to shaping the green industry of the future. We are proud to contribute to the development of the region and to creating a brighter, greener future.
About Nova Industri
Nova Industri AB is now part of SMS group Nordic, with SMS group GmbH in Germany as our parent company. We are a leading service company specialising in industrial production and mechanical engineering, with operations in Boden and Kalix.
For more than 20 years, we have delivered high-quality solutions in turning, milling, welding and steel construction. Our customers are primarily industrial companies in Norrbotten, and our strong local presence is an important part of our success.
About the role
As a manual welder with us, you will be responsible for carrying out qualified welding work on various materials and in different dimensions. You will work daytime shifts, both in the workshop and out in the field.
This is an independent role, making it important that you can read and work from technical drawings, welding procedure specifications (WPS) and work instructions. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the work is carried out in accordance with applicable quality requirements.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Manual welding using the MMA (111), MAG (135, 136, 138) and TIG (141) processes.
Interpreting technical drawings, welding procedures and work instructions.
Performing welding work in various positions, such as PA, PB and PF.
Carrying out visual self-inspections of completed welds.
Contributing to a safe and clean working environment.

We believe that you have
A vocational upper-secondary education in welding or equivalent qualifications.
At least two years of documented experience in manual welding in an industrial environment.
As our working environment is international, it is an advantage if you understand and can communicate in English.
An understanding of and experience in applying occupational health and safety regulations, as well as experience working with personal protective equipment.

It is an advantage if you have
A valid welding certificate in accordance with SS-EN ISO 9606-1 for steel, or another relevant standard depending on the material.
Experience in stainless steel and aluminium welding.
Hot Work certification.
SSG Lift and Fall Protection training.
A valid driving licence and an overhead crane licence.

As a person, you are
Meticulous, with a strong focus on safety and quality.
Self-motivated, able to take initiative and solve problems that arise in your work.
Cooperative and flexible in your approach.

Submit your application today. Interviews will be conducted continuously.
We look forward to receiving your application in English. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact our HR Manager, Maria Taylor, at maria.taylor@sms-group.com.
We look forward to hearing from you.

P.S
We will participate on the European Job Days event the 6th of November Swedish Day – Cross-border Sweden / Norway | EURES - European Job Days We hope to meet you there!

Boreal Raptors – Understanding and Predicting the Dynamics of Mountain Raptor Communities under Climate Change
Why do some raptor species thrive while others decline as northern ecosystems become warmer? We are seeking a motivated PhD student to join the Boreal Raptor Project to investigate how climate, prey dynamics, landscape changes and interactions among species shape raptor communities in mountain and boreal forest ecosystems.
The project combines long-term monitoring data from northern Sweden and the Scandinavian mountains with new field observations and quantitative ecological modelling. We will examine variation in species occurrence, breeding phenology, reproductive success and distribution, and investigate how these patterns can be used to predict changes under future climate and land-use scenarios.
The research may include eagles, falcons, hawks and other raptors characteristic of northern ecosystems, as well as ecological interactions with species such as ravens.
Key questions include how weather, snow conditions and prey populations influence different raptor species, why species differ in their responses, and how forestry, infrastructure and other landscape changes interact with climate-driven processes. Specific research questions will be developed jointly with the PhD student.
About the position
Research tasks
The PhD student will analyse existing long-term datasets and newly collected information on species occurrence, breeding territories, reproductive success and environmental conditions.
The research will involve advanced statistical and spatial modelling, potentially including generalised linear mixed models, hierarchical models, occupancy and population models, time-series analysis and community ecology approaches. GIS and remote sensing will be used to quantify changes in climate, snow cover, vegetation and land use.
Fieldwork in mountain and boreal forest environments may include breeding territory surveys, reproductive monitoring and collection of complementary ecological data.
An important objective is to move beyond describing historical patterns towards developing models capable of predicting future ecological changes.
Requirements
Eligibility
Applicants must hold a second-cycle (Master's) degree, have completed at least 240 higher education credits, including 60 credits at second-cycle level, or have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge through other means in Sweden or abroad (Swedish Higher Education Ordinance, Chapter 7, Section 39).
English proficiency equivalent to English B/6 in the Swedish upper-secondary school system is required.
Your profile
We seek candidates with a Master's degree or equivalent in ecology, biology, wildlife ecology, conservation biology, zoology or a related discipline.
Applicants should have experience in quantitative ecological analysis and statistical modelling, proficiency in R or a comparable programming environment, and a strong interest in population and community ecology and ecological responses to environmental change.
The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team is essential.
Excellent spoken and written English is required, as the position involves scientific writing, presentations and collaboration in an international research environment.
Additional merits include experience in raptor or avian ecology, analysis of long-term ecological datasets, hierarchical or demographic modelling, spatial ecology, GIS, remote sensing and ecological fieldwork.
We particularly value scientific curiosity, analytical thinking and the ability to formulate independent ecological research questions rather than simply applying existing analytical methods.
About us
The Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Umeå conducts internationally recognised research in wildlife ecology, conservation biology, restoration ecology and quantitative ecology.
The PhD student will join an active international research environment with opportunities to collaborate with researchers, government agencies and organisations working on the monitoring and conservation of northern raptor populations.
We offer a fully funded four-year PhD position, training in advanced ecological modelling, opportunities for fieldwork and participation in scientific conferences and international research networks.
