jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Urban Water Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
The Urban Water Engineering research group at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural resources engineering at Luleå University of Technology seeks a driven and committed PhD student to investigate how smart monitoring and predictive modelling can support more effective and environmentally sustainable maintenance of urban drainage infrastructure. The research focuses on understanding sediment accumulation through sensor-based monitoring and data analysis, contributing to improved water quality and urban flood resilience. More information on http://www.ltu.se/water
Subject description
Urban Water Engineering encompasses the entire urban water system (storm drains, drinking water supply and wastewater) with respect to collection, transport and treatment, as well as organisation and planning. The research aims to encourage a strong economy, clean environment and the wise use of resources, while preserving the public’s health and safety.
Project description
Stormwater transports a wide range of pollutants from urban environments to receiving waters, posing major challenges for the protection of surface waters and coastal ecosystems. Urban drainage infrastructures, such as gully pots and stormwater ponds, play a critical role by retaining sediments and associated contaminants. However, their performance depends on effective operation and maintenance (O&M), which in practice is often reactive or based on fixed schedules, despite large spatial and temporal variability in sediment accumulation. This PhD project is part of a larger interdisciplinary research initiative aiming to enable a transition towards more data-driven and environmentally responsible maintenance of urban drainage infrastructures. The overall goal is to reduce pollutant loads to coastal and marine environments while supporting sustainable urban water management.
The PhD research will focus on developing a data-driven understanding of sediment accumulation processes in urban drainage infrastructures. This includes long-term monitoring using high-resolution sensors to capture sediment dynamics across rainfall events and seasons. Based on these data, predictive models will be developed to estimate sediment accumulation and infrastructure’s remaining functionality. The results will support more effective maintenance strategies by identifying when and where maintenances are needed to maximise environmental performance and operational efficiency.
Within this project, the doctoral student will be involved in collaboration with stakeholders in the water and wastewater industry and will communicate results both with the industry and international researchers through LTU's well-established competence network.
Duties
As a PhD student, you will perform both experimental and theoretical work. You will learn how to collect and analyse scientific data within your research area as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies, including both research and coursework. In addition, you will also carry out departmental duties, such as teaching and/or assisting in other research projects. You will have two or three supervisors who support you in your work. The research work for this project will specifically include experimental work.
Qualifications
We seek a candidate with an MSc degree or equivalent or fully completed course requirements of at least 240 ETCS of which at least 60 ETCS are at an advanced level or equivalent. The degree should be within the field of water and environment, environmental engineering, natural resources engineering, civil engineering, or equivalent. Specific knowledge of stormwater management, hydraulics/hydrology, statistics, machine learning, thermodynamics (e.g. heat transfer processes) and programming, as well as experience of sensor-based monitoring, are meritorious. Other important skills are the ability to work independently and take initiative, as well as being able to explore new research areas.
English language skills are required since the results will be presented internationally in scientific journals and at conferences. Swedish/Scandinavian language skills are beneficial, as they will facilitate communication with stakeholders and participation in teaching activities. Having a driver’s license is meritorious, as it will facilitate research work.
Applicants should provide contact details to minimum two reference persons upon request.

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added to that time with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: Spring 2027.

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable learning digital systems, investigating problems and finding practical solutions.

Strong English skills, both written and spoken.
Previous Customer Service experience, preferably within e-commerce or a digital environment.
Strong technical aptitude and confidence working across multiple digital systems.
Good problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a structured way of working.
Ability to maintain high service quality in a fast-paced environment.
Confidence in writing, editing and proofreading customer-facing content in Dutch.

Nice to Have
Experience with Zendesk, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Centra.

Experience with automation, AI-supported customer service tools or similar technologies.

Employment: Full-time (100%), fixed-term maternity cover, March 2027 – August 2028, with the possibility of extension.
Start date: March 2027
Location: Stockholm
We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

At IKEA, the product range is our identity. Every textile product we create should be safe, compliant, affordable and designed for the many people. 
As legislation, standards and customer expectations continue to evolve, we need people who are curious about what comes next and motivated by turning complexity into opportunities.
That's why we're looking for a Product Requirement Specialist within Textiles to join us on our journey. 
As a Product Requirement Specialist (PRS), you help IKEA understand and prepare for existing and future product coordinating stakeholders in relevant working groups and forums, e.g. PRIO groups. Be responsible to influence, relevant to the IKEA range, new and existing legislations, regulations, and standards, within assigned area(s) and when relevant, to maintain a network of stakeholders in external alliances, e.g. standardization, organizations and academia. 
You will work closely with colleagues across the value chain while building networks with external stakeholders, including standardization organizations and industry partners. Through these collaborations, you will contribute to influencing legislation, regulations, and standards relevant to the IKEA range. 
If you are energized by understanding what is happening beyond today's requirements and curious about how future developments may shape tomorrow's products, this could be the role for you. 
You are passionate about textiles and motivated by helping others understand complex topics. 
We believe you have: 

University degree in Textile Engineering or Textile Technology 

Knowledge of textile materials and relevant standards, regulations, or product requirements. 

Experience from product development, requirement management, compliance, or another relevant part of the value chain. 

Strong analytical skills and the ability to assess and interpret complex topics. 

The ability to communicate complex issues in a clear and engaging way. 

Experience collaborating with many stakeholders and building strong networks. 

Fluency in English, both written and spoken. 

Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and driven by continuous learning. You want to use your expertise to make a difference and contribute to a better everyday life for the many people. 

Additional Information

At IKEA, you'll have the opportunity to combine deep specialist knowledge with collaboration, learning, and influence. You'll join a global environment where your expertise helps us understand change, prepare for the future, and continuously improve the way we develop our products. 
If you're passionate about textiles, fascinated by how requirements shape products, and excited by the opportunity to influence what comes next, we'd love to hear from you.

• What made you interested in this role and enticed you to apply?

jobs.occupation: Teacher Librarian, Bladins International School of Malmö
jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic Teacher Librarian to join our Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) in January 2027.
If you are passionate about inspiring a love of reading, developing information literacy and supporting learning in an international school, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
BISM is an IB Continuum School in central Malmö, offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 360 students from diverse nationalities and cultures.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation, we provide a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students grow into knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As Teacher Librarian, you will promote reading, inquiry-based learning and students' research, information literacy and critical thinking skills across PYP and MYP.
BISM has two dedicated libraries, one for PYP and one for MYP. You will develop these as welcoming and inclusive learning spaces and work closely with teachers to support learning across the curriculum.
Key responsibilities include:

Developing and managing both school libraries and their print and digital collections

Promoting reading for pleasure through library lessons, initiatives and events

Teaching information literacy, research skills, digital literacy and critical thinking

Collaborating with teachers to support PYP units of inquiry and MYP subjects, with awareness of the curriculum across MYP

Supporting students' Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills, including ethical use of information, referencing and academic integrity

Ensuring resources reflect the school's international, multilingual community and diverse learning needs

Building positive relationships with students, colleagues and families and engaging with the wider BISM community

Contributing to school development and a welcoming library environment

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a qualified, proactive Teacher Librarian with a passion for literacy and student learning.
You are:

Qualified in library and information science, preferably with school library experience

Experienced in supporting children's and young people's reading, research and information literacy

Knowledgeable about children's and young adult literature and able to inspire readers of different ages

Skilled in inquiry-based learning and collaboration with classroom and subject teachers

Confident using digital library systems, educational technology and online resources

Inclusive, organised and able to manage library activities independently

A positive communicator and collaborative member of an international team

Committed to professional development

Experience with the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly PYP and/or MYP, is an advantage. Understanding the IB philosophy, Learner Profile and Approaches to Learning (ATL) is highly valued.
As English is the school's working language, professional spoken and written English is required.
Why Join BISM?
At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community committed to students, colleagues and learning. We offer supportive colleagues, professional development, an IB learning environment and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' development.
Employment Information
Position: Teacher Librarian  Employment type: Permanent employment, with a six-month probationary period  Working hours: Part-time (60%)  Start date: January 2027
Application
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Please apply by 30 November 2026.
For more information, contact:
Kumari Nevill, Primary School Principal Kumari.nevill@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming a colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

Reports to: Middle School Principal
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Duties and Responsibilities: 
Teaching MYP 1 - Grade 6 to MYP 4 - Grade 9, and Primary Grades 4-5 French language acquisition.
Developing materials appropriate for classes with a wide range of abilities.
Contributing to the development and implementation of the curriculum.
Creating and implementing lessons for differentiated skill levels in a classroom.  
Communicating regularly with parents. 
Being an active and contributing member of the school’s faculty. 
Participating in the full range of professional activities in the school. 
Actively contributing to the operational needs of the school. 

Qualifications and Experience:
French language teaching qualification.
At least two years of experience as a teacher. 
Preferred experience with IB programmes, MYP or PYP.
Excellent communication skills in English, at a native speaker level.
The ability to establish rapport with adults and students. 
The ability to work effectively in a team.
The ability to function effectively under pressure. 
The ability to show initiative and work independently. 
A pleasant and friendly personality.

Experience working with students from diverse cultures and countries would be an advantage. In addition, there may be a possibility to increase the employment percentage if a candidate can teach other subjects and take on other responsibilities. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.
What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our locations in central Stockholm are easily accessible by public transportation.

Part-time, 80 %.
Start: January 7th, 2027
End: February 27th, 2027
Salary: Salary scale

Applications will no longer be accepted after November 20th.
SIS reserves the right to close the application process when a suitable candidate is found.

jobs.occupation: Solution Architect  MES Production Information Labeling
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of software architecture, problem-solving and hands-on collaboration? Join us in shaping digital solutions that support manufacturing on the workshop floor, while taking the architectural lead in building smart and future-ready systems. 
 
About your job 
As Solution Architect for MES Production Information & Labeling, you define and evolve the architecture that brings together the information needed to run manufacturing equipment. Working at both an architectural and technical level, you help transform future needs into scalable, user-friendly solutions. 
 
Job responsibilities 
Design and evolve end-to-end system architectures. 
Define integration strategies, technical standards and architecture across the software stack. 
Participate in the MES architecture forum and establish shared development principles with fellow architects. 
Shape modern solutions using C#, Angular, OAuth 2.0, Kubernetes, pipelines and DevOps practices. 
Guide development teams through design reviews, code reviews and technical coaching. 
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate future needs into sustainable solutions. 

 
Location 
This position is based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden and offers a hybrid work setup, with the possibility to work remotely a couple of days per week. You also spend time close to the workshop environment, where many key interactions take place, and occasional travel may occur. 
 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced software architect with a strong background in software development. Combining architectural thinking with hands-on technical expertise, you build clean, flexible and scalable solutions while supporting development teams in moving from ideas to implementation. 
 
Your background includes 
Solid experience in software architecture and modern distributed systems. 
Strong full-stack development skills and experience guiding development teams. 
Knowledge of DevOps and technologies such as C#, Angular, OAuth 2.0, Kubernetes and pipelines. 
A relevant technical degree. 
Strong communication skills in English. 

 
Curious and collaborative, you combine structure with creativity and enjoy solving complex technical challenges. You communicate clearly, take the lead when needed and help teams move in the same direction. 
 
Our culture 
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.   
 
Contact information 
Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Mattias Stensson, hiring manager, at mattias.stensson@sandvik.com 
 
We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter.

Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-222 48 55

Send your application no later than November 27th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0090101.

jobs.occupation: Finance Manager for growing manufacturing company - south of Malmö
jobs.description:
With more than 30 years of experience in the industry, we are one of the most established recruitment and staffing agencies in southern Sweden. As a trusted specialist, we have extensive knowledge of the regional job market and business community. We combine our experience with a personal and dedicated approach, enabling us to compete successfully with the largest players in the market. We recruit managers and specialists at all levels within Engineering, Logistics, Sales, Finance, and Office Administration. Our operations cover the Skåne region and the Greater Copenhagen area, and our office is centrally located at Gustav Adolfs Torg in Malmö.
 
Finance Manager for a growing manufacturing company - south of Malmö
Are you a skilled finance executive? Would you like to take on a key role in a small and rapidly expanding manufacturing company? Do you also have an eye for details and do you like the idea of products being manufactured in Sweden and sold worldwide? Then this could be your next opportunity!
Our client is an independent Swedish business unit (turn-over 150 MSEK) operating in an international business structure who develops and manufactures at their Swedish site in the Trelleborg area. The company is currently in an exciting development phase and is now looking for a Finance Manager who can take on responsibility for the finance function in Sweden.
This is a broad and hands-on finance management role: you will run the month-end close and personally prepare project costing, over-time revenue recognition, inventory valuation, reconciliations and the Group reporting package, supervising one Finance Assistant. The role works day-to-day with the MD and Project Managers to keep project costs and margins accurate. You will play a key role in supporting the business with financial insight, investment analysis, and decision-making support that drives performance and long-term development.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Project Accounting and Costing
Financial Reporting and Control
Budgeting, Forecasting and Analysis
Cash and Treasury Management (supervising, reviewing)
Support improvement of financial systems and processes
Ensure compliance with tax regulations and applicable financial standards

Your Profile:
You have a relevant degree in e.g. business administration, finance, or accounting and several years of experience in the field. You also have proven experience in a leadership role. You have strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken. Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (preferably Microsoft Dynamics BC) is essential.
You have a good understanding of US GAAP and Swedish statutory requirements. Experience from manufacturing or project-based industry is an advantage, as well as experience in a multinational group environment with cross-border reporting responsibilities.
As a person, you are a self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet demanding deadlines. You thrive in a dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with practical implementation. You have a high level of integrity and are a good communicator with excellent leadership skills.
 
About the Position:
This is a permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based south of Malmö.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application in English as soon as possible via the application link. For more information about the role, please contact Karin Dahlin, Standby Workteam, +46 733 76 39 88.

We look forward to your application!

Company Description
IKEA is one of the world's leading home furnishing companies. Our vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible will be able to afford them. The role of IKEA Supply to buy, produce and distribute the IKEA range at the lowest total cost whilst ensuring that the products and services are safe and compliant to the customer under good social and environmental conditions.  
Are you passionate about inspiring a culture where quality is part of everything we do? We are now looking to recruit a Test Specialist, join our Quality Compliance team, based in Älmhult, Sweden. 
Job Description

In this role you are responsible to develop, maintain and ensure the quality and capacity of the external test labs approved by IKEA.
Key Responsibilities 
Responsible for communicating with external test labs about new method approval, updated specifications and IKEA approved lab steering documents
Plan, lead and follow up Lab steering group forum
Being the point of contact for our labs and suppliers when it comes to test information and capacity 
Hand in information from Product Requirements Specialist when new test methods are added or updated in our specifications and present different information in LSG  
Maintenance, update and add information in TRS (Test report system)
Contribute to knowledge sharing with the business team regarding verification testing 
Contribute to the strategy for our external test labs 

Qualifications
About you 
To be successful in this role, you will have: 
Very good knowledge of verification principles and test methods
Good knowledge about Develop Product Requirement process
Knowledge of IKEA values, concepts, directions, strategies and processes
Strong will to secure the prerequisites for safe and compliant products
Solution oriented with the business and customer in focus
Communicate with different target groups internally and externally
Ability to work in a structured way  
An analytical and objective mindset 
Ability to build network and establish trustful relationships, internally and externally 
Ability to communicate and build relationships in a good way 
Ability to work individually, as part of a team and sharing knowledge.  
Goal oriented and ability to prioritize from a business perspective 

Fluent in the English language both spoken and written.

We’re excited to learn more about you! Please send us your application (CV + motivation letter) in English as soon as possible, and no later than 20th November 2026. We truly want to get to know you—so tell us: Why do you believe you’re the right fit for this role, what gives you energy and drives your passion, what kind of environment helps you thrive, what are you eager to learn and develop next.

Here, you’ll work alongside passionate people from all over the world. Älmhult offers excellent commuting options, with hourly trains to Malmö, Lund, and Växjö, and an IKEA shuttle bus running to and from Helsingborg twice daily.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
We are now seeking a dedicated Student Care Coordinator (SCC) to help develop our work regarding student safety, a calm learning environment, attendance, and student well-being at IES Upplands Väsby. The position is a full time substitute during a maternity leave. 

Responsibilities:

- Work with the school’s anti-bullying policy.
- Safety and a calm learning environment: Maintain a visible presence within the school and engage in proactive work regarding conflict prevention, the prevention of abusive treatment, and student safety. 
- Student Support: Supporting students facing social, psychosocial, or behavioral challenges through conversations, relationship-building, and individual support interventions.
- School Attendance: Monitoring and analyzing student attendance, identifying concerning absence patterns early, and collaborating with students, guardians, mentors, and the student health team to promote better attendance.
- Active Presence at School: Contributing to a positive school environment by being present during breaks and in common areas.
- Collaboration and Communication: Maintaining a dialogue with guardians and working closely with school staff.

We are looking for someone who is empathetic, organized, and solution-oriented, with a genuine commitment to the safety and development of children and young people. You are skilled at building relationships, handling challenging situations professionally, and able to combine a warm, welcoming approach with clear expectations.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Trygghets- och elevstödsamordnare 

Vi söker nu en engagerad Trygghets- och elevstödsamordnare (engelska: Student Care Coordinator (SCC) som ska vara med och utveckla vårt arbete kring elevtrygghet, en lugn lärmiljö, närvaro och elevers välmående på IES Upplands Väsby. Jobbet är ett vikariat under mammaledighet. 

Ansvarsområden:

- Arbete med skolans plan mot kränkande behandling.
- Trygghet och en lugn lärmiljö: Att vara synlig i skolan och arbeta proaktivt med att förebygga konflikter och kränkningar samt främja elevtryggheten.
- Elevstöd: Att stötta elever som möter sociala, psykosociala eller beteendemässiga utmaningar genom samtal, relationsbyggande och individuella stödinsatser.
- Skolnärvaro: Att följa upp och analysera elevers närvaro, tidigt identifiera oroväckande frånvaromönster samt samarbeta med elever, vårdnadshavare, mentorer och elevhälsoteamet för att främja god närvaro.
- Aktiv närvaro i skolan: Att bidra till en positiv skolmiljö genom att vara närvarande under raster och i gemensamma utrymmen.
- Samarbete och kommunikation: Att ha en dialog med vårdnadshavare och samarbete med skolans personal. 

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, organiserad och lösningsorienterad, med ett genuint engagemang för barns och ungas trygghet och utveckling. Du är skicklig på att bygga relationer, hantera utmanande situationer på ett professionellt sätt och att kombinera ett varmt bemötande med tydliga förväntningar.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.description:
Studie- och yrkesvägledare 50%

Välkommen till vår skola! Internationella Engelska Skolan i Upplands Väsby öppnade dörrarna för våra elever år 2020. Vi är en F-9 skola med ca 600 elever samt ca 65 anställda.  Vi söker nu en utvecklingsinriktad studie- och yrkesvägledare som vill bidra till att våra elevers drömmar och hopp om framtiden blir verklighet. 

Ditt uppdrag som studie- och yrkesvägledare, är att i samarbete med elevhälsoteamet och övrig skolpersonal arbeta hälsofrämjande, förebyggande och åtgärdande med det pedagogiska uppdraget i fokus för att alla elever ska ges förutsättningar att nå utbildningens mål i en miljö som främjar elevernas välmående och lärande. Studie- och yrkesvägledaren har ett särskilt ansvar för att vidga elevernas perspektiv i syfte att eleverna ska kunna fatta väl underbyggda studie- och yrkesval. 

Arbetet innebär bland annat att delta aktivt i elevhälsoteamet och i det kollegiala lärandet. Du håller motiverande och vägledande individuella elevsamtal liksom vägledning i klass eller grupp. Det ingår också att ge information till vårdnadshavare i enskilda samtal eller på föräldramöten. Uppdraget omfattar årskurserna F-9 där arbetet med att leda, systematisera och följa upp prao i årskurs 8 samt gymnasieval i årskurs 9, periodvis är i fokus.

Du omvärldsbevakar och har ett stort intresse i att hålla dig uppdaterad om olika studievägar, utbildningar och rådande läge på arbetsmarknaden. Du är systematisk och utvärderar kontinuerligt kvaliteten i den vägledning som eleverna erbjuds och är väl förtrogen med skolsystemet. Du initierar och samverkar med samverkanspartners inom exempelvis näringslivet.

Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som studie- och yrkesvägledare inom grundskola. Du har examen för studie- och yrkesvägledare eller en pågående utbildning. 

Som person är du tydlig, trygg och pedagogisk. Du skapar förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du har förmågan att planera och organisera ditt arbete på ett strukturerat och effektfullt sätt. Du sätter självständigt och i samarbete med andra upp mål, organiserar resurser, följer upp och avslutar aktiviteter. 

Du formulerar dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska samt har hög digital kompetens. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i denna rekrytering då det är viktigt för oss att du passar in i vårt team. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. 

Start: Från den 1 december eller enligt överenskommelse. Du kommer att ha en relativt stor möjlighet att påverka ditt veckoschema tillsammans med oss för att eventuellt matcha ett annat uppdrag.

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar
- Har erfarenhet av eller intresse för att arbeta med elever med NPF eller andra behov av stöd
- Är lugn, ansvarstagande och lösningsfokuserad
- Har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med elever
- Är flexibel och kan anpassa ditt stöd utifrån situation och behov
- Tycker om att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika yrkesgrupper

- Erfarenhet av lågaffektivt bemötande eller arbete med extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är trygg, lyhörd och har ett genuint engagemang för att stötta barn i deras utveckling. Du är en stabil vuxen som kan skapa förtroende och bidra till ett lugnt och positivt klimat omkring eleven.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: Methane removal from ventilation air at Henriksdal
jobs.description:
Methane is a strong greenhouse gas which is 28 times more potent than carbon dioxide. Methane is formed by microorganisms as a result of anaerobic transformation of organic matter. In wastewater handling, anaerobic conditions prevail in wastewater network, during the first wastewater treatment steps and in sludge handling processes at wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs). In order to limit methane emissions, an intensive work is being done to find biogas leaks and to destruct the methane in ventilation air. However, some ventilation streams have methane content significantly lower than 2 000 ppm, which is the lower limit for destruction using existing matured technologies. Direct methane emissions at Henriksdal WWTP stand for around 40% of all the climate impact of wastewater treatment and can be lowered if a suitable method for methane destruction be found and implemented.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
In the proposed project several alternatives of methane destruction will be tested experimentally. Biological trickling filters can be used for aerobic degradation of methane and it was demonstrated that the conversion rate can be significantly increased by applying a mixture of water and silicon oil as the liquid medium compared with using only water (Lebrero et al. 2015). It is planned to operate two trickling filters within the project, one with water and one with two-liquid medium, and treat real ventilation air from methane at Henriksdal WWTP. Methane and hydrogen sulphide reduction will be monitored. Moreover, chemical analysis of the liquid medium for nitrogen and phosphorus species will be performed regularly.

Another opportunity which will be explored is using the polluted air for aeration in the biological treatment step of the wastewater treatment process. This possibility will be explored in lab or pilot scale.

Two other possibilities, which will most probably be investigated only theoretically, is concentration by gas membranes and destruction in a membrane aerated biological reactor.

This Thesis project is experimentally oriented and big part of the work will include running experiments and performing chemical analyses. The Master Thesis project is to be performed during the spring term 2027 (30 hp).

KVALIFIKATIONER
To be eligible for this thesis project, you should be enrolled in a program within chemistry, environmental engineering, water engineering, or another relevant field of study.

Most of the work will be performed at Henriksdals reningsverk (Värmdövägen 23, Stockholm). Daily attendance is required.

Industrial supervisor: Andriy Malovanyy, andriy.malovanyy@svoa.se (SVOA).

Practical help: Gabriel Persson (SVOA).

This specific project is intended solely for students planning to conduct their thesis during the spring term 2027.  However, if you are interested in doing a thesis project with us during the autumn semester of 2027, there may be opportunities closer to that time.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

The applicants are invited to send a short motivation letter (do not use AI !), a CV, and a transcript of records from education on university level with name of the courses and grades for those. The application can be done in English or Swedish. The Thesis can be written in either English or Swedish. The last day to apply is 15th of Dec 2025. Candidate selection is done continuously and will most probably be finalized in November. In line with SVOA policy, a successfully completed Master's project is rewarded with a compensation of 1 000 SEK (pre-tax) for every hp of the project (30 000 kr for a 30 hp project).

8+ years of experience as a frontend developer, with strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks (React, Angular or Vue)

Experience taking product ownership for what you build, shaping requirements, prioritizing work and driving technical decisions

Experience with API design and backwards compatibility

Experience leading technical customer conversations and product discussions in English

Strong written communication: specs, product documentation and clear requirements

 Meritorious Experience from an SDK or component library company is a plus. A big bonus is comfort and ambition around modern AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex, it's something we genuinely care about.
Fluent English is a requirement, Swedish is a plus. 
 Who you are To thrive in this role, you're genuinely tech-curious, someone who loves having many touchpoints and brings real ambition to everything you take on. You will make decisions that affect thousands of production systems. You listen, read the room and know how to handle demanding customers in a way that builds relationships. You're comfortable with high ownership and like keeping things organized. You enjoy working independently and act proactively even in uncertain situations. 
What we offer

6 weeks of vacation

ITP pension and insurance

Wellness allowance

Freedom with responsibility. You own your day as long as the work gets done

Hybrid model with a Stockholm hub at Epicenter

One joint team trip per year where the whole organization comes together

 Apply Does this sound like a role for you? We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't hesitate to reach out today. For questions, contact Johanna Ottosson at johanna.ottosson@ants.se.

jobs.description:
Lärare i matematik 7-9 IES Österåker öppnade i augusti 2024 och är en modern F–9-skola med höga ambitioner.När skolan är fullt utbyggd kommer den att ha cirka 600 elever, fördelade på två klasser per årskurs.

Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och har möjlighet att bedriva upp till 50 procent av undervisningen på engelska. Vår verksamhet bygger på tydliga rutiner, höga förväntningar och en trygg lärmiljö där både elever och medarbetare ges möjlighet att utvecklas och lyckas.

Skolan ligger centralt i Åkersberga, cirka 30 minuter från Stockholm. Vårt campus består av både nybyggda och renoverade lokaler och har nära tillgång till idrottsanläggningar, natur och Stockholms skärgård.

Vi söker nu en erfaren och behörig matematiklärare för årskurs 7–9 som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Om tjänsten

Som lärare ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra, bedöma och följa upp elevernas lärande i matematik. Du hjälper eleverna att utveckla tilltro till sin egen förmåga, stärka sina problemlösningsstrategier och nå goda kunskapsresultat.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att möta elever med olika behov och förutsättningar. Du behöver kunna ge stöd till elever som har utmaningar i matematik, samtidigt som du erbjuder fördjupning och ytterligare utmaningar till elever som behöver utvecklas vidare.

Det finns även möjlighet att undervisa i IGCSE Mathematics i årskurs 9 för den som är intresserad och har relevant erfarenhet eller kompetens.

I tjänsten ingår mentorskap för en grupp elever samt ett nära samarbete med vårdnadshavare, kollegor, elevhälsoteamet och skolledningen för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för elevernas utveckling och lärande.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har en giltig lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i matematik för årskurs 7–9.
- Behärskar både svenska och engelska obehindrat.
- Kan undervisa i matematik på både svenska och engelska med god säkerhet.
- Har flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av framgångsrik undervisning.
- Har god förmåga att hjälpa elever som har svårt med matematik att utvecklas och nå sina mål.
- Har erfarenhet av att stödja och utmana elever med hög måluppfyllelse och goda ämneskunskaper.
- Har erfarenhet av eller kunskap om IGCSE Mathematics. Detta är meriterande men inget krav.
- Skapar en lugn, strukturerad och positiv lärmiljö.
- Har höga förväntningar på alla elever och tror på varje elevs förmåga att utvecklas.
- Samarbetar väl med kollegor och trivs med att arbeta i team.
- Ger tydlig och utvecklande återkoppling som hjälper eleverna att komma vidare i sitt lärande.

Vi erbjuder:

- En skola med tydliga rutiner och ett närvarande och engagerat ledarskap.
- Stöttande och engagerade kollegor.
- En internationell arbetsmiljö.
- Möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp och utveckla en växande skola.
- En verksamhetskultur med fokus på lärande, respekt och goda kunskapsresultat.

Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är på 100 procent. Sex månaders provanställning tillämpas.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret ska uppvisas före anställning.

jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens första steg i lärandet?

Vi söker en legitimerad lärare F–3 med behörighet att undervisa i förskoleklass – en nyckelroll i elevernas livslånga läranderesa. I ljuset av den kommande läroplanen 2028 utvecklar vi undervisning som sätter elevens nyfikenhet, språk- och matematikutveckling samt utforskande arbetssätt i centrum.

Internationella Engelska Skolan har i över 30 år haft en positiv inverkan på sina elevers utveckling. Vi är övertygade om att detta framgångsrika resultat kommer från vårt starka etos, där engagerade och närvarande ledare skapar en miljö där alla strävar mot gemensamma mål. Hos oss får lärarna fokus på det viktigaste – undervisning och lärande. Eleverna är alltid i centrum, och alla elever är dina elever. Vi tror på värderingar som grund för framgång, och samarbete är en självklar del av vårt sätt att arbeta.

Som lärare i förskoleklass planerar, genomför och utvärderar du undervisningen i nära samarbete med kollegor och i linje med skolans styrdokument. Du arbetar med Skolverkets kartläggningsmaterial Hitta språket och Hitta matematiken som en del av ett systematiskt och framåtsyftande kvalitetsarbete.

Hos oss skapar du inspirerande lärmiljöer där lek, kreativitet och praktiskt lärande är centrala verktyg – i linje med läroplanens ökade fokus på elevaktivt lärande och helhetsförståelse. Du följer elevernas utveckling genom att dokumentera, analysera och anpassa undervisningen för att ge varje elev bästa möjliga förutsättningar att lyckas.

På IES Kungsbacka bygger vi en skola där varje elev ges möjlighet att nå sin fulla potential – kunskapsmässigt, socialt och personligt. Vi värdesätter mångfald och ser elevernas olika erfarenheter, språk och perspektiv som en tillgång i undervisningen.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat lärarlag där det finns avsatt tid för kollegialt lärande, pedagogisk utveckling och att tillsammans utforska framtidens undervisning. I förskoleklassen samarbetar svensk- och engelsktalande lärare, vilket skapar en dynamisk och internationell lärmiljö.

 Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med behörighet för förskoleklass och som vill vara med och utveckla undervisning i takt med framtidens krav och möjligheter.

Du har en positiv människosyn och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du motiverar och engagerar elever genom tydlig kommunikation och ett inkluderande arbetssätt, och du ser styrkan i att undervisa i en flerspråkig och mångkulturell miljö.

Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska och använder digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av undervisningen – i linje med läroplanens fokus på digital kompetens och framtidsfärdigheter.

Vi söker en lagspelare som drivs av skolutveckling och som vill bidra till en undervisning där elever inte bara lär – utan växer, utforskar och utvecklar förmågor de bär med sig in i framtiden. 

Är du redo att göra skillnad – redan från första skoldagen?

På Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) gör vi skillnad för våra elever. Vår skola är en gemenskap av yrkesmänniskor, och oavsett om du är ny i yrket eller en erfaren pedagog kommer du att få möjlighet att utvecklas hos oss.

Vi söker nu en legitimerad lärare i spanska för årskurs 9.Om tjänsten

Som lärare i spanska vid IES Kista kommer du att:

- Undervisning i spanska för elever i årskurs 9 i enlighet med den svenska läroplanen (Lgr22).
- Vara kunnig och passionerad kring ditt ämne.
- Vara en ledare i klassrummet med verktyg att skapa en lugn studiemiljö.
- Planera, genomföra och bedöma engagerande och välstrukturerade lektioner.
- Anpassa och differentiera din undervisning för att möta elevernas olika behov och nivåer.
- Samarbeta med kollegor inom institutionen för moderna språk och i andra arbetslag.
- Bidra till skolans positiva och internationella atmosfär.

Information om tjänstens omfattning: Tjänsten är på  1,5 timme i veckan och innebär undervisning för en grupp i årskurs 9 på fredagar.Kvalifikationer

- Lärarexamen och legitimation i spanska för årskurs 6–9 (svensk lärarlegitimation).
- Stark kommunikationsförmåga på både engelska och svenska.
- Erfarenhet av undervisning i en internationell eller tvåspråkig miljö är meriterande.
- Ett strukturerat, engagerat och professionellt förhållningssätt till undervisning och lagarbete.Ansökan

För att ansöka, skicka in ditt CV, personligt brev och ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret för arbete inom skolan. Rekrytering sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdagen, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Lärare i fritidshem till Internationella Engelska Skolan i Kungsbacka 

 Vill du arbeta i en skola där studiero, tydligt ledarskap och höga förväntningar gör verklig skillnad - varje dag?  

Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vår tydliga etos med engagerad personal som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever. 

På Internationella Engelska Skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.    

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker nu en engagerad lärare i fritidshem som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vår verksamhet i en internationell och tvåspråkig miljö. I ditt uppdrag arbetar du aktivt för att stimulera elevernas lärande och utveckling, med utgångspunkt i deras behov, intressen och erfarenheter. Samtidigt utmanar du dem att nå nya höjder genom att inspirera till ny kunskap och nya perspektiv.

Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar fritidsverksamheten tillsammans med dina kollegor, med fokus på kvalitet, tydlighet och kontinuerlig utveckling. Genom varierade arbetssätt, kreativa lärmiljöer och en tydlig struktur skapar du en meningsfull fritid där eleverna utvecklas både socialt och kunskapsmässigt.

Du har en viktig roll i att bygga en stark gemenskap där elever känner sig trygga, sedda och motiverade att lyckas. Möjlighet till en förstelärartjänst inom fritidshem finns.Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med inriktning mot fritidshem och som drivs av att skapa en trygg, strukturerad och inspirerande lärmiljö.

Du är väl insatt i läroplanen och arbetar målmedvetet för att utveckla kvaliteten i verksamheten. Med din energi och kreativitet inspirerar du både elever och kollegor, och du trivs i en kultur där samarbete och professionalism är centralt.

Du använder digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av din undervisning och dokumentation. Eftersom vi är en internationell skola är det viktigt att du behärskar både svenska och engelska väl, i tal och skrift.

Som person är du en tydlig ledare som skapar struktur och arbetsro. Du bygger starka relationer och har förmågan att motivera elever att utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar -  alltid med höga förväntningar och ett positivt förhållningssätt.Varför välja oss?

Hos oss blir du en del av en professionell och internationell arbetsmiljö där:

- Tydliga strukturer skapar studiero
- Engagerade kollegor samarbetar och stöttar varandra
- Höga förväntningar leder till goda resultat
- Du får möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten

Vill du vara med och göra skillnad i en skola där ambition, trygghet och kvalitet går hand i hand?

jobs.occupation: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology develops autonomous robots for field use and has tested them in mines and other underground environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop autonomy for teams of legged, wheeled and aerial robots in places with extended risk, such as underground mines and areas prone to rockfall. The work covers scene understanding with foundation models, navigation, and coordinated decisions within the robot team when communication is limited. 
 
Subject description
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
  
Project description
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics.
 
Autonomous robots deployment in underground mines, areas prone to rockfall and other environments that are dangerous for people often need several robots working together. Communication between the robots is often intermittent, and each robot must interpret its surroundings well enough to judge risk on its own. Vision and language foundation models can support this kind of interpretation, but they rarely model the physics of the terrain or the dynamics of the robot. This position will develop methods that connect scene understanding, physics-informed navigation and coordination within the robot team, and validate them in real environments.
  
The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.
 
- Scene and context understanding with foundation models, for example vision-language models, in underground mines and areas prone to rockfall, including hazard identification and risk-aware traversability assessment
 
- Physics-informed foundation models for autonomous navigation, where learned models account for the robot's dynamics and the physical properties of the terrain
 
- Multi-robot collaboration over mesh networks, with shared mapping and coordinated decision making under intermittent communication
 
- Communication-aware planning of multi-robot missions that use 5G/6G infrastructure, where the robots plan their motion and tasks based on network coverage and capacity
 
- Experimental validation on legged, wheeled and aerial robots in underground and mining environments
 
Duties
The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real robots and field experiments in mines and other underground environments. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.
 
Qualifications
To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.
 
You need a good knowledge of at least one of the following: robot perception, learning-based methods for robotics, multi-robot systems, or motion and mission planning. Previous work with experimentally verified results on real robots, in at least one of the research areas above, is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python, and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.
 
Experience of foundation models or vision-language models in robotics, of legged robots, of communication and mesh networking for robots, of wireless communication systems such as 5G or 6G, or of field experiments in underground environments is a merit.
 
Further information
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.
 
For further information about the position, please contact
 
Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, +46 920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se 
 
Postdoctoral Researcher, Akash Patel, mailto:akash.patel@ltu.se
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities and market conditions of the role.

Also include a research plan of at most two pages that describes how you would approach one or more of the research areas above, and the names and contact details of two references. jobs.occupation: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology works in field robotics and tests its methods on robots in real environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop sensing and autonomy for drones that inspect infrastructure and terrain in Arctic environments such as Greenland, where the flights take place in severe cold. You will work on sensor systems that withstand the arctic cold and, on the localisation, mapping and mission planning methods that depend on them. We value good collaboration skills and an interest in field work in cold climates.
Subject description
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
Project description
The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics as well as http://www.fieldrobotics.eu
Drones make it possible to inspect infrastructure and terrain in the Arctic without sending people into dangerous conditions, but the cold affects the hardware the drones depend on. Batteries lose capacity, ice forms on lenses and propellers, and lidar and cameras return degraded data in blowing snow, fog and low sun. At high magnetic latitudes, magnetometers become unreliable for heading, and GNSS reception can be limited in fjords and steep terrain. This position will develop sensing and autonomy that work under these conditions, with drone inspection in environments such as Greenland as the main application.
The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.
Design, characterisation and calibration of cold-hardened sensor payloads for drones, for example lidar, radar, thermal cameras, event cameras and inertial sensors
Multi-sensor state estimation and mapping that accounts for degraded sensor data, for example in snow, fog, low-texture scenes and with unreliable GNSS or magnetometer data
Sensor health monitoring and fault detection, so that the autonomy systems can detect when a sensor can no longer be trusted and adapt to it
Energy- and weather-aware mission planning for inspection flights that accounts for battery behaviour in the cold and for wind
Autonomous inspection of infrastructure and terrain in Arctic settings, with field experiments in cold climates, for example in Greenland and northern Sweden

Duties
The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real drones and field experiments in cold climates that involve travel. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.
Qualifications
To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.
You need a good knowledge of state estimation, sensor fusion or robot perception, and documented experience of experimental work with drones. Previous work with experimentally verified results in at least one of the research areas above is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.
Experience of sensor integration and drone hardware, of perception with lidar, radar or thermal cameras, of field experiments in cold or harsh environments, or of autonomous inspection missions is a merit.
Further information
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.
For further information about the position, please contact
Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, +46 920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se
Postdoctoral Researcher, Akash Patel, mailto:akash.patel@ltu.se
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities and market conditions of the role.

Application

A concurrency bug that only appears under real load. A service that must stay available when a

Join 2MNordic for a long-term client assignment in a small, autonomous engineering team. 
Own services from design through production, influence the technical approach and build frameworks used across teams and by the developer community.
Why this role is worth your attention
• Ownership from design to production. Take a goal, work out the approach and see your service through delivery.

• Decisions with consequences. Design for availability, security and distributed failure modes, with privacy central to the system.

What you will build and improve
• Customer-facing web services that handle authentication, authorisation, spam control and demanding availability requirements.

• Distributed services designed around consistency, partitioning and failure recovery.
• Shared frameworks and reliable releases supported by automated testing and CI/CD.

You will work across teams, manage dependencies and make technical decisions others can follow.
Priorities evolve as capabilities, security considerations and partner needs change. You should be comfortable adapting the plan, challenging assumptions and protecting quality as you do.

You have built and scaled services for real users, debugged production failures and learned from the results. Typically, that means five or more years of experience; the depth of your work matters more than the number.
• Deep Java knowledge: the memory model, garbage collection behaviour and tuning, allocation pressure and java.util.concurrent beyond synchronised blocks. You can explain when to use virtual threads versus classic reactive models.
• Production debugging: experience investigating problems that only appear under real load or concurrency, and reading dependency source code when documentation is no longer enough.
• Service engineering: authentication, authorisation, availability, abuse prevention, reliability and performance tuning under load.
• Distributed systems and data: sound reasoning about consistency, partitioning and failure modes, plus strong knowledge of Cassandra, Redis, memcached or comparable technologies.
• Reliable delivery: REST services with Netty or similar frameworks, automated testing and CI/CD tooling.
• Clear communication in English: explain technical decisions to engineers and non-engineers, write useful design documents and work through trade-offs across teams.
Experience that adds value
Cryptography knowledge is particularly valuable: PKCS, KMIP, X.509, AES, key derivation functions and certificate authorities. Key handling and privacy guarantees are central to the system.
Experience with ML systems, frameworks or algorithms is a bonus, as is familiarity with GitHub, Maven, Docker, Spinnaker and Kubernetes.

Vi söker legitimerad lärare i fritidshem - Vikariat 20270107 - 20271220

IES i Landskrona öppnades 2017, och är en F-9 skola. Här möts dagligen närmare 600 elever samt närmare 70 medarbetare. Vi är en tvåspråkig skola, engelska-svenska, som följer den svenska läroplanen. Våra möten sker mestadels på engelska. Att jobba i vår skola är att vara del av en professionell gemenskap och samarbete.

Om tjänsten

Vill du vara med och skapa trygga, roliga och meningsfulla dagar för våra yngsta elever? Vi söker en engagerad  legitimerad lärare i fritidshem som brinner för social utveckling, rörelse och aktivitet både i klassrummet och ute på skolgården.

I den här rollen har du en central funktion under hela elevens skoldag. Ditt fokus täcker tre viktiga områden:

- Fritidshem (Placering i Förskoleklass): Du planerar och leder den pedagogiska verksamheten på fritidshemmet tillsammans med ditt arbetslag, med särskilt fokus på eleverna i förskoleklass.
- Rastverksamhet under skoltid: Du ansvarar för att strukturera, planera och genomföra aktiva och inkluderande rastaktiviteter. Du finns där som en närvarande vuxen som främjar rörelseglädje, stimulerar lek och förebygger utanförskap och konflikter.
- Samverkan i skolan: Du samverkar med klasslärare under skoltiden för att skapa en sammanhållen dag för eleverna.Vi söker dig som:

- Är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem (eller har en äldre examen som grundskollärare med inriktning mot fritidshem).
- Har ett starkt intresse för rastpedagogik och ser rasten som en viktig lärandemiljö för sociala färdigheter och trygghet.
- Har erfarenhet av – eller ett särskilt engagemang för – arbete med barn i förskoleklass.
- Är en trygg, relationsskapande och närvarande vuxen med god förmåga att skapa struktur och studiero.
- Har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att arbeta i nära team runt eleverna.

Vad erbjuder vi?

- En dynamisk arbetsplats där fritidshemmet och rastverksamheten ses som viktiga delar av elevens hela skoldag.
- Ett kollegialt sammanhang med erfarna pedagoger och ett starkt stöd i arbetslaget.
- Möjlighet att forma och utveckla skolans rastaktiviteter.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och tydlig ledare, lyhörd och empatisk i ditt bemötande av elever. Du skapar engagemang och delaktighet, bygger goda relationer och möter varje elev med respekt och värme. Du ser möjligheter istället för hinder och hanterar konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Vi söker dig som

- Är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem
- Har en positiv elevsyn och sätter eleven i centrum
- Trivs med att arbeta i team och värdesätter kollegialt samarbete
- Är väl insatt i och arbetar utifrån Lgr22 (fritidshemmets uppdrag)
- Är engagerad, strukturerad och utvecklingsinriktad
- Har god digital kompetens och använder digitala verktyg i verksamheten
- Kommunicerar väl med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare

Hos oss är trygghet och studiero viktigt, vilket innebär att du behöver vara säker i din yrkesroll och ha förmåga att skapa ett gott socialt klimat i elevgrupperna. Du är en lagspelare med hög arbetsmoral och trivs med att arbeta med människor i en internationell skolmiljö.

Du har god förmåga att samverka och kommunicera samt en vilja att vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet. Våra digitala plattformar är Google och SchoolSoft.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och hoppas att du vill bli en del av vårt fritidsteam på IES Landskrona!

jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1'900 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and produce solutions for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com.
 
Your crew
As a Product Assurance Manager you'll be part of the Quality Department, responsible for the development, implementation and verification of the Product Assurance requirements among entire project life. The Product Assurance Manager will act as main interface to the customer and the subcontractors for quality and safety topics. Quality Management at Beyond Gravity is all about ensuring a Learning Organization that leads the Space Industry improvement rate and garantees customer satisfaction.
 
Your mission
Develop the Product Assurance Requirements and Culture at project level, ensuring robust quality processes, cost excellence for program quality execution through collaboration with Programs, Engineering and Operations.
Act as main interface for Customer for all quality and safety topics.
Establish Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) features in collaboration with Customer and Engineering.
Lead NC and failure investigation whenever product requirements are violated.
Supervise and direct Product Development and Qualification for all relevant quality aspects.
Coordinate for all Quality matters international multi-site and cross-country programs.

 
Main Tasks:
Execute Product Assurance Program in accordance with Project Milestones.
Ensure successful execution of the Customer, Regulatory and Internal Requirements for Program Execution.
Convert the Customer Critical to Quality Requirements into internal specifications and requirements.
Lead Customer Critical RCA and investigation activities.
Moderate Design FMEA.
Develop Process/Product CTQ and Control Plans in collaboration with Customer and Engineering.
Establish Product Quality Documentation.
Support and achieve final Product Qualification.
Contribute as needed to Customer and internal Audit as Quality representative.

 
Most important output
Contribute to Customer Satisfaction for Quality Performance
Quality Milestone Achievements for Projects
Design FMEA
Product CTQs Development (Control Plans)
Product Quality data-package for Space Application
Final Product Qualification data-package for Space Application
Customer RCA and NC Report

 
Your story
Must’s:
Relevant experience in the field of Quality and Continuous Improvement
Preferred education: MSc degree in Engineering or in a similar relevant discipline
Knowledge of standards such as EN9100, ECSS, NASA and MIL
Ability to quickly understand and analyse technical products/systems and their function
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
MS Office experience required
Experience in the application of Quality preventive methodology (5Why, Ishikawa Fishbone…)

 
Nice to have’s:
Any further language (German, French and Swedish) beyond English is a strong asset
Experience in other Space companies

 
Why Beyond Gravity
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!
 
🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​
Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​
​
For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Catarina Rio |  | catarina.afonsorio@beyondgravity.com 
Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​
​
Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

ABOUT THE ROLE    

We’re looking for a BI Engineer to join our Business Intelligence Engineering team at LeoVegas Group. You’ll work across the full BI stack, from modelling data in BigQuery to building the dashboards senior leaders use to run a multi-brand, multi-jurisdiction iGaming business.
This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. We treat our reporting as data products, built to scale and to last, and we’re moving our BI platform to Sigma, so you’ll help shape how we build on it from early on. If you enjoy writing clean SQL, solving messy data problems, and seeing your work shape decisions across the business, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Design, build, and maintain scalable presentation-layer datasets using SQL, dbt, Python, Airflow, and BigQuery on GCP.

Choose the right materialisation strategies and follow CI/CD practices to keep our models reliable, performant, and cost-efficient.
Design and maintain a semantic layer with governed, consistent metric definitions that power both dashboards and AI-driven self-service, so stakeholders can ask questions of the data in natural language and trust the answers.
Build interactive dashboards in Sigma, our strategic BI platform, while supporting existing Tableau reporting during the transition, working alongside Business Analysts and applying data storytelling principles that encourage self-service analytics.
Apply a data product mindset to everything you deliver, building reporting that is reusable, well-documented, and designed for long-term impact.
Partner with our Data Engineering team on upstream pipeline changes, investigate data issues through root-cause analysis, and help improve the platform we build on.
Work directly with stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, Compliance, Operations, Payments, Data Science, Marketing, and Product to understand their needs and translate them into well-designed data solutions.
Help harmonise KPIs and metric definitions across brands and BI platforms.
Champion data quality, documentation, and consistent metric definitions so people can trust what they see.
Keep learning, and share useful tools, techniques, and ideas with the team.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential:
2-5 years of experience in a BI Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar role.

Advanced SQL, with a solid grasp of data modelling concepts (for example, dimensional modelling).
Hands-on experience with at least one modern BI tool, ideally Sigma or Tableau.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and senior management.
Clear, concise written documentation that others can actually use.
A structured, curious approach to problem-solving and debugging data issues.

Nice to have:
Experience in the iGaming industry (Sportsbook and/or Casino).

Python, Airflow, and dbt.
Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, and with GCP more broadly.
Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
Exposure to Sigma

 
WHO WE ARE
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 
BENEFITS:
Hybrid work policy

30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partne
Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
