Why this role matters
Our platform teams tackle a wide array of technical and business-facing challenges, and the design demand naturally shifts from one domain to another. Having a flexible, highly capable Senior Designer who can move where the impact is greatest allows us to stay agile. Your ability to jump in, quickly understand a problem space, and ship clean, accessible designs, ensures that the experience is seamless and cohesive.

Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for creating awesome character design concepts, magical environment concepts and whatever is needed to enhance game experience? Are you excited about crafting vibrant visuals for mobile games that captivate millions of players?
As a Concept Artist at Snowprint, you’ll have a broad role with plenty of room to influence the visual direction of our new game project. You’ll mainly work on character and outfit concepts, but also contribute to props, items, environments, key art, and whatever else is needed to bring the game’s visual world together.
You’ll be part of a small team where your ideas and perspective matter. You’ll work closely with the Art Director, other artists, designers, and developers, with the freedom to take ownership of your work and find solutions rather than simply working from a list of tasks.
At Snowprint, we believe that kindness, curiosity, collaboration, and a shared passion for making great games are key to creating a good place to work and great games.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll primarily create concepts for characters and their outfits, developing ideas that can be translated into 3D models and eventually brought into the game. You’ll work from early ideas through to more detailed concepts and turnarounds, making sure your designs communicate the character clearly and give the 3D team what they need to take them further.
You’ll also create key art and title screens, as well as concepts for props, items, environments, and other visual elements when needed. The role gives you the opportunity to work across different types of concept art and contribute to the overall visual quality of the game.
You’ll work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the art team, sharing work early, discussing ideas, and responding to feedback throughout the process. You’ll be encouraged to explore different approaches, adapt your style to the needs of the game, and keep moving rather than over-polishing before getting feedback.
Is this you?
You’re an experienced Concept Artist with professional experience working on at least one released game. Experience from a stylized, fantasy, or high-fidelity game is particularly relevant.

You have a strong understanding of character design, including anatomy, proportions, clothing, poses, lighting, composition, mood, and surfaces. You know how to make designs feel visually interesting while still having a clear function and purpose.

You understand the path from concept to 3D. You know how to create clear character turnarounds and other concepts that give 3D artists what they need to build and implement the asset.

You’re adaptable and comfortable working within an established art direction. You can adjust your style to what the game needs and are comfortable working across characters, props, environments, and key art.

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio
Strong character / creature appeal and design fundamentals

Dynamic / interesting character presentation

Work samples showing confidence in human and animal anatomy

A strong understanding of light and material behaviour

Clear character sheets for 3D artists

Where you’ll work
Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.
We’re unable to support relocation for this position, so you need to be based in Stockholm, Sweden.
About Snowprint Studios
Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment, while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.
Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.
For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.
At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.
Good to know
We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Behörig speciallärare till F–3 sökes!

Är du en behörig och erfaren speciallärare som kan inspirera och stödja våra elever på IES Kista? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Kista öppnade 2015 och har idag omkring 640 elever från F till årskurs 9. Vi är övertygade om att vårt tydliga etos och våra engagerade och närvarande ledare bidrar till en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare möjlighet att fokusera på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör – alla elever är dina elever.

På Internationella Engelska Skolan arbetar vi som ett team och strävar åt samma håll. För att trivas hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande samt gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi vill att varje elev ska känna sig trygg och trivas i en stimulerande lärmiljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga.

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker en kvalificerad och erfaren speciallärare som ska arbeta specifikt med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 3. Du har ett positivt förhållningssätt och en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga att utvecklas.

Tillsammans med klasslärare, fritidsassistenter, specialpedagog och övrig personal i elevhälsoteamet arbetar du för att skapa en trygg, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö. Du bidrar med speciallärare kompetens och stöttar elevernas kunskapsmässiga och sociala utveckling.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

- planera, genomföra och följa upp riktade stödinsatser för elever i F–3
- undervisa enskilda elever och elever i mindre grupper
- stödja elever i klassrummet vid behovs
- arbeta förebyggande och främjande tillsammans med klasslärare och elevhälsoteamet
- handleda lärare och samarbeta med övrig pedagogisk personal
- arbeta med ett särskilt fokus på språk-, läs-, skriv- och matematikutveckling.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100 procent, med tillträde så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

Provanställning tillämpas under de första sex månaderna.Vem är du?

Det är ett krav att du har:

- svensk lärarexamen och svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i F–3
- speciallärarexamen eller specialpedagogexamen
- dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 3.

Du har god pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att omsätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du är trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap och i mötet med eleverna. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Som en närvarande och reflekterande pedagog utmanar och stimulerar du eleverna i deras utveckling.

Du ser samarbete som en viktig framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen. Du kommunicerar tydligt och respektfullt med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.

Du har erfarenhet av pedagogisk dokumentation och av att upprätta och följa upp åtgärdsprogram. Du har goda kunskaper om NPF och tydliggörande pedagogik samt erfarenhet av positivt beteendestöd och lågaffektivt bemötande.

Du är positiv, lösningsfokuserad och samarbetsvillig samt beredd att ingå i ett internationellt team.

I din roll undervisar du på svenska och/eller engelska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personalen. Du behöver därför behärska både svenska och engelska väl, i tal och skrift.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se:https://engelska.se/our-schools/kista/about-our-school/

Intervjuer genomförs löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret och giltig ID-handling krävs.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

What will you do?
As a AI/ML Engineer at Rebtel you will define how AI is done at Rebtel. What tooling we standardise on, how we evaluate models we put in front of real users, what "good" looks like for our prompts and our pipelines. AI is going from a side project to the core of how Rebtel operates and what we ship to our users. We're hiring the second engineer on our ML/AI subteam to help build it classical ML for the business, LLM-powered systems for the product, and a clear production mindset on both.
You'll sit inside the Data team, report to our Head of Data, and partner with one other ML/AI engineer to shape this capability from the ground up.

Classical ML, in production, for operational leverage

Risk and fraud models across payments, top-ups, and account behaviour

Churn prediction and retention modelling on a user base of a million-plus

Forecasting, pricing, segmentation, and the next batch of operational problems we haven't tackled yet

Owning models end-to-end scoping with stakeholders, building, deploying, monitoring, retraining

LLMs and AI agents, from internal automation to in-product features

Move LLM capability into the product as user-facing features

Help guide the company on where AI actually creates leverage, what to build, what to buy, what to ignore and turn the good ideas into shipped systems

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office

4+ years of hands-on ML engineering in Python, with real production ownership not just notebooks

Strong fundamentals in classical ML: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and the unglamorous parts of keeping a model healthy in prod

A genuine production mindset: monitoring, retraining, eval harnesses, CI/CD for models, and the instinct to debug when something drifts at 2am

Comfort working the whole loop: stakeholder scoping → data → model → deployment → measurement → iteration

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to translate between business problems and ML ones

Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents

Built RAG systems, agentic workflows, or LLM-backed products that real users (or real internal teams) actually used

Comfortable with vector databases, embeddings, prompt evaluation, and measuring LLM systems with something more rigorous than vibes

Obsession with staying up-to-date on developments in the AI space 

Experience with a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure), containers, and a modern data stack

Experience in MLOps tooling: MLflow, Airflow, Kubernetes and feature stores is a plus

Background in fintech, payments, telecom, or other regulated / operational domains is a plus

About the assignment We are looking for an experienced security governance professional to join an international team delivering a secure private cloud environment. The assignment starts in January 2027 and runs for approximately 18 months. You will work onsite in Luxembourg around 40–60% of the time, with the remainder remote.
What you will do Your mission is to guide the solution towards formal security accreditation and authorisation to operate. In practice, you will:

Define the scope of the accreditation together with stakeholders, and set up governance and a structured approach to evidence

Gather and organise the security standards and requirements that apply

Review evidence across people, processes and technology, and evaluate it against agreed criteria

Keep a clear record of requirements, findings, gaps, decisions and remediation priorities

Lead review sessions with the customer and NATO accreditation authorities

Deliver a complete, traceable accreditation package, including workbook, evidence and open actions, ready for handover

What we are looking for

Solid experience of security accreditation, certification or compliance work in complex environments

Strong knowledge of NIST and ISO 27001, and experience mapping controls to government cloud frameworks

Familiarity with SSP, ST&E and POA&M, as well as defining system boundaries

Experience with gap analysis, risk assessment and remediation planning

Understanding of the compliance challenges in air-gapped/isolated environments

Fluent English, written and spoken

Requirements

Valid NATO security clearance (or eligibility to hold one)

Ability to work onsite in Luxembourg part of the week

Why join us? At CyberInstincts, you will be part of a specialist cybersecurity community working on high-impact assignments. We offer flexibility in how we work together, as an employee or as an independent consultant, and support you throughout the assignment.
Interested? Apply with your CV and a brief description of your accreditation experience. We review applications continuously, so don’t wait to apply.

We are looking for an Automation Engineer for a global company in Lund. Start is ASAP, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Lund.

Assignment description
﻿
We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to join exciting industrial and process automation projects. In this role, you will be responsible for programming, testing, commissioning, and optimizing automation solutions tailored to various production processes and customer requirements.
﻿ 
You will work closely with process engineers and other technical specialists to ensure seamless integration and full functionality of the delivered solutions. The role combines technical expertise with a strong understanding of process automation, enabling you to contribute throughout the project lifecycle.
﻿ 
As an Automation Engineer, you are familiar with our standards, processes, and our Plant Master, and you play a key role in delivering high-quality and sustainable automation solutions. Depending on project needs, work may be performed at our customer sites, or supplier locations.
﻿ 
Key Responsibilities

Develop and program automation solutions for industrial processes

Perform testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities

Collaborate with process engineers to ensure optimal system performance

Work according to company standards and best practices

Support customers and project teams throughout implementation and start-up phases

﻿ 
This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working in dynamic project environments and contributing to innovative automation solutions.
﻿
 This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Lund through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Lund.

 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.occupation: Senior DevOps Engineer  Mainframe, COBOL & CI/CD - 20604
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Senior Technical Consultant to improve development tools and automated delivery pipelines within an organisation with extensive COBOL development on IBM z/OS.
The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for evaluating and improving tools, processes and technical solutions. You will work closely with developers, infrastructure teams and external technology providers to establish efficient, automated and quality-assured development and delivery processes.
What You Will Work On
Develop and maintain tools and processes for COBOL development on IBM z/OS.
Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated delivery processes.
Integrate development tools with version control and deployment solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve automation, quality and developer experience.
Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
Provide technical guidance and support to development teams.
Collaborate with internal technology teams and external suppliers.

What You Bring
Experience with COBOL development and modern mainframe development environments.
Good understanding of IBM z/OS.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD and automated development and delivery pipelines.
Experience with Git and version control.
Knowledge of Linux and Java.
Ability to take technical ownership, evaluate solutions and drive improvements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Fluency in Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Experience building modern COBOL pipelines.
Experience with z/OS development tools.
Experience with TeamCity, Artifactory or IBM DevOps Deploy.
Experience with AI-related initiatives in software development.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join a multidisciplinary development team working alongside mechanical, electronics and software engineers. The assignment involves both improving existing products and developing new mechanical designs, from initial concepts to complete manufacturing documentation.
What You Will Work On
Develop and improve mechanical product designs.
Create and maintain 3D models, technical drawings and revisions in PDM systems.
Take designs from initial concepts and requirements to manufacturing-ready documentation.
Work with tolerances, material selection and manufacturing methods.
Support prototype development, assembly and practical verification.
Independently drive mechanical design activities.
Collaborate with electronics and software engineers throughout product development.

What You Bring
A few years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
Good experience with Autodesk Inventor.
Experience managing drawings, models and revisions in PDM systems.
Ability to take designs from concept to manufacturing documentation.
Good understanding of technical drawings, tolerances, materials and manufacturing methods.
Experience with prototyping, assembly and practical verification.
Ability to independently manage design tasks.
Strong collaboration skills, particularly between mechanical and electronics disciplines.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and/or English.

Meritorious
Experience with Autodesk Vault.
Knowledge of DFAM and design for additive manufacturing.
Experience designing products for low- and medium-volume production.
Experience with 3D printing, CNC machining and sheet metal design.
Experience designing instruments, electronic products or electromechanical products.
Experience with electronic enclosures, seals and IP-rated designs.
Knowledge of DFM/DFA.
Experience with product maintenance, change management and products in serial production.
Experience with injection-moulded components.

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Cable Harness Design Engineers  Several Positions
jobs.description:
Multiply Teknik & IT AB is growing, and we are looking for experienced engineers within electrical design, electrical installations, electromechanical design, and cable harness development.
The roles are connected to advanced products and systems within defence, automotive, aerospace, marine, industrial technology, and other demanding engineering environments.

About the Role
Depending on your background, you may work with:
Electrical systems, schematics, and wiring documentation
Cable harness design and 3D routing
Electrical installations, connectors, and interfaces
Mechanical packaging and installation of cables
Optimization for robustness, manufacturability, serviceability, quality, and cost
Prototype builds, verification, troubleshooting, and production support
Engineering changes and technical documentation
Collaboration with mechanics, production, purchasing, suppliers, and test teams

Your Profile
We believe you have:
A degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or equivalent experience
Several years of experience in electrical design, cable harness development, routing, or installation design
Experience from cross-functional and project-based product development
Understanding of Design for Manufacturing and Design for Assembly
A structured, analytical, and solution-oriented way of working
Good knowledge of Swedish and English
Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, CATIA V5, CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Capital, ENOVIA, Teamcenter, or similar tools is meriting.
Experience from MIL cabling, automotive, defence, aerospace, marine, or other advanced cable systems is highly valuable.

For several positions, Swedish citizenship and approved security clearance are required.

About Multiply
Multiply is an end-to-end solution provider within electronics, embedded systems, electrical engineering, automation, functional safety, cybersecurity, and advanced product development.
We support customers from requirements and design to integration, verification, industrialization, and lifecycle support. We also develop VisFlow, our own platform for visualization, analysis, and governance of complex technical and operational flows.
Several positions are located in Västmanland and the Stockholm region. Accommodation in Västmanland may be available for candidates living elsewhere.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer  C & Hardware-Near Programming - 20574
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Developer with strong skills in hardware-near programming using C.
You will work in a technically complex environment within the automotive industry, developing embedded software while considering relevant industry regulations and requirements.
Knowledge of electronics and electrical design is an advantage. The role does not involve designing circuit boards but may include technical activities related to electrical systems and production testing.
You will join a growing organisation with a team of approximately 15 people, short decision-making processes and opportunities to influence technical solutions. The environment can be fast-paced.
What You Will Work On
Develop embedded software in C.
Work with hardware-near programming in technically complex environments.
Consider automotive industry regulations and requirements.
Support technical investigations related to electronics and electrical systems.
Work with topics such as signal screens, grounding, power resistors and current circuits.
Contribute to activities involving braking systems and motor control.
Support production testing and final testing when required.
Collaborate with a cross-functional engineering team.

What You Bring
Strong experience in embedded software development using C.
Good understanding of hardware-near programming.
Experience working in technically complex environments.
Understanding of automotive industry regulations.
Good spoken and written Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Knowledge of electronics and electrical engineering.
Experience with signal screens, grounding and power resistors.
Knowledge of current circuits, braking systems and motor control.
Experience with production testing and final testing.

jobs.description:

From ideas to reality. Decode the future.

At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
 

All about the role:

As aftermarket sales Product Owner, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining business processes to ensure efficiency and compliance for aftermarket sales and services. You will be part of the product team within IT EMEA/APAC, working cross-functionally with product, engineering and bunsiess owners to ensure that our products meet the needs of our customers and align with our business goals.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to define requirements for the core commerce platform, manage the sales backlog, monitor development team deliveries, and coordinate cross-functional dependencies with Contact Centers, Service Operations, Finance, Online Services, and B2B Operations.

 

What you'll do:

Provide guidance to engineering and commercial teams on process-related matters and foster a culture of process and product excellence.
Mirror Key Users (KU) in the markets and responsible for running KU forums. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify process and product improvement opportunities.
Work with technical teams to ensure processes are supported by appropriate tools and systems.
Ensure processes facilitate smooth delivery of product features across the product areas.
Monitor product performance, business adoption and business & tech KPIs to implement corrective actions when necessary.
Consolidate the sales backlog across multiple product areas. Manage process-related tasks and prioritize improvements based on business impact.
Support with developing a roadmap for process enhancements to support organizational goals.
Create and update process documentation, analyse the requirments and transfer it into detailed requirement specification for development team, support commercial counterparts centrally and locally to drive adoption of standardized processes across the organization.

 

Who you are:

You have a strong understanding of cross-functional business processes, systems, and postpurchase operations, with knowledge of sales, service, and financial flows and have proven experience working in product team. You are a hands-on problem solver who can translate business needs into process improvements and solutions that drive commercial growth.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have good prioritization skills and the ability to go into details without losing focus of the bigger picture.
3+ years as Process Owner/Product Owner or similar role in digital solutions supporting aftermarket sales, service, finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong product mindset and understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile teams.
Proficiency in Jira and/or Github for managing product backlogs and sprints.
In-depth knowledge of aftermarket sales processes (sales orders, payments, invoicing, refunds) related to services, extended warranties, spares, consumables & accessories
Understanding of fulfillment and logistics processes, especially in the context of spare parts, consumables and accessories is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Curious, self motivated and problem solver
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills
In-depth knowledge of the sales & distribution and finance domain in SAP (e.g. SD/GL/AP) would be beneficial

 

 
Where you will be:

This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
 

Benefits highlights:

Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO
As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
You will:
Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
We are looking for people with:
Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
An example of our benefits:
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Hunt Consulting is a reputable consultancy firm specialising in program and project
management, business development and executive management. Our clients include
international organisations and non-governmental organisations working to advance the sustainable use of natural resources worldwide. The work of the clients may include but is not limited to international collaboration, policy engagement, knowledge sharing, and capacity development.
The opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Program Manager to support
the development and implementation of international programmes and policy
initiatives related to sustainable resource governance.
The successful candidate will contribute to policy analysis, programme development, stakeholder engagement, and international cooperation efforts aimed at strengthening governance frameworks and supporting evidence-based
decision-making. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic international environment with governments, multilateral organisations, research institutions, NGOs, and private sector stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Support the design, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of international programmes and projects related to sustainable resource management. 
Conduct policy analysis and research on environmental governance issues at local, national, and international levels.
Engage with governments,international organisations, donors, and other stakeholders to advance programme objectives.
Build and maintain relationships with senior government officials, ministries, public     authorities, development agencies, and international partners.
Contribute to the development
of policy briefs, reports, technical papers, and knowledge products.
Organise and facilitate workshops, consultations, conferences, and multi-stakeholder dialogues.
Support fundraising efforts, including proposal development and donor reporting.
Monitor developments in international environmental and water policy and identify implications for programme activities.
Represent the organisation in external meetings, working groups, international forums, and professional networks as required.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Requirements
Master's degree or higher in Environmental
Governance, Environmental Policy, International Development, Natural
Resource Management, or a closely related field.
Minimum eight (8) years of relevant professional experience in sustainable governance of natural resources or related fields.
Demonstrated experience working in the Global South with international environmental and sustainability policy processes.
Proven experience organising and hosting events at international conferences related to natural resource management.
Experience engaging with senior government officials, ministries, public authorities, intergovernmental organisations, and other high-level stakeholders.
Strong understanding of environmental governance, environmental policy, sustainable development, and international cooperation frameworks.
Experience working in Sweden with Swedish stakeholders.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong analytical, research, drafting, and report-writing skills.
Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills.
Advanced computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite and practical experience with SAP, Microsoft Project, or similar enterprise and project management systems.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively contributing to multinational and multidisciplinary teams.
Willingness and ability to undertake extensive international travel.

Desirable Qualifications
Additional language skills, particularly Spanish, Swedish, German, or other internationally relevant languages.
Experience working with international NGOs, UN organisations, development agencies, research institutions, or donor-funded programmes.
Experience in natural resource management approaches.
Knowledge of international environmental agreements and global sustainability frameworks.
Experience in programme management, monitoring and evaluation, donor reporting, and partnership development.

Personal attributes
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Strong intercultural awareness and the ability to build effective relationships across diverse cultural, political, and institutional contexts.
Proven capacity to engage confidently with high-level decision makers and represent the organisation in international forums.
Excellent diplomatic,negotiation, and communication skills.
Strong project coordination and organisational abilities.
Initiative, adaptability, and a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive issues and stakeholder relationships.
A strong commitment to sustainable development and environmental stewardship.

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to contribute to global efforts that strengthen sustainable development worldwide.
A dynamic and international work environment with engagement across governments, multilateral organisations, academia, civil society, and the private sector.
The opportunity to work with leading experts and decision makers in the fields of environmental governance, and sustainable development.
A competitive compensation and
benefits package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Excellent opportunities for professional growth.
Exposure to high-level international policy processes, conferences, and strategic initiatives.
An inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven organisational culture that values innovation,
diversity, and impact.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are invited to submit:
A cover letter outlining their suitability for the role.
A detailed CV in English.
Contact details for three professional references.

Applications should be submitted no later than dec 13 2026 to: Sales@Huntconsulting.se 
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Qualified candidates may be contacted for interviews prior to the application deadline. The organisation reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a suitable candidate has been identified.
Hunt Consulting AB is managing this recruitment. All applications will be treated with the utmost confidentiality. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Data Protection Notice (GDPR)
For questions regarding the processing and management of your personal data, please
contact Sales@Huntconsulting.se.

Want to be part of a collaborative team delivering reliable digital solutions that support thousands of passengers every day?
 
We are looking for a Fullstack Developer to join our Check-in & Boarding team. We are a small, autonomous development team responsible for systems and applications supporting passenger check-in and boarding across Stena Line. Our team is responsible for the systems and applications used throughout the check-in and boarding process. This includes everything from passenger information and travel document checks to boarding cards and integrations with other systems. We work with business-critical solutions while continuously modernising our technical landscape and moving towards a more digital and self-service passenger journey.
 
 
As a Fullstack Developer, you will work with both backend and frontend development and contribute throughout the development lifecycle - from architecture and design to implementation, testing and continuous improvement. We value developers who want to understand the problem, discuss different solutions and have an influence on how things are actually built.
 
 
Some of your key responsibilities:
 
- Develop and maintain applications and APIs related to check-in and boarding
 
 - Work across frontend and backend using technologies such as React, TypeScript, .NET and SQL
 
 - Design and develop integrations with other systems and external services
 
 - Develop new functionality based on business and user needs
 
 - Troubleshoot, maintain and improve existing business-critical applications
 
 - Contribute to architectural and technical decisions
 
 - Modernise and gradually replace parts of our legacy landscape
 
 
What you will experience
 
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
 
 
Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of developers, UX, Product Owner and other colleagues.
 
 
Who are you? 
 
You are a curious and collaborative developer who enjoys working across the stack and taking responsibility for solutions from idea to production.
 
 
You like to understand the problem before building the solution and enjoy discussing different approaches with the team. You care about quality and understand that delivering software is not only about writing code quickly, but about building solutions that are secure, scalable and maintainable.
 
 
You see modern AI tools and coding agents as a natural part of software development and use them to work smarter, while applying your own technical judgement to the solutions they help produce.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
 - Several years of professional software development experience, including C# and .NET
 
 - Experience with modern frontend development, preferably React and TypeScript
 
 - Experience building and consuming REST APIs, system integrations and event-driven systems
 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD and modern development practices
 
 - Professional proficiency in Swedish and English
 
 
Experience with OpenShift/Kubernetes, modernising legacy applications, cloud development or business-critical systems is considered a plus.
 
 
Interested? 
 
This is a full-time, permanent position based in Gothenburg within our Commercial Digital department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than October 12, 2026. We are having an ongoing selection, so do not wait with your application. To ensure the secure and structured processing of your personal data, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system.
 
 
We have collective bargaining agreements with Unionen, among others, who you can contact for more information. Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment. We may conduct background checks as part of our efforts to ensure the quality of our recruitment process.
 
 
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Mattias Niklasson at mailto:mattias.niklasson@stenaline.com or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, mailto:hedwig.blixt@stenaline.com . 
 
 
About Stena Line
 
As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe’s most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.
 
 
Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.

Ref. 4297Ö
We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced night nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine passion for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has an injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. A nanny must therefore always be present and available when he is with her, providing essential practical support.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Night Nanny – Responsibilities
He usually goes to bed around 20:00 and sleeps until 05:30–06:30, occasionally waking briefly.
Responsibilities include:
Being available and monitoring his wellbeing throughout the night.
Comforting and assisting him if he wakes.
Preparing breakfast, meals and snacks.
Completing morning routines and getting him ready for nursery.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing and spending quality time together.
Supporting his interests and activities.
Packing his nursery bag.
Making beds and keeping his areas tidy.
Child-related laundry and ironing when needed.
Light household tasks, including tidying up and wiping kitchen surfaces.
Administering medication when required.

The nanny sleeps in a separate area with the child, away from the mother.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and genuinely passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
We are looking for someone who will genuinely care about his happiness and development and bring warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!

Are you motivated by combining finance, business understanding and systems to create clear insights and support better decision-making?
We are looking for a Business & System Controller to join our Business Control team. In this role, you will support Group-wide financial reporting, planning and analysis while contributing to the development of tools and processes that enable better business decisions.
 
Some of your key responsibilities:
- Maintain and validate central planning assumptions and calculations, ensuring accurate and reliable planning across the Group.
- Coordinate and quality-assure central postings, allocations and intercompany reconciliations, ensuring correct legal-entity treatment and complete inclusion of all Group companies’ revenues and costs in closing and planning.

jobs.occupation: Doctoral position in RNA-based crop protection in wheat and potato
jobs.description:
Department of Plant Breeding
Third-cycle subject area
Biology
RNA-based approaches offer new possibilities for protecting crops against disease. Spray-induced gene silencing (SIGS) uses externally applied double-stranded RNA to reduce the expression of selected pathogen genes. Its effectiveness depends on how RNA reaches the pathogen, is taken up and remains biologically active. Understanding these processes is an important step towards reliable RNA-based crop protection.
We are looking for a doctoral student to develop and evaluate SIGS against Septoria tritici blotch in wheat, caused by the fungus Zymoseptoria tritici, and to build on our ongoing research on potato late blight, caused by the oomycete Phytophthora infestans.
About the position
Establishing SIGS in wheat will be a central part of the project. You will evaluate RNA-based treatments and investigate their effects on pathogen gene expression and disease development. In potato, you will build on established approaches to further investigate RNA-based disease control. Across the two systems, you will also study aspects of RNA uptake, movement and biological activity to better understand the factors that influence treatment effectiveness. The results will help guide the next stages of the project.
The work will combine plant–pathogen experiments, molecular biology, RNA analysis, gene expression studies and microscopy. Depending on the research questions, it may also include small RNA sequencing and bioinformatic analysis. You will receive training in the methods needed for your project and work closely with colleagues in RNA biology and plant pathology.
Your work will combine questions about how RNA functions with the development of new approaches to crop disease control. During your doctoral studies, you will develop your own scientific questions, analyse and publish your results, and present your work at scientific meetings. You will also participate in doctoral courses, seminars and collaboration within and beyond SLU.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in Biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must hold, or be in the process of completing, a Master’s degree or equivalent in biology, biotechnology, plant breeding, horticulture, agronomy or a related subject, with a relevant focus such as molecular biology, plant pathology, microbiology or plant protection. You must meet the requirements for admission to doctoral education before admission.
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
Practical laboratory experience in molecular biology, RNA analysis or plant–microbe interactions is an advantage. Experience with plant disease experiments, fungal or oomycete pathogens, microscopy or bioinformatic analysis of sequencing data is also valuable. You are not expected to have experience in all these areas.
We are looking for someone who is curious, works carefully and takes initiative. You should be able to organise your work, assess results critically and collaborate with others. Good written and spoken English is required. Teaching and supervision of students may be included in the position.
About us
The Department of Plant Breeding at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) conducts research and education to support sustainable production of food, feed and plant-based industrial products. Our research spans plant genetic diversity, genomics, biotechnology, crop improvement, product quality and interactions between plants and their environment. We combine fundamental and applied research to understand important plant traits and develop improved crops and sustainable production methods. Read more about our department here https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/vf_en/
This doctoral position is within the subject area Plants and the Environment, where we study crop responses to environmental conditions, disease resistance, RNA biology and interactions between plants and microorganisms. The research includes RNA-based approaches to crop protection and the role of beneficial microorganisms in plant health.
Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ 
Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/

Employment as a doctoral student
Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.

jobs.occupation: Thesis Work - Generative AI for Scenario and Injection Design in IT/OT
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company serving approximately 12 million customers and employing around 21,000 people. We believe there is a way to build a future where everyone can choose fossil-free ways to move, make, and live.

Job Description

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.
About the Thesis Work
The Thesis will be held under Corporate Security & Resilience function at Vattenfall which is a modern, flexible, and agile unit that is operating in a challenging and rapidly changing environment. We strive to embed security & resilience into all our business operations and we apply a holistic and risk-based approach to constantly adopt and improve our security posture.
Background and Scope
Cybersecurity exercises, including tabletop exercises and functional exercises are an important part of organizational resilience, particularly for critical infrastructure operators where information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) environments are interconnected. The effectiveness of such exercises depends on the realism, technical accuracy, and relevance of the scenario and its supporting injects (alerts, emails, media reports, decision points).
However, developing scenarios and injects is often manual and resource intensive activity. Exercise planners must translate and combine multiple variables into a sequence that is credible for both IT and OT participants. Generative AI and large language models can support on scenario development, structured content generation and role-based dialogues, while agentic capabilities can enable more adaptive exercises by proposing subsequent injects.
The thesis will investigate how generative AI can support both the design and adaptive facilitation of IT/OT cybersecurity exercises. The thesis will follow a qualitative approach, focusing on the development of a conceptual framework and workflow specification for AI assisted exercise design. The proposed framework and workflow will be evaluated through expert review and walkthroughs with focus on real world applicability and relevance for IT/OT cybersecurity environments.
The thesis is expected to deliver: 
An academic framework for generative AI assisted scenarios and injection design;
A small library of reviewed example artifacts demonstrating the framework;
A documented workflow covering source preparation, scenario generation, state tracking, adaptive inject selection, human approval and debrief support.
A limited demonstrator or simulation showing how participant decisions can change subsequent injects and scenario outcomes.
Output and summary of experts after review where they will analyze the risk factors and the possible adoption issue that they foresee.

This thesis project is for 2 students.

Qualifications

Furthermore, we see that you have: 
Education - Computer Science, Software Engineering
Fluency in written and spoken English as the thesis project will be in English

Join Telavox as a Systems Engineer for Storage
Are you a hands-on systems engineer who thrives in operational depth and wants to own the storage that the rest of engineering runs on? At Telavox, we run our own: our own Ceph clusters, on-prem Kubernetes, and a fleet of physical servers across six countries. We're providers of infrastructure, not consumers of cloud - a deliberate choice, and what our product and economics demand. Storage is where we're investing next.
Ceph specifically is not a requirement. If you've run distributed or enterprise storage in production - Ceph, ZFS, Gluster, Lustre, MinIO, a vendor array - the instincts are what we're after, and we'll teach you ours.
About the job
This is a hands-on operations role. You'd own how our storage runs day-to-day - health, capacity, upgrades, expansion, and the operational foundations underneath it. You'll have real input into architecture, and you'll set the long-term direction with our storage lead rather than on your own. The emphasis here is deliberately operational - if making storage actually work, and being trusted to do it unsupervised, is the part you want, there's a lot of room in this role.
Ceph (block and S3) is our main estate - real production storage, growing across regions, with Sweden the largest footprint.
Your day-to-day would be mostly spent on things like:

Keeping the clusters healthy - issues, monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, and expansion across regions

Getting the foundations right: stability, security, predictable scaling.

Making the work repeatable - runbooks, upgrade procedures that hold across regions, automation for what's manual today

You won't work in isolation from the rest of the platform: on-prem Kubernetes runs most of our workloads and has clear impact on the storage domain, and our Ansible-driven server and OS fleet spans six countries

How we work together:
You’ll join our Infrastructure Engineering team of around 15 people, working from our Malmö HQ, Gjuteriet, with international colleagues working remotely. English is our working language, and Swedish is a bonus.
There’s no mandatory on-call rotation, although Compute and Storage have an informal secondary list. You’ll have real ownership from day one, with plenty of room to identify, propose, and implement improvements. We also use Claude Code across Engineering, and you’ll help explore how it can support our platform work.
About you
You treat automation as the direction and repetition as its trigger, you factor in risk from the start rather than discovering it at the end, and you're pragmatic enough to do the manual work until automation catches up.
We're looking for:

Real operational depth in distributed or enterprise storage - a system you've run in production, been on the hook for, and debugged under pressure. Which system matters far less than how deeply

Strong Linux fundamentals - the substrate everything else sits on

Comfort taking an unclear problem, scoping it, and seeing it through

We strongly value experience with Ceph or object storage at scale, Ansible or similar configuration management, and operating systems across distributed environments. Experience with on-prem Kubernetes, server/OS lifecycle management, or firmware, BIOS, and BMC/IPMI is also a plus.
We’re looking for someone at a mid-to-senior level, with growth focused on deeper expertise, broader ownership, and becoming the go-to person for storage across the organisation.
Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!

At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English. 
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Emil Nilsson, Engineering Manager emil.nilsson@telavox.com. 
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of the platform that powers our data products, from real-time APIs our customers depend on to the batch pipelines behind our analytics. You'll work across a lambda architecture that combines a low-latency streaming layer built in Go with a batch layer on Google Cloud, running on infrastructure spread across AWS, Azure, and GCP in regions around the world.
This is a hands-on senior role with real technical leadership. Beyond building and maintaining the platform, you'll set the bar for engineering quality on the team, shape how we design services so they stay modular and scalable as we grow, and act as tech lead and mentor for junior engineers.
Build and evolve the data platform
Develop and maintain our real-time layer, including the Go-based gateway and processing engine that serve customer-facing workloads with high availability and low latency.
Own and improve the batch layer on GCP, working with BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt to deliver reliable, well-modelled, and cost-efficient pipelines.
Keep the speed and batch layers consistent with each other, making sure data is correct, reconcilable, and trustworthy regardless of which path it takes.

Design and ship customer-facing backend services
Design, build, and operate backend APIs that customers use directly, with strong attention to contracts, versioning, performance, and backwards compatibility.
Think through failure modes, observability, and scaling up front, so services behave predictably in production.

Own multi-cloud infrastructure
Manage and evolve our infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP in multiple global regions using Terraform.
Improve how we structure infrastructure code through reusable modules, sensible environment separation, and safe, repeatable deployments.
Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, security, and cost visibility across clouds. Participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems.

Raise the bar on engineering excellence
Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation.
Lead technical design discussions and write clear design documents for significant changes, bringing the team along in the reasoning.
Identify technical debt and architectural weak points and build a pragmatic plan to address them alongside feature work.

Lead and mentor
Serve as tech lead for the team, guiding technical direction and helping prioritize work (this role has no direct reports).
Mentor two junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and gradually increasing ownership, helping them grow into confident, independent engineers.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant professional experience as a software or data engineer (typically 6+ years), including time spent owning production systems end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean and modular design, testing strategies, API design, and an understanding of distributed systems trade-offs.
Experience building and operating backend services in a compiled or typed language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, or similar.
Hands-on experience with a modern data stack, ideally BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt or close equivalents.
Solid experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider in depth.
Familiarity with both real-time/streaming and batch data processing patterns, and the challenges of combining them.
A track record of mentoring others and raising the quality of the teams you've been part of.
Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to engineers of varying experience.

Nice to have
Professional experience with Go. This is a strong plus, though we'll happily support an experienced backend engineer in going deep on it.
Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions, including networking, identity, and data residency considerations.
Background with lambda or kappa architectures, event streaming systems (such as Kafka or Pub/Sub), or high-throughput API gateways.
Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) and cloud cost optimization.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This is a hybrid role based in Stockholm, Sweden, and reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​
All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. JOIN US​
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
This position is based in Stockholm so you will be required to relocate if you do not already live here. You will report to the department Assortment Designer

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Är du den SO och svensklärare som kan inspirera våra elever på IES Norrtälje?

Gillar du att göra SO och svenska både tydligt och engagerande? Trivs du i en internationell skolmiljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas som både lärare och ledare? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!

Vi söker en legitimerad SO och svensklärare för årskurs 4–9, med planerad start i januari 2027. 

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Norrtälje öppnade 2024 och har idag omkring 520 elever i årskurs F–9. 

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi arbetar för att varje elev ska känna trygghet och trivsel i en lärande miljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga. Undervisningen i SO och svenska sker på svenska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personal.Det här erbjuder vi

Hos oss får du:

- En internationell och inspirerande arbetsplats där svenska och engelska används parallellt.
- Kollegor som samarbetar, stöttar varandra och arbetar mot gemensamma mål.
- En skola med studiero, tydliga rutiner och en positiv kultur som gynnar både elever och personal.
- Möjligheten att ingå i en väletablerad organisation där din kompetens tas tillvara.

- Heltidstjänst.

- Ferieanställning med tillträde januari 2027. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. Your role with us

IES Norrtalje continues to expand and with this increase in student volume we are now looking for an extraordinary person to work in the school as an ‘SO Lärare’. This role is one which requires a person who has the ability to multi-task´: One can find oneself working one on one with individuals and or with small groups in classrooms. Furthermore, we expect our SO teacher to follow the National Curriculum, teaching History, Geography, Religion and Civics, but also expect SO subjects to inform students about general good behaviour and the correlation between Humanities and life. All teachers at IESN act as mentors to 15 students and our academic expectations are very high. The suitable applicant needs to have the ability to engage with students across Mellanstadiet and Högstadiet and to believe in the IES ethos of good discipline, good manners and wherein going the extra mile to win is a given part of your inner characteristic. Experience, positively socialisation with young children and winning their confidence, would be desirable skills that a bilingual SO Lärare would supply in abundance. At IES Norrtalje engaging with students is not work, it is a calling!Vi söker dig som

- Har svensk lärarbehörighet för ovan nämnda ämnen och åldrar. 

- Är trygg i ditt professionella ledarskap och skapar en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet.

- Värdesätter och levererar ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med både kontroll och elevengagemang i fokus

- Är en entusiastisk och engagerad lärare med en stark vilja att bidra till både elevers och kollegors framgång.

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i skolan samt anpassa undervisning och arbeta tillsammans med elevhälsa och specialpedagoger.

- Känner dig bekväm med att undervisa och kommunicera både på svenska och engelska.Varför välja oss?

Hos oss blir du del av en engagerad och varm arbetsgemenskap där glädje, professionalism och samarbete går hand i hand. Du får chansen att göra verklig skillnad för elever – samtidigt som du får utvecklas i ditt yrke.

*För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/norrtalje/

Vill du vara med och inspirera framtidens matematiker och samtidigt ta nästa steg i din karriär?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt fantastiska team!

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats eller till peter-john.fyles.norrtalje@engelska.se så snart som möjligt.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
