Platform Team Lead
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
The Role:
The Platform team creates the foundations that help Netlight’s builders start faster, ship safely, and work with confidence. Its scope spans cloud landing zones, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, service-catalogue capabilities, and AI tooling. We are looking for a Team Lead who can help a senior team turn these components into a reliable, easy-to-use platform.
You will protect the health of today’s services while helping the team invest in what comes next: production-grade cloud environments, clear self-service paths, stronger operational practices, and practical AI-assisted development. You will report to the Head of Tech and work closely with Operations and technical teams across Netlight.
At Netlight, the Team Lead role combines Engineering Manager responsibilities – people, technology, and business impact – with Product Manager responsibilities: problem discovery, stakeholder management, and prioritisation. You set direction, remove blockers, and make trade-offs visible. Goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are shaped with the Head of Tech.

With your help, we want to:
- Make hard-won operational knowledge shared and documented, so reliability does not depend on one person’s memory.
- Develop Builder Experience Foundations into production-grade environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Build AI-platform tooling and workflows that help builders adopt AI-assisted development with confidence.
- Create clear standards, guardrails, and self-service onboarding so teams can build on solid foundations from day one.

Who you are
You can lead through ambiguity, turn competing needs into clear priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
- Strong prioritisation skills and a product mindset. You can balance operational requests, strategic investment, and team capacity.
- Experience building or running a platform as a product. You understand self-service, golden paths, service catalogues, clear ownership, and useful defaults – not only keeping infrastructure available.
- A self-directed, improvement-oriented mindset. You spot what can work better and turn that observation into focused action.
- A track record of advocating clearly for your team with leadership and stakeholders. You can challenge a commitment while keeping the conversation constructive.
- Strong communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs in business terms and turn business needs into choices engineers can act on.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:
- At least three years of experience leading software-engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, or a combination of these platforms. You do not need to be hands-on every day, but you should make informed calls and earn credibility with the team.
- A record of bringing structure to ambiguous, high-pressure situations and turning them into well-run operations.
- The ability to work from a Netlight office at least three days per week.
- Fluency in English.
- Swedish or German skills are a plus.

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer-infrastructure platforms.
- Experience working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group, team, or area.
- Direct experience with AI coding assistants or custom LLM-based developer tooling.
- Familiarity with cloud cost governance or FinOps.

What you will do:
You will lead a small, senior platform team responsible for cloud landing zones, AI tooling, and builder-experience components including monitoring, CI/CD, and service catalogue capabilities. The team wants to invest more energy in cloud and builder infrastructure. Your leadership will help it do that while keeping shared services dependable.
You will work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations, and technical teams. Your key responsibilities will be to:
- Team leadership and development: Set direction, coach, and grow engineers. Build an environment where ideas, risks, and concerns surface early and feedback leads to action.
- Operational oversight: Maintain a clear view of cloud and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including GitLab and CI/CD. Build documentation and knowledge-sharing practices that make the platform resilient by design.
- Planning and execution: Shape the cloud-infrastructure and AI-platform roadmap. Balance stability work with the ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and guide the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling where it creates value.
- Communication and collaboration: Represent the team’s needs and constraints upward. Involve the team before making commitments that affect its scope, capacity, or working conditions.
- Culture and engagement: Build trust through consistency. Close the loop on feedback, follow through on commitments, and make room for different perspectives.

What we offer:
- The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
- Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
- Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
- A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
- Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
- Mental health & parental support offerings
- 30 days of paid vacation.

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
- Deutschlandticket
- Wellpass

Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
- 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
- Private pension savings

About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.

Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.

Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you passionate about driving innovation and working on groundbreaking 5G and 6G mobile communication solutions? Do you thrive in a flexible working culture, where new insights are championed, and you are encouraged to develop new skills? Then join Ericsson and our team in Stockholm, Sweden. 
 We are looking for an FPGA Developer within the Ericsson Silicon organization. You will work with dedicated engineers passionate about developing world-class Radio and RAN Compute products. You will contribute to the FPGA team by developing and integrating high-performance FPGA solutions. 
 As part of our global organization, you'll collaborate with talented teams across our different sites. We are committed to Agile principles, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and teamwork. 
  
 What you will do:
  Design and implement FPGA-based Radio and RAN Compute solutions. 
   Develop and optimize FPGA designs for performance, power and cost-efficiency. 
   Apply industry-standard tools and methodologies for FPGA development and implementation. 
   Stay up to date with relevant FPGA technologies, tools and development methods. 
   Document design specifications, test procedures and results. 
   Participate in design reviews and contribute ideas to improve FPGA solutions. 
   Develop testbenches and test cases for your FPGA designs, following functional specifications, agreed verification plans and Ericsson development processes. 
   Use functional and code coverage results to identify verification gaps and meet agreed coverage targets. 
   Debug RTL issues found in simulation and on hardware, together with other designers. 
   Collaborate with hardware, software, systems and integration teams across Radio and RAN Compute development to understand product requirements and contribute to efficient solutions. 
   Contribute to the continuous improvement of products, tools and processes. 
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or equivalent. 
   3–5 years of experience in FPGA/ASIC development, including RTL design and verification. 
   Solid knowledge of FPGA technology, design environment and methodology. 
   Hands-on use of FPGA design tools (e.g., Vivado, Quartus, or similar). 
   Proficiency in a hardware description language (HDL) such as Verilog or VHDL. 
   Working knowledge of interfaces and protocols such as DDR, AXI4, PCIe, SPI or I2C. 
   Scripting skills, for example in Python, Tcl or shell scripting. 
   Ability to create RTL testbenches to verify your own designs. 
   Familiarity with hardware architecture and digital signal processing. 
   Knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM experience is a plus. 
   An analytical, results-oriented approach with the ability to manage priorities and meet agreed commitments. 
   Good English spoken and written communication skills. 
   Self-motivation and the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with others. 
   Experience collaborating across teams and sites.

Key Requirements:
Degree in Quantity Surveying or Construction Cost Management. 
B.Sc. Construction Economics / Quantity Surveying with 4-5 years’ experience at Senior QS level
A proven track record in delivering complex projects on time and within budget
Chartered MSCSI / MRICS or embarking on the APC process
Time management and communication skills. 
Computer literacy and digital systems proficiency. Microsoft Office, Cubit / CostX, COINS
Reporting and administrative skills. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English 

As a Senior Quantity Surveyor, you will play a key role in the successful commercial delivery of projects, providing commercial leadership across cost management, contractual administration, and commercial governance. Through effective cost control, value management, procurement strategy, and commercial risk management, you will help drive strong commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Working closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, and other key stakeholders, you will support commercial decision-making across tendering, contract administration, commercial analysis, and project cost planning. Through collaboration and effective commercial management, you will contribute to positive commercial outcomes and the successful delivery of projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting to the Commercial Director, your key responsibilities may vary depending on the nature and stage of the project being worked on, but can include: 
Tendering & Contract Administration 
Prepare and manage tender documentation, bills of quantities, tender pricing information and contract-related commercial documentation. 
Analyse subcontractor quotations and support commercially sound appointment decisions. 

Cost Planning & Commercial Management 
Manage cost control, value management and commercial performance across assigned projects. 
Support valuations, payment assessments, final accounts and retention management. 

Procurement & Subcontractor Management 
Advise on procurement strategy and support the development and management of project procurement schedules. 
Manage subcontractor packages, including tendering, appointments, payments, claims and final accounts. 

Commercial Risk & Change Management 
Identify and assess commercial risks and support the development of appropriate mitigation measures. 
Identify and manage variations, contractual claims, delays and disruption in accordance with contract requirements. 

Commercial Reporting 
Prepare and support commercial reporting, including cost value reconciliation, cash flow, material and subcontractor cost updates. 

Contract Management 
Support the administration of main contracts and subcontract agreements, ensuring contractual requirements and procedures are appropriately followed. 

Team Support 
Mentor and support junior and project Quantity Surveyors.  

Key Skills: 
Cost management, value management, and commercial risk management skills. 
Procurement strategy and commercial planning skills. 
Contract administration and contractual claims management skills. 
Tendering, estimating, and commercial analysis skills. 
Subcontractor management, valuation, and payment administration skills. 
Commercial reporting and analytical skills. 
Feasibility assessment and commercial advisory skills.

Role Purpose
Drive the optimization of metallurgical processes across the aluminium extrusion value chain. 
Ensure consistent product quality and strengthen operational excellence through expertise in alloys, heat treatment, and process performance. Collaborate with research, operations, commercial teams, customers, institutes, and universities to solve technical challenges and develop advanced aluminium extrusion solutions.
What you will be doing
Provide metallurgical expertise for aluminium extrusion operations, including casting, homogenization, extrusion, quenching, stretching, and aging
Develop, evaluate, and qualify new alloys, process technologies, and extrusion products
Develop and optimize alloy performance for mechanical and functional properties, extrusion productivity, and sustainability
Collaborate with production teams to establish process standards and best practices
Support customer projects with technical expertise and metallurgical guidance
Support root cause analysis and problem-solving for quality issues related to alloy selection, mechanical properties, and geometrical stability
Conduct metallurgical investigations, laboratory testing, and failure analyses
Prepare technical reports, specifications, and customer documentation
Ensure work is performed in compliance with the Hydro Quality system, HSE regulations, policies, and standardized operating procedures
Perform other tasks assigned by the responsible manager that support the operation of the unit and comply with applicable laws and company rules
Comply with area-specific customer requirements

What will make you successful?
PhD or Master’s degree in Physical Metallurgy, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline
Strong knowledge of aluminium alloys
Knowledge of heat treatment, precipitation hardening, recrystallization, grain structure control, and mechanical property development
Familiarity with metallography, microscopy, hardness testing, tensile testing, quality systems, ISO standards, and customer qualification requirements is preferred
Experience in aluminium extrusion, aluminium processing, or a metallurgical manufacturing environment
Practical experience with metallurgical testing and analysis techniques
Experience with automotive, building systems, industrial, electrical, or renewable energy applications is preferred
Knowledge of adjacent fields such as corrosion, extrusion simulation, or process modelling is an advantage
Familiarity with data analytics tools, including Power BI and Python, is an asset
Fluent English and Swedish both written and spoken
Curious, data-driven, and motivated to solve complex technical challenges
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to combine deep metallurgical knowledge with practical manufacturing understanding
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
Able to work effectively with research, operational, commercial, customer, and academic partners
Focused on measurable improvements in product performance, quality, operational efficiency, and customer success

What we offer you
A high-impact role in advanced manufacturing projects
Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies
International collaboration and exposure across sites
A dynamic and hands-on technical environment
Autonomy and responsibility in driving process improvements
Travel opportunities and involvement in on-site operations
A strong culture of quality, safety, and continuous learning

Your role

The team plays a critical role in enabling and supporting one of Atlas Copco's strategic software platforms, providing the infrastructure, tools, and expertise needed to develop the next generation of connected products.
 
This is a leadership role where your success will be measured by your ability to develop people, create structure, drive continuous improvement, and ensure delivery in a business-critical environment.

Managing recruitment, competence development, and resource planning

Experience working with agile teams and Scrum methodologies

As a person, you are structured, collaborative, and able to balance operational priorities with long-term development. Your job location

Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

Manage strategic sourcing activities and commercial negotiations.

Your profile
You are commercially minded, results-oriented and comfortable working with complex challenges. You identify opportunities, propose practical solutions and constructively challenge established approaches.
You build effective working relationships and bring integrity, accountability and a collaborative approach to your work. You can manage several projects simultaneously, set clear priorities and deliver against agreed objectives. You also take an active interest in developing your skills.
Your background

A university degree in business or engineering, or equivalent qualifications.

Two to five years of experience in commercial and/or engineering roles, including commercial negotiations.

Relevant legal knowledge, particularly in relation to purchasing and contracts.

Strong business judgement and the ability to organise your work and meet deadlines.

Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
Be part of the medical technology revolution – Neko Health is expanding and looking for talented assistant nurses to join our team. Are you ready for an exciting career where you can make a real difference? This is your chance to become part of our dynamic team and help shape the exciting journey ahead!
In this role you will be at the center of our mission. Based at one of our futuristic Neko Health clinics in Central Stockholm, your main tasks will be to carry out examinations, collect clinical research data, take blood samples, analyse blood samples, and handle administrative documentation. You will be a key person in ensuring the smooth operation and high quality of our activities. You will work closely in teams with other skilled medical operators and experienced professionals, but you will also have the opportunity to take initiative and work independently.
We are looking for full-time assistant nurses who are comfortable working a variety of shifts, including daytime, evening, and Saturday shifts. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month.
Minimum Qualifications
Relevant healthcare education as an assistant nurse.
Clinical skills: Confident in performing ECGs and blood sampling. Minimum of one year of clinical experience.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal structures, brackets and installation solutions, pneumatic components and installations, component packaging, and chassis integration. Experience in at least one of these areas is required, while broader experience spanning multiple areas is advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components, brackets, and installation solutions for heavy-duty vehicle chassis.
Produce and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5 and applicable design standards.
Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.
Develop solutions involving sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components, with consideration for manufacturing feasibility.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical and engineering documentation.
Provide technical support to production when required.
Independently plan and drive assigned design activities while contributing to technical knowledge sharing within the team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
CAD: CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or pneumatic system design.
Engineering analysis: Practical experience with tolerance analysis and the management of mechanical interfaces.
Vehicle integration: Understanding of component packaging, installation constraints, and chassis integration.
Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Development environment: Previous R&D experience involving heavy-duty vehicle development.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous research and development experience from heavy-duty vehicle development, hands-on CATIA V5 competence, and a strong background in sheet metal and/or pneumatic design. Previous experience with chassis design and installation for heavy-duty vehicles is advantageous, as is experience combining several of the relevant technical disciplines. The role requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Fluency in English is required.

Technical Lead – Active Chassis Systems
At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and delivering the products of tomorrow for the world's leading manufacturers.
We are currently looking for a Embedded Software Engineer to join a highly innovative team developing next-generation Active Chassis and Suspension Systems for future vehicle platforms. About the Assignment
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing software for advanced suspension systems. You will collaborate closely with software developers, system engineers, safety engineers, and test engineers, contributing throughout the software development lifecycle from concept to validation.
Main Responsibilities
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will:
Develop application software in C++ and middleware software in C for active chassis and suspension systems.

Contribute to software development for both dedicated ECUs and centralized vehicle computing platforms.

Collaborate with system, safety, and test engineers in a cross-functional environment.

Support integration, testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities.

Participate in the development of control algorithms and supporting toolchains.

Contribute to software quality, performance, and safety throughout the development process.

Drive technical improvements and continuous development of products and processes.

Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of experience in C++ (C++11/C++14) and/or C (C90/C99) development.

Minimum 5 years of experience in real-time embedded software development.

Experience within the automotive industry.

Experience working with AUTOSAR.

Knowledge of automotive communication protocols, including: CAN, Automotive Ethernet, Experience with UDS (Unified Diagnostic Services).

Experience using Vector tools such as: CANoe, CANalyzer, vTESTstudio

Knowledge of low-level embedded protocols: SPI, UART, PWM, DIO, PSI5

Experience with HIL systems and real-time simulation environments.

Knowledge of ISO 26262 Functional Safety implementation.

Familiarity with automotive cybersecurity standards.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on, then we would love to hear from you.

DevSecOps Consultant
Who are we?
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.
Job description
Join Amaris Consulting as a DevSecOps Consultant in Gothenburg and contribute to a strategic project for one of our clients in the automotive sector. Within a Cyber Security Expert Team, the role focuses on supporting development and platform teams with security expertise, governance, and practical DevSecOps practices across cloud, application, and platform environments.
Your missions
Provide operational security support to development and platform teams on security questions, findings, incidents, and risk assessments.
Support the integration of automated security controls, scanning, and policies into development lifecycles and CI/CD pipelines.
Contribute to secure design and implementation across cloud environments, applications, and container-based platforms.
Assist teams with vulnerability handling, third-party dependency management, and software supply chain security practices.
Coach development and platform teams on practical security measures that support delivery speed and reliability.
Apply established security best practices, benchmarks, and governance standards across technical environments.
Share knowledge within the Cyber Security Expert Team to improve ways of working and common practices.
Contribute to the development of security standards, guidelines, and reusable approaches across the organization.

Your profile
Experience in application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, or security engineering within development or platform environments.
Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms and core services, including compute, identity, networking, logging, and monitoring.
Experience with vulnerability management, secure development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and security automation.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent.
Knowledge of container orchestration platforms, code scanning, artifact scanning, and dependency governance is a plus.
Familiarity with common security and compliance frameworks is a plus.
Academic background in cybersecurity, computer science, software development, information systems, or a related field is appreciated.
English fluent. Swedish is a plus.
Strong analytical and structured mindset, with the ability to work independently in complex technical environments.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

In this role, you will manage daily IT operations and security tasks for our customer. You will support employees with their technical needs, manage cloud platforms, and ensure the organization's technical setup remains secure and aligned with industry standards.
You are offered
This is a flexible, part-time position (50% / 20 hours per week) perfect for students or junior professionals looking to gain hands-on IT experience. It offers a highly adaptable schedule (mornings or afternoons) and a supportive environment to learn and grow.

A dual-focus role handling first-line helpdesk support and essential IT security tasks to keep daily office operations running securely and smoothly.

Professional proficiency in English.

Supportive
Social
Orderly
Responsible

Join Midsummer as a Production Operator at our production facility in Järfälla. You'll work with the manufacturing of our lightweight and flexible solar panels, supporting efficient production and consistent product quality.
This is a role for someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in quality and is interested in technology and manufacturing. You'll work closely with your colleagues in production and contribute to stable processes and daily operations.
Please note that we are primarily recruiting for our evening shift.

What you'll be doing
As we rotate between different workstations and production steps, your tasks may vary over time. Depending on your workstation, the role may include:

Operating and monitoring automated and semi-automated production processes

Manufacturing and assembling solar cells and solar panels throughout different stages of production

Working with small components that require precision and attention to detail

Performing quality checks and documenting production results

Monitoring processes and reporting deviations

Following work instructions, procedures and safety routines

Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient production flow

Supporting continuous improvements within the production team

The role requires you to work both independently and as part of a team while taking ownership of your responsibilities following your training period.

What we're looking for
An interest in technology and the ability to understand manufacturing processes

The ability to read, understand and follow technical instructions and work procedures

A structured and quality-focused way of working

Fluency in English, both written and spoken

The ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Previous experience from industrial production, assembly work, manufacturing environments or other roles involving precision and quality control is considered advantageous.
Technical, industrial or scientific education is also considered advantageous.

Who you are
You're reliable, responsible and quality conscious. You work in a structured manner, follow established procedures and take ownership of your work.
You have a safety-focused mindset and understand the importance of following routines and maintaining high quality standards. At the same time, you're a team player with good collaboration skills, adaptable to changing priorities and interested in technology and production.
Most importantly, you're motivated to learn, contribute and grow as part of the production team.

About Midsummer
Midsummer is a Swedish solar energy company that develops and manufactures lightweight, flexible solar cells with a carbon footprint approximately 90% lower than traditional solar panels. We control the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished products.
In addition to our own production, Midsummer develops and supplies complete manufacturing systems for flexible thin-film solar cells to customers around the world.
By joining Midsummer, you'll become part of a team contributing to the production of solar technology while working in an international and collaborative environment.

The key responsibility of the Quality Control technician is for  receiving  and analyzing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Research & Development, Testing & Validation, and Production using a range of instruments as well as participating in problem solving and technical troubleshooting exercises on the execution side.   
Key Responsibilities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Execute work instructions and participate in laboratory functions/tasks/work.   
Follow 5S and safety protocols within the production and laboratory work environment.  
Conduct analysis on a wide range of instruments and report data/results for a diverse set of samples in the expected template and/or Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS); and maintain control charts.  
Able to understand and execute testing and validation plans for incoming parts, product intermediates, finalized products, and other material accordingly. 
Identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Be able to troubleshoot basic to advance problems; utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Understand the fundamental principles of method development and/or method validation and able to participate in the execution.   
Able to write support documentation for standard operations.  
Maintaining instruments and measurement areas to a high standard, involving responsibility to ensure that the laboratory or production room(s)/area(s) comply with safety related guidelines, 5S guidelines, maintaining consumable inventory and instrument readiness.  
Able to train and qualifying personnel according to a skill and competence level.  
Strict adherence to Quality Assurance and Quality Control Principles.   
Participate in improvement plans and investigations for various topics.   

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
Bachelor´s degree or master’s degree in a technical field is preferred.  
2 years experience in quality control from relevant industry is preferred.  
Specific knowledge in any relevant instrumentation, measurement system, or scientific field used by the company. (preferred)  
Familiar with quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, Total Quality Management (TQM). 
Familiar with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plan (CP), Lean, Six Sigma, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. (Preferred)  
Curious, technically educated and preferably with a strong business background.  
Experience in Cell Manufacturing, or Test and Validation is an advantage.  

 Specific skills & Knowledge 
Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.

jobs.description:
Join our team and help shape the future of sustainable transport solutions. We are seeking an Electrical Engineer with experience in cable harness routing design to support the development of new vehicle platforms and products. In this role, you will design and optimize cable harness routing solutions that meet functional, manufacturing, serviceability, quality, and cost requirements while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development process.

Collaborate closely with Android, Web, Product, Design to ship the right solutions

Ship to the App Store and monitor what happens after release

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

Maintain and improve the overall health of the iOS platform

5+ years building iOS apps

Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Comfortable maintaining and modernizing legacy Objective-C

Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM-C, VIPER)

Shipped production iOS apps to the App Store, including post-release monitoring

Experience with REST and/or GraphQL, with solid error handling and async patterns

Write unit tests, cover edge cases, and give code reviews that favor simple solutions

Work effectively with AI coding tools

Good English (we write and speak it all day)

Worked on large, mature products

jobs.occupation: R&D Senior Engineer for System Design
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Join our HVDC R&D team at Hitachi Energy and help pioneer the future of energy transmission. We are now looking for a R&D Senior Engineer to contribute to the development of advanced control strategies for HVDC systems, including Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) and Line Commutated Converter (LCC) technologies. This is a unique opportunity to work in a global, collaborative environment focused on innovation and technical excellence.
In this role, you will design and optimize control algorithms for MMC- and LCC-based HVDC systems, including multiterminal HVDC (MTDC) configurations. You will also perform small-signal stability analysis, harmonic studies, and transient simulations to ensure robust and reliable system performance. A key part of your responsibilities will be to lead system-level dynamic performance evaluations and drive continuous improvements in control strategies. Additionally, you will mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, helping shape the future direction of HVDC control systems and power electronics design.
How You Will Make an Impact
Contribute to converter topology design, control and protection, and main circuit development for VSC HVDC and LCC HVDC systems.
Perform insulation coordination, steady-state and dynamic stability studies, harmonic analysis, and performances under various conditions.
Address evolving customer requirements with a strong stakeholder focus.
Uphold our core values of safety, integrity, and responsibility.
Collaborate in a supportive and agile team environment.
Take ownership of both technology and your personal development.

Your Background
PhD or MSc in Power Systems, Electrical Machines and Drives, or Power Electronics Control.
Several years of experience in HVDC or FACTS technologies.
Strong knowledge of MMC topologies and HVDC control systems.
Experience in small-signal stability analysis and transient simulations.
Skilled in simulation tools: MATLAB, PSCAD/EMTDC, EMTP-RV, and ideally Modelica, RTDS, Python, C/C++.
Open-minded, solution-oriented, and collaborative with strong organizational skills.
Proficiency in English is required

What we offer 
Collective agreement

Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden

Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

Help Scale the Manufacturing Platform Behind Next-Generation AI Technology

Define automation requirements and manage equipment selection and integration.

Establish process control systems to meet customer and quality requirements.

Drive continuous improvement in yield, quality, productivity and operational performance.

Support factory design, production line development, commissioning and ramp-up.

Collaborate with R&D, Production, Quality and Supply Chain teams to ensure successful industrialisation.

Build and develop a high-performing process engineering capability.

Minimum 10 years' experience in automation process engineering, industrialisation or advanced manufacturing.

Proven experience scaling manufacturing operations from pilot production to mass production.

Strong expertise in factory automation, process engineering and industrial process control.

Hands-on experience in production line design, commissioning and optimisation.

Experience working with automation suppliers and system integrators.

Strong leadership, project management and stakeholder management skills.

Semiconductors

Electronics manufacturing

Other high-tech industrial environments

This is an opportunity to play a key role in building the manufacturing platform required to support next-generation AI infrastructure and advanced electronics.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage early applications.

Influence uptime, efficiency and future system design.

Strengthened automation performance and process stability.

Successfully supported the commissioning of new production equipment.

Provide technical guidance on embedded software, ECU/platform integration, software component design, and system-level dependencies.
Apply AUTOSAR architectural principles and support alignment between software architecture, platform configuration, and integration needs.
Coordinate technical dependencies and interfaces between development, integration, verification, quality, and other relevant engineering teams.
Identify, assess, and manage technical risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; escalate critical topics with clear impact analysis and proposed options.
Lead or coordinate technical investigations, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex platform issues.
Promote software quality, maintainability, reuse, robustness, and integration efficiency throughout the development lifecycle.
Support integration planning, technical readiness reviews, release preparation, and resolution of issues affecting delivery milestones.
Encourage continuous improvement in engineering practices, automation, development workflows, and technical governance.
Ensure technical documentation is accurate, accessible, and maintained, and support knowledge transfer across teams.
Provide clear technical status, risks, decisions, and recommendations to program and engineering stakeholders.

 
Department/Project Description
The Platform Technical Lead is responsible for overall technical coordination, architectural alignment, and technical quality across platform maintenance and development activities. The role ensures that technical decisions, designs, interfaces, and implementation approaches remain consistent with agreed platform architecture, engineering standards, and delivery objectives. Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Utilising our high-resolution skin scanning and AI technology, you'll play a key role in early detection and management of skin conditions. Leveraging your expertise to educate patients about their cardiovascular risks, you will foster a proactive approach to heart health. Surrounded by a clinical team who's passionate about preventive healthcare and functional medicine, you'll join a ground-breaking organisation that values excellence, promotes work-life balance, and offers professional growth opportunities in the realms of dermatology, preventative healthcare, health technology and AI.
We are looking for doctors who can work from 17 hours per week up to full-time in shifts. Available shifts: daytime, evenings, and Saturdays. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month. The remaining shifts are as agreed.

Translate complex diagnostic results into actionable insights.
Craft personalised plans for lifestyle change to improve health outcomes.
Offer holistic advice on a spectrum of health conditions.
Liaise with our members' doctors for seamless patient care coordination.
Collaborate with our multidisciplinary team to coordinate and improve patient care.
Stay abreast of the latest developments in medical diagnostics and preventive health.
Champion patient education, inspiring proactive health management.
Contribute to clinical quality improvement activity.
Participate in our research programs.
Collaborate with teams across Neko to develop and improve our technology.

Minimum Qualifications
You are a registered doctor.

You enjoy a fast pace, are confident in your role, and challenges excite you.
You are compelled to deliver high-quality results in everything you do.
You are curious and dedicated to continuous learning.
You have a solution-oriented mindset.
You speak fluent in both Swedish and English.

Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, or automotive environments.

Would you like to help build a growing executive search and specialist recruitment business in the Nordic defence and security sector?

In this role, you will develop client relationships, identify new business opportunities and lead recruitment assignments for organisations operating in a fast-growing and highly competitive industry. You will work closely with both clients and candidates, building a strong understanding of their needs and the people who can help move their organisations forward.

You will take ownership of your market and have the opportunity to shape your own position. This means staying close to the industry, learning continuously and taking an active role in conversations with companies and candidates across the Nordics and internationally.

The role combines business development with the delivery of high-quality search assignments.

PROFILE

You are curious about the defence and security sector and genuinely motivated to understand the industry, its organisations and the people who work in it. Previous experience from the defence industry is not essential. What matters is that you are keen to learn, read up on the sector and enjoy building relationships with people who work in complex and important fields.

You are confident in client-facing situations and able to earn trust in a demanding environment. You take responsibility, put the client first and understand the importance of careful, professional relationship management with both clients and candidates. - Experience in a commercial, consulting, recruitment or other client-facing role
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills
- A genuine interest in people and in developing a deep understanding of the industries you serve
- A proactive, accountable and curious approach to your work
- The ability to communicate fluently in Swedish and English
- A valid B-category driving licence

Defence Executive is being built as a Nordic executive search and specialist recruitment business focused on the defence and security sector. About the role:
As a Lead Product Assurance Engineer – Space at APR Technologies you will own the Product Assurance and compliance framework for our space products and projects. You will provide independent oversight from design and supplier selection through manufacturing, qualification, acceptance and delivery, ensuring reliable, traceable and compliant flight hardware.

Key responsibilities:

Establish project Product Assurance plans, compliance matrices, deliverables and identify applicable standards.

Review specifications, drawings, manufacturing records, test plans, qualification evidence and End Item Data Packs.

Ensure configuration and change control, critical-item control, traceability and product conformity.

Monitor quality trends, systematic or safety-related defects, continuity risks and export-compliance evidence.

Experience from working with Product Assurance in at least one space project.

We are looking for a Network Infrastructure Manager for a consultancy assignment that will start as soon as possible and last 12 months in Solna.

Operational coordination and lifecycle execution for telecom sites and data center infrastructure in assigned countries.

Implementation coordination for site growth, end-of-life equipment replacement, telecom equipment installation and customer infrastructure installation.
Support OSP implementation.

Maintenance governance, planned works coordination and local incident escalation for infrastructure-related site issues.
Vendor, contractor, site provider and engineering partner coordination for assigned countries and sites.
Infrastructure data quality, network inventory accuracy, documentation and reporting in relevant systems, inventory and reporting systems.

Support to bids, solution design, delivery, product development, service assurance and customer care processes with site infrastructure inputs.

jobs.occupation: We are looking for an Experienced Hardware Lead Engineer!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about high-performance electronics, embedded systems, and cutting-edge engine technology? Join our client’s innovative engineering team where your expertise in hardware design will directly impact next-generation technology. Apply today, as we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Our client is a specialist and market leader in advanced electronic engine management systems, Vessel/Vehicle control systems and Power distribution modules. They develop the hardware and software that optimizes performance, reduces fuel consumption, and lowers emissions for everything from marine and automotive applications to industrial engines running on renewable fuels and next- generation hybrid/electric systems with a legacy of high-octane motorsport.
As a Hardware Engineer, you will play an important role creating next-generation Electronic Control Units (ECUs). You will join a collaborative, highly technical engineering team where your work has a direct impact. Your market will be truly global, supporting customers across the EU, US, India, and the UK from initial specification all the way to mass production.
Work tasks
In this role, you will own the hardware development lifecycle. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality products on time and within scope. Your main responsibilities will include:
Group Lead: Work with daily planning and cost estimations and follow up of deliverables.
HW System Engineering: Designing an efficient System/ ECU layout to reaach safety, Performance and cost demands. This includes understanding the ECU outside environment and Performance requirements.
Future Concept: Define Next generation HW module solutions.
End-to-End Hardware Design: Developing specifications, schematics, component configurations, and PCB designs for advanced ECUs.
Documentation & Strategy: Creating Bill of Materials (BOM) and documented design strategies, including hardware design descriptions and precise calculations.
Design Verification: Ensuring technical excellence through rigorous testing and verification phases.
Customer Collaboration: Acting as a technical bridge for clients worldwide. This includes understanding their needs, supporting them from prototyping to certification, and occasionally traveling to client sites to help implement the products firsthand.

We are looking for
A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a similar field
A few years of experience in Hardware Engineering – preferably within a company in the automotive industry
Previous experience as a group Lead – daily planning and follow up of deliverables
Solid knowledge of embedded systems hardware
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken

It is meritorious if you have experience in:
Power electronics development
Emotor control
Unmanned Vessels/Vehicles
Low level software: HardWare InterFace (HWIF) and eTPU coding
Establishing and maintaining customer relations

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced and confident Project Manager is required for a consulting assignment focused on establishing a receiving organisation for long-term service management and continued development following a major transformation programme. The programme involves significant changes to system support, processes and ways of working.
A feasibility study has mapped deliveries, systems, processes and existing management structures. The Project Manager will take ownership of its outcomes, prioritise identified gaps, and translate recommendations into a concrete, practical and executable implementation plan.
The role focuses on organisational establishment, business transformation and the transition from a programme structure to a line organisation. The assignment requires the creation of clear accountability, mandates and process ownership, ensuring that the appropriate capabilities, resources, governance and service-management processes are in place before handover.

Take over and assess the results of the feasibility study, including mapped deliveries, systems, processes and existing management structures.
Prioritise organisational, operational and technical gaps and convert recommendations into an actionable delivery and implementation plan.
Establish a receiving organisation capable of supporting long-term management and continued development after programme completion.
Define responsibilities, decision-making mandates, process ownership and organisational interfaces for the future operating model.
Ensure that required competencies, resources, governance structures and service-management processes are established ahead of the handover.
Lead cross-functional change initiatives involving business stakeholders, IT, service management, service desk functions, programme management and external suppliers.
Manage dependencies, drive decisions and create progress within a complex organisation where responsibilities and organisational interfaces are still being defined.
Balance organisational and technical requirements against business value, cost, resource needs and long-term sustainability.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Strong experience in Project Management for business development, IT, transformation and organisational change initiatives.
Experience with ITIL or other established IT Service Management frameworks.
Ability to establish governance models, operating structures, process ownership and service-management capabilities.
Experience translating feasibility studies, assessments and mapping activities into decisions, implementation plans and operational execution.
Understanding of the interaction between business operations, IT, service management, service desk functions and external suppliers.
Experience managing cross-functional dependencies and organisational transition activities in large, complex environments.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate has documented senior-level experience in project management within business development, IT, transformation and organisational change. Previous experience establishing receiving organisations, service-management organisations or equivalent structures in large and complex enterprises is required. The candidate should be able to turn analysis and identified needs into effective organisational structures, governance and working methods, while driving alignment and progress in environments with unclear or evolving responsibilities and mandates.
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and good written and spoken English are required.

jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. Are you a specialist in pathology looking for a role where you can combine advanced diagnostics with a balanced lifestyle?
We are currently seeking specialist surgical pathologists to join a modern and accredited department in central Sweden, located in a region known for its coastal setting, rich history, and strong connection to nature.
About the Department
The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.
The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.
In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:
Gynecological screening programs
Autopsy services and morgue operations
Multidisciplinary clinical conferences
You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.
Your role
As a specialist surgical pathologist, your work will include:
Diagnostic work in histopathology and cytology
Gross examination and specimen handling
Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
Autopsy
Supervising and mentoring residents

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
Experience in surgical pathology
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?
This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:
Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round
A rich industrial and cultural heritage
A safe and family-friendly environment
Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities
The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
Apply now!

jobs.description:
Join a high-performance engineering environment where you will tackle complex logic and massive datasets. Our client leverages custom database structures and heavy algorithms to drive innovation in scalable backend architecture. Apply today as we use ongoing selection.
About the role
Our client is a well-established, technology-driven organization where deep engineering is at the heart of what they build. From a proprietary search engine to advanced cybersecurity solutions, their products are built to handle massive amounts of data and deliver actionable insights in real time.  Their R&D, engineering, and data centers are located in Sweden, headquarters in London, and teams across the US, the company operates on a truly global scale.
Together with our client, we are looking for a motivated C# .NET Developer to join their core engine team, currently consisting of four developers. Here, you will work on the systems that power the platform’s high-volume, near-real-time data processing. You will design and develop scalable backend services and APIs, working closely with data ingestion, search, and indexing technologies. Performance, reliability, scalability, and clean architecture are central to the role, and you will have a real opportunity to influence technical decisions as the platform continues to evolve. You will work in an agile and highly collaborative environment alongside experienced engineers. Most importantly, your work will have a direct impact: the systems you build will help security teams around the world detect and act on critical cyber intelligence.
Work tasks
Design and implement distributed and scalable backend solutions using C# .NET.  
Manage and process large datasets through efficient data pipelines.  
Own the performance and health of our databases and data structures.  
Maintain and evolve the company's proprietary in-house database structures and search engines.  
Build and optimize robust integrations between diverse systems and data sources.  
Leverage modern AI tools in your daily workflow as part of the company-wide AI-first mindset.  
Maintain and optimize existing codebase while actively driving new feature development and modernization initiatives.  
Move between fast-paced integration work and deeper architectural design as the platform evolves.

We are looking for
Platform/support mindset, self-directedness, or production ownership
A couple years experience and advanced knowledge of C# .NET development.
Good knowledge of databases SQL and/or postgres, search engines such as ElasticSearch.
Pragmatic approach to AI with an eagerness to adopt AI-assisted development tools.
Previous experience with one or more of Crawlers, Indexing or Search and Information Retrieval.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

It is meritorious if you have experience in Python.

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Experience with databases, SQL, ERP systems (such as SAP), and programming.

Want to take new light technology from the lab out into the world?
About us
LunaLEC is a Swedish deep tech company that has mastered printed light. Just like text on a newspaper, the light-emitting structure is printed, forming a thin, patterned, flexible device. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) technology is built on 30 years of research, during which the team behind LunaLEC became the first in the world to fully print a light source. The technology is protected by several patents.
We are now taking the LEC technology from the lab to large-scale roll-to-roll production. This is your opportunity to be part of it from the start and build something significant, as well as working with technology that is not yet on the market. It is a pivotal stage for the company, and you could get the chance to lead it.
About the role
As Process Engineer, you will be the one who takes our process from the lab to industry. You will transfer today's sheet-to-sheet manufacturing to roll-to-roll and build the network of partners who will handle production, from substrates and printing to lamination and quality control. You will work closely with a team with deep expertise in the materials and the technology, while contributing with your experience in production. The role is new, and you will have a strong say in how it takes shape.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and owning the scale-up of our production from sheet-to-sheet to roll-to-roll
Implementing and optimising our processes in production environments with partners and in existing facilities
Leading the collaboration with our production partners and taking part in customer and partner demos as well as EU projects
Being responsible for quality, routines and compliance in production
Travelling internationally to implement and follow up production on site

We believe that you…
…hold a Master of Science in Engineering, for example in materials engineering, chemical engineering or physics. You have experience of production, roll-to-roll and process development. Experience of scaling a production process, solution based device fabrication at scale and printed electronics are merits. You communicate fluently in English.
As a person, you are driven, solution-oriented and enjoy taking responsibility. You take ownership of your areas and have a business-oriented mindset. Above all, you want to help build something new and see a unique technology reach the market.
We offer
🚀 The opportunity to become a valued part of a deep tech company on its way out into the world
💡 Plenty of room to make an impact and build a completely new function from the ground up
🌍 An international and dedicated team
✈️ International assignments and close collaboration with customers and partners
About the position
Employment type: Permanent (with an initial 6-month probationary period)
Start: By agreement
Scope: Full-time
Location: Umeå preferred, but remote work with regular visits to Umeå is possible. International travel is part of the role

Read more about us at www.lunalec.com

jobs.description:
Job description: 
Industrial painting, surface preparation and protective coating work on offshore oil and gas installations in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea. Typical work includes abrasive blasting, water jetting, coating application by airless spray / brush / roller, stripe coating, and application or repair of epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), including Chartek systems. Work is performed in accordance with project specifications, coating procedures, HSE requirements and client quality standards.

Requirements: 
- Minimum 2 years of relevant, documented experience in industrial painting and surface treatment.
- Hands-on experience with surface preparation, including abrasive blasting and/or high-pressure water jetting, and application of protective coating systems.
- Documented experience with epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), preferably Chartek or equivalent systems.
- Experience with NORSOK M-501 or equivalent offshore coating requirements is an advantage.
- Trade certificate (fagbrev) in industrial painting/surface treatment is an advantage. Candidates without a trade certificate must meet §13 or equivalent site-test competence requirements, where applicable.
- Minimum B1 level in a Scandinavian language: Norwegian, Swedish or Danish.
- Before offshore mobilisation, candidates must meet the assignment-specific requirements for recognised basic safety/emergency training and a valid offshore medical certificate. Exact certificate requirements will be confirmed during recruitment.
- Strong HSE awareness, quality focus, reliability and ability to work effectively in multicultural project teams.

Type of work contract: 
Permanent employment with JJS ProsjektPartner AS, subject to the applicable probationary period. Offshore assignments are normally organised on a 2 weeks on / 4 weeks off rotation, subject to client and project requirements.

Starting date: 
Expected start: 01.01.2027. Exact mobilisation date to be agreed with the selected candidate.

Working hours: 
Typical 2/4 offshore rotation: 14 days on / 28 days off, normally 12-hour shifts (168 working hours per 6-week rotation cycle), subject to the assignment schedule.

Place of work: 
Offshore installations in the Norwegian sector of the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS), depending on assignment.

Salary: 
Salary and applicable supplements in accordance with the relevant Norwegian collective agreement (tariff) and assignment-specific terms.

Other information: 
ProsjektPartner coordinates assignment-related travel and accommodation. Selected candidates will receive guidance on mobilisation, required documentation and client-specific courses. ProsjektPartner can assist with selected training through companies in NSE Gruppen.

About the company: 
JJS ProsjektPartner AS is a Norwegian staffing company specialising in qualified personnel for complex industrial projects, both onshore and offshore. With roots dating back to 2003 and as part of NSE Gruppen, we provide experienced professionals within industrial painting and surface treatment, insulation and cladding, scaffolding, and mechanical trades. Our focus is to supply the right competence at the right time, with high standards for HSE, quality and reliable project execution.

How to apply? 
Send your CV and relevant trade/certificate documentation to marco@propartner.no. Please include a short summary of your surface-treatment, offshore and PFP/Chartek experience. You may also call +47 975 92 360.

Contact: 
Marco Scharin
+47 975 92 360
marco@propartner.no

Marco speaks both Finnish, Norwegian and English, and Finnish-speaking candidates are welcome to contact him directly in Finnish.

Bannerflow is a fast-growing global SaaS company building a Creative Intelligence Platform that enables enterprise brands to predict, create, and optimize advertising across channels. We're on a company-wide AI transformation journey, where AI and agentic workflows are becoming a core part of how we build and sell, with high expectations on adoption across all teams.
We're now strengthening our Sales team for the next phase of the business and are looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) who gets energy from who gets energy from starting new conversations with prospects and building pipeline, not just booking meetings.
Where first conversations turn into pipeline
We're seeking an experienced, structured and ambitious SDR to join our growing sales team. You'll play a key role in prospecting and generating qualified leads to support our commercial success. As our SDR, you'll work collaboratively with Account Executives, engage with prospects across international markets, and help drive our growth across both new and existing regions.
You bring a structured and ambitious approach to outbound, a genuine curiosity about enterprise buyers, and a knack for turning a cold conversation into a qualified opportunity. You know how to use data and the right tools to work smarter, not just harder.
What you actually will do

Generate and nurture Sales Qualified Leads, especially in complex and enterprise-level sales cycles.

Educate potential customers about the value of Bannerflow's SaaS platform.

Use tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Cognism, and our CRM to manage leads and pipeline effectively.

Stay informed about industry trends to bring relevant insights back to the team.

Who you are
We're looking for someone self-driven and AI-native, comfortable using AI to make their prospecting and workflows more impactful and efficient. You bring a start-up/scale-up mentality, and you're happy to pitch in on projects that fall slightly outside a traditional SDR role.
You're a strong fit if:

You have 1.5+ years of SDR experience, ideally in a SaaS environment with enterprise-level complexity.

You thrive in a fast-paced setting, are goal-oriented, and take full ownership of your work.

You communicate fluently in English, and any additional European languages are a major plus.

You're excited by international sales and working with prospects across multiple markets.

You're known for being a proactive team player with a sense of responsibility and strong personal drive.

Why join us?
We live alongside our values of Collaboration, Passion, and Challenge; with many events going on at Bannerflow such as padel tournaments, webinars, Friday beers, and Level-up Hackathons, there's something for everyone.
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
We offer a hybrid workplace and a competitive compensation package including pension according to ITP1, health allowance, parental leave top-up, and health care insurance.
Sound like you? We'd love to hear how you'd bring energy, structure, and curiosity to our team.  Apply now and become part of our journey!

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a driven Customer Success Specialist to support our Benelux operations.
About the Role
In this hybrid role, you will bridge relationship management with active credit risk assessment. You will manage incoming SMB loan applications, conduct financial health checks, and guide Dutch-speaking business owners through their lending journey, ensuring both strong customer satisfaction and healthy portfolio quality.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate and process standard-to-mid complexity SMB loan applications using our risk frameworks and credit data.

Act as the main consultative contact for business applicants in Dutch, guiding them through underwriting and closing deals.

Analyze financial statements, cash flow patterns, and credit reports to verify deal quality and risk profiles.

Collaborate with senior underwriters on complex, high-ticket cases that require customized financing structures.

Act as a voice of the customer, sharing insights to continuously improve our product and localized operational processes.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a commercially driven, analytical team player who understands business finance and loves solving problems for entrepreneurs. You possess strong interpersonal skills, carry an eye for numerical detail, and are eager to take clear ownership of SMB credit applications.
Qualifications
A few years experience in Customer Success, B2B account management, strategic lending, or credit processing within Banking, Fintech, or Financial Services.

Hands-on familiarity with evaluating financial statements, corporate documents, and credit scoring models.

Native or professional fluency in Dutch, combined with strong professional English.

A structured approach, good business acumen, and a keen interest in SMB financing models.

Strong communication and negotiation skills with a drive to help small businesses succeed.

Detail-oriented, comfortable working with data, and skilled at prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Why Qred?
This role offers a clear path to fast-track your career in commercial lending and fintech. Qred operates with a non-bureaucratic structure, short decision paths, and a high-performing culture where initiative is rewarded. You will take true ownership of your portfolio while deepening your credit and financial expertise alongside top industry talent.
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach with the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis, and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

Accountability/Authorization

Direct reports: No

Educational background and previous experience required for the role.

5+ years of work experience as a health and safety engineer, specialist or coordinator. 
Strong knowledge and experience with Swedish health and safety legislation, rules, regulations, and reporting processes. 
Good knowledge of data analysis and risk assessment methods.
Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
Experience in the battery manufacturing industry is a plus.

Specific skills
Excellent English written and oral skills, Swedish is a plus.
Highly organized and result driven.
Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as independently.
