Qualities that we cherish are flexibility, sense of quality, friendliness, motivation to take on new challenges

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We are now looking for a Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for developing Hacksaw Studios’ own games, bringing together expertise from different functions.
The Role
In this role, you will plan, coordinate, and support game projects from concept through to release. You will act as a central point of coordination between departments, helping teams stay aligned and ensuring that projects meet their timelines, quality standards, and creative goals.
Your key responsibilities include:
Taking ownership of assigned game projects, from initial planning through execution and delivery.
Creating and maintaining project plans, schedules, milestones, and priorities in our project management system.
Coordinating across functions to ensure an efficient workflow and alignment on project scope, goals, responsibilities, and deadlines.
Monitoring progress, quality, risks, and potential blockers, and supporting the teams in resolving issues proactively.
Facilitating project kick-offs, milestone check-ins, reviews, and other relevant meetings.
Keeping the Team Lead and relevant stakeholders informed about project progress, changes, risks, and key decisions.
Participating in review and feedback cycles to ensure consistency and high-quality deliverables.
Identifying improvements to workflows and tools that strengthen quality, efficiency, and collaboration.
Staying up to date with industry trends, game development practices, and player preferences.

What We’re Looking For
Experience in project management or production, ideally involving several projects or workstreams simultaneously.
A structured, organized, and proactive approach to your work.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and create clarity around responsibilities, priorities, and deadlines.
A collaborative mindset and the confidence to take ownership of assigned project areas.
The ability to identify risks and proactively seek guidance or clarification when needed.
Openness to feedback and a willingness to continuously develop your ways of working.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Nice to Have
Experience in the gaming or iGaming industry.
Experience coordinating creative and technical teams.
Familiarity with game development processes and project management tools.
Experience in or a strong interest in technology. 
A personal interest in games and game development.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
The opportunity to work with experienced and passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The chance to help create games played by a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

Practical Details
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?
Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

Bus Driver – Northern Sweden
With approximately 15,000 employees across four countries, we are the Nordic region's largest public transport company. Every day, one million people choose to travel more sustainably with us. Together with our passengers and clients, we have a unique opportunity to make a difference, through responsible sustainability and innovative thinking that contributes to more fossil-free journeys. Together, we move society forward every day. Read more at www.nobina.se
Traffic area Norrbotten consists of approximately 150 employees, and we operate around 70 buses every day. Together with our client Länstrafiken Norrbotten, we are responsible for operating and developing bus services in area Boden/Luleå/Piteå/Älvsbyn.
Personal qualities and qualifications
As a bus driver at Nobina, you are sociable, flexible and enjoy meeting people. You handle stressful situations in a calm and confident manner and always drive safely and with environmentally awareness. In this role, you take responsibility for both passengers and the vehicle, in line with the Nobina Driver standard and our passenger promise. This means that you:

Welcome passengers and provide the information they need for a safe and positive journey

Drive safely, comfortably and with a green mindset, following all traffic regulations

Take care of the bus and report any damage or risks you notice

Contribute to a good working environment and collaborate with colleagues

Stay up to date and participate in required training

We are looking for someone who:

Has the right to work in Sweden (EU citizenship or a valid Swedish work permit)

Holds a Category D driving licence and a valid CPC/YKB (Code 95) issued in an EU/EEA country

Has a valid driver card (tachograph card)

Has at least 1 year of professional bus-driving experience within the last 3 years

Has communicative English skills

Is willing to work shifts, including mornings, evenings and weekends

Is motivated to learn Swedish.

What do we offer?

Salary according to Swedish collective agreement

Temporary accommodation on arrival (small fee)

Health and social insurance

Free job-specific Swedish training

Full operational training

Support with relocation and formalities

EU/EEA driving experience recognised for salary placement

Fixed-term or permanent employment

As a new employee at Nobina, you will receive a thorough introduction and the opportunity for continued skills development.
As part of the recruitment process, digital tests are carried out. The tests are sent to you by email. Before you are offered a job with us, you will be asked to complete a health examination.
Why Nobina?
At Nobina, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where every employee feels valued. Our leaders take responsibility, make courageous decisions, and consistently embrace an outside-in perspective to meet the needs of our passengers. By being business-driven and focusing on the bigger picture, we strive to develop our operations and create sustainable solutions for today and the future. In a coaching way, we are engaging. Our culture is built on respect, care, and responsibility, and we constantly seek new perspectives to drive innovation.
Welcome with your application!

Are you a university student who wants to pave the way for young professionals in the cybersecurity sector? Do you want to bridge the gap between students and their dream career? If so, we want you to become a Student Ambassador for Orange Cyberdefense!

Student Ambassadors are a direct link from Orange Cyberdefense to junior talent. You equip fellow young professionals with opportunities and skills to pursue a career in cybersecurity. This is your way of contributing to our vision: to help secure the digital society. By helping junior talent grow, we are making this vision come true.

You will belong to a team of multiple Student Ambassadors from different schools led by a coach. Your main task is to help us develop, plan, and carry out student-oriented events and employer branding activities. You also have the freedom to initiate your own projects and events. The role entails about 10-20 hours of work per month, is unpaid, and is compatible with full-time studies.

Examples of responsibilities include:

Plan and carry out student-oriented events with other Student Ambassadors, such as student after-works, educational workshops, and on-campus activities.

Accompany Orange Cyberdefense to security meetups and fairs.

Create material for cybersecurity workshops and networking events.

Assist us in developing and marketing educational activities, networking events, and employer branding campaigns.

Represent Orange Cyberdefense on your university campus and at career fairs.

Who are you?
You must live up to the following requirements:

You want to contribute to our vision and help junior cybersecurity talent grow.

You are currently a student at a Swedish university or higher vocational school in Gothenburg, or near Gothenburg.

You are available for 10-20 hours a month from autumn 2026 through spring 2027, and will continue to be a student during this period.

You are capable and willing to take initiatives and drive projects forward.

You share and embody our core values: Simplicity, Humble, Innovation, Respect and Trust.

You are fluent in both Swedish and English

The following characteristics are desirable, but not mandatory:

Cybersecurity or a related topic is your main field of study.

You are interested in marketing, employer branding, and similar fields.

Who are we?
Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to help secure the digital society. We provide our customers with services across a wide range of areas, from advanced technical solutions to strategic services such as security governance, risk management frameworks, and risk assessments. We are 400 colleagues in Sweden and 3,000 colleagues globally.

At Orange Cyberdefense, we are all different, but we share the same passion for cybersecurity—and that is our greatest strength. We are proud of our diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, and we firmly believe that creating solutions for everyone requires including everyone. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all applications are assessed fairly and equally.

The opportunity 
The HVDC System Design department is now searching for a highly motivated Simulation Model Engineer to join the team. As a Simulation model Engineer, you will have the chance to dive into the fascinating world of simulation, working on real-life applications that have a significant impact on the global transition to renewable energy resources through HVDC transmission connections. Joining our team means working alongside a group of highly skilled and passionate professionals from across the globe.
How you’ll make an impact 
Develop simulation models in different tools used for power system studies.
Develop tools to allow virtual representation of real-time control and protection system. 
Produce technical documentation and reports. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand different requirements and design solutions. 
Engage with customers throughout the process, from specification to final acceptance.
Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices related to simulation models and tools. 

Your Background 
Master's or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or a related field. 
5+ years experience with control/signal theory, dynamic modelling, or power system tools (for example PSCAD, PSSE, PowerFactory, PSLF, EMTP-RV, Hypersim, Dymola, PSS® NETOMAC, etc.) is required. 
Knowledge and/or interest in programming (C++, C#, Fortran, Python, MATLAB, Modelica). 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
Ability to work and solve problems independently and take own initiatives. 
Fluency in English is required, as you will be part of a company that operates on a global scale.

#LI-JL1

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 
Senior Production Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality of products and processes.  Works very closely with manufacturing and engineering to follow-up and improve processes to ensure a flawless transition into manufacturing and supplying of Li-Ion cells.  This role is the technical leader for specific processes, and is responsible for their performance and results, providing technical expertise and guidance to the team to reach targets assigned.   
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Lead quality assurance activities to ensure that production/product quality specifications are met.   
Lead and train quality team members and operations on quality standards and procedures.   
Perform onboarding, timesheets validation related to lead team members.   
Create Control plan and take part in FMEA analysis and facilitate continuous update of PFMEAs by working with multidisciplinary teams.   
Define and improve Work instructions and procedures for quality related activities.   
Monitor and analyse complex data with the help of statistical process control tools.   
Monitor and lead analysis of internal and external quality problems.   
Drive complex problem solving and root cause analysis.   
Drive quality improvement and optimization projects utilizing six sigma methodology.   
Transfer actions and lessons learned between products and production lines and integrate external lessons into preventive or corrective actions.   
Quality stakeholder in change management.   
Provide expert technology and quality knowledge of selected manufacturing processes.   
Define, improve, and validate results of the methods for MSA of the measurement equipment.  
Lead the team members on SPC, capability studies and quality process release and line release activities.   
Lead launch activities to ensure the deliverables of different projects.   
Report and mitigate safety relevant issues within the team in the appropriate system.   
Collaborate closely with Customer quality engineers to deliver required input to customer projects, e.g., PPAP documentation.   
Be part of equipment commissioning team and deliver acceptance testing and qualification milestones of new process equipment and installation of additional production lines. Quality stakeholder in process and product gate reviews.  

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively  supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
MSc or BSc degree in Chemical/Manufacturing/Engineering.   
6+ years of relevant work experience within high volume assembly/production, ideally in an operational role.   
Experience in Manufacturing quality in relevant industry. Experience in the battery/ automotive industry is a plus.   

Specific skills & Knowledge 
Leadership skills and a successful track record of leading quality improvement/six sigma projects in manufacturing and/or with suppliers.   
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.   
Knowledge of quality management systems, e.g., ISO 9001, IATF16949, TQM.   
Knowledgeable in SPC, process capability, FMEA, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology, Lean Six sigma and Statistics.

The opportunity
We’re Hiring: R&D Software Engineer | Hitachi Energy Do you want to develop software that helps power some of the world's most critical energy infrastructure? Join the MACH Infrastructure & Tools team at Hitachi Energy and work at the intersection of software engineering, industrial automation, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering team developing and evolving a strategically important in-house application used across our HVDC business. Unlike many corporate software roles, you'll have the opportunity to work across the complete software lifecycle and gain real ownership from day one.

jobs.occupation: Product Development Senior Engineer – Situational Safety
jobs.description:
Autoliv is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems. We develop, manufacture and market protective solutions such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for all major automotive manufacturers worldwide, along with advanced safety solutions for new mobility. In 2025, our products helped save approximately 40,000 lives and prevented around 600,000 serious injuries.
We are now looking for an experienced Product Development Senior Engineer to lead the development and execution of safety strategies for next-generation interior safety technologies. In this role, you will drive safety activities from concept through production release, working across engineering disciplines to deliver innovative solutions that help protect vehicle occupants worldwide. 
Role and Responsibilities

Define safety goals, hazard analyses, misuse scenarios, and mitigation strategies.

Lead the development and maintenance of safety cases, including claims, arguments, and supporting evidence.

Drive system architecture and safety decomposition for interior safety functions.

Establish safety milestones, release gates, and acceptance criteria.

Partner with Human Body Modeling & Simulation teams to translate insights into safety solutions.

Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, validation, human factors, and systems engineering.

Manage safety risks, escalations, audits, and customer assessments.

Align global requirements across Europe, North America, China, and Japan.

Support customer reviews and promote innovative interior safety technologies.

Bachelor's or master’s degree in engineering or a related field.

Deep understanding of occupant protection, safety mechanisms, and system-level design.

jobs.description:

At Smart High Tech, we are industrialising advanced graphene-based materials that enable next-generation AI systems, electronics and data centres.
As we scale production, thermal performance and equipment reliability become critical for quality, uptime and efficiency.
We are now looking for a Senior Maintenance Technician – Mechanical & Cooling Systems who will take ownership of this important area and help ensure stable, reliable and scalable production.

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical equipment, furnaces and cooling systems.

Troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and thermal systems.

Lead fault diagnosis related to cooling, temperature control and process stability.

Monitor temperature, pressure and flow systems.

Prevent and manage risks related to overheating, leakage and reduced cooling performance.

Maintain technical documentation and maintenance records.

Continuous Improvement
Drive root cause analysis and long-term corrective actions.

Apply preventive and predictive maintenance methods.

Improve equipment reliability, uptime and energy efficiency.

Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.

Support and mentor colleagues within the maintenance organisation.

Equipment & Industrialisation
Participate in the installation and commissioning of new production equipment.

Support FAT and SAT activities.

Validate cooling systems, thermal processes and mechanical functionality.

Ensure systems are operational before production start-up.

You will work closely with:

Facility & Maintenance Manager

Electrical & Automation Maintenance

Production & Engineering

External suppliers and equipment vendors

You are a hands-on technical specialist with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for operational reliability.
Required Qualifications
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Technology or similar.

F-Gas certification or equivalent refrigeration qualification.

Strong knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics and cooling systems.

Minimum 5 years of industrial maintenance experience.

Experience with thermal processes and industrial cooling equipment.

Knowledge of CMMS systems and structured maintenance practices.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience with reliability-centred or predictive maintenance.

Experience from semiconductor, electronics, advanced materials or process industries.

Knowledge of FAT, SAT and equipment commissioning.

Training in LOTO, pressurised systems and industrial safety standards.

Swedish language skills.

This is a role for someone who wants technical ownership in a high-performance manufacturing environment.

Own systems that directly impact product quality and production stability.

Work with advanced thermal and mechanical technologies.

Help scale a deep-tech factory from development to global production.

Influence uptime, efficiency and long-term operational performance.

Join a company solving real challenges in AI infrastructure and advanced electronics.

What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months, you have:

Improved cooling system reliability and production uptime.

Reduced equipment failures and unplanned downtime.

Increased energy efficiency and equipment lifetime.

Successfully supported commissioning of new production systems.

Do you want to help develop the next generation of connected products and digital platforms? Sigma Embedded Engineering is now looking for experienced Android Platform Engineers to join us in creating smart, connected, and sustainable solutions together with our clients.

Fluency in English (Swedish is a plus)

Meritorious experience

Curious and driven by technology, you are eager to learn and continuously grow within Android and embedded systems. You are a collaborative and communicative team player who takes ownership, works proactively, and builds strong relationships with colleagues and clients.

We offer
At Sigma Embedded Engineering, we believe in you and that together we can create the most exciting opportunities by building the workplace and environment we want to work in. Together, we also find assignments where you thrive and grow. We have assignments in everything from self-driving cars (ADAS), application development, Medtech, Active Safety, IoT, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, 5G, and algorithm development.

Who are we? We love doing things together and strive for a good balance between work and leisure. This could be after-work hangouts, events, sports activities, ski trips, or inspirational talks. We've been on many fun trips together, which have been fantastic, and something we want to continue doing.
Skills development has always been important to us, and in addition to growth opportunities within your consulting assignments and various technical trainings, we also have internal programs for personal development.

We are part of the Sigma Group As part of the Sigma Group, we offer the best of both worlds: stability and entrepreneurial spirit. Sigma consists of several companies within different technical competence areas and currently has over 5,000 employees and operations in many countries. This makes us Sweden’s largest privately-owned consulting group.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a Senior Oracle PL/SQL Developer for a long-term consulting assignment within a complex, business-critical IT environment. The consultant will join an experienced team responsible for the development and maintenance of databases and backend solutions.
This is a hands-on development role with a strong focus on Oracle PL/SQL, database-centric business logic, and transaction-intensive systems. The environment handles large data volumes, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows, with demanding requirements for stability, performance, and availability. A significant portion of the business logic is implemented directly in the database through SQL and stored procedures. Microservices developed in Java and .NET operate above the database layer and communicate with different business functions and external systems.
The position is specifically focused on Oracle PL/SQL development and business logic. It is not a traditional database administrator role and does not focus on Data Warehousing or Business Intelligence.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and enhance database functionality and business logic using Oracle PL/SQL and SQL.
Design and maintain stored procedures and other database-centric application components.
Troubleshoot database code and resolve issues in complex, transaction-intensive backend systems.
Analyze and optimize database performance across large-scale Oracle environments.
Work with high-volume data processing, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows.
Develop and maintain integrations and data flows between databases, microservices, external partners, and connected systems.
Collaborate closely with senior developers and architects on technical solutions, system enhancements, and improvements to existing platforms.
Understand complex business processes and translate functional requirements into reliable database-level implementations.
Contribute ideas, technical improvements, and knowledge sharing within a senior, international engineering team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Database platform: Extensive, current hands-on experience with Oracle Database and PL/SQL development.
Database programming: Advanced SQL skills, including stored procedures and database-centric programming.
Performance: Experience troubleshooting and optimizing code in large database environments with stringent performance and availability requirements.
Backend architecture: Experience working with complex, transaction-intensive backend systems and high-volume data processing.
Microservices: Understanding of microservices architecture and backend services developed with Java or .NET is advantageous.
Integrations: Experience implementing data flows and integrations with external partners and systems is advantageous.
Business systems: Experience with billing platforms, CRM solutions, or other business-critical transaction systems is beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience
The successful consultant will have substantial and recent practical experience in Oracle PL/SQL development, together with a strong understanding of SQL, stored procedures, business logic, and transaction flows. Experience diagnosing technical issues, improving performance, and solving problems in large Oracle environments is required. The role also requires the ability to work independently, take initiative, and quickly understand complex technical environments and interconnected business systems.
Previous experience in banking, financial services, energy, or another transaction-intensive industry is advantageous. The consultant should be comfortable collaborating with experienced developers and architects while contributing to technical discussions and continuous system improvement. Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.

Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for an experienced Back-End Developer to join our IAM engineering team in Stockholm, developing products for authentication, identity management and digital signing.
Working alongside experienced engineers, architects and product specialists, you will contribute to the continued evolution of established software products used by organisations across the public and private sectors.
About Clavister
Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.
The role
As a Back-End Developer in our IAM team, you will design, develop and maintain Java-based server-side software that supports secure authentication, identity management and digital signing.
You will work with established products that continue to evolve as customer needs, security requirements and technology change. This means balancing new functionality with reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
You will be part of a collaborative engineering team where technical discussions, shared ownership and continuous improvement are important parts of everyday work.
Key responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain Java-based backend services and applications.

Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions.

Develop secure, reliable and maintainable software with a focus on long-term product quality.

Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, including performance and reliability challenges.

Identify and address technical debt while balancing new development with improvements to existing products.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, Product Management and Customer Success to deliver customer value.

Contribute to engineering practices such as code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvement.

To thrive in this role we believe you have
Several years of professional experience in Java backend development and a strong understanding of the Java ecosystem.

Experience developing asynchronous or concurrent software.

Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.

Familiarity with both Windows and Linux environments.

An understanding of software design, maintainability and quality.

A collaborative mindset, curiosity and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges.

Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Extra points for
Experience with IAM, authentication, authorisation, identity management or digital signing solutions.

Experience designing and developing complex enterprise software products.

Familiarity with security-related technologies, protocols or integrations.

Frontend development experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript or React.

What we offer
Meaningful work developing cybersecurity products that protect digital identities and critical services.

The opportunity to work with experienced engineers on technically challenging, established software products.

A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning are encouraged.

The opportunity to influence technical solutions and contribute to the long-term evolution of our IAM portfolio.

A supportive team culture that values work–life balance and sustainable software development.

Join us
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, developing reliable software and contributing to products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.
The position is based in Stockholm. We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced ERP consultant and cross-functional process lead for a major business systems transformation. The organization has completed a current-state assessment and established a project organization to evaluate, procure, and introduce a new ERP solution.

The ERP scope covers both financial and operational processes, including installation projects, service orders, and product sales. The Process Lead will play a central role in coordinating business workstreams, maintaining an end-to-end perspective, and establishing a consistent way of working throughout the Selection and Discovery phases.

Lead and facilitate cross-functional forums throughout the Selection and Discovery phases.
Coordinate dependencies, handovers, and coherent end-to-end process flows across business workstreams.
Support business representatives in defining requirements based on use cases and business cases rather than existing processes or legacy system solutions.
Work with the Project Manager and ERP Architect to ensure that necessary decisions are documented and logged from an enterprise-wide perspective.
Ensure that business evaluation scenarios and demonstration scripts are complete and fit for purpose during Selection.
Coordinate and quality-assure business scenarios for the proof of concept during Discovery.
Maintain a cross-functional register of decisions, open questions, and risks together with the Project Manager and workstream leads.
Identify, describe, and present cross-functional challenges to the Project Manager and steering committee.
Provide project management guidance and support to business subproject managers and workstream owners.
Help establish the prerequisites for a structured, realistic, and robust ERP implementation plan.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Extensive experience with ERP selection, procurement, validation, and implementation initiatives.
Strong understanding of end-to-end business process design and cross-functional process dependencies.
Solid knowledge of order-to-cash processes.
Experience with project-oriented and service-oriented operational processes, including installation projects, service orders, and product sales.
Experience using a delivery model in which solution procurement is followed by structured validation and proof-of-concept activities.
Ability to translate business needs, use cases, and business cases into solution evaluation criteria and implementation requirements.
Experience maintaining decision, issue, dependency, and risk registers in complex transformation programs.

Qualifications & Experience

jobs.occupation: Telecom Data Scientist | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity    Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI  contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. 
  
 This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
      What you will do   You will join a dynamic and international environment where you’ll have the opportunity to learn, grow and make a real business impact. As part of the Applied Generative AI team, you will use data science, machine learning and generative AI to help transform Ericsson R&D from a development flow organized in separate disciplines into a connected, data-driven and AI-native way of working. You will:
  Translate Radio Access Network (RAN) and product-development challenges into data science and AI problems, define success measures, and evaluate results with engineering and domain teams.
 Make engineering information, including specifications, architecture, code, tests, logs and operational reports, useful and trustworthy for AI.
 Build data pipelines, knowledge systems and retrieval capabilities that connect engineering information in different formats.
 Experiment with and evaluate machine learning and generative AI, including large language models and AI-agent systems.
 Connect code, system knowledge and operational evidence to support work throughout development, verification, deployment, operation and troubleshooting.
 Help develop and assess AI models for Ericsson technologies and terminology with RAN specialists and users.
 Turn successful experiments into maintainable engineering capabilities, with attention to data quality, security, responsible AI, monitoring and human review.
  
 
 You will bringYou are curious and pragmatic, take initiative, ask questions and work well across disciplines. You combine a strong foundation in data science, machine learning and generative AI with knowledge of telecommunications or radio networks, and want to apply it to real product-development challenges. Experience in software or product development is an advantage.
  
 In addition, you have:
  MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, AI, machine learning, telecommunications, electrical or software engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
 Applied data science and machine-learning skills, including statistics, experimentation, model development and evaluation.
 Practical generative-AI experience in one or more areas such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model adaptation, AI agents or model evaluation.
 Knowledge of wireless communications or radio networks, and interest in building deeper RAN expertise.
 Hands-on programming and software-development experience, including work with complex data and reproducible analyses, models or pipelines.
 An understanding of how product development connects requirements, architecture, implementation, verification, release and maintenance.
 Analytical judgement, an experimental mindset, and the ability to explain uncertainty, model limitations and technical trade-offs.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, proficiency in English, and readiness to work in global, cross-functional teams.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer - ATLAS ITk Pixel Detector
jobs.description:
What you'll do
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing.

As a mechanical engineer in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment on the design, construction and installation of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer System.

Your responsibilities
-Design of precision tooling for the integration, testing and installation of the ITk Pixel Outer System Detector, comprising the Outer Barrel, Endcaps and Inner System Support Tube.
-Design and develop service installation procedures and tooling, including temporary service management solutions for testing of the ITk Pixel Detector.
-Verify the design of components and tooling according to the relevant standards and best engineering practices, performing both, analytical and numerical calculations.
-Develop, document and implement tools and procedures for integration and installation of detector components and services.
-Participate hands-on in the detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom as well as the preparation on surface and in the cavern for the installation.
-Prepare technical specifications for components and tools, following up their production, acceptance and installation.
-Support preparation of and participate in the ATLAS ID detector extraction.

Your profile
-Proven experience in the design of precision mechanical components and assembly tools for complex systems.
-Demonstrated experience in the use of CAD software for 3D modelling and management of large assemblies. Proficiency in Catia V5 would be a plus.
-Demonstrated experience in the production of 2D technical drawings according to the relevant standards for dimensioning and tolerances (e.g. ISO Geometrical Product Specifications, GPS).
-Proven hands-on experience in the construction and testing of mechanical systems.
-Demonstrated experience drafting technical specifications, assembly procedures and engineering reports.
-Experience with assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.
-Experience with structural joining techniques, particularly orbital welding is advantageous.
-Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
-Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
-Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).
-Integration of mechanical systems.
-Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.
-Knowledge and application of joining techniques, welding.
-Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
-Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements, adopting a pragmatic approach. Understands the value of adopting generic rather than 'gold -plated' technical solutions.
-Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships, but also works well autonomously. Takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role
As a Data Solutions Engineer, you will work with complex vehicle data and build reliable data flows that turn fragmented information into structured, high-quality data for our diagnostic products. You will work across the entire data flow, from ingestion and transformation to validation and delivery, with a strong focus on data quality, automation and scalable solutions.
You will play an important role in developing and maintaining the data pipelines that form the foundation of our diagnostic products. This position combines hands-on development with problem-solving and continuous improvement and you will work independently on technical solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, data developers and other teams across the organization.
Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.

Working with data ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery.

Ensuring data quality through automated testing and monitoring.

Identifying and resolving data errors, anomalies and pipeline issues.

Automating manual and repetitive data management processes.

Contributing to data modelling and cloud-based data solutions.

Translating technical requirements and vehicle protocols into reliable and useful datasets together with software developers, data developers and other stakeholders.

What you bring
We are looking for someone with solid experience in software development, data engineering or data solutions, who is comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation. You enjoy working hands-on and solving technical problems, while also being able to step back, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute your own ideas on technical solutions and ways of working.
A relevant university degree is an advantage, but your professional experience will be the most important factor.
We believe you have:

Solid experience in programming and software development, for example Python.

Experience working with data management, data transformation and/or data pipelines.

Experience working with structured data such as XML, JSON and APIs.

The ability to independently drive technical solutions and take ownership of your work.

Good Swedish and English skills, both spoken and written.

As a person, you are self-motivated, proactive and communicative. You take ownership and enjoy driving things forward, while contributing your own ideas on how technical solutions and processes can be improved. You work in a structured and quality-focused way and enjoy collaborating with people with different areas of expertise.
Application
In this recruitment process, Autocom is collaborating with Skill. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

ALTEN is seeking an engaged Embedded Developer to join our team in Sweden. You will work with a leading client in the Automotive industry, focusing on Driver Interaction systems in a hybrid setup. In this role, you will take ownership of the development process from start to finish: understanding user needs, implementing solutions, and ensuring quality in an Agile team environment.

What do we offer

A chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative projects

A dynamic and collaborative work environment

Opportunities for professional growth and career development

A role where you can make a real impact in the Automotive industry

About the role

You will be part of a team developing Driver Interaction systems, focusing on how drivers interact with the vehicle through displays, stalks, and switches. Your work will primarily involve Embedded C for core logic and C++/Qt for HMI visualization. The developed code will be integrated into the Instrument Cluster (Driver Information Module), which runs on a dual-processor architecture—one for AUTOSAR and another for Linux/Yocto with Qt.

You will collaborate in a Scrum team of around 6 people, including a dedicated Product Owner and Scrum Master. The team emphasizes continuous integration and automated regression testing, ensuring high-quality deliverables. Communication protocols like CAN, LIN, and Ethernet (SOME/IP, STOMP, display sharing) will be part of your daily work.

Your main responsibilities

Develop Embedded C code for core logic in Driver Interaction systems

Implement HMI visualization using C++/Qt

Work with AUTOSAR and ensure compliance with ISO 26262 requirements

Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum team to define and realize driver interaction features

Integrate and test software on a dual-processor architecture (AUTOSAR + Linux/Yocto)

Utilize communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet (SOME/IP, STOMP)

Participate in continuous integration and automated regression testing

Your profile

We are looking for a fast-learning, curious, and team-oriented developer with a strong background in Embedded C, AUTOSAR, and ISO 26262.

Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field

Proven experience in Embedded C development

Hands-on experience with AUTOSAR and ISO 26262 implementation

Experience with HMI development and driver interaction systems

Familiarity with C++/Qt for visualization

Fluent in English (Swedish is a plus)

About ALTEN

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

For the sixth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

You will work both independently and in close collaboration with project managers, contractors, and other professionals to ensure accuracy and quality throughout the various stages of each project.
Our projects are primarily based in the Stockholm area, but assignments may also take place in other locations throughout Sweden. Therefore, candidates must be flexible and willing and able to work outside Stockholm when required.

Previous experience as a Survey Technician or Survey Engineer within the construction or civil engineering industry.

Relevant technical education, such as a degree in Civil Engineering, Surveying, Geomatics, or a vocational qualification in surveying or geodesy.

Experience with modern surveying instruments and related software.

A valid Category B driving licence.

Good communication skills in Swedish or English, both written and spoken.

Experience working on infrastructure and large-scale civil engineering projects.

Knowledge of CAD, BIM, SBG Geo, MS Office, and AMA (Swedish construction specifications).

Experience with GNSS, total stations, and laser scanning, preferably using Leica or Trimble equipment.

Experience with quantity surveying, measurement-based quantity verification, and machine control systems.

Responsible and independent – able to manage your tasks effectively and take ownership of your work.

Detail-oriented and organised – committed to accuracy, precision, and high-quality results.

Solution-focused – capable of identifying challenges and developing practical solutions.

Communicative and team-oriented – comfortable collaborating with professionals from different disciplines.

Flexible and adaptable – willing to work across different projects, environments, and locations.

What We Offer
At Precisiona AB, you will have the opportunity to become part of a dedicated team within a growing company. We offer:
Diverse and challenging construction and civil engineering projects.

A collaborative working environment built on responsibility, professionalism, and technical expertise.

Opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility.

Competitive employment terms and conditions.

Opportunities to work on a variety of projects across Sweden.

How to Apply

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN).

Personal qualities:
Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.
A responsible, structured, and flexible approach to patient care.
The ability to remain calm and perform under pressure, handling stressful situations with a professional attitude.
Respect for patients’ individual needs and a compassionate approach to their care.
A strong desire to move to Norway and integrate into Norwegian society, bringing your family along for a rewarding experience.
A genuine passion for nursing, combined with a clear understanding of your professional responsibilities and limitations.
The ability to prioritize tasks and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.

What we offer:
Competitive salary packages and pension plans.
A permanent employment opportunity in a supportive and friendly environment.
A clear path for professional growth and development.
Free online Norwegian language courses with a private tutor to ease your transition.
Full assistance with obtaining Norwegian nursing authorization.
Comprehensive support with relocation logistics, including help with accommodation, schools, and childcare for your family.
Guidance from professional headhunters with 19 years of experience, who will assist you throughout the entire process.

Why choose Norway?
Norway is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world for quality of life. Our healthcare system is publicly funded, providing patients with excellent care while offering healthcare professionals a structured and rewarding work environment. 
Nurses in Norway benefit from clear career progression, strong support from interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to spend quality time with each patient, contributing to better health outcomes. In addition to professional growth, moving to Norway offers a chance to experience a high standard of living, with clean air, a focus on outdoor activities and a family-friendly environment.
If you see yourself thriving in this role and want to explore the possibilities of working in Norway, we encourage you to contact us. We look forward to guiding you through the next steps in your journey!

About the role
Victoria 3 is our grand strategy game about building a society through the 19th and early 20th centuries, from its economy and trade to its politics and the lives of its people. Our players debate tariffs, trade routes and voting reform with a passion few genres see, and we want someone who enjoys being in the middle of those conversations.
As Community Manager for Victoria 3, you are the voice of the game in the community and the voice of our players inside the team. You take part in discussions on the Paradox Forum and social media, front our streams and community activities, and make sure what players tell us reaches the people who make the game.
You work inside the Victoria 3 team at Paradox Development Studio Red, next to the designers, producers and developers who build the game. That puts you close to the decisions and gives you a direct role in shaping where the game goes next.
What you will do
Own the Victoria 3 Community Plan: set targets for reach, engagement and sentiment, and grow a healthy, inclusive community around the game.

Run all owned Victoria 3 channels, including the Paradox Forum, X, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram, as the voice of the brand.

Plan the content calendar and make sure dev diaries, announcements and patch notes go out on time.

Write copy for patch notes, campaign pages and other brand communication.

Turn community feedback into input the design and development teams can act on, and tell players what we did with it.

Measure how your content and campaigns perform, and report on reach, engagement and community sentiment to the team and our partners.

Coordinate announcements and campaigns with marketing, PR, partner management and performance marketing.

Lead the freelance Community Ambassadors who help you moderate and run the channels.

Take part in live streams, events and other community activities as one of the faces of Victoria 3.

What we are looking for
Experience building and nurturing audiences on social media, and creating engaging content for a consumer audience.

Strong copywriting and content creation skills.

Excellent proactive and reactive communication: you can plan a campaign and handle a heated thread with the same calm.

A deep understanding of and interest in video game culture and communities.

The ability to turn player feedback and channel data into clear conclusions.

Fluency in written and spoken English.

Nice to have
Experience playing Victoria 3 or other Paradox grand strategy games.

An interest in history, economics or politics.

Basic skills in Photoshop and video editing tools.

Practical information
Scope: Full time and permanent

Reports to: Studio Manager, Paradox Development Studio Red

Location: Stockholm, Sweden

Working at Paradox
At Paradox you join a result-driven, high-trust and player-centric culture. Our games and players take center stage, and our first priority is always to add player value. If you thrive on the opportunities this culture brings and know how to handle the challenges that come with it, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

The opportunity
Would you like to join our excellent team of Sub-Project Managers in HVDC System Engineering organization and have an impact on the goals and future business opportunities?
Then you may become one of our great colleagues and take on responsibility in a stimulating work environment. Together with the team you will work in cross-functional project groups to design and develop
HVDC systems. Working with us will offer you to grow your network internationally and open a multitude of career possibilities based on your interests and ambitions.
We are interested in learning more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don’t meet all requirements.
How you´ll make an impact
Supporting projects and tenders for HVDC System Design - managing the scope, budget and schedule while ensuring quality requirements are met.
Be ready to be proactive and apply your project management and analytical skills.
Interface with other departments in HVDC organization, representing your System Design team in project and tender meetings and discussions, also representing System Design in customer meetings.
Participate in technical design reviews and in technical problem solving.
Responsible for the technical coordination of System Design deliveries as well as managing the risks and identifying opportunities to reduce time and cost while ensuring quality requirements are met.
When you feel comfortable in the role you get the opportunity to manage complex projects on your own. In other words, your ambition is the foundation for your development opportunities!
Living Hitachi Energy’s Leadership Pillars as a leader which means live our vision, work together, deliver promises, and develop people.

Your background
You hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering preferably in Electric Power Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
HVDC system design knowledge is considered an asset.
You have good communication- and interpersonal skills.
You enjoy working in diverse and multicultural teams and are interested to share your experiences and knowledge with your colleagues as well as learn from them.
You are a flexible leader that enjoy problem solving and work in a structured way.
Fluency in English, additional languages are considered an asset.
Preferably, you have project management experience from working in engineering and are familiar with managing system delivery projects or tenders. HVDC system design project management experience is considered an asset.

Additional Information
Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today!

jobs.occupation: Commercial Contract Manager | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunityEricsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.
 The Excellerate track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across Sales, Commercial Management, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value.
 This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here.Your journey within the Excellerate Program will start as a Commercial Contract Manager in Business Area Networks Sales & Commercial Management!
 What you will do In this role, you will work together with a team of experienced, senior Contract Managers to handle complex and key contractual questions about the Networks Portfolio. In addition, you will contribute to the implementation of the Global Sales and Networks Contracting strategy, being part of shaping the future of contracting at Ericsson. You will also have the opportunity to engage in selected high-priority deals as a Business Area Contract Manager and ensure that lessons learned are captured and reused to evolve our contracting strategy. And as a member of the Sales Operations & Contract Management team, you will support and participate in strengthening the Contract Management community across Ericsson, including how we build competence and awareness across the wider organization.
 You will bring Joining the team will offer you an exciting journey through business and technology where you will learn, be able to challenge, take decisions and most importantly have a lot of fun! We believe you can challenge us in who we're looking for and believe you have an interest for business and commerical contract management combined with a technical interest in the telecommunications industry. 
 In addition, we believe you have:
  A master’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering & Management, or equivalent.
 Experience in Contract Management, Law or Project Management. Sales and Commerical roles can also be a relevant background.
 Strong analytics skills, ability to extract relevant information from large source material.
 Communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Understanding and awareness of Telecoms & Technology sectors and the role of Contracts in business.
 A global attitude and willingness to relocate internationally, with a desire and ability to work in a multicultural environment.
 Keen interest to learn new things and to broaden experience.
 Ability to collaborate, engage with and mobilize the organization to secure results.
 Solid presentation and communication skills, and proficiency in English.
  
We can promise you a steep learning curve, exciting tasks and close collaboration as a valued member of a strategically important team. Be the one who did.

A Snapshot of Your Day
In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and publishing machine, spare parts, and partner data in Energy Shop, ensuring high data quality and timely availability for users worldwide. You will act as the primary point of contact for Energy Shop-related questions, supporting internal stakeholders across different functions and helping them get the most value from the platform.
Your day will also involve supporting the testing, validation, and implementation of new features and enhancements, while monitoring and reporting on key performance indicators to drive continuous improvement.
 
How you’ll make a difference
Extract, validate, and manage data from source systems (including SAP).
Drive Energy Shop improvements by gathering requirements, prioritizing feedback, and collaborating with development teams.
Identify and resolve data quality issues, manage backlogs, and coordinate corrective actions.
Improve data quality, process efficiency, automation, and AI-supported workflows.
Collaborate across functions to improve data flows, standardize processes, and strengthen data governance.

What you bring
Experience with spare parts catalogs, product information systems, or e-commerce platforms.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Strong knowledge of master data management, data governance, and data quality principles.
Experience with SAP and managing large datasets.
Experience with requirements gathering, process improvement, or digital platform development is an advantage.
Proficiency in Excel; Power BI or similar analytical tools are a plus.
Knowledge of rotating equipment, gas turbines, or industrial service operations is beneficial.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Able to work independently, take ownership, and collaborate effectively in a global environment.
Fluent in English.

 
 
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 306185 not later than 2026-11-15
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.
We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced, hands-on Integration Specialist to support business-critical HR IT solutions within a complex enterprise environment. The assignment combines the development of new integrations, modernization of existing interfaces, and technical troubleshooting across an integration platform built on PostgreSQL.
The platform facilitates the exchange and transformation of employee, organizational, and other HR-related data between core HR systems and downstream applications covering payroll, time management, benefits, expense management, and analytics. The Integration Specialist will own solutions throughout the complete lifecycle, from technical analysis and design through implementation, testing, deployment, operational handover, and production maintenance.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, configure, and maintain enterprise integration solutions.
Translate functional requirements, field mappings, and business rules into technical implementations using PostgreSQL, SQL, Web APIs, web services, and file-based interfaces.
Implement data mapping, transformation, validation, filtering, routing logic, and reference data handling.
Analyze existing interfaces, data flows, system dependencies, and integration behavior.
Conduct integration testing, defect analysis, debugging, and technical troubleshooting.
Maintain and troubleshoot integrations operating in production environments.
Improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, monitoring, and data quality.
Prepare technical documentation and support deployments and operational handovers.
Apply secure integration practices related to data protection, access controls, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Independently drive technical delivery while collaborating with developers, solution architects, service managers, system owners, and business stakeholders.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Database and query technologies: Strong practical experience with PostgreSQL and SQL development.
Integration interfaces: Experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations through Web APIs, web services, and file-based interfaces such as SFTP.
Data formats: Practical experience working with structured formats including JSON and XML.
Integration engineering: Sound understanding of integration architecture, technical design, data mapping, transformations, validations, filtering, routing, and business-rule implementation.
Delivery lifecycle: Experience with integration testing, defect analysis, debugging, deployment, production support, and operational monitoring.
Security: Understanding of secure integration development, data protection, access controls, error handling, and appropriate monitoring.
Advantageous technologies: Experience with SQL-based integration platforms, integration middleware, comparable in-house solutions, JavaScript, or Groovy.
Engineering practices: Experience with Agile development methods, version control, and collaborative software development is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
Candidates must have at least three years of professional experience in hands-on integration development or a comparable technical development role. A relevant technical degree or equivalent professional experience is required, together with professional written and spoken English.
Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or other HR master-data integrations is advantageous. Additional merit will be given for experience integrating payroll, benefits, time-management, expense-management, analytics, or other HR applications, as well as knowledge of HR and payroll data structures, employee lifecycle processes, and organizational data dependencies. Swedish language proficiency is also advantageous.
The successful consultant should be capable of independently owning technical assignments from analysis through implementation and operational handover while working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Are you ready to be the central point of contact for transport and logistics in a groundbreaking industrial project? Do you thrive in managing complex supply flows, optimizing deliveries, and driving green energy forward? Then we have the perfect role for you!
 About the position

The position is located in Boden and involves key responsibility for all transport and logistics matters connected to their construction stream. Your daily tasks
As a Logistics Specialist, you will be the focal point for the supply chain, ensuring seamless and efficient transport of goods from the warehouse to handover with contractors. 
Main responsibilities:

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone with excellent interpersonal and communication skills who excels in a dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders. Is this a challenge you are ready to take on? We look forward to receiving your application – welcome to apply today!

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-06-30. Start 2026-11-09.
Let us help you take the next step in your career

 Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. We’re looking for a Product Developer RTW to join us on a 12-month parental leave cover. As one of three product developers, you’ll share ownership of the full product lifecycle for RTW across multiple categories, from sourcing and development through fittings, SMS, PPS and into production. Are you hands-on with quality, precise in the details and at your best as part of a team? Come join us.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

Oversee the full RTW product lifecycle from seasonal kick-off to shipment, with a focus on quality, on-time delivery and efficient bulk processes.

Lead fittings and make sure every product meets our quality standards.

Keep the critical path on track, aligning with other departments and suppliers so that all sample rounds and production land on time for key business dates.

Support pre-bookings, drop planning and capacity booking throughout the creation stages.

Keep PLM and internal systems up to date so cross-functional teams have the information they need.

Support supplier sourcing and counter-sourcing strategies together with the Head of Development & Production.

Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers.

Drive improvements in production delivery, quality and lead times.

ARE YOU THE ONE?
We seek people with most of the following:

A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

At least 3 years of experience in RTW product development, with 2 or more of those years within a brand.

A strong understanding of garment construction, techniques and fittings, including complex pieces.

Proficiency in MS Office, Adobe and PLM systems.

An analytical, structured and organized way of working.

A proactive approach to solving problems, with the ability to prioritize and coordinate several things at once.

Curiosity, adaptability and passion for product.

HERE'S HOW TO APPLY
If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.
Please apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.

DETAILS

Contract type: Full-time, 12-month parental leave cover, with the possibility of extension.

Location: Gothenburg HQ

A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO
Founded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset, modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach.
