Today, Axel Arigato continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.
Built on curiosity. Driven by connection.
OUR VALUES
Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our core values that we live and breathe. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

Job description
Are you a visionary software architect looking for a challenge that goes beyond standard app development? At Teledyne FLIR in Täby, we build the sensor systems and thermal cameras used globally in fire detection, industrial applications, and blue-light equipment. Now, we need your expertise to shape the brain inside these life-saving products.

We are on a journey to centralize and streamline our Linux-based product offerings into one robust, unified software platform. As our new Embedded Software Architect, you will own the long-term vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Android/AOSP-based platform.
This is a high-impact, strategic, and hands-on role. You will be the technical anchor for our R&D, tasked with balancing urgent product needs with sustainable, scalable, and reusable strategies. You won’t just maintain an architecture; you will define it.

What we offer you
True Autonomy: The mandate to define architectural principles and shape the future of our R&D.
A Collaborative Culture: You will work within a highly skilled, senior team of architects in an environment that values mentorship, continuous learning, and innovation.
Global Impact: The code you architect will run in critical systems used worldwide, making a tangible difference in commercial and government sectors.

Application:
Are you ready to take command of our platform architecture and drive innovation? We look forward to your application. Please note that this role is security-classified, and a security vetting process will be conducted as part of the recruitment. 

Responsibilities
Drive Platform Strategy: Own the long-term architectural vision for our software platform, balancing urgent product needs with sustainable, reusable strategies.
Lead Integration: Facilitate cross-functional synchronization across multiple teams to ensure scale, performance, and security.
Translate Requirements: Collaborate with product management to convert system and business needs into high-level platform technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Act as the primary spokesperson for the platform area, guiding engineering decisions and fostering a culture of technical excellence.
Drive Modernization: Lead the effort to centralize and streamline our Linux-based product offerings into a robust, unified platform.

Qualifications
We believe you thrive at the intersection of complex software, system engineering, and product development. You are a strategic problem-solver with a proven track record of leading technical decisions and successfully managing multiple product launches.
To succeed in this role, we see that you have:
Deep, hands-on expertise in Android platform architecture, AOSP, and embedded Linux.
A strong background in embedded software development and system integration.
The capacity to influence stakeholders and teams through clear, technical communication.
Fluency in English (professional proficiency in Swedish is a merit).
A relevant academic degree (e.g., M.Sc. in Computer Science/Engineering) OR equivalent deep, practical experience in the field.

About the company

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

About the Role
As a Senior Backend Engineer in the Orders team, you will shape the overall architecture, technical direction, and scalability of our core order-handling engine. The Orders domain is central to Instabee’s operations, processing deliveries for millions of consumers across Europe.
In this role, you’ll take on a high-leverage technical leadership position—driving architectural decisions, integrating modern technologies, and elevating engineering standards across our distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Architect Core Systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and resilience of our high-throughput order backbone.

Integrate AI & Modern Tech: Proactively adopt AI tools, LLMs, and smart automations to boost system capabilities and developer workflows.

Drive Strategy & Mentorship: Partner with product leaders to align tech roadmaps with business goals while coaching junior and mid-level engineers.

Continuous Optimization: Audit, refactor, and evolve our distributed microservices to ensure top-tier reliability and performance.

Collaborative Engineering: Champion technical excellence through high-standard code reviews, mob/pair programming, and shared ownership.

Your Future Team
The Orders team builds and maintains the core engine responsible for the end-to-end order lifecycle—from creation to successful delivery. Supported by an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and Staff Engineer, you will operate with high autonomy in a tight-knit, collaborative environment where your technical decisions carry direct, company-wide impact.
What We’re Looking For
Senior Backend Background: Solid track record of architecting and operating resilient, high-throughput distributed systems in production.

Core Stack: Deep, hands-on expertise in Node.js and TypeScript.

Databases: Advanced experience with MongoDB (or similar NoSQL/relational systems), including query optimization and schema design at scale.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and hands-on experience with GCP (or equivalent cloud environments).

AI-Forward Mindset: Practical curiosity for applying AI tooling and developer automations to streamline engineering and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership: Ability to take complex initiatives from concept to production while communicating architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical peers.

Fluency in English: Confident verbal and written communication.

(We value curiosity, problem-solving, and adaptability over ticking every single stack requirement on day one.)
What We Offer
Significant architectural ownership within one of the Nordics' most high-volume logistics platforms.

A culture of technical ambition, continuous learning, and minimal bureaucracy.

A supportive, senior engineering peer group focused on code quality and innovation.

Perks & Benefits:

🏢 Brand-New Office: Modern collaborative workspace in our new Stockholm HQ.

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Designated dog-friendly areas throughout the office.

🏓 Fun & Games: Foosball, shuffleboard, table tennis, and an in-house karaoke room.

👶 Parental Top-Up: 6 months of parental pay support.

🎂 Birthday Off: An extra paid day off each year to celebrate your birthday.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup: Flexible working hours tailored to balance life and work.

About Instabee
Formed in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox (uniting the Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy brands), Instabee provides seamless e-commerce deliveries to millions of consumers. We are growing quickly across the Nordics and continental Europe, building cutting-edge logistics technology that handles millions of parcels each week.
As part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden, mandatory confidential background checks are conducted via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys.

The Opportunity
Join a growing engineering team responsible for the plant electrical design of HVDC converter station projects. Based in Ludvika or Västerås, you will work with plant circuit and cable design, ensuring customer requirements are translated into compliant, high-quality engineering deliverables. Working closely with project teams, suppliers, and technical specialists, you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects from design through execution.

You are a self-motivated engineer who takes ownership of your work and enjoys solving technical challenges in collaboration with others. You thrive in a project environment where priorities can shift and where balancing quality, schedule, and technical requirements is essential.

How you’ll make an impact
Develop plant circuit and cable engineering designs for HVDC converter station projects.
Translate customer specifications and contractual requirements into compliant engineering deliverables.
Review and validate technical documentation from suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure technical and contractual compliance.
Apply established design principles, engineering standards, and available base solutions to meet project requirements.
Collaborate with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and technical specialists throughout project execution.
Identify and resolve technical issues, risks, and design deviations that may impact project delivery.
Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering methods, tools, and design documentation.

Your Background
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (electrical, mechanical, industrial, computer science) or a related technical field.
Proven experience in a technical engineering role, preferably within a project-based environment.
Ability to collaborate effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English.
A structured and proactive approach with a focus on quality, accuracy, and delivery.
Experience from the energy sector, power systems, HVDC, or other related industries is highly valued.

he laboratory team performs tasks including:

TL;DR You'll secure how Lovable works - the laptops, identities, SaaS apps, and AI tools 250+ Lovables use every day - without slowing anyone down.

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. 5+ years in corporate, enterprise, or endpoint security at a fast-growing tech company.
Deep expertise in identity (Google Workspace/Okta/Entra, SSO, SCIM, conditional access), MDM (Jamf/Kandji/Intune), and SaaS security posture (SSPM).
You can write code (Python, Bash, or Go) and treat policies as software - versioned, tested, deployed.
Strong instincts for IT risks such as phishing, social engineering, and insider risk - including the new AI-flavored variants.
Pragmatic about UX. You know when a control is real security and when it's just friction.
Bonus: experience securing AI tools and agents in the workplace (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, et al).
Bonus: experience managing hardware security keys

What you'll do
Own the security of Lovable's corporate environment: identity, endpoints, SaaS, email, and the AI tools we live in.
Roll out and maintain controls that scale - passkeys, device trust, conditional access, DLP, SSPM.
Run phishing, awareness, and tabletop programs that actually change behavior.
Work on Detection & Response to make detection of insider and account-takeover risk first-class.
Secure and optimise our diverse AI toolstack, including Lovable itself, working closely with the product team on feedback and iterations
Help the Security and GRC teams make least-privilege the default and auditability free.
Ensure the right data is surfaced to the right people, while implementing data classifications and reducing the risk of data loss

Our Stack
Devices: macOS, Linux, Kandji, Crowdstrike
Networking: Tailscale, Cloudflare, Meter, Unifi
IAM: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra

Comsys AB is a Swedish cleantech company based in Lund, developing advanced solutions for power quality and energy efficiency. Designing, building, and verifying prototypes

Collaborating closely with system, software, and mechanical engineers

Experience with active filters, variable frequency drives, or other power electronics is highly desirable.

Hands-on experience with laboratory work, testing, measurements, and troubleshooting

Experience with Altium Designer

Knowledge of EMC design and verification

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Jobbeskrivning
Company Story
 
Sigma Connectivity is a global tech house with all the resources needed to bring a product to market under one roof. We believe in investing in knowledge and education, making a positive impact on society and shaping a brighter future for all.
Through our core values, at Sigma Connectivity we create an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Our company culture promotes the freedom to explore new ideas and push the boundaries of what is possible.
Working with us means you will be working in an international environment with a diverse and inclusive atmosphere. We operate globally from 12 sites and have expert teams in North America, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, United Kingdom and Poland.
 
We are looking for a Senior System Architect!
In this role, you’ll translate client visions into robust blueprints for connected products, bridging hardware and software to define the project skeleton. As a part of the Industrialization & System Design team, you’ll own the end-to-end strategy for manufacturability, testability, and product launch—driving DFX (Design for Excellence, including DFM and DFT) directly into early PCB designs and defining test architectures from initial prototype validation through to mass production.
 
What we offer
High-Impact Engineering: Own the technical vision for complex, market-defining products from concept to high-volume manufacturing.
World-Class Team & Culture: Work alongside elite cross-functional engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.
Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct access to diverse, challenging hardware and IoT projects for leading global brands.
Autonomy & Influence: High visibility and direct influence over architectural decisions, client strategies, and design-for-test practices.

Work tasks
This role focuses on the early-stage design and technical leadership of industrialization projects, ensuring that hardware and software components are optimized for production and testing.
Architecture & Strategy: Lead system architecture definitions and create comprehensive production test strategies that balance quality, yield, schedule, and cost.
Requirements Breakdown: Convert product, hardware, and quality constraints into clear specifications, including System Requirement Specifications, Production Test Requirements, and Test Implementation Specs.
DFX & Risk Management: Review hardware schematics and PCB concepts early to identify manufacturability, testability, and reliability risks, driving proactive mitigations with R&D teams.
Test Architecture Definition: Define test coverage, interfaces, embedded test functionality, fixtures, measurement methods, and factory data traceability.
Cross-Functional & Client Leadership: Drive technical discussions and balance trade-offs with customers, EMS partners, suppliers, R&D, quality, and sourcing teams.
Mentorship: Guide engineering teams on best practices in systems engineering, hardware testability, and production deployment.

We are looking for someone with
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Engineering Physics, or equivalent practical background.
Proven experience working as a System Architect guiding complex electronic or embedded products from concept to production.
Proven background in production and manufacturing engineering, with strong practical experience bridging development and mass manufacturing environments.
Solid hardware depth to evaluate schematics, drive DFT/DFM improvements, and establish production test architectures alongside EMS partners.
Fluent English communication skills to present trade-offs, draft specifications, and align stakeholders

It is meritorious if you have
Experience with connected/IoT devices, wireless protocols, or embedded systems.
Exposure to end-of-line testing, RF validation, JTAG, or factory yield optimization.
Track record supporting customer proposals, SOWs, or technical pre-studies.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Social
Intellectually curious
Respectful

 
References
Reference checks are conducted as part of the recruitment process and may include both provided and independently identified professional references.

The Machine Learning group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for experienced students from the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme for a project focusing student retention through the mentoring and support of first year students in the programme.
 
 
You will have the opportunity to work together with other mentors and keep in contact with some senior staff, while getting the opportunity to:
Meet new people and refresh information from earlier courses
Improve your communication- and social skills
Gain leadership/mentoring experience

Job Duties
 
Typical job duties for this position will focus on tasks related to leadership and mentoring:
Organizing regular meetings with the mentee-group assigned to you, where you discuss their current challenges and questions
Having some hours set aside on a weekly basis in case one of your mentees would like to have an individual meeting/discussion
Advising students on who they can help/advise them in certain situations (if you cannot do so yourself)
Keeping in regular touch both with the mentees and other mentors

Qualifications
 
To be eligible for the position, you must be enrolled as a student in the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme of LTU. You must be in at least your second year of study and have some experience in mentoring (e.g. having had earlier meetings with the 1st year students during the first study period of the year). Hourly pay/renumeration
 
All assignments provide hourly pay and valuable work experience for your CV. The hourly rate depends on the complexity of the duties:

Information

jobs.occupation: Researcher in anaerobic microbiology, modelling and aI
jobs.description:
About the position
We are seeking a researcher in anaerobic microbiology with good technical and programming skills to work on a project related to mixotrophic gas fermentation. The aim of the project is to develop novel methods for enriching carbon-efficient microorganisms and characterising their metabolism.
Your background
We are looking for a candidate with practical experience in anaerobic microbiology and bioinformatics methods, such as the analysis of metagenomic sequencing data and metabolic modelling. Strong technical skills are also required, as the position involves the construction, further development and troubleshooting of bioreactors.
Experience in developing AI-based systems using large language models, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, is a strong merit. Such experience would also enable the successful candidate to contribute to an additional project focused on developing an AI-based advisory tool for farm-scale biogas production.
The candidate is expected to independently lead the experimental and analytical work within the project, collaborate with other researchers in the group, and supervise students.
Qualifications
PhD in biotechnology, microbiology or another relevant field
Knowledge of anaerobic microbiology and metabolic modelling
Practical experience in bioprocesses and associated technical skills
Very good written and oral English skills
Good programming skills in R or an equivalent programming language
Experience in software development
Knowledge of machine learning or other data-driven approaches to the analysis of biological datasets
Experience in supervising PhD students

Additional qualifications
Experience in developing AI systems based on large language models
Very good written and oral Swedish skills
Knowledge of biogas production

Assessment criteria
The assessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Considerable emphasis will also be placed on personal qualities, particularly the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with other members of the research group and the wider scientific community. 
About us
The position is based at the Department of Molecular Sciences at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Uppsala. The project will be carried out within the Microbial Biotechnology research group. Please visit our https://www.slu.se/en/departments/molecular-sciences/ for more information.
Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU on our https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/.
Employment
Permanent employment
Scope
100% of full-time
Location
Uppsala, Sweden
Starting date
By agreement, but no later than December 2026.
Please submit your application by 26 November 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

We are the global leader in dispensing solutions for liquid portion control. We specialize in creating dispenser solutions for businesses in the foodservice, personal care, and cleaning industries. Whether it is ketchup, mayonnaise, hand soap, or detergent - ASEPT ensures accurate and reliable liquid dispensing. We are committed to reducing the environmental footprint through sustainable dispensing solutions.
In addition to our base in Lund, Sweden, we have two more group companies located in the Netherlands and in the US. ASEPT Group has around 100 employees and are a part of Lagercrantz Group listed on NASDAQ Stockholm. Read more at www.asept.com
 
Business Development Manager to ASEPT 
Would you like to work with a unique product developed in Lund and used by customers worldwide? Are you passionate about Business Development and eager to drive sales to new and existing customers?
Then join ASEPT and be part of the company’s exciting growth journey! You will play a key role in keeping current business and developing new business by launching innovative products and services that help customers to be more successful.
Your customers will typically range from large companies like Kraft Heinz, Unilever and Orkla, quick-service-restaurant (QSR), to local smaller food producers. The position involves extensive collaboration, both internally and externally, and requires you to have excellent collaboration and communication skills. You enjoy being close to your customers, both in person and digitally, and see travel as a natural part of the role.
You will be part of a great team and a workplace with supportive and committed colleagues in a culture that is innovative, down to earth and growth oriented. For the right person, this is a great opportunity to build an exciting career in an international, fast-growing environment where you can make a real impact on the company’s continued journey. You will be part of the Sales & Marketing team in Lund with five additional colleagues and report to the Sales & Marketing Director at ASEPT AB.
 
Key Responsibilities
Customer Relationship Building: Foster long-lasting relationships with customers by understanding their needs (KAM).
Lead and motivate yourself and collaborate with the other parts of the ASEPT Group to achieve and exceed targets for customers in Europe and other parts of the world.
Strategic Planning: Develop and implement business plans to expand our market presence.
Market Awareness: Stay informed about our markets and competitors.
Performance Monitoring: Present sales reports and revenue forecast

Requirements
Proven experience in Sales or in a relevant role (e.g. KAM).
Successful track record in meeting or exceeding targets.
Strong business acumenship and preferably industry expertise
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration or relevant experience.
Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels of customer organizations
International B2B experience and fluency in both English and Swedish (other languages, e.g. German, French, or Spanish is an advantage).

Your background
As a person you have a strong and analytic business mind. Your background is probably either in B2B Sales or in some related field like Business Development / Key Account Management / Market Management. Experience from the food-service industry and being familiar with large food-producing companies or the quick-service-restaurant (QSR) industry will give you a head start but it’s not a necessary requirement. You are communicative, driven, target oriented and have a structured way of working as well as a positive “can do attitude”.
 
Application
In this recruitment ASEPT collaborates with Standby Workteam. We recruit continuously and you are welcome to submit your application as soon as possible. For more information about the position, please contact Kristian Berglund, Standby Workteam, +46 709 605 372.

jobs.occupation: MCN Technical Support Strategic Driver | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity 
Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. 
  
 This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
  
 Your journey in the Innovate program will start as an MCN Technical Support Strategic Driver, supporting Mission Critical Networks (MCN) and Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) in safety-critical contexts. You will help teams deliver dependable support for customers such as defence organizations and government agencies. 
 What you will do  
You will help ensure that mission-critical network projects are supported from early planning through deployment and live operation. This includes integrated sensing and communication (ISAC)—technology that allows a wireless network to provide connectivity and also detect or monitor objects and activity in its environment. In safety-critical settings, dependable service and clear support arrangements are essential. 
  
  Connect pre-sales and deployment teams with RAN software and hardware support teams, using your view of the radio portfolio to help set clear expectations and move from product-by-product support to coordinated, end-to-end support.
 Define practical support processes, case triage, escalation routes and clear responsibilities across radio, transport, core network, applications, customer operations, system integrators and third-party partners, bringing structure and operational leadership to cross-functional ways of working.
 Coordinate proactively with design, solution, customer, project and operations teams so support needs and responsibilities are clear and considered early in project planning.
 Join early studies, proofs of concept and pilot projects. Use lab environments to validate support approaches, reproduce faults and test complete solutions.
 Identify gaps in skills, tools, infrastructure and security practices; develop training and practical troubleshooting guides; and share lessons from customer cases to improve future solutions.
 Participate in live support cases, identify recurring issues, track readiness and performance, and recommend improvements. 
  You will bring  
We provide a platform for you to contribute to technology and services that matter in safety-critical situations. 
 Bring initiative: ask questions, take responsibility for your work, and collaborate across teams to turn support needs into clear actions. 
     In addition you have    MSc or BSc in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent, with 3–5 years of relevant experience.
 Ability to structure complex problems, take initiative, define ways of working and prioritize actions; project-planning experience is helpful but can be developed on the job.
 Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to work across organizational, technical and cultural boundaries and drive change.
 Curiosity to explore emerging MCN/ISAC use cases, learn quickly and adapt in a changing environment, with a proactive, action-oriented mindset.
 Working knowledge of RAN software and hardware, the radio portfolio, wireless communication and network architecture; familiarity with mission-critical communications is an advantage.
 Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or deployment of complex network solutions; experience with labs, PoCs or security considerations is an advantage.
 Strong stakeholder coordination, communication and analytical skills, with proficiency in English and an ability to lead operational work across teams. 
  
Pre-offer checks including references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

Are you an experienced HR professional with a strong background in employee relations and workplace investigations? Do you thrive in handling complex cases and leading sensitive conversations with confidence and integrity? This could be the right opportunity for you.
About the position 
Perido is currently seeking a Senior HR Business Partner for an exciting assignment with our client, a global industrial organization within the automotive industry. You will join a small, highly skilled team of HRBPs and work closely with managers, local HR, employees, and union representatives. Leading and conducting workplace investigations
Managing rehabilitation processes in line with internal frameworks
Handling misconduct and disciplinary matters

Leading difficult and sensitive conversations with various stakeholders
Providing expert HR support to production units and other business areas
Collaborating closely with HR colleagues and other internal stakeholders

Workplace investigations
Difficult employee conversations

Fluency in English

Product Development Engineer
Turn Innovation into Life-Changing Medical Technology
About the Role
Smartwise Sweden AB is looking for an experienced Product Development Engineer to develop minimally invasive medical devices, with a focus on catheter-based endovascular technologies.
You will work across the product lifecycle—from new development and product improvements to new configurations—partnering with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, suppliers and manufacturers to deliver safe, robust and manufacturable solutions.
This is a hands-on role with ownership, complex problem-solving and a clear impact on next-generation medical technology.
What You’ll DoDevelop Products
Participate and lead product development, design changes, improvements and new variants.

Develop and assess technical solutions, prototypes and product configurations.

Implement engineering changes with safety, performance and manufacturability in focus.

Maintain specifications, drawings, bills of materials (BOMs) and design documentation.

Support design reviews, design control and risk management in line with ISO 14971.

Test and Solve
Plan and execute engineering testing, design verification and validation.

Create test methods, protocols and reports.

Troubleshoot product issues, lead root-cause analysis and support CAPA.

Drive Delivery
Maintain design documentation and medical device technical files.

Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners on components, processes and improvements.

Support design transfer and implementation in manufacturing.

Coordinate engineering activities in line with project plans, quality procedures and regulatory requirements.

What You BringMust have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering or a related field.

5+ years in medical device product development or design engineering.

Experience with product modifications, engineering change management and design control.

Hands-on experience in testing, verification, validation and technical documentation.

Knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971 and relevant medical device regulations.

Experience working across functions and with suppliers and manufacturing partners.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.

Ability to manage engineering activities independently and communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

We believe you are established in Sweden and live in the Stockholm/Uppsala region.
Nice to Have
Additional experience with minimally invasive devices, particularly catheter-based endovascular systems, would be valuable. We also welcome experience in technical investigations, root-cause analysis and CAPA, as well as working with contract manufacturers and external test laboratories. Knowledge of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) is an advantage.
Who You Are
You are structured, practical and detail-oriented, with an analytical and solution-focused mindset. Proactive and accountable, you manage priorities confidently and collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary R&D teams. Above all, you are motivated by medical innovation and the opportunity to improve patient care.
Why Join Us?
You will join a team where your curiosity, practical mindset, and attention to quality can make a real difference. Together, we develop solutions that support meaningful progress in medical device innovation.
We offer you to be part of an innovative journey pioneering new treatment paradigms based on world-class science, a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and integral to the company’s success, a transparent culture where vital information is shared across the organization and competitive compensation & benefits.
Ready to Make an Impact?
Apply today and take the next step with Smartwise. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we aim to fill the position as soon as possible.
The SmartCella group consist of SmartCella Holding AB, SmartWise Sweden AB and SmartCella Solutions AB with a total of 38 employees from 11 nationalities. We are a global drug delivery company pioneering innovative delivery solutions for targeted therapies, such as the Extroducer® (an endovascular delivery device that enables direct injection to hard-to-reach organs and tumors). We are an international and diverse team of scientists, visionary innovators, and experienced business leaders, dedicated to shaping the future of targeted therapies.

jobs.description:
We need more people - join our team!

Say hello to Scandic Go, a fresh, urban hotel concept, offering the essentials with a “get what you need, pay for what you want” mindset. We’re making it possible for more guests to explore the city in their own way. Always smart, always sustainable, and always with smooth self-service. We welcome all tomorrow’s adventurers to Scandic Go.

What's it like being a Host at Scandic Go?As a Host at Scandic Go, you're all about the guest. You greet them warmly when they arrive and help them with online check in or at our self-service kiosks in the lounge. You also answer any questions they might have.

Check in-out, F&B sales and answering phone- it is a stimulating position and you will be on your feet all day!

You prepare food and drinks. You keep the lounge area neat and cozy so our guests can relax and enjoy themselves. You're always ready to chat with them and share some local tips.

At check-out, you make sure they had a great stay and assist them if needed.

Who are you?We're looking for someone who can juggle multiple things at once and make our guests feel welcome. You should be good at talking to people and fluent in Swedish and English. Other languages are a plus.

But what really matters is who you are and how you act. You should be a responsive and prestige-free team player who are reliable and care about the quality of your work.

About the positionWe're looking for someone to join our team as a host. You'll work on different shifts, including days, evenings and weekends. Your boss will be the Hospitality Manager.

Please apply through our website only. We'll review the applications as they come and we might hire someone before the deadline, so don't wait too long. We'll also give you a short service test during the selection process.

The position includes:

Part time employee
Probationary period

Can't wait to see you!

We are looking for You- your personality and energy is the most important factors.

If you have earlier experiences from Reception, F&B or customer service this will be a plus but not a must.

Allt börjar med dig. Att arbeta på ett av våra hotell innebär att vara en del av ett team där omtanke, samarbete och små vardagsögonblick gör skillnad. Du hjälper till att skapa den varma, hemlika känslan som kännetecknar Scandic – genom att vara närvarande, här och nu, och låta detaljerna räknas.

Om du tror att fantastisk gästfrihet skapas genom samarbete, konsekvent kvalitet och små välgjorda ögonblick, kommer du att känna dig som hemma hos oss.

Partner with engineering and supply chain teams on supplier qualifications, quality monitoring, and contract parameter maintenance.

Experience in supplier quality, procurement, or quality assurance within an industrial or project-driven environment.
Hands-on proficiency with SAP, SAP Ariba, and Master Data Governance (MDG) and Office365.
Resilient, decisive, and communicative mindset, with the confidence to uphold standards and work through complex challenges with patience and integrity.
Self-driven approach with strong organizational skills and the ability to guide and collaborate across global functions.
Prior knowledge of ABB procurement processes and sustainability frameworks is an advantage.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

Are you passionate about power systems protection and eager to contribute to the energy transition? We are now looking for an experienced HVDC Protection Project Engineer to join our global HVDC team in Ludvika. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, implementing, and testing advanced protection systems that enable reliable and efficient transmission of electricity across the world. Lead and contribute to the specification, design, and engineering of HVDC protection systems for global projects.

Collaborate closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and engineering disciplines to resolve technical challenges and optimize solutions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives, share knowledge, and mentor less experienced engineers within the organization.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5-7 years of experience in protection engineering, preferably within HVDC, FACTS, or power transmission systems.
Strong knowledge of HVDC and high voltage substation protection and control systems, including design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of protection schemes for transmission and distribution networks.
Experience with Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) settings, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
Proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or DIgSILENT PowerFactory.
Knowledge of international standards and communication protocols.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in global, multidisciplinary teams.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and delivering the products of tomorrow for the world's leading manufacturers. We are looking for Technical Lead Exterior Lighting/ Exterior Functions.
Role Summary 
We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Lead / SPOC to lead test automation activities for advanced automotive Exterior Lighting and Exterior Function systems. The role combines technical leadership, test automation strategy, stakeholder management, and onsite-offshore coordination to ensure delivery of high-quality automated verification solutions integrated into Continuous Integration (CI) environments. 
The candidate will act as the primary technical focal point for automation development, validation activities, and cross-functional collaboration across multiple testing levels including vehicle, system, integration, and component verification. 
Key Responsibilities 
Technical Leadership 
Lead and coordinate onsite and offshore test automation teams. 
Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to automation engineers. 
Act as the primary technical interface between development, integration, verification, and CI teams. 
Establish and enforce automation best practices, coding standards, and framework governance. 

Test Automation Strategy 
Define and drive the overall test automation strategy aligned with project goals and quality objectives. 
Develop scalable automation architectures and CI/CD integration approaches. 
Evaluate and adopt innovative techniques, including AI-assisted test generation, where beneficial. 

Test Analysis & Planning 
Analyze requirements, features, and verification needs to identify automation opportunities. 
Develop automation test plans, effort estimates, schedules, and resource strategies. 
Ensure alignment between automation activities, delivery milestones, and program objectives. 

Test Execution & Delivery 
Oversee development, maintenance, and execution of automated test cases. 
Ensure test coverage across:  
Software-in-the-Loop (SIL)
Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) 
Vehicle/System Integration Testing
Component-Level Verification 
Regression and Confirmation Testing
Drive successful deployment of automated tests into CI environments. 

Quality Assurance & Reporting 
Monitor automation progress, quality metrics, risks, and defect trends. 
Lead regular technical reviews and status reporting activities. 
Ensure test automation deliverables meet quality, maintainability, and performance expectations. 
Communicate delivery status and recommendations to stakeholders. 

Domain Support & Collaboration 
Provide technical expertise within: 
Exterior Lighting 
Visibility Systems 
Vehicle Locking Functions 
Alarm Systems
Door and Closure Systems 
Support onsite investigations, manual verification activities, and requirement clarifications. 
Work closely with software development, system integration, CI, and validation teams. 

Required Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or equivalent. 
Proven experience in quality assurance and verification of complex embedded systems.
Experience leading automotive test automation activities and distributed engineering teams.
Strong stakeholder and delivery management capabilities. 
Fluent in written and spoken English. 

Required Technical Skills 
Automotive Test Automation 
Test Automation Framework Design and Architecture 
Automated Test Case Development and Management 
Continuous Integration / Continuous Testing 
Python and/or CAPL scripting
CANoe 
Jenkins or similar CI tools 
Linux 
Requirement and Test Management Tools
Embedded Systems Verification & Validation 
HIL, SIL and Integration Testing 

Preferred Skills 
Experience in Exterior Lighting and Exterior Functions. 
AI-assisted test generation and automation techniques. 
Software development background. 
Model-Based Development and Testing experience.

If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on and want to help shape the future of automotive electronic systems, we would love to hear from you.

Solve complex problems. Decode the future.
At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
 
All about the role:
As a Platform Data Engineer, you are an architect and builder of the foundations. You do not just move data; you build the resilient infrastructure, automated tooling, and scalable systems that allow the entire analytics ecosystem to function. 
Your mission is to eliminate human bottlenecks by stitching together complex components into a high-performance, controlled, and reliable data engine. You will match the capabilities and scale of the platform to our unique business requirements, ensuring that every byte of data is stored, orchestrated, and accessed with maximum efficiency and minimum manual intervention.
 
 
What you'll do:
 
●     Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design, build, and maintain the physical and logical architecture of our data platform. You ensure the platform evolves with our needs, moving beyond a "set it and forget it" mentality to a dynamic, scalable system.
●     Ingestion & Integration: Build the ingestion layer to take raw data from various internal and external sources and integrate it seamlessly into the analytical platform for processing.
●     Automation & Developer Experience: Champion the "machine-first" approach by automating repetitive tasks and building software to handle data efficiently. You ensure that data foundations are built on code, not manual inputs or human-heavy workflows.
●     Orchestration & Workflow Management: Turn computational chaos into a controlled ecosystem by designing complex orchestration chains that distribute, monitor, and recover processes automatically.
●     System Reliability & Performance: Optimize SQL queries, schema designs, and distributed processing tasks to ensure the platform remains performant as scale increases.
●     Security & Cost Control: Implement tightly designed access controls and resource management strategies to ensure compliance and prevent cloud bills from skyrocketing.
 
Qualifications:
●     Technical Background: Proven track record as a builder in cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure) with a focus on System Design and Architecture.
●     Software Engineering Mindset: Strong foundation in Python development and experience with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark).
●     Expertise in Data Structures: Deep knowledge of Data Warehouses, Lakes, and Lakehouses, including query optimization and schema design.
●     Automation: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing to ensure platform resilience and maintainability.
●     Problem Solving: The ability to take a complex chain of computations and turn it into a controlled, reliable ecosystem that recovers easily from failure.
 
Valuable extras:
●     Experience in MLOps Engineering to support model development and deployment.
●     Knowledge of Security & Governance frameworks (encryption, access control, and compliance).
●     Familiarity with Observability & Monitoring tools (logging, metrics, and audit trails) to ensure platform health.
 
 
Where you'll be:
This is a position based at our Global Headquarters in Stockholm (Sweden).
We are proud of our culture of inclusivity and diversity. At our Global Headquarters we have 60+ nationalities working together for our common goals. You will be part of this dynamic international team where English is the natural language.
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

At Qred, we’re building the world’s best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, and following our merger with Liberis, we’re now a global group generating over €300 million in annual revenue and serving more than 100,000 small businesses across 17 countries in Europe and North America. Together, we combine a regulated, deposit-funded bank with an embedded finance network of partners, using smart technology, real-time data and human judgment to make financing simple, fast and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets and currencies, we’re now looking for a Commercial Manager to strengthen our Card function for the next phase of growth.
About the Role
In this role, you will hold end-to-end commercial ownership of our rapidly scaling business card P&L. You bridge rigorous technical execution with commercial impact, using modern financial systems and advanced AI tooling to transform raw performance data into actionable business decisions.
Key responsibilities
Track portfolio performance against forecast targets across markets, proactively diagnosing root causes behind variance for key stakeholders.

Model unit economics and P&L drivers - including revenue streams, acquisition costs, and credit losses - to identify high-impact margin opportunities.

Define and optimize core commercial levers such as feature pricing, partner commission frameworks, and loyalty program economics.

Align cross-functional initiatives across Product, Credit Strategy, and Finance to implement performance improvements and quantify business outcomes.

Embed modern AI agents into daily research, financial modeling, and data analysis workflows to elevate operational scaling.

What we’re looking for
You bring a highly structured, analytical mindset and an instinct for resolving ambiguous business problems with quantitative clarity. You drive alignment effortlessly across disciplines, communicate complex metrics concisely to leadership, and are motivated to build scalable commercial frameworks in a high-velocity environment.
Qualifications
Several years of experience across commercial strategy, business development, partnerships, or commercial finance within fintech, payments, lending, or regulated financial services.

Proven track record of owning end-to-end partner terms, contract negotiations, and long-term commercial relationship management.

Strong expertise in building financial models from scratch, with deep command of unit economics, lifetime value (CLV), and P&L dynamics.

Daily fluency using AI agents for data querying, financial modeling, and analysis, paired with the critical judgment to audit their outputs.

Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Why us?
This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

 Head of Maintenance Volvo Powertrain Industrial Skövde 
Volvo Powertrain Industrial in Skövde is undergoing a historic transformation as we develop and begin producing tomorrow’s sustainable powertrains. At the same time, we continue to manufacture world-class engines. To succeed in this transformation, we need a maintenance organisation that delivers high reliability today while developing to meet future needs.
 We are now looking for a Head of Maintenance to lead and develop the organisation through this change. We are looking not only for an experienced maintenance leader, but for a results-oriented transformation leader who can engage people, challenge established ways of working and build a strong culture characterised by both Dare and Care.
 Who are you? 
A present and inclusive leader, you bring people together in a clear direction and create the trust and engagement needed to deliver results. You understand the connection between people, ways of working and results, and know that sustainable improvements are achieved together with the organisation. You will encourage fresh thinking, and not just rely on established practices, drive change, while showing care and creating psychological safety.
 Experienced in leading through other leaders, you build alignment across the organisation and make complex topics easy to understand. Your communication helps people see why change matters and how they can contribute. When obstacles arise, with a structured and persistent approach you keep focus on the target, the gap, root causes, clear priorities and improvements that deliver results. Following up on progress, giving regular feedback and celebrating successes are all important parts of how you lead.
 The assignment
 You will join the Skövde management team, report to the Head of Skövde plant, and play a central role in developing the business strategy and advancing initiatives that strengthen the entire production site. Volvo’s site in Skövde includes a foundry, machining and engine assembly, hub production and other components, as well as the manufacture of battery modules, battery packs and battery energy storage systems. In this role your heading an organisation of approximately 600 employees together with four department managers and several production leaders across the respective functions.
 Together with your management team, you will continue the journey of developing maintenance from reactive interventions towards a more planned, preventive and data-driven approach. By understanding and addressing root causes, you and the organisation will contribute to greater reliability, improved availability and more efficient production flows. You will drive the development of maintenance strategies, processes, competence and ways of working. This also includes developing the use of data and AI to plan and prioritize maintenance activities, monitor results and predict failures.
 The role involves close collaboration with Production, Engineering and other functions. You will have overall responsibility for ensuring that maintenance contributes to safety, quality, production performance, budget and continuous improvement.
  
  
 Your ticket to ride  A Master of Science in Engineering or equivalent experience considered relevant by the employer.
 Several years of experience in manufacturing or process industries, together with a good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, reliability and systematic improvement.
 A proven track record of successful leadership in maintenance, engineering or production.
 Experience leading through managers and developing large organisations.
 Experience in change management and in developing ways of working, organisations and culture.
 The ability to use data and relevant performance measures to set priorities, monitor progress and deliver results.
 Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across functions and organisational boundaries.
 The ability to communicate effectively in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.

jobs.occupation: The Swedish House of Finance (SHoF) is looking for an Executive Director
jobs.description:
Introduction
The Swedish House of Finance (SHoF) at the Stockholm School of Economics is Sweden's national center for financial research and an internationally oriented environment for research, knowledge exchange and societal relevance. SHoF brings together prominent researchers in financial economics and creates meeting places where academia, the financial sector and public decision makers can exchange knowledge, challenge established perspectives and develop new ideas.
As Executive Director of SHoF, you will have a central role in leading and further developing this business. The role combines strategic leadership with clear operational responsibility and offers great opportunities to influence how SHoF develops, is visible and creates value. You will work closely with some of Sweden's and the world's leading researchers in financial economics and at the same time have extensive contacts with the financial sector and other key societal actors.
Main responsibilities
The leadership of SHoF is shared between two people: Director and Executive Director. The Director is responsible for ensuring that SHoF's activities are academically relevant and of high scientific quality, while the Executive Director leads and distributes the work and has budget, personnel and work environment responsibility. The Executive Director is a full-time position located in Stockholm.
The Executive Director is responsible for ensuring that the business is managed in accordance with the Board's instructions. This includes, among other things, to
prepare the matters to be dealt with at the meetings of the Board of Directors
analyze issues of strategic and organizational importance
lead and distribute the work in the business
ensure that the business complies with relevant laws and regulations
ensure the long-term financing of the business
represent SHoF towards external stakeholders (together with the Director)

Tasks
The Executive Director shall take the measures necessary to ensure that the business is managed in an appropriate, efficient and satisfactory manner. This includes, among other things, to
implement decisions made by the board
recruit the necessary staff
sign the necessary agreements (in ongoing matters)
ensure the planning, budgeting, monitoring and reporting of operations
be responsible for the contact with the Stockholm School of Economics and other academic partners and coordinate relevant processes with these

Requirements profile
SHoF is a small organization with short decision-making paths and limited internal support functions, operating at the intersection of academia, policy and the financial sector. The Executive Director is therefore expected to understand and work effectively within an academic environment, but must also be able to interact with decision-makers in both the private and public financial sectors. The work includes handling a wide range of strategic, operational and administrative issues, which is why it is a requirement that the applicant has
experience of previous management roles
good administrative skills
ability to work independently
ability to prioritize and create structure in a creative (and sometimes chaotic) environment
a relevant academic degree
a strong interest in financial economics
good knowledge of English

In addition, the successful applicant should
be flexible and unpretentious
have experience in fundraising
be a good communicator
have experience from academic activities

Application
The deadline for applications is November 20, 2026; however, selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. Welcome to apply here: https://pnty-apply.ponty-system.se/lagerpartners?id=1969 . If you have any questions about the position, please contact Lager & Partners’ consultant, Niclas Näslund, at 08-407 64 60.

The Opportunity
As power systems become increasingly complex, utilities and grid operators rely on advanced SCADA solutions to monitor and control their networks. At Hitachi Energy, you will join a global team delivering these solutions to customers around the world, supporting the reliable operation of critical power infrastructures.
As a SCADA Engineer you will work closely with customers, project teams, and technical specialists throughout the full project lifecycle, from solution design and system configuration to testing, commissioning, and deployment. You'll combine technical expertise, problem-solving, and collaboration to deliver high quality solutions that meet operational and business requirements.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys working with complex systems, solving technical challenges, and collaborating with stakeholders in an international project environment.
How you’ll make an impact
Act as a technical expert for SCADA functionality within Network Manager projects.
Configure and implement SCADA applications and support system infrastructure.
Translate customer operational requirements into effective SCADA solutions.
Support system migrations, integrations, and data exchange between connected systems.
Validate delivered solutions through testing, commissioning, and customer acceptance activities.
Collaborate with customers and project teams throughout the full project lifecycle.
Strengthen engineering practices: contribute to continuous improvements and knowledge sharing across the SCADA engineering team.

Your Background
Bachelor's degree in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automation or equivalent. A Master’s degree is highly regarded.
Experience with SCADA systems, industrial automation, or industrial control environments.
Understanding of power systems, including generation, transmission, and distribution systems.
Familiarity with industry standards and protocols including OPC UA, ICCP, and ISO/IEC standards related to SCADA.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail when working with SCADA configurations and data models.
Strong communication skills with the ability to gather and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions.
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required. Swedish language skills are preferred.
The role includes occasional travel, with mobility requirements of up to 20% depending on business needs and project activities.

jobs.occupation: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark's power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installations
You will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

-Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

-Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

-Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

-Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

-Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibility
You are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

-Works independently and takes a structured approach

-Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

-Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

-Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

-Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call duties
At Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish "fritvalgsordning" scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from you
If this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

TL;DR
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Security at Lovable, end-to-end, from conception through rollout. You'll make sure the millions of apps built on Lovable are safe, trustworthy, and secure by default, turning security from a checkbox into a genuine product differentiator.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
8+ years in the software industry, with exposure to security, trust & safety, or platform integrity in a product management or engineering leadership role
Familiarity with the security challenges unique to AI-generated software, including code vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and unsafe defaults, and how to build secure-by-default experiences users don't have to think about
Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on threat models, vulnerabilities, and platform architecture
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You know how to translate security constraints into good user experiences rather than friction, and you have sharp opinions on when security should be invisible vs. unmistakable
Preferred: Prior experience working on platform security or trust & safety at scale; familiarity with enterprise security requirements and how they influence product decisions

What you'll do
Represent the user. Bring findings on security posture, threat models, and trust signals to the team with clarity and conviction
Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and crafting security messaging that resonates with both technical and non-technical users
Shape how security surfaces across the product, spanning AI output review, permissions, publishing safeguards, and vulnerability detection
Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't
Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to speak credibly about security, especially for enterprise buyers where it's a dealbreaker
Projects you'll tackle first: Mapping the current threat surface across Lovable-generated apps and defining the biggest gaps; owning the first iteration of secure-by-default publishing safeguards; building the internal framework for how security features get scoped, prioritized, and communicated across the company

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

At Senior Material, we are currently seeking a dedicated and analytical Operations Analysis Engineer to join our growing team. If you are passionate about data-driven decision-making, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, this opportunity is for you!
WHO ARE WE?
We work every day to electrify the world for a greener future. Through a thin plastic film – more precisely, a separator film – we help make lithium-ion batteries durable and safe. It is one of the key components ensuring the optimal performance of batteries.
Founded in 2003 in Shenzhen, China, Senior Material has been driven by innovation since the very beginning.
Since 2021, we have established our European headquarters in Eskilstuna, Sweden. Here, we are developing one of Europe's most modern production facilities, contributing to the electrification of transportation.
We have an exciting journey ahead of us, and now you have the opportunity to be part of it!

ABOUT THE ROLE:
As an Operations Analysis Engineer at Senior Material, you will play an important role in monitoring and analyzing operational performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization.
You will be responsible for analyzing production performance, maintaining operational KPIs, preparing management reports, and supporting capacity and cost optimization.
Working closely with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and other departments, you will contribute to improving operational efficiency, productivity, and overall business performance.
In summary, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and continuous improvement within our Operations department!
 Job Responsibilities
- Monitor and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), including production output, capacity utilization, yield, scrap, downtime, and delivery performance.
- Develop and maintain operational dashboards, performance reports, and data analysis tools to support management decisions.
- Analyze operational data to identify trends, performance deviations, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
- Support production capacity planning, workforce planning, inventory management, and operational cost analysis.
- Evaluate operational efficiency and cost drivers, providing recommendations to improve productivity and reduce operational costs.
- Ensure the accuracy and consistency of operational data across different reporting systems and departments.
- Collaborate with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and HSE teams to support operational improvements and business objectives.
- Monitor the implementation of improvement initiatives and evaluate their operational and financial results.
- Support the optimization and automation of reporting processes to improve data accuracy and reporting efficiency.
- Follow company policies, quality standards, and health, safety, and environmental requirements.

 Job Competence Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Statistics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Previous experience in operations analysis, production performance analysis, or a similar analytical role, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex operational data and provide practical recommendations.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with ERP systems, reporting tools, or BI dashboards.
- Knowledge of production KPIs, capacity planning, operational efficiency, and cost analysis.
- Experience with SQL, Power BI, or reporting automation is considered an advantage.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to work.
- Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different departments.
- Good command of English, both written and spoken.
- A proactive mindset, willingness to learn, and a strong interest in continuous improvement.

Scope and Impact
You are an autonomous contributor holding end-to-end stewardship accountability for an assigned scope, on behalf of the business owners of that data. You balance stewardship responsibilities, analytics delivery, and self-service enablement while maximizing business value from data through trusted metrics, high-quality data products, and adoption of analytical solutions.
You may sit within a regional IT organization or directly within the business domain, depending on structure.
As a domain resource, you receive governance standards, tooling, and escalation support from the central Data & AI Governance function, Global Data & AI Platform team and the visualization engineering CoE.

What you do
Metrics & Data Products
Align existing and new metric definitions across teams so everyone works from the same numbers.
Curate metric definitions, metadata, and the semantic layer so they're reliable enough for AI agents to answer business questions directly, not just for human dashboard users.
Act as Data Steward for all data products within your assigned sub-domain.
Monitor and improve data quality through controls and remediation activities, elevating data quality and data management from source to the analytical layer.
Maintain metadata, data lineage, business glossaries, and ownership information within the enterprise data catalog.
Track and demonstrate the business value and ROI realized from the data products you steward, using this evidence to prioritize improvements or retirement.
Partner with Data Engineers to define the semantic layer in the global data and AI platform and understand how they built data models and pipelines.
Review and coordinate data access approvals and stewardship workflows in accordance with governance policies and business ownership responsibilities.

Analytical Solutions
Support business stakeholders with complex, non-standard analytical questions that go beyond self-service, applying analytical rigor to validate findings before they inform decisions.
Drive adoption of self-service analytics developed with data engineers.
Build and maintain complex dashboards and analytical solutions.
Validate that self-service and analytical outputs remain accurate when consumed by AI agents, not only by human users.

Data Literacy 
Take ownership for growing data literacy within your sub-domain.
Train and support business users on self-service analytics solutions

AI-readiness & Ways of Working 
Proactively automates routine parts of their own workflow (quality checks, documentation updates, recurring reporting) using agentic AI, and prototypes solutions live with business stakeholders using AI instead of running a traditional multi-week build cycle.

Where you will be
This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.

Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 

 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.
