The Verification & Quality Lead is responsible for coordinating verification activities and quality follow-up across the Platform. The role establishes and maintains verification plans and strategies, monitors execution and quality status, coordinates defect management, and provides clear reporting on verification progress and release readiness. The role works closely with technical leadership, development, integration, test, and other engineering stakeholders to ensure that verification evidence and quality information support informed delivery decisions.
Requirements:
Significant experience as a Verification Lead, Quality Lead, Test Manager, Verification Manager, or in a comparable senior engineering role.
Strong experience in automotive software verification and validation, preferably involving embedded software and complex electronic control units or comparable platforms.
Experience defining verification strategies, planning test activities, managing execution, assessing coverage, and reporting results against requirements and milestones.
Practical experience in defect management, triage, root-cause follow-up, regression testing, and quality improvement.
Good understanding of software development lifecycles, integration processes, release-readiness assessment, and evidence-based quality decisions.
Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) verification, automated testing, and integration test workflows.
Ability to define and interpret verification and quality KPIs, identify trends, and communicate quality status and risks clearly.
Experience coordinating cross-functional engineering teams and managing dependencies across development, integration, and testing.
Familiarity with automotive engineering processes, quality practices, requirements traceability, and applicable organizational standards.
Working knowledge of test automation or scripting, such as Python, Pytest, YAML, or Bash, is beneficial.
Experience with test tools such as CANoe and with CI, issue tracking, reporting, and documentation tools is beneficial.
Strong analytical, organizational, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Relevant Tools and Technologies:
Test and verification: CANoe, Pytest, and other applicable verification tools.
CI/CD and automation: Jenkins, GitLab CI, Zuul, Cynosure, Ansible.
Programming and scripting: Python, Bash, YAML; C/C++ familiarity is beneficial.
Version control and review: Git, Gerrit.
Test execution environments and packaging: Docker, Artifactory.
Monitoring and reporting: Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, and relevant engineering dashboards.
Planning, defect tracking, and documentation: Jira, Confluence, and applicable engineering lifecycle tools.
Processes and standards: applicable engineering frameworks, verification processes, and organizational software quality standards

Job Responsibilities:
Define, maintain, and coordinate the platform verification strategy, verification plans, scope, priorities, and execution approach in line with agreed requirements and milestones.
Coordinate verification activities across relevant engineering workstreams, ensuring suitable coverage of requirements, software changes, interfaces, integration scenarios, and identified risks.
Track verification execution, results, test coverage, outstanding activities, and deviations against the agreed plan.
Establish and maintain clear quality reporting, verification status, metrics, dashboards, and progress summaries for engineering and program stakeholders.
Coordinate defect management, including defect triage, severity and priority discussions, ownership, follow-up, retesting, and closure tracking.
Work with development and integration teams to ensure defects are analyzed, corrective actions are tracked, and regression risks are addressed.
Monitor quality trends and verification KPIs; identify recurring issues, gaps, and risks, and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
Coordinate test readiness and release-readiness assessments, consolidating verification evidence, open defects, residual risks, and unresolved quality concerns.
Ensure verification activities and outcomes are documented, traceable, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Support continuous integration and automated verification practices, collaborating with teams responsible for CI/CD pipelines and test environments.
Coordinate with the Technical Lead to align verification priorities with technical risks, architecture changes, integration dependencies, and delivery plans.
Facilitate collaboration among development, integration, verification, and other relevant engineering teams to resolve quality issues efficiently.
Escalate critical defects, verification gaps, schedule risks, and quality concerns through the agreed governance process.
Promote continuous improvement in test strategy, defect prevention, verification efficiency, reporting, and quality practices.
Support knowledge transfer and maintain continuity of verification methods, processes, metrics, and quality records.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Fiber Technicians at Optic Tunnels
jobs.description:
Optic Tunnels is a new Swedish provider of data communication and AI services for demanding organizations – services produced on truly dedicated infrastructure, all the way down into the ground. To deliver them, we are building an entirely new, independent fiber backbone network between the Nordic capital regions, with strict requirements for security and performance at every step. Our services are launched step by step as the network grows, for customers along the entire route – not only between the endpoints. The network build-out is well underway, initially focused on Greater Stockholm, the Mälaren Valley, Dalarna and Skåne, and we are now looking for experienced fiber technicians who want to join us on the journey.
The role
As a fiber technician at Optic Tunnels, you will work with fiber installation and high-precision fusion splicing, as well as measurement and documentation. You will work closely with the civil works, follow each route from trench to completed connection, and take part alongside our subcontractors when the fiber cables are installed in the ducts.
The work is largely in the field along our backbone network, but also in our own small data centers along the routes and at end-customer premises. This means flexible, mobile working days with a high degree of responsibility for planning your own work.
A strategic capability we are building in-house
While Optic Tunnels procures most of the network build-out from external contractors, all fiber splicing, measurement and documentation is carried out by our own staff. This is to ensure maximum control and security in the most sensitive parts of the network.
Measurements and documentation of splice quality and the optical properties of the fiber matter more to us than to most. The measurement data is used not only to verify that the fiber and the splice meet specification at the moment of testing, but also as a reference for detecting anomalies and intrusion attempts throughout the fiber's lifetime. This is a central part of our security offering, which is why careful measurement and impeccable documentation are as important as the fiber and the splices themselves.
What we are looking for
•      Documented experience as a fiber technician on backbone networks
•      A category B driver's license
•      The right to work in Sweden
•      Good computer skills and experience working with documentation
•      Fluent spoken and written English, the language of all our technical documentation. Working knowledge of Swedish is a plus.
You are orderly and meticulous, and you see documentation as a critical part of the work, not an add-on to it. You enjoy planning your own work and taking responsibility for it.
Terms
Location: Stockholm. The work involves travel and work throughout Optic Tunnels' network.
Extent: Full-time
Type of employment: Permanent, following an initial probationary period
Start: By agreement. Positions are filled on a rolling basis.
Working hours: The work is mainly carried out during daytime. Some tasks, such as planned maintenance within scheduled maintenance windows, may be carried out at other times. Around-the-clock on-call duty for repairing infrequent network faults is included on a rotating schedule, with compensation under the applicable agreement.
Applications and questions
Send a description of yourself and your experience as a fiber technician – the types of networks and projects you have worked on, and your responsibilities in them – together with details of your references, to jobs@optictunnels.com. We will only contact your references once we have agreed with you to do so. Questions about the position are welcome at the same address. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Read more about Optic Tunnels at www.optictunnels.com.

Lead mechanical and seismic design and qualification activities for HV circuit breakers in accordance with international standards and customer specifications, including IEEE 693, IEC 62271, and utility-specific seismic requirements.

Convert theoretical results into reality in actual design suggestions in cooperation with product development team.

You hold a M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical, Structural, or Civil Engineering. 
Strong background in structural dynamics, earthquake engineering, and finite element analysis.
Knowledge of material behavior, damping characterization, and experimental modal testing.

Complete a structured handover with the current project lead.  
Review the project baseline, root causes, decisions, initiatives, and expected benefits.  
Convert the existing improvement plan into an integrated realisation plan.

Drive cross-functional implementation and remove barriers to progress.

Track forecast, implemented, and realised benefits together with Finance.

Protect quality, delivery, compliance, and customer value during implementation.  
Ensure sustainable ownership in the line organisation and capture lessons learned.

Strong experience in performance improvement, turnaround, or transformation projects.

Good understanding of P&L, margin, ROS, and product costing.
Experience working across engineering, sourcing, production, and commercial functions.
Structured, persistent, fact-based, and comfortable challenging stakeholders.

Supportive

Responsible

jobs.occupation: Family Medicine Specialist Opportunity in Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Build your medical career in one of Norway's most beautiful regions
Would you like to work in a modern and well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, a manageable patient list, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?
On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a Family Medicine Specialist for a permanent position in a well-established GP practice in Western Norway.
This is an excellent opportunity for a doctor who wants professional autonomy, a strong clinical environment, and a high quality of life surrounded by fjords, mountains, and stunning nature.
About the position
You will join a modern GP practice with three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently consists of approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of increasing the list size over time if desired.
The municipality is committed to maintaining a supportive professional environment with skilled colleagues, experienced support staff, and a strong focus on quality of care.
Your responsibilities will include:
Managing your own patient list
Diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of patients of all ages
Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
Up to 20% municipal medical duties
Participation in the local emergency care service rotation

Emergency care services
The municipality is part of an established intermunicipal emergency care collaboration serving five municipalities.
The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and offers:
Well-organised out-of-hours emergency services
Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
Emergency medical communication services
24/7 support from experienced healthcare personnel
This provides a safe and professionally rewarding environment during emergency shifts.

We offer
Permanent full-time position
A modern and well-established GP practice
Strong professional support and collaboration
Continuing medical education and professional development opportunities
Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements
Free Norwegian language training
Guidance throughout the Norwegian authorisation process
Dedicated support from an experienced recruitment advisor

About the area
The position is located in Vestland County, home to some of Norway's most spectacular landscapes.
The region offers:
World-famous fjords and mountain scenery
Excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, climbing, and fishing
Safe and family-friendly communities
Good schools, cultural activities, and sports facilities
Easy access to larger towns and cities in Western Norway
Here, you can enjoy both an exciting medical career and an exceptional work-life balance.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates who:
Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
Have good English language skills
Are motivated to learn Norwegian
Have good communication and collaboration skills
Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?
General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.
Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

We are looking for a software developer to join our Home & Pro product development team at Dirac at our office in Copenhagen, Danmark. If you are eager to work with cutting-edge audio technologies and contribute to innovative audio solutions, this role is for you. You will work on the Dirac Live end-user application that helps bring our latest flagship technologies to market, including Dirac Live Active Room Treatment (ART), now available on several leading OEMs.

At Dirac, we provide a highly entrepreneurial environment where you can be part of a team that is passionate about building a great business and inventing the future of sound. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in leading-edge technologies that make a real impact on everyday experiences. You’ll be a part of a supportive and collaborative agile development team that values quality and continuous improvement. You’ll join a product area with strong momentum, with Dirac Live expanding across premium home audio categories, from AV receivers and processors to streaming amplifiers and soundbars.
Key responsibilities
As a software developer for Dirac Live, you will join an agile product team of passionate developers and audio enthusiasts. You will contribute to the solution’s end-user application, including design, implementation, testing, and evaluation of the front-end. You will be key in integration, testing, and release. Most of the implementation is in C++ and the application is released for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. The team also releases plug-ins for digital audio workstations. This code is written in JUCE and is also part of your responsibilities.
Develop the Dirac Live application for desktop and mobile
Implement new features, as well as testing and maintenance of the existing applications
Implement the user interfaces using Qt QML and JUCE
Configure and evaluate the complete solution using audio equipment in our audio labs
Assist the product manager to refine complex and large work items into smaller, valuable and estimated user stories
Assist with 2nd-line customer support

Who you are
Master of Science in Computer Science, Engineering Physics or a related field
2+ years of industry experience of UI development
Experience building cross-platform applications for desktop and mobile
Programming experience and proficiency in C++
A team-oriented attitude, as well as the ability to work independently
Fluency in both spoken and written English
Valid work permit or citizenship that allows you to work in Denmark

Desired qualifications
Programming experience with Qt QML or similar languages
Strong passion for audio, and experience setting up audio systems for recording and mixing audio
Experience with relevant software engineering tools for CI/CD (Git, CMake, Conan)
Experience with agile development
Experience collaborating on UI/UX and product design
Familiarity with signal processing

About Dirac
Dirac is an audio tech company, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world’s most reputable brands. We are passionate about audio and innovation, and our pioneering technology is shaping the future of sound experiences.
We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, and R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, with representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States.
Please read more about us at https://www.dirac.com/ and follow us on social media!
Location
The location will be at Dirac’s R&D office in Copenhagen.

Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's functionality while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies
Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.
Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)
Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints

This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.

Background
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or equivalent. • Experience with hardware engineering and system design activities for substations, HVDC, FACTS or grid infrastructure projects. • Experience developing Plant Circuit Diagrams and other hardware engineering documentation. • Experience with hardware selection and cubicle design activities. • Experience working with transmission and distribution networks or substations. • Understanding of power system planning, grid integration and energy infrastructure development. • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments. • Fluent English is required. Swedish is considered an advantage.
Meritorious
• Experience from battery energy storage systems (BESS) and energy storage integration projects. • Experience working with regulatory frameworks, permitting processes, grid codes or utility compliance requirements. • Experience from HVDC, FACTS or STATCOM projects. • Experience from renewable energy integration projects. • Experience coordinating engineering activities or technical work packages. • Experience working with utilities, transmission operators or grid owners. • Project Management certification or formal project management experience. • Experience working in international project environments. • Willingness to learn Swedish and engage with the local working environment.

ABOUT THE POSITION AND THE COMPANY
With a wide range of products for the entire family, Biltema is a strong brand with more than 160 stores across the Nordic region and plans for further expansion. The success and vision are based on a simple concept that has been refined over the years; To make it economically easier for people to have cars, boats, homes, tools, and leisure articles of high quality, thereby creating a richer leisure time for these people. They choose their own path and have therefore decided to invest in their own operations and development of systems and technical solutions, among other things. Biltema Nordic Services is a service company within Biltema with various departments that together deliver a complete solution for the department stores' assortment and operations. The IT department in Helsingborg provides systems and digital solutions in collaboration with Biltema's other companies within the group for our Nordic markets.
We are looking for a Solution Architect to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions across our international organization.
Working closely with the Enterprise Architecture team, business stakeholders, project managers, and technical teams, you will own solution architecture from initial assessment through implementation and operational handover. You will ensure that projects align with our enterprise architecture principles, technology roadmap, security requirements, and operational capabilities.

YOU ARE OFFERED

To work for a company with healthy values and play an important role in the future development of Biltema's systems.

Work in an organization with clear leadership and a clear and long-term vision.

The opportunity to work at a well-managed and very prosperous company that values entrepreneurship and simplicity.

EXAMPLES OF WORK TASKS

Own end-to-end solution architecture for assigned projects, from business requirements through design, implementation and operational handover

Design secure, scalable solutions across Azure and on-premises environments, including identity, data flows and non-functional requirements

Define integration approaches between ERP platforms (Dynamics 365 and AX), business applications and data platforms

Apply enterprise architecture standards, prepare proposals for architecture reviews, and flag risks, technical debt and exceptions early

Embed security and privacy in every design, including threat modeling and production readiness

Lead workshops with business stakeholders, delivery teams and vendors, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences

Assess vendor proposals and challenge unnecessary complexity or long-term dependency

EXPERIENCE

Significant experience in solution architecture or a comparable role, with ownership of complex solutions in an enterprise environment.

Demonstrated ability to take solutions from business requirements through design, implementation, and operational transition.

Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud architecture.

Experience designing integrations across enterprise applications, including APIs, messaging, events, and data exchanges.

Working knowledge of identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, authentication, and authorization.

Ability to define non-functional requirements and make informed decisions about resilience, performance, security, and cost.

Experience working with project managers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, developers, security teams, and external suppliers.

Strong architectural documentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Experience working within architecture governance and Agile delivery practices.

Professional fluency in English and the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Start: By agreement
Working hours: Standard office hours with the possibility for hybrid work.
Location: Helsingborg
Type of employment: This assignment is a recruitment, and the employment will be directly with our client. Salary, terms, and conditions are discussed separately.
The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Therefore, Biltema Nordic Services requests that all inquiries regarding the position be directed to A-Hub.

TL;DR: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the Lovable agent end-to-end - owning quality, roadmap, and the feedback loops that make it better. You'll shape how our agent reasons, acts, and delivers for millions of users, directly influencing one of the most consequential product surfaces at Lovable.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
8+ years in the software industry, with direct ownership of an AI or LLM-powered product in a product management or engineering leadership role

Hands-on experience building and shipping agent-based systems - you understand tool use, planning loops, multi-step reasoning, and how agents fail

Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can read model outputs, traces, and evals with confidence

Strong product sense and systems thinking - you know when to move fast and when to invest in foundational work, and you have sharp opinions on how agents should communicate, recover from errors, and earn user trust

Preferred: Deep familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluation frameworks; prior experience operating at the frontier where best practices are still being written

What you'll do
Represent the user - synthesize findings on agent performance and behavior, and bring them to the team with clarity and conviction

Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, eval analysis, prompt experimentation, and crafting messaging for upcoming agent capabilities

Own the quality bar for agent outputs - drive eval infrastructure, monitor regressions, and ensure the agent improves with every release

Scope ruthlessly - ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't

Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to communicate new agent capabilities effectively

Projects you'll tackle first: Rebuilding the agent evaluation framework to catch regressions before they ship; running discovery on the biggest gaps in agent reliability and trust; defining and shipping the first iteration of improved agent error recovery and communication

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

OpenAPI specifications

Job Scope 
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 
The Manufacturing technician is responsible for ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient production and maintenance operations. This position covers a broad technical scope, including production support, troubleshooting, preventive and corrective maintenance, and continuous improvements in mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and automation systems. Technicians act as first-line responders to equipment and process issues, ensuring minimum downtime and maximum output and high quality. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections. 
Perform risk analysis and participate in risk assessments according to established routines. 
Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time. 
Troubleshoot and resolve production line issues (mechanical, electrical, automation, process) and completing validation runs of production to confirm the effectiveness of work. 
Support production teams with first-line problem solving and escalate unsolved issues. 
Perform corrective and preventive maintenance on production equipment (electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic). 
Install, maintain, and repair equipment, wiring, and systems (mechanical assemblies, electrical systems). 
Inspect equipment for wear, vibrations, lubrication, or electrical faults and escalate to one level above the need for repair if necessary. 
Define and manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability. 
Read and update technical documentation including (but not limited to): diagrams, blueprints, troubleshooting guidelines, checklists and work instructions. 
Train newly onboarded team members and colleagues in technical and safety procedures. 
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and maintenance program optimization. 
Ensure all work complies with safety standards and regulatory requirements. 
Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for repairs, troubleshooting and escalation. 
Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process. 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business, including but not limited to running the line, completing 5S, cleaning activities & quality sampling. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 
Qualifications and Experience 
Technical/industrial background (Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or related). 
3+ years previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing) 
Vocational education within Industrial/Electrical Gymnasium or equivalent. 
Six Sigma White or Yellow Belt certification is a plus. 
Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) 
Basic IT literacy (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). 
Understanding how to utilize equipment to run efficient manufacturing with energy and costing optimization. 
Experience in troubleshooting with specialized diagnostic equipment (multimeter, oscilloscope, etc). 
Experience with equipment, piping, pumps, valves, control tools, chemicals, and electronics. 
Administrative competence, including experience with ERP systems, work orders, email, and incident reporting. 

Specific skills & Knowledge  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 
A genuine technical interest and curiosity about working within production is highly valued. A good understanding of machines and equipment such as pipes, pumps, and valves is a plus.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 
A Quality Technician leads product and process quality compliance in production line. This role is responsible for confirming key quality attributes of intermediate products and processes as well as identifying and responding to non-conformity issues in production. In addition, this role is responsible for analysing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Production using a range of instruments. This role will work closely with production staff and Quality Engineers. A Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that production processes and products meet internal and customers’ quality specifications as well as defining problems, recommending solutions and follows-up on improvements. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities . Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  :
Lead day-to-day quality assurance activities in production ensuring that production/product quality specifications are met.  
Ensure control checks are completed according to control plan in defined time.  
Ensure robust start of production and coordinated quality handover between shifts.   
Ensure 5S in control and measurement areas and participate in improving 5S methodology and actions together with production team.  
Ensure documentation and record of product and process quality data and utilize these to improve processes.  
Potential to operate various measurement equipment such as a Karl Fischer, measurement by ruler or micrometre, microscopes, perform testing with measuring instruments, perform basic data analysis, interpret data and report data/results as instructed.   
Interpret data and report data/results on yearly, monthly, and daily basis.  
Understand and execute the testing plans for material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products.   
Help identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Organize test results in the expected template and/or LIMS system and maintain control charts.  
Be able to troubleshoot instrument on basic and advance problems and utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Act on deviations and ensure coordination with customer processes.  
Ensure imminent containment activities and decision making in case of non-conformities and quality issues. 
Mentor less experienced personnel on practical aspects of the analysis methods such as sample preparation and running instruments.   
Maintain the instruments to a high standard.   
Ensure conformity of cleanliness requirements in process. 
Conduct Layered Product audit according to schedule.  
Contribute to improvement actions in area of responsibility.  
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No 
Direct reports: No 
Work environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 
Qualifications and Experience 
Professional education (ideally in industry) is a plus. 
2 years experience in manufacturing and 2 years experience in quality.   
Bachelor´s degree in a technical field is preferred but not required. 
Previous experience of quality control from automotive industry is preferred.   
Familiar with Lean and Six Sigma concepts.  
Familiar with SPC, FMEA, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. 

Specific skills & Knowledge  
Specific knowledge of quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, TQM is preferred.   
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform work in controlled environments, including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs.

jobs.occupation: Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric- Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Mpya Finance is recruiting a Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric in Copenhagen – a key role for you who want to combine technical accounting expertise with impact, development and an international context.
If you are looking to advance your career, this is your opportunity to take the next step and develop together with Schneider.
At Schneider Electric, sustainability, innovation and performance go hand in hand. This is an opportunity to become a trusted financial partner in an organization that is actively shaping the future of energy.

About the role
As Chief Accountant, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance across the Nordic and Baltic entities, working closely with the global Shared Service Center in India. You will be part of a strong, international finance organization where collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development are highly valued.
The role offers both responsibility and variety – from statutory reporting and balance sheet ownership to process improvements and cross-border collaboration.

Your main responsibilities:

Ensure high quality and accuracy in financial reporting

Lead monthly and quarterly closings in accordance with IFRS and local GAAP

Full responsibility for balance sheet accuracy and reviews

Ownership of annual reports, income tax returns and tax reporting

Lead Balance Sheet Review meetings and collaborate with key stakeholders

Coordinate and drive external audits for assigned legal entities

Drive simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of accounting processes

Participate in finance projects, system improvements and ad hoc analyses

Who are we looking for?
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a solid accounting foundation and the confidence to take ownership in a complex, international environment.
We are looking for someone who has:
• A degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent
• At least 3 years of experience working with Danish accounting, preferably in a global organization
• Experience working with a Shared Service Center (meritorious)
• Strong skills in SAP (or similar), Excel and other MS tools
• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

As a person, you are structured, methodical, and quality-driven. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work proactively, and thrive in a complex international environment. At the same time, you are a true team player who enjoys collaborating closely with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and geographies.
We believe that success in this role comes from balancing strong individual accountability with a collaborative mindset. You build trust easily, communicate clearly, and actively contribute to the team's results and development. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and working together to achieve common goals.

What Schneider Electric offers
At Schneider Electric, you will join a globally recognized company with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation and people development. You will be part of a professional and forward-looking finance organization where you are encouraged to grow, challenge existing ways of working and develop your career over time.
This is a role where your expertise truly matters – and where you can make a real impact.
Learn more at www.se.com

Application
In this recruitment, Schneider Electric cooperates with Mpya Finance. Selection is ongoing, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For questions about the role or the process, please contact: Kristina Bennet – kristina.bennet@mpya.se Johanna Andersson – johanna.andersson@mpya.se 
Welcome with your application – we look forward to hearing from you.

Är du vår nästa sushi-stjärna? Bli en del av Woso-familjen!
Woso Sushi Salad är en populär restaurang med japanska smaker som fått Sverige att sukta efter mer. Vår första restaurang, som öppnade i Malmö, lade grunden för vårt äventyr. Nu söker vi dig som vill bli en del av vår familj och förgylla våra gästers smakupplevelser!

Vi söker dig som har en passion för asiatisk matlagning inom sushi & sallad och som vill ta med den energin till vår kökspersonal i Malmö. En heltidstjänst med arbete både vardagar och helger. Ett härligt gäng kollegor och en chans att utvecklas inom restaurangen.

Are you our next sushi star? Become part of the Woso family!
Woso Sushi Salad is a popular restaurant with Japanese flavors that has made Sweden yearn for more. Our first restaurant, which opened in Malmö, laid the foundation for our adventure. Now we are looking for you who want to become part of our family and enhance our guests' taste experiences!

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who has a passion for Asian cooking in sushi & salad and who wants to bring that energy to our kitchen staff in Malmö. You have a positive attitude and contribute to a good atmosphere in the kitchen. You work efficiently and enjoy being part of a team where everyone strives towards the same goal.

What we offer
A full-time position with work both weekdays and weekends. A wonderful group of colleagues and a chance to develop within the restaurant.
- Permanent employment
- Full time
- fixed monthly salary
- No requirement to be able to work with sushi before

SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
The Role
As a Software Engineer in our Backend team, you are part of our tech team based in Stockholm or Halmstad. You will be a part of building and developing the next generation investment platform. Your role involves close collaboration with fellow Software Engineers, as well as with Data Scientists, Product Designers and Product Managers.
Your Mission
Build Software Features in a fast paced environment

Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective

Contribute towards improving our tech stack, architecture, and operational methods

Collaborate and build high-quality products by following good engineering practices

Develop integrations to third-party API's

Embrace our learning culture by both receiving and providing feedback, and be open to getting constructive feedback on your code

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...
Are a motivated engineer with a passion for software development 

Recognize the importance of collaboration in order to build a great product, and enjoys engaging with colleagues to exchange ideas and concepts

Have 5+ years professional software development experience

Are a team player who is open to everyone’s opinions

Do you enjoy building products that people rely on every day, and having the freedom to decide how the solution should be built?

At Jobylon, you'll join a team where engineers are trusted to own features from idea to production. You'll spend most of your time building, with few meetings competing for your attention, and you'll see the impact of your work in a product used by thousands of recruiters and hiring managers worldwide.

You'll have room to shape solutions, improve existing workflows, and contribute to the direction of the product. Some of the challenges involve scaling for new markets and growing customer demands. Others are much smaller but equally important: removing friction, simplifying complex processes, and making everyday work easier for the people using the platform.

About the job

You'll work on a product that many of our customers spend hours in every day. The improvements you make won't disappear into a backlog or an internal system that nobody sees. They'll become part of the daily workflow of recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates across Europe.

You'll take ownership of features from specification through deployment, working closely with product and engineering to understand the problem before deciding on the solution. Rather than being handed isolated tasks, you'll be trusted to drive meaningful parts of the product forward.

The team works in focused 8-week cycles, with dedicated time both for building and for improving. That means you'll have space to address technical debt, refine existing functionality, and explore better ways of working, not just move from one deadline to the next.

You'll primarily work with Python and Django, alongside modern frontend technologies, but the focus is less on the tools themselves and more on building a product that solves real customer problems.

We're also actively exploring how AI can help us build better products and work more effectively, and you'll have plenty of freedom to experiment with modern tools and ways of working.

About you

You have several years of experience as a full-stack developer, primarily working with web-based products. You feel comfortable taking ownership of features throughout the entire development lifecycle, from understanding requirements to seeing your work live in production.

You have professional experience with Django, meaning you have been hands-on in building scalable Django based products in a professional setting.

You've worked in product-focused environments where engineers are expected to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and help shape solutions, not just implement them.

You speak and write English fluently, as it's our working language.

You are currently located in Poland and is open to working remotely.

Jobylon develops and offers a modern hiring software (SaaS) to companies who want to create and share beautiful job ads and manage their applicants with ease. The recruitment industry has stayed unchanged for too long whilst the need for a simple and efficient tool has increased.

Jobylon was founded in 2011 and since then we've launched a number of exciting projects and ventures within the HR tech space. We've always had the same goal - to use technology and innovation to change and simplify what is today a traditional space.

During this time we've also been awarded as one of Sweden's hottest entrepreneurs and nominated for the Red Herring award - we've done this with a small but dedicated team!

Today, we work with nearly 1000 employers from more than 80 countries worldwide , including amazing organisations such as 7-Eleven, Schibsted, Scandic Hotels, Vaimo, Bonnier and many more!

jobs.occupation: Technical Support Engineer to a Global Company in Västerås
jobs.description:
About the company
Our client is a global industrial company that creates products, solutions, and services within areas including automation and electrification. The group operates in more than 100 countries with over 100,000 employees worldwide. They develop technology that makes industries more efficient, more reliable, and that keeps the world running, every day.
At our client, you'll be part of an organisation where technical expertise, responsibility, and long-term thinking are at the centre. We're looking for people who take ownership and constantly strive to get better at what they do, in an environment with strong support, experienced colleagues, and the opportunity to develop over time.
About the role 
As a Technical Support Engineer, you will work in the division working with high voltage rotating machines, ranging from motors and generators to synchronous condensers, for some of the world's most demanding industrial environments. The service organisation in Västerås is responsible for supporting the globally installed base of these machines.
In this role you'll be part of the technical support team and work closely with local service units, external customers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service and professionalism in every interaction.
Key responsibilities

Provide technical support to local service units, external customers, and internal teams

Handle warranty cases for factory products, including technical investigations and root cause analysis

Manage and follow up on support cases in a shared case management system

Ensure cases and projects are handled in a structured, professional, and high-quality manner

Deliver clear and effective communication from both a technical and customer perspective

Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems and communicating clearly with customers. To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

A vocational education in automation or other related field, or a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, automation, energy systems, or a similar field

Experience and knowledge of PLC programming, ideally function block programming

Knowledge of testing and troubleshooting

Good communication skills in English, as the role involves contact with customers and colleagues globally. Swedish is an advantage but not required

It's an advantage if you have

Previous experience in a technical role, preferably within testing and troubleshooting of electrical machines and control cabinets

Experience with systems such as Salesforce and SAP

Personal qualities
You're customer-focused and collaborative, with a strong service mindset, and thrive on handling demanding customer dialogues in a global environment. You're a natural team player who also takes initiative, with strong prioritisation skills and a level head when several cases are running in parallel. You're curious, solution-oriented, and genuinely interested in contributing to the team's continuous improvement work.
Practical information
Start: To be discussed Location: Västerås Scope: Full-time Employment: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months
Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Don't hesitate to send in your application today – the selection process is ongoing!
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy (https://www.a-hub.se/integritetspolicy).

Are you passionate about power systems protection and eager to contribute to the energy transition? We are now looking for several HVDC Protection Project Engineers to join our global HVDC team in Ludvika. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, customers, and suppliers to deliver innovative HVDC solutions that support grid stability and sustainable energy development.

Perform protection studies including fault calculations, relay coordination, and stability analyses for HVDC converter stations and transmission systems.
Develop and review protection philosophies, functional design specifications, logic diagrams, and test procedures.
Configure, verify, and validate protection schemes to ensure reliable system performance and compliance with project requirements.

Collaborate closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and engineering disciplines to resolve technical challenges and optimize solutions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives, share knowledge, and mentor less experienced engineers within the organization.

Desirable understanding of HVDC technology, converter topologies (VSC and/or LCC), and associated protection principles.
Strong knowledge of high voltage substation protection and control systems, including design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of protection schemes for transmission and distribution networks.
Experience with Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) settings, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
Proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or DIgSILENT PowerFactory.

jobs.description:
As a Senior/Lead Economy and Engagement Designer at Embark, you will be responsible for designing and implementing systems and mechanics that are deep and interesting for our players to engage with and retain them, short, medium and long term, as well as sustainable and player-friendly monetization features and models, that provide real value to our players, in a fair way.
You will join the team on ARC Raiders and collaborate closely with the directors of the project, in refining concepts and ideas into tangible designs, prototypes and features, as well as Production leadership helping in articulating and establishing estimates, project scope and timelines. You will share your insights and knowledge in shaping relevant performance indicators, as well as validation methods using telemetry data and simulations.
As a senior member of the design team we would like you to act as a coach and mentor to some of the other designers on the project, and possibly take on direct managerial responsibilities, if relevant and suitable. Inspiring and helping more junior designers with design methodology, documentation practices, etc.
You will also own and spearhead game features directly, and work hands-on in cross disciplinary teams while implementing features and tools for running a successful and smooth live service game, including community events and other types of events. 
Example of responsibilities 

Design, implementation and evaluation of our monetization strategy including quantitative and qualitative analysis, as well as any available automation and simulation strategies.

Understanding player motivations and how they relate to our game loops, especially in terms of delivering a fun gameplay experience with engagement systems.

Responsible for in-game virtual store including recommendations and contributions towards catalog and pricing strategy for micro-transactions.

Joint optimization with marketing, acquisition and crm teams for the entire user journey.

Be a key stakeholder in game frontend presentation and flow for engagement and game economy features.

Design and collaborate on metagame, progression and economy systems for long term player retention and engagement.

Analyze the impact of changes in the game, identify opportunities that will have a positive impact on monetization and engagement in development and post launch.

Help define key performance indicators (KPIs) related to monetization, analyze KPI reports and share information with the team and stakeholders to identify and predict trends.

Monitor trends on monetization in order to identify best practices, achieve optimal results and innovation.

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind.

5+ years or more experience in equivalent roles.

An understanding of acquisition, retention and monetization concepts.

Understanding of AAA gameplay and game design, including player psychology, UX design, gameplay design.

Proficiency with the Unreal Engine and experience with Blueprints and scripting.

Ability to design and continuously improve the optimization process of any given game.

Experience with experimental design and/or AB Testing for data driven designs.

Experience of coaching more junior members of the team.

Strong communication skills and the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders

Professional English communication skills. 

This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities.

Do you enjoy hands-on electronics work and turning ideas into working prototypes?
You will join our Technology team, a group of around 20 colleagues working with electronics for our robotic lawn mowers. The team brings together a mix of employees and consultants with expertise across hardware development, detailed electronics design, test development, lab activities, and supporting engineering systems.
It is a collaborative and practical environment where you will work closely with hardware engineers and other specialists throughout the development process.
Role Description:
In this role, you will be part of our Lab & Test team, supporting our electronics development with practical lab work. You will work closely with hardware engineers and other colleagues across the team, helping them modify circuit boards, build prototypes and prepare electronics for development and testing. Your main tasks will include:
Responsible for maintaining and supporting the soldering lab.
Advanced soldering, including manual SMD rework on PCBAs
Modifying and troubleshooting electronic assemblies
Building electronic and electromechanical prototypes
Supporting engineers with practical electronics and lab activities
Working according to ESD and EPA requirements

Your profile
We believe you have a practical background in electronics, for example from electronics manufacturing, EMS, electronics production or a similar environment. You are comfortable working hands-on with circuit boards and electronic components and have a good general understanding of electronics and electromechanical circuits. You have:
Around 3-4 years of relevant experience, particularly if you have worked extensively with soldering and electronics service
Strong skills in manual soldering and SMD rework
Good knowledge of ESD and EPA practices
Good communication skills in Swedish and English

Experience with 3D modelling and 3D printing and knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC-7711, or similar soldering standards is a plus.
This is an on-site role, where access to the electronics lab and close collaboration with the team are an important part of the everyday work.
Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Fredrik Huus. fredrik.huus@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.
Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.
Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 
Learn more about our culture here.

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – Machine Foundation to join our SW Platform organisation. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role you’ll help shape the core software that every machine application relies on, from our Linux-based operating system to the base functionality and middleware that support it.
 Do you enjoy working close to technology, collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Then we’d love to hear from you.
 Your mission
 As Product Owner you’re responsible for the Machine Foundation product stream. You work with two agile development teams:
  OS team: develops our Linux-based operating system, including the service OS and secure boot.
 Base & Middleware team: works with base functionality and middleware that support the applications running on our machines.
  
You connect the teams with their stakeholders, mainly the internal teams that build on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap, and you shape what goes into the OS. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value.
 You work closely with each team’s Scrum Master and Tech Lead, and you collaborate with our architects in the direction of the base and middleware areas. You work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap, take part in cross-team planning and contribute to release go/no-go decisions. Each team has about 5–8 members.
 You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.
Profile description:Your profile
  You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.
 You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.
 You have an interest in software development and enjoy discussions with developers and architects.
 It’s a plus if you have experience with embedded Linux, operating systems, middleware or platform software, for example in industrial, automotive or similar products.
 You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  
As a person, you’re structured, communicative and collaborative. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and handle different perspectives with care. You enjoy working with people as much as with technology and like to keep learning together with others.
 We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products.
 Location
 The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office.
 Application and contacts
 Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November.
 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media. 
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Manager for External Design
jobs.description:
The opportunity 
At Hitachi Energy Power Transformers in Ludvika, we develop and deliver some of the world's most advanced transformers, supporting the global transition to a more sustainable energy system.
We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Manager to lead our External Design team. In this role, you will be responsible for a group of highly skilled engineers working with customer-driven projects in close collaboration with production, project management, quality, supply chain, and customers around the world.
This is a people-focused leadership role where success is built through trust, collaboration, technical excellence, and long-term competence development. You will lead an experienced team, support individual growth, and create conditions for engineers to perform their best while delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.
As part of the Power Transformers Engineering Management Team, you will contribute to the continued development of our engineering organization and help shape how we work, grow, and succeed together.
Ludvika has been at the center of power transmission innovation for more than a century. Here, you will combine local teamwork and long-term relationships with the opportunity to contribute to projects that support energy transition on a global scale.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 15–20 mechanical engineers.
Foster a culture built on collaboration, ownership, safety, and continuous learning.
Support competence development and long-term succession planning within the team.
Work closely with project management, production, quality, and other engineering functions to ensure successful project execution.
Drive continuous improvements in ways of working, quality, and operational performance.
Balance customer requirements, business priorities, and sound engineering judgement.
Contribute to the strategic development of the Mechanical Design organization.
Create an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and challenged to grow

Your background
You hold a degree in Engineering or have gained equivalent knowledge through substantial experience in a technical field.
You have experience from engineering, product development, manufacturing, project execution, or another industrial environment.
Previous leadership experience is beneficial but not required. We are equally interested in experienced leaders and strong technical professionals ready to take the next step.
Experience from transformers, power systems, heavy industry, manufacturing, mechanical design, or related technical fields is an advantage.
You enjoy working with people and understanding how to build engagement, trust, and high-performing teams.
You are comfortable balancing day-to-day operational needs with longer-term strategic objectives.
You communicate effectively with engineers, specialists, project managers, production teams, customers, and senior stakeholders.
You are fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​
Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com​

CellaVision is a global leader in digital microscopy, delivering complete solutions that combine advanced instruments, reagents, and software to support healthcare services worldwide. Our vision is clear: To elevate healthcare through the evolution of microscopy - in a sustainable way.
We work at the forefront of technology and use advances in programming, chemistry, digital imaging, and machine learning. Joining CellaVision means playing an important role in supporting healthcare through the continued evolution of microscopy.
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Location: Lund, Sweden
Job type: Full Time, Permanent
How will you contribute?
As a member of an Applications team, you will develop algorithms and software for our analyzers that automatically locate and pre-classify cells. Working together in the Application team, you will specialize in programming and digital image processing, used in our software to automatically detect, and classify cells and other objects in blood and body fluids. You will contribute to our entire development process, from algorithm development, implementation, code reviews, and documentation, to the creation and execution of tests.
As a Senior Software Engineer your work will involve:
Act as technical lead and advisor for SW development.
Develop and maintain Windows desktop applications for lab personnel, using C++, C# and WPF.
Develop and maintain backend services for coordinating access to databases and connecting labs, using C++ and SQL.
Develop algorithms within digital imaging using C++ and Python.
Develop and maintain existing products within Product care.
Perform troubleshooting and testing as part of the quality work.
Conduct investigations and research tasks.
Review designs, reports, and source code contributions from colleagues.
Participate in cross-functional demos and forums as team representative.
Mentor more junior colleagues.

What will you bring?
M.Sc. in Engineering within an appropriate field.
Extensive experience in programming skills in C++ or C#.
Experience in machine learning is a bonus.
Very good ability to understand the overall architecture and design of large software systems.
Very good ability to take initiatives and come up with new proposals for working methods as well a strong sense of responsibility.
Very good at evaluating and solving problems.
Very good English communication skills, verbal and written.
Experience in product development involving electronics, mechanics, and software.

What We Offer
Inclusive, Innovative Culture: Work in an international, collaborative environment focused on executing big ideas and adding customer value.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible hours and reduced working hours to help maintain balance.
Job Security: We offer a collective agreement, including comprehensive insurance, occupational pension, parental leave supplements, and more.
Health & Wellbeing: We support your health with free access to a gym, wellness allowance, lunch benefits, sponsored running competitions, and discounts on gym memberships.
Modern Workplace: Enjoy a vibrant, collaborative office environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.
Team Spirit: Join us for weekly breakfasts and fun team-building activities.

Ready to Join Us?
This is a full-time position based at our CellaVision HQ in Lund, Sweden—a modern office with great infrastructure and commuting options. We’re looking for someone to start as soon as possible.
Apply Now! Follow the application form and attach your resume by November 30, at the latest. We’re excited to hear from you!
Please note that you need a valid working permit in Sweden for this role.
Diversity is in our blood.
CellaVision is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.
We decline all contact regarding services in advertising, consulting, or recruitment.
About Us
CellaVision is a global leader in digital cell morphology within hematology, and our analyzers are trusted in healthcare services around the world. We focus on innovation, working with the latest in programming, digital imaging, and machine learning to provide value to our customers. By joining us, you'll be part of a creative, skilled team shaping the future of medical technology.

Company Description
AFRY is a European leader in engineering, design, and advisory services, with a global reach. We accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society. We are 17,000 devoted experts in infrastructure, industry, energy and digitalisation, creating sustainable solutions for generations to come. 
Continuous learning of all our employees is critical for our ability to deliver on our business strategy. We need to develop the right skills and foster a culture of continuous learning to win in a complex and competitive market. We want to offer dynamic and proactive learning opportunities for our people to develop themselves.

Job Description
Group Treasury is responsible for managing and coordinating the AFRY Group’s financial activities and financial risk exposure. The team consists of five dedicated professionals and plays a central role in supporting the company’s financial stability and growth. In this position, you will join a close-knit and collaborative team in a broad and dynamic role encompassing cash management, cash flow forecasting, bank guarantees, KYC processes, treasury operations, and related back-office activities. You will gain exposure to a wide range of treasury disciplines while working closely with stakeholders across the organization.
Group Treasury is also driving several development initiatives, including the enhancement of cash management processes, banking relationships, and the treasury system landscape. As a key member of the team, you will play an integral role in shaping and implementing these initiatives, contributing to the continued development and efficiency of the treasury function.

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate with a post-secondary education in finance, economics, or equivalent. Previous experience from a corporate treasury function, particularly within treasury operations, is considered an advantage. You are able to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. As the role involves active participation in and leadership of development projects, we are looking for someone with strong coordination skills and a proven ability to drive initiatives, manage stakeholders, and contribute to successful project delivery.
Main responsibilities
Support in preparation of monthly financial statements and reporting
Manage bank and corporate guarantees
Financial payments and transactions and related administration
Responsible for banking authorizations and bank administration together with our Treasury Specialist
Management of cashpools, group netting, and liquidity forecasting
Main KYC contact person towards banks
Maintaining key processes and static data in the Treasury Management System
