Are you ready to take the next step in your career in intellectual property?
Do you want to work with innovative companies, develop strong client relationships, take increasing responsibility for client matters over time, and grow your career alongside highly skilled colleagues across AWA?
 
At AWA, we believe great results are created through collaboration, knowledge sharing and a genuine commitment to helping our clients succeed.
About AWA                                                                                                                                                      
AWA is one of Europe's leading intellectual property firms, with more than 400 colleagues across 20 offices in Europe and Asia.
We work with innovative companies ranging from ambitious start-ups to some of the world's most recognized brands, helping them create, protect and maximize the value of their intellectual assets.
At AWA, you'll collaborate across disciplines, offices and countries while developing your expertise alongside experienced colleagues.
As an employee-owned company, we share a common commitment to our clients and our future. More than half of our colleagues choose to become shareholders, creating a culture of ownership, entrepreneurship and long-term thinking.
 
About the role                                                                                                                                                
As an Associate, Intellectual Property, you will advise clients on a wide range of intellectual property matters and support them in navigating both legal and commercial challenges. You'll support clients across a broad range of intellectual property matters, including trademarks, designs, patents, domain names, agreements and disputes. Working closely with attorneys, patent consultants and paralegals, you'll help clients navigate both legal and commercial challenges while developing your own expertise and client relationships.
The role can be based in Lund, Malmö, Helsingborg or Gothenburg (Hybrid).
Your role will include:
Advising clients on intellectual property strategy and risk assessment.
Supporting clients in matters relating to trademarks, designs, patents and domain names.
Handling infringement matters, disputes and enforcement-related issues.
Drafting, reviewing and negotiating IP-related agreements.
Representing clients in interactions with authorities and courts.
Building client relationships and collaborating with colleagues across AWA.

 
Who are you?
We believe you are a curious, driven and collaborative legal professional with a genuine interest in intellectual property. You enjoy working in a collaborative and down-to-earth environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork and a low-prestige mindset are valued.
You:
Hold a law degree.
Have approximately 3-5 years of post-graduation experience, with at least some of this time spent within intellectual property law at a law firm, IP firm, in-house legal department, court or relevant authority.
Communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.
Enjoy combining legal analysis with practical and commercially relevant advice.
Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.
Take initiative, ownership and responsibility for your work.
Enjoy a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and teamwork are key.
Are curious, eager to learn and motivated to continue developing your expertise.
Experience of IP disputes, drafting and negotiating agreements, or working directly with clients is an advantage, but not required.

 
Why join AWA?
At AWA, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow and take on increasing responsibility while working alongside highly skilled colleagues in a collaborative and employee-owned environment.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Work with innovative companies ranging from start-ups to global market leaders.
Develop your expertise across a broad range of IP matters.
Develop strong client relationships and take increasing responsibility for client matters over time.
Learn from experienced colleagues and collaborate across disciplines
Benefit from continuous professional development, teamwork and knowledge sharing.
Join a collaborative and employee-owned company where your ideas and contributions matter.

Interested?
We look forward to receiving your application and will review candidates continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 3 December 2026.
If you have questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Ida Listrup, HR Business Partner, at ida.listrup@awa.com.

deedooh är ett svenskt techbolag som utvecklar en plattform för att göra digital utomhusreklam enklare och mer tillgänglig för företag och marknadsförare.
Sedan lanseringen i juni 2026 har vi genomfört kampanjer på 10 internationella marknader. Nu växer vi och söker en ny kollega som vill vara med och utveckla vår plattform vidare.
Om rollen
Vi söker en driven Product Developer / Fullstack Developer som vill vara med och forma framtidens deedooh.
Du arbetar nära grundarna och får en central roll i produktutvecklingen, med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både teknik och produkt.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
Utveckla nya funktioner i vår plattform.

Arbeta med frontend, backend och API-integrationer.

Förbättra användarupplevelse och prestanda.

Bidra till tekniska lösningar, produktstrategi och automatisering.

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker en självgående och lösningsorienterad utvecklare med ett starkt intresse för teknik och produktutveckling.
Vi tror att du:
Har erfarenhet av modern webbutveckling, frontend och backend.

Har kunskap om API, databaser och integrationer.

Har känsla för design och användarupplevelse.

Är initiativrik, nyfiken och gillar att lösa problem.

Har intresse för AI och nya tekniska möjligheter.

Kommunicerar obehindrat på engelska.

Department of Wildlife, Fish, and Environmental Studies
We are seeking a post doc for a research project focused on understanding biodiversity in managed boreal forests. The project is part of a larger SLU research initiative (the Key Performance Indicator Project) where several researchers, postdocs and PhDs are currently involved, which opens opportunities for collaboration. 
This post doc will focus on issues that concern biodiversity conservation in managed forests by analysing species and structure data from a large-scale field survey conducted in both Sweden and Finland. The research will focus on lichens and polypore fungi, using HMSC modeling to learn how their biodiversity varies based on local forest management and landscape variables. The post doc will work at the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies in Umeå and become a part of a strong research environment focusing on restoration ecology, through empirical studies and large-scale field experiments (see https://www.slu.se/en/departments/wildlife-fish-environmental-studies/research/research-areas/restoration-ecology/). The postdoc will collaborate with the Department of Ecology, the department of Forest Ecology and Management, and the Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) in Finland. 
About the position
The post doc will analyse data from the field survey with the aim of gaining a better understanding of factors controlling species diversity in relation to forest management. They are also expected to write scientific publications together with the research group.
Your profile
The applicant should hold a PhD in ecology (or in a similar relevant subject). As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates obtained a doctoral degree within the last three years. Experience from relevant research questions (Bayesian modeling, Species distribution modeling, terrestrial ecology, nature conservation in forests, landscape ecology, conservation strategies) is a merit. Experience from statistical analyses of large data sets is considered a merit along with a strong publication record (in relation to the time since the doctoral degree). The applicant is expected to be able to take own initiative and work independently and in a group. Excellent skills in written and oral communication in English are required.   
About us
At the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies we offer a creative and stimulating environment and perform internationally recognised basic and applied research, education and environmental monitoring in the areas of biodiversity restoration and conservation, fish biology, wildlife ecology and zoonosis. The department has a large proportion of international employees and well established national and international cooperation which gives opportunities for fruitful exchange.

Company Description

Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort
We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description

Join the Electric Solutions group at Bosch Home Comfort, where software engineering and DevOps come together to support the development of heat pump applications. You will work closely with engineers using model-based development approaches, building a strong understanding of how their software is designed, implemented, tested, integrated, and maintained. 
You will use that understanding to shape reliable, practical tools and workflows that make continuous software development easier. From fast feedback during development to reproducible builds and releases, your work will help teams deliver high-quality software with confidence. 
Your contribution to something big:
Enable continuous development: Design and improve CI/CD workflows that support the way software teams work, from early development and integration through testing and delivery.
Enhance automation: Automate builds, tests, code analysis, packaging, and release activities, with useful feedback that helps engineers identify issues early.
Put software quality first: Consider what matters throughout the development lifecycle, including testability, reproducible builds, version control, traceability, and maintainability.
Partner with engineers: Collaborate with software teams and turn real needs into effective platform improvements.
Improve developer experience: Reduce repetitive manual work and help teams integrate and validate changes frequently and reliably.
Keep delivery systems dependable: Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot build and integration issues, and address bottlenecks across teams and sites.
Scale delivery infrastructure: Contribute to reliable and scalable build infrastructure, including cloud-based services.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you:
Education: 
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. 

Professional Experience & Skills: 
Methodologies: Solid experience in software development, CI/CD, DevOps and agile practices at scale.
Programming: Practical programming skills in Bash, Git, Python, Go, and C. 
Operating Systems: Practical knowledge with Linux and Windows systems.
DevOps Tooling: Practical knowledge of Jenkins, SonarQube, jFrog Artifactory, Bitbucket, Jira, and GitHub.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools (Ansible, Terraform) and server administration (Windows/Linux) is a plus.
Additional Tech Stack: Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, NoSQL databases (such as MongoDB), Grafana, Conan, and Maven is beneficial.

Interpersonal & Language Skills: 
Languages: Fluent in English

About the company
Unilever is one of the world´s leading consumer goods companies, with a portfolio of well-known brands across food, personal care, beauty and home care. With a strong focus on innovation, sustainability and growth, Unilever operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where collaboration and continuous improvement are key to success.
About Customer Operations Europe
The Customer Operations team consist of various roles and teams that make Excellent Execution a success. The Customer Operations teams focus on less time spent on ‘Running the Business’ to reinvest in ‘Growing the Business’ whilst improving Customer and Employee Satisfaction. Operations brings Sales, Supply Chain and Marketing within Unilever together in realizing excellent execution. The 4 principles driving Customer Operations are: end 2 end ownership, maximized automation, one version of the truth and continuous improvement. Team members within Customer Operations embrace the vision and their daily work practice reflects the 4 principles of Operations. Operations effectively works in a cross-country setting, embracing cultural diversity and working in virtual teams.
Competencies key to make Customer Operations a success, are:
Practical creativity
Enterprising behavior                            
Ability to learn

Job summary
As a Product Data Specialist in Customer Operations Europe, you will play a pivotal role in developing end-to-end European product data management (EPDM). EPDM ensures the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of product data across our portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, R&D, and IT, to manage and optimize product data information systems. Your responsibilities will include maintaining product data, overseeing data entry processes, and implementing data governance standards to ensure end-to-end product data management. Furthermore you support the MDM improvement processes by monitoring, evaluating, and resolving processing/programming issues, by coming up with tangible solutions for EPDM systems and related material data sources.
Within the EPDM team, there are three areas of expertise among the European Product Data Specialists:
Material data specialist
End-to-end data specialist
Data flow specialist

During your time as a European Product Data Specialist, you will have the opportunity to alternate between the different expertise groups.
The material data specialists focus is on managing the product data that is classified as material data. Material data relates to the internal supply chain product data; weights, dimensions, hierarchies, transport and storage specifications. The material data specialist is responsible for:
Data enrichment- Creating on-time and in-full data
Data governance- Ensuring on-time and in-full data from Unilever central master data management (MDM) hub
KPI performance- Deliver on target performance on the EPDM KPI’s

Data Accuracy and Quality: Ensure all material product data is accurate, complete, and up-to-date.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure product data complies with local and international regulations.
Data Governance: Establish and maintain data governance policies to ensure data integrity and availability.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for improving data management processes and implement best practices to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
Process Improvement: Identifying and implementing best practices for data management.
Master Data Management (MDM): Overseeing master data creation and maintenance.
Data Standardization: Ensuring adherence to data standards.
Data Cleansing: Regularly auditing and cleaning data.
Innovation Tracking: Monitoring innovations in data management.

Required skills & qualifications
Proficiency in the English language.
Attention to Detail: Ensuring data accuracy and quality.
Data Integration Skills: Integrating and synchronizing data across systems.
Product Information Management (PIM): Managing centralized product information systems.
Data Governance: Establishing and maintaining data governance policies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working with various departments to meet data needs.
Analytical Ability: Analysing process optimization patterns.
Stakeholder Management: Persuading teams to adopt process standards.
Change Management: Leading process change initiatives.
Continuous Improvement: Constantly enhancing processes.
Communication: Effectively conveying process requirements.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer – Innovative Wind Propulsion Technology
jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Oceanbird

Are you a Mechanical Engineer who enjoys turning technical designs into practical solutions? Would you like to contribute to innovative technology that is helping transform the global shipping industry?
Briljantin Consulting is currently looking for a Mechanical Engineer for our client Oceanbird.
Oceanbird is developing innovative wind propulsion technology with the ambition to reduce emissions from commercial shipping. The company is a joint venture between Alfa Laval and Wallenius, combining extensive industrial experience with pioneering engineering solutions.
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Oceanbird's Customer Projects team, where you will play an important role in adapting and delivering mechanical solutions for customer-specific installations.
You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements and mechanical design to manufacturing, installation and commissioning. The role offers a combination of technical engineering, practical problem-solving and collaboration with international customers, suppliers and shipyards.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and adapt mechanical designs for customer-specific projects and installations.

Translate customer and vessel requirements into practical engineering solutions.

Produce and review 3D models, manufacturing drawings, technical specifications, calculations and documentation.

Manage mechanical interfaces between Oceanbird's technology, vessels and shipyard structures.

Participate in design reviews, risk assessments and technical investigations.

Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners regarding quality, cost and delivery.

Provide technical support during installation, commissioning and testing.

Contribute to continuous improvements, standardization and engineering best practices.

Ensure compliance with relevant marine regulations, classification requirements and internal processes.

Key and mandatory skills
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical field.

Experience in mechanical design, product development or project engineering.

Good knowledge of 3D CAD software and experience producing manufacturing drawings.

Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, tolerances and mechanical interfaces.

Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take responsibility for technical deliverables.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Desired skills
It is considered an advantage if you have experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

Maritime, offshore, heavy machinery or renewable energy industries.

Ship structures, vessel integration or marine installations.

Hydraulic systems, rotating machinery or large mechanical structures.

Marine classification rules and regulatory requirements.

Installation, commissioning and testing of mechanical equipment.

Working with international suppliers, shipyards or customers.

About you
We are looking for a collaborative, structured and solution-oriented engineer with a genuine interest in mechanical engineering and technical development.
You enjoy taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions to complex engineering challenges. You are comfortable working across different technical disciplines and understand the importance of balancing technical performance with quality, project timelines and cost requirements.
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with colleagues, customers and external partners.
Above all, you are motivated by seeing your engineering work become part of real-world installations.
Location and travel
The position is based at Oceanbird's office in Flemingsberg, Stockholm.
As the role supports international customer projects, you should be willing and able to travel to shipyards, customer sites and installation locations. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on project requirements.
Why join Oceanbird?
At Oceanbird, you will have the opportunity to work with pioneering wind propulsion technology that contributes to the decarbonization of the shipping industry.
You will become part of a highly competent and dedicated team, working in an innovative and international environment where engineering expertise, collaboration and practical execution are key.
This is an opportunity to follow technical solutions from initial engineering through installation and operation, while contributing to a more sustainable future for global shipping.
Does this sound like you?
Then we look forward to receiving your application!
For more information about the position, please contact Briljantin Consulting.
We review applications continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

jobs.occupation: Research and Development Engineer in Techno-Economic Assessment

jobs.description:
Are you driven, analytical and eager to make a change and drive development? Join RISE Processum and work on research projects to develop the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry.
RISE is a gathering of forces for the sustainable transition that business, society, and the world need. We work with the solutions that can make a difference here and now, and with the areas of knowledge and techniques that can be crucial tomorrow.
About us At RISE Processum, we are developing the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry. Through chemistry and biotechnology, we seek to maximize resource efficiency and sustainability in the utilization of society's residual streams for new fossil-free products in food, feed, chemicals, materials and fuel. Within our cluster activities, guidance in techno-economic assessment to both large and small companies in the bioeconomy is a crucial step in the development of new sustainable and competitive concepts.
Our projects range from shorter assignments to larger national and international research projects, often in collaboration with colleagues from RISE's various areas of expertise. You will be part of the Innovationssystem group within Processum, consisting of 10 colleagues.
About the role In collaboration with a team of experts in biotechnology, chemistry, process simulations, business development and technoeconomic assessments, you will develop new research and development projects from idea to finished results. You will conduct contract research to support industry in developing roadmaps for expanding or transitioning existing businesses into competitive and sustainable new market offerings. A substantial part of the role involves developing tools and knowledge through publicly funded collaborative projects, as well as contributing to the development of internal TEA activities at RISE.
You will identify customer needs and build strong customer relationships and develop new business opportunities. This includes securing project funding, preparing funding applications, and contributing to sales and contract-based projects.
The location is Örnsköldsvik. We follow a hybrid work model that allows employees to split their working time between the office and their home workspace. The role includes travel in connection with international projects, such as attending project meetings, events, and conferences.
Who are you? To be successful in the role you are analytical, structured and self-driven. You are motivated by developing projects to create value together with colleagues and partners. You are good at building relationships and with your interest in technology from a societal perspective, you identify needs and turn them into action. You have a strong interest in project management and communication of results.
Requirements for the role
• A Master’s degree in Engineering or Natural Sciences, preferably in Biotechnology or Chemistry
• Experience from working in or closely linked to bioeconomy related industries
• Experience in performing value chain analyses at different levels and techno-economic assessment, preferably on biobased processes
• Experience with process simulations tools
• Project management experience within research and development
• You speak and write fluently in Swedish or English
Are we a good match? At Processum, you will work close to one of Europe’s leading technology infrastructures for the bioeconomy and contribute to strengthening RISE’s capabilities in scale-up, testing and demonstration. You will work with a wide variety of concepts and value chains in an international and dynamic environment, with colleagues representing many different nationalities. At RISE, we like different things and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge and skills for the future.
Welcome with your application! If this sounds exciting and you want to know more, please contact Johan Börjesson, Director of Innovation Systems, johan.borjesson@ri.se, +46 738 032 315. The application deadline is December 2. Selection and interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Apply with CV and questionnaire (no cover letter needed).
Our union representatives are Frida Sandberg (+46 10 516 67 79) and Veronica Benavente (+46 76 935 86 32) for Unionen and Johanna Källman, +46 10 516 60 10 for Saco.

Department of Soil and Environment
A 2-month research assistant position is available in the Soil and Environmental Physics group at the Department of Soil and Environment, Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), in Uppsala. We are looking for a researcher with interest in vegetation-atmosphere interactions, in particular using eddy-covariance data. We offer a stimulating research environment with opportunities to collaborate with soil scientists and ecologists, within SLU, in Sweden and internationally).
About the position
As a research assistant in the project, you will be expected to drive independent research, including data collection from online databases and statistical data analyses, writing scientific papers in collaboration with the project group and external collaborators, and presenting research results at seminars and conferences.
Your profile
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher with excellent skills and experience in collection, harmonization, and statistical analysis of eddy covariance data on carbon fluxes. We are particularly interested in candidates able to link eddy covariance data to remote sensing products.
Given the nature of the research project, we expect the selected candidate to be able to interact with soil scientists, ecologists, and biogeochemists. Experience in publishing in highly ranked scientific journals in English is also important.
About us
The Department of Soil and Environment is a leading soil research institution, both nationally and internationally. Our research focuses on fundamental soil properties and processes, as well as how soil functions are affected by changes in environmental conditions, including climate change. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decision-making in agriculture, forestry and the urban environment. The working environment at the department is international and we have around 100 employees.
Our research is carried out in seven subject groups with a focus on Soil Biology, Soil Nutrient Cycling, Soil Chemistry, Agricultural Water Management, Soil and Environmental Physics, Soil Mechanics and Soil Management, and the Biogeochemistry of Forest Soils. We are responsible for important research infrastructure in the form of soil chemistry and soil physics laboratories, an X-ray scanner, long-term field experiments, a lysimeter facility, and the field research stations at Lanna and Lövsta. The Department participates in approximately 30 courses at undergraduate and advanced level.
We are a part of the Soil, Water and Environment Center at SLU (MVM-center), which provides links to research on water systems, recycling and bioenergy. Our work is aligned to national environmental and climate goals as well as to the Sustainable Development Goals. We are situated at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and in Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/en/departments/soil-environment/).
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Manage contract negotiations and claims in collaboration with contract managers and legal functions.
Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your Background
As a Project Manager you are structured, open-minded and communicative.
You are a curious person with the drive to challenge yourself and the organization for continuous development in both short and long term.
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or have equivalent work experience.
Proven working experience in relevant field, preferably within HVDC Project Management, the minimum objective is Associate Certification (APM) or similar.

As you will be part of a company that operates on a global arena, fluency in English is required. Swedish is strongly preferable for collaboration with local stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Future Talent - Development Engineer Lamination & Webhandling
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
 Start your career development and become Tetra Pak’s next Future Talent! We are looking for highly motivated newly graduates to join us in 2027! 
 
 
Future Talent Programme is a Trainee Programme within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in September 2027 at our site in Lund. You will onboard an individually designed development programme for 18 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the programme you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person. As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
 
In Lamination & Web Handling, we develop and support converting equipment that enables the production of today’s and tomorrow’s packaging materials. Our work focuses on coating processes, including extrusion coating, with a strong emphasis on sustainability. You will be part of this organisation throughout the programme and, on completion, work as a Development Engineer in one of our agile teams.
 
Visit https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/future-talent and read more about Tetra Pak Future Talent Programme!
 
This position belongs to the Leadership Track.
 
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.
What you will do
As our new Future Talent – Lamination & Web handling you will:

Collaborate with fellow engineers in an agile team to develop and maintain converting equipment and processes.
Help ensure production solutions meet the requirements of the new packaging materials we develop.
Share your knowledge to support internal and external stakeholders.
Partner with suppliers and colleagues in other organisations to exchange knowledge and apply it where it makes a difference.
Support our converting factories by applying engineering knowledge to achieve efficient, high-quality production.

We believe you have
A Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Engineering Physics (Graduated 2026-2027)
Experience in the processing industry or equipment development is welcome, but not required.
An interest in materials and material processing.
An analytical approach and good problem-solving skills.
An ability to understand and apply engineering solutions.
You are fluent in English, written and spoken.
Good written and spoken communication skills.
International study or experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-12-01.

To know more about the position contact Rune Sjölin at +46 46 36 3246
Questions about your application contact Josephine Malalla at +46 46 36 5253
For trade union information contact Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533 and Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320
 
Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

Logent provides contract logistics, transport management, customs services and related solutions across the Nordics and Europe. Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations, creating long-term value for customers, employees, society and the environment.
The Role:
We are looking for a business-oriented Sustainability Manager to lead and develop Logent’s Group-wide sustainability agenda.
You will drive strategy, compliance, ESG reporting and continuous improvement, working with management, operations, HR, Finance, Procurement and customers to embed sustainability in decisions and daily operations.
As the Group’s sustainability expert, you will translate requirements into practical actions and measurable environmental, social and governance outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:
Sustainability Strategy & Governance:
· Develop and implement the sustainability strategy and roadmap; monitor progress, risks and deviations across the Group.
· Develop and maintain sustainability policies, guidelines and procedures, and support their implementation.
· Translate objectives into business-unit action plans and KPIs.
· Advise executive management and the Board on sustainability.
· Coordinate governance processes and quarterly performance reviews.
ESG Reporting & Compliance:
· Lead sustainability reporting under CSRD, ESRS and other applicable regulations.
· Manage double materiality assessments, ESG data collection and internal controls.
· Coordinate external assurance and auditor reviews.
· Monitor sustainability legislation and ensure ongoing compliance.
· Assess sustainability risks and opportunities and integrate them into business planning.
Climate & Environmental Management:
· Drive emissions reduction programmes and SBTi target implementation.
· Oversee Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reporting and improvements.
· Support energy efficiency, waste management and resource optimisation.
· Work with operations to develop sustainable logistics solutions and customer offerings.
Social & Employee Sustainability:
· Support health and safety, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
· Partner with HR on sustainability training and awareness.
· Promote a strong sustainability culture across the organisation.
Supply Chain & Customer Engagement:
· Identify business opportunities through sustainable logistics solutions.
· Support customer development, sustainability requests, questionnaires and tenders.
· Drive supplier sustainability assessments and responsible sourcing.
Data, Performance & Continuous Improvement:
· Develop sustainability KPIs, dashboards and performance reports.
· Ensure high-quality sustainability data across business units.
· Identify improvements and support sustainability project delivery.
Qualifications:
· Degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Engineering or a related field.
· 3+ years’ experience in sustainability, ESG, environmental management or a related discipline.
· Strong knowledge of CSRD, ESRS, EU Taxonomy, GHG Protocol and relevant ESG frameworks.
· Experience in change management and turning complex requirements into practical business actions.
· Experience in sustainability reporting and ESG data management.

Are you an analytical and structured finance professional with experience in cash flow forecasting? In this role, you will take ownership of cash flow planning in large-scale projects, working closely with stakeholders across multiple functions to ensure accurate forecasts and support sound financial decision-making.
About the position
Perido are looking for a Treasury analyst for our client in Stockholm. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring accurate and reliable cash flow forecasts across large-scale projects. You will work closely with stakeholders across finance, procurement, contracts and project delivery, gathering and analysing financial information to support effective cash flow planning and decision-making.
Your daily tasks
As a Treasury Analyst, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing the project cash flow forecasting process from start to finish. You will gather information from multiple project teams and workstreams, analyse payment schedules and contractual terms, and translate these into reliable cash flow forecasts. The role involves maintaining and developing forecasting models, conducting scenario analyses and following up on payment milestones and financial commitments.
You will collaborate with stakeholders across different functions, ensuring that relevant information is collected, validated and documented. This includes understanding project payment cycles, such as payment certifications, invoice processing and advance payments, as well as identifying potential discrepancies or risks that may affect cash flow projections.
Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is structured, analytical and confident in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. You have the ability to build relationships across different functions and obtain the information needed to produce accurate forecasts, even when working with incomplete or unstructured data. You are proactive, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities in a fast-paced and complex environment. Furthermore, you have strong organisational skills and can manage several parallel workstreams and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
At least a B.Sc. in Accounting, Finance or Business
3–5 years of relevant experience in cash flow forecasting within large construction projects and/or process manufacturing industries
Demonstrated experience in cash forecasting, payment scheduling, or financial planning within a project environment
Proven track record of working across multiple workstreams or packages simultaneously, coordinating inputs from diverse stakeholders
Strong command of Excel for model building and scenario analysis
Ability to interpret contract structures and understand how payment terms translate into cash timing
Solid understanding of large project payment cycle: certification, invoice processing, and advance payment mechanics

Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .
Embedded C Developer – Transmission 
Mpya Sci & Tech is a company built by engineers – for engineers. We’ve created a workplace where you, as an employee, are always at the center. In everything we do, we strive for a high level of involvement and responsiveness to our employees' thoughts about their future roles and careers. Together, we are building a strong, inclusive, curious, and open-minded culture that offers great opportunities for our team members. We want you to work on assignments that you are passionate about, grow professionally, and maintain a healthy work–life balance.
 About the role
As an Embedded C Developer, you will play a key role in developing the transmission control software for future electric propulsion solutions. You will work on the full software lifecycle of the transmission control unit (TCU), from specifying and designing the architecture to implementation, verification, integration and testing in C. You will also develop test frameworks. We can offer you challenges that are both fun and exciting.
You will work on software that brings the driveline to life. This includes gear shift and clutch control functions, actuator control for solenoids, valves and electric motors, and sensor handling for speed, position, pressure and temperature. The software platform covers MCU low-level drivers, device drivers for all connected peripherals, and CAN and Ethernet communication stacks. It also covers RTOS configuration, the diagnostic event manager and ECU power management. On top of this, you will help improve how we work, our development tools and our continuous integration framework.
We are looking for you…
…who wants to grow as a professional and brings an open mind and a proactive approach. You have strong drive and creativity, and you come up with ideas and solutions all the way from system design to verification. You understand how software and mechanics work together in a transmission and enjoy solving problems where timing, control and hardware meet. You like working in a team but are just as comfortable working on your own.
Requirements:
B.Sc./M.Sc. in Embedded Software, Electronics, Mechatronics, Physics or equivalent education.
At least five years of experience in embedded software development and real-time systems programming.
Strong skills in embedded C for safety-critical real-time systems.
Experience developing software for transmission, driveline or propulsion systems, for example TCU, gearbox, clutch or e-axle control.
Skills in embedded software architecture, design and verification.
Skilled in Python and Git.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

It is a merit if you have experience with:
Shift strategies, torque control, clutch control or control engineering in general.
ISO 26262 (functional safety) 
AUTOSAR.
Tools such as the Lauterbach TRACE32 debugger, oscilloscopes, CANoe/CANalyzer and Robot Framework.
Electronics and actuator control (PWM, current control, solenoids).
Software development for Volvo Powertrain or another transmission supplier, which will be highly valued.

You are open-minded, proactive and structured, and you have the drive to take the lead.
Who we areAt Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life, and we’re living a culture where you can:
Be Dedicated
Be Brave and Curious
Be Inclusive and Allowing

You have real influence over your assignments and your career development, with a good balance between work and life.
Your application
Does this sound like the opportunity you’ve been waiting for? Please go ahead and apply!For questions about the position, feel free to contact Patrik Artman, 0733-908035 or patrik.artman@mpyascitech.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Director, Project Management Office (PMO), China Joint Venture Office
jobs.description:
Company description:
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Job description: 
 The opportunity 
 
 As Director of the Project Management Office (PMO) in the China Joint Venture Office, you will lead and coordinate Volvo Group/ Dongfeng Management/Group workstreams. You will establish strong PMO governance, align stakeholders across organizations, and support the delivery of shared business objectives.
  
 Working closely with senior leaders and workstream owners, you will bring structure, transparency and execution discipline to a complex, cross-organizational environment. You will also support strategic and transformation initiatives and help ensure effective communication between Volvo Group, its joint venture partners and other stakeholders.
  
 This position is located in Gothenburg, Sweden and requires frequent travel.
  
 You will report to Head of China JV Office. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1.    Lead workstreams
  Drive key workstreams in close collaboration with their leaders.
 Establish appropriate governance structures and project management practices.
 Monitor progress, risks, dependencies and decisions, and escalate issues when needed.
 Ensure workstreams remain aligned with business objectives and applicable corporate standards.
  
 
 2.    Establish and lead the PMO
  Set up and lead a JV-level PMO to govern key projects and initiatives.
 Oversee the project portfolio, including organizational transformation and JV collaboration initiatives.
 Promote disciplined project planning, resource allocation, progress tracking and reporting.
 Align project execution with Volvo Group standards while taking JV requirements and constraints into account.
 Support project negotiations when required.
  
 
 3.    Enable communication and alignment
  Drive structured communication across Volvo Group and DongFeng divisions, business areas, group functions and business units.
 Connect global, regional and JV-specific priorities.
 Support the Head of China JV Office and the leadership team with clear internal communication, decision tracking and execution follow-up.
  
 
 4.    Manage JV and external stakeholders
  Act as a key interface with JV partners, shareholders and other external stakeholders.
 Coordinate communication between Volvo Group entities and JV counterparts, ensuring clarity and compliance.
 Support executive interactions, including board meetings, shareholder discussions and strategic dialogues.
 Maintain consistent and professional external communication.
  
 
 5.    Support strategy and transformation
  Support leaders in defining and delivering JV strategy and transformation initiatives.
 Translate strategic direction into actionable programs and governance structures.
 Provide structured analysis, reporting and insights to support executive decision-making.
  
 
Profile description:Who you are
 
 
You are a structured and action-oriented leader who can bring people together and move complex initiatives forward with a can-do attitude. You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, build alignment across organizational boundaries and maintain focus on delivery in a changing, cross-cultural environment.
 
You bring
 
 
Strong experience in PMO, project or program management, communications, strategy or consulting.
A proven track record of managing complex, cross-entity or joint venture environments.
Experience with executive-level communication and engagement with external partners.
The ability to coordinate stakeholders and teams across a complex organization.
Strong problem-solving skills, execution discipline and attention to detail.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Mandarin proficiency is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with multinational business and the China business environment is highly preferred.
 
 
 
 
For more information please contact:
 
 
John Han, Head of China JV Office, john.han@volvo.com
 
Kristina Dahm Ahlén, Talent Acquisition Partner, kristina.dahm.ahlen@volvo.com
 
 
 
Last application date is November 23.
 
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable
 
 
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
 
 
 
We offer:Who we are and what we believe in 
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Company Description
Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
But where does that take you?
To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.
And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Stockholm
In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.
The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.
On a daily basis you will
Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications
You will be a strong fit if you have
At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development. 
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.
Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.
Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are
Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

 
Additional Information

The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.
The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

Electronics Engineer, R&D Stockholm
Want to start your engineering career by designing the electronics inside network cameras used around the world? We're looking for an Electronics Engineer to join our growing R&D site in central Stockholm. You'll work with electronics from the first concept all the way to a finished product that's ready to sell.
 
Location: Stockholm, Sweden (on-site) | Employment: Permanent, full-time
 
Who is your future team?
Our Stockholm R&D site has grown to more than 50 colleagues. We're still early in our journey but we are growing fast. That means you can help shape how we work while being part of the world leader in network video.
We develop network-based surveillance cameras. We work in projects together with engineers and designers from other departments such as mechanics, firmware and imaging engineers. We keep processes and control to a minimum, and ideas are welcome from everyone, not just from the top. Here, your voice is heard.
 
What you'll do as an Electronics Engineer
As an Electronics Engineer at Axis, you play a central role in designing, testing and certifying the electronics in products that help make the world safer and more secure. You'll be part of the project from concept to production, until the product you and your team built is ready to be sold.
Projects vary a lot. They range from 3-month concept studies, for example in sensor technology, to 2-year projects developing advanced cameras. Your work will include:
Designing electronics, including system design, schematics and component selection
Testing and verifying your designs hands-on in the lab, including soldering
Certifying the electronics so our products meet the required standards
Working across disciplines with engineers and designers from other departments
Following the product from concept to production

 
You'll get a lot of responsibility and freedom from the start. Your mentor and experienced colleagues will support you as you grow into the role.
 
Who are you?
You're curious with an interest in technology, and electronics is what you're most passionate about. You like to take initiative and enjoy working independently. You find it easy to reach out to people and build contacts. You're thorough and take the time to understand the problem you're solving, both the big picture and the details. You enjoy sharing what you know, you stay humble, and you're motivated by working in an environment that keeps changing.
 
What you need:
A university degree in a technical field, preferably electronics
A genuine interest in electronics development
Professional proficiency in English

Bonus points for experience with any of these areas:
Soldering and modifications at PCB (printed circuit board) level
Electronics measuring on PCB using oscilloscope and multimeter
Testing and certification related to EMC (electromagnetic compatibility), ESD (electrostatic discharge), safety, etc.
Knowledge of production

 
What Axis has to offer
We're a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. You'll work on meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance, developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a team that values creativity, innovation and work-life balance.
This is a unique opportunity to help build our R&D office in central Stockholm. You'll get the advantages of a small, agile site while also being part of a successful global organization.
Your well-being matters to us. Our benefits include a company bonus, Friday cake, a wellness allowance, health insurance, and even your own Axis bicycle.
 
Curious to discover more? Check out: Life at Axis blog | Engineering at Axis blog | Innovation at Axis
 
Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
We go through applications continuously, so don't wait. Apply today!
For questions about the role, contact Katarina In de Betou, Engineering Director, at Katarina.In..

jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Engineer – Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description:
Do you want to own procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a commercially sharp engineer who wants to master the technology in depth and grow into a skilled procurement professional – in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.
What will you do at NYAB? 
As our Technical Procurement Engineer, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, driving procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. You get real responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side as you grow into the full scope of the role.
Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions.
In this role, you will: 
Own the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.

Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.

Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.

Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable-energy projects and make our supply-chain more resilient.

Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver.

You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does – and spotting opportunities for optimization.

About you
You are strongly goal-oriented, a self-starter with plenty of grit and a natural talent for making things happen. You bring commercial instinct, sound judgment and a genuine hunger to learn – both the technology and the art of dealmaking. For you, speed and precision go hand in hand: you take ownership of your commitments and willingly go the extra mile when it matters – while building trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners along the way.
 We believe you have: 
A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems – recently graduated or planned graduation in 2027.

Previous experience from procurement, engineering, project work, construction, energy or another technically oriented environment. 

A strong interest in sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiations.

Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad.

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience from sourcing, supplier contacts or commercial work.

Knowledge of solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.

Why work at NYAB? 
NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it.
Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise.
You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow.
We also offer:

Comprehensive health assessments 

Generous wellness allowance  -

Parental pay supplement

Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)

A secure pension plan 

 
Ready to make it happen?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and academic records. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.
Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. Join us in building technology that drives real change.
Machine Learning Engineer at Sellpy
We look for you who want to be part of our journey to make sustainable shopping the first-hand choice by building great product recommendations, creating clever pricing algorithms and optimizing warehouse logistics with machine learning. We want to provide the best customer experience and that’s why we need you on board.
This job will suit you if you’re excited to build solutions leveraging the latest machine learning models and build custom models to solve unique challenges together with a team of highly motivated engineers.
In short, you will
Build machine learning models with a major impact on our product
Simplify, maintain and improve our already existing models
Build solutions leveraging the latest machine learning development
Keep up with ML development with the team on weekly deep dives
Make use of your skills in Tensorflow/Pytorch, Python and SQL

Requirements
B.S or M.S. degree in Computer Science or related field
At least 2 years of working experience within the machine learning field
Strong proficiency in Python
In-depth expertise about machine learning algorithms, deep learning and LLMs

Experience with AWS or similar cloud service providers
Experience with relational databases and SQL
Experience of setting up ML systems in production
Written and spoken fluency in English

Experience working with vector databases

You’ll get to
Be part of a tech-minded company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will get direction, energy, and work on meaningful challenges daily
Benefit from hybrid work from our offices at Medborgarplatsen, Rosersberg and from home
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues

Location
You are welcome to do all these things from our office at Medborgarplatsen in Stockholm, and from home. Ideally, we’d love to see you in the office frequently, as it helps create a positive and productive environment.
Hybrid work
We work flexibly but value being together. During your first period, you’ll be on-site more often to get settled. Moving forward, we maintain a 50% office presence, with some flexibility depending on your team and tasks.
Our Interview Process 🤝
We want to get to know you, your way of thinking, and how we would work together.
Culture Interview (45 min): A video call to get to know each other. We talk about your background, your drive, and why you are interested in Sellpy.
Technical Interview (1 hour): A deep dive into your technical knowledge and how you approach problem-solving.
Case Interview (2 hours): You will receive a real-world case assignment to prepare in advance. We then invite you to our office at Medborgarplatsen where you will present your solution and we will discuss your reasoning in depth.
Founder Interview (30 min): A final chat with one of our founders to discuss the company vision and your potential journey with us.

AbbVie is one of the world’s leading research biopharma companies, and we develop innovative treatments and sustainable care solutions for severe diseases within the focus areas immunology, neurology, oncology, eyecare and virology. Patient orientation is key, and the company aims to develop specialized treatments and medicines for unsolved health problems. This is a student position as a Junior Demand & Supply Coordinator, where you will be part of AbbVie’s supply chain function for Scandinavia, covering four countries including Iceland. Monitor wholesaler inventory and handle exceptions with internal stakeholders

Contribute to various projects across the team

Ongoing university studies in a relevant field, for example in IT, engineering, supply chain, logistics or finance.
Strong interest in and hands-on experience with AI tools and Excel

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer Industrial Automation & Machine Control
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Industrial Automation & Machine Control
to Ursviken Technology in Västerås
Ursviken Technology is expanding! We are establishing a new engineering office in Västerås and looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our growing international engineering team.
Are you passionate about software development, advanced automation, and intelligent industrial machines? Would you like to help shape the future of industrial technology while being part of something new?
This is an opportunity to work with advanced industrial machinery, develop machine control software, and contribute to the establishment of a new engineering office.
About Ursviken Technology
Ursviken Technology develops advanced CNC-controlled machinery for the sheet metal processing industry, including press brakes, shears, and automated manufacturing systems. With more than 140 years of industrial engineering experience, we are known for technical excellence, innovation, and customized machine solutions.
We are part of Vaski Group, a growing Finnish industrial technology group, and are investing in our engineering capabilities and future product development.
About the Role
As a Software Engineer specializing in Industrial Automation and Machine Control, you will develop and improve the software that powers our machines. You will work with both new machine development and existing products, contributing throughout the development process, from software design and programming to testing and commissioning.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Developing and maintaining PLC and machine control software.
Working with motion control, servo axes, hydraulics, and CNC-related functionality.
Integrating robotic systems and external automation equipment.
Testing, troubleshooting, and improving software solutions.
Collaborating with colleagues in software, automation, electrical engineering, and mechanical design.
Contributing to the development of common software platforms, reusable components, and engineering standards.

You will work with PLC programming in B&R Automation Studio, primarily using Structured Text (ST). The role may also involve C/C++ development for more advanced functions and integrations.
Technology Development and New Opportunities
We are strengthening our in-house software development capabilities and investing in our own machine control technologies. This creates exciting opportunities to contribute to new software architectures, shared platforms, and improved development methods.
You will also have the opportunity to help establish our new engineering office in Västerås, influence technical decisions, and collaborate with experienced engineers at our headquarters in Ursviken and across Vaski Group.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical foundation and a genuine interest in programming, automation, and industrial machinery.
We believe you have:
A degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in PLC programming or industrial control software development.
An understanding of industrial automation and machine control.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
Good communication skills and fluency in English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

Experience with B&R Automation Studio, Siemens TIA Portal, Structured Text, C/C++, motion control, CNC technology, or industrial robot integration is an advantage. Most importantly, you are curious, take initiative, and enjoy developing reliable and maintainable software.
What We Offer
At Ursviken Technology, you will work with advanced industrial machinery and challenging engineering projects in an international environment. You will have the opportunity to influence our products, contribute to exciting technology development, and grow professionally as our organization expands.
You will join an established company with a long engineering history while helping build a new team and shape the future of our machine control systems.
If you enjoy combining software engineering with real-world machines and want to see your code bring powerful industrial equipment to life, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. Welcome to the team!

Senior Project Engineer – Control & Protection Software, Sequence & Interlocking HVDC
Our names are Andrew Carruthers and Richard Palm, and together we lead the teams responsible for Sequence & Interlocking within HVDC Control & Protection. Our work sits at the operational core of an HVDC station.
We define the logic that ensures equipment is operated safely and correctly. We develop interlocking principles, automated switching sequences, operating states, and the conditions that determine when a station is ready to perform a specific action. Our solutions help ensure that complex HVDC systems operate safely, predictably, and reliably throughout their lifecycle.
As HVDC technology continues to evolve, so do the challenges. New technologies, new customer requirements, and new ways of operating power systems continuously shape how we work. Success depends on our team members who can understand the bigger picture, exercise strong engineering judgement, and transform complex requirements into robust and reliable solutions.
We are looking for experienced engineers who enjoy technical ownership, system thinking, and solving challenging engineering problems together with highly skilled colleagues.
This is not a role for someone looking to simply execute predefined tasks. It is a role for you who want to understand how things work, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the future of HVDC technology.
“As managers, our goal is to create an environment where everyone can do their best work while continuing to develop their skills and expertise. We strongly believe in open technical discussions, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and a psychologically safe environment where questions, feedback, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value every person's voice and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.” Andrew Carruthers & Richard Palm, Hiring Managers
How you'll make an impact
Design and develop Sequence & Interlocking solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.
Transform system and customer requirements into robust operational logic and engineering solutions.
Work closely with system design, control, protection, testing, and commissioning teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Take technical ownership of specific functions, systems, or project areas.
Verify and validate solutions through testing, troubleshooting, and system integration activities.
Support commissioning activities and experience how your engineering decisions perform in the real world.
Drive technical discussions both internally and with customers.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers while contributing to the development of our team's technical capability.
Contribute to future methods, tools, and technical solutions within Sequence & Interlocking.

Your background
We care more about technical capability and your personal skills than matching every item on a checklist. You likely have:
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
Several years of experience working with complex technical systems.
Experience in HVDC, FACTS, substation automation, protection and control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or similar fields.
Experience with commissioning, protection systems, relay applications, operational sequencing, or HVDC projects is highly valued.
Strong analytical skills and an ability to understand interactions across multiple systems and disciplines.
The confidence to challenge assumptions and contribute to technical discussions.
A structured approach and a curios mindset to engineering and problem solving.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
Professional communication skills in English.

Quality Engineer | QA Specialist
Technogarden is currently recruiting a Quality Assurance Specialist/Quality Engineer within Medtech to a Stockholm/Solna based client that manufactures and markets assistive technology that supports communication, cognition, environmental control and personal safety. The company's products help people with disabilities and special needs live more independent lives.
You will join a collaborative organisation where quality, innovation and continuous improvement are part of everyday work, with the opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to products that make a meaningful difference.
About the role
As a Quality Engineer/QA Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring product quality throughout the supply chain and manufacturing process.
Working across the entire product lifecycle, you will collaborate with colleagues in Development, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Regulatory Affairs, as well as with external suppliers.
You will contribute to continuous improvement by identifying risks, solving quality-related challenges and helping to strengthen quality processes across the organization. From time to time, you will also lead and/or coordinate quality related projects and improvement initiatives.
The position is based in Solna, Stockholm, or Gothenburg and is part of the Operations organization and reports to the Quality Manager.

Quality systems and supplier quality
Support internal teams and suppliers in improving and developing quality practices
Perform internal quality audits according to ISO 13485
Lead supplier audits and follow up on findings

Data and analysis

Who are you?
You are a process-oriented person who works well independently but also enjoy collaborating across different functions and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You are curious, eager to learn and motivated by finding practical solutions that improve products and the way we work through our processes.
You enjoy combining analytical thinking with a practical approach to problem solving. You are proactive, structured and comfortable taking ownership of your work.
We believe you have
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Science or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
At least 2–5 years of experience within Quality Engineering and/or Quality Assurance, preferably in a regulated industry within medical device.
Good knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485.
Experience working with quality tools such as FMEA, Root Cause Analysis, 8D, CAPA or Six Sigma.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Professional communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
