jobs.occupation: Danish-speaking Sales Development Representative to Debtist
jobs.description:
About the company
Debtist is a fast-growing German tech company developing a digital platform for accounts receivable management and debt collection. With a modern, data-driven approach, they are redefining how businesses manage their receivables and collections. Debtist has been recognized as one of Europe's most exciting growth companies and is featured on Sifteds prestigious Future 50 list of Europe's most promising scaleups.
Debtist is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding its presence across Europe, including Sweden, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Germany. As part of this expansion, we are looking to welcome several new members to our sales team across these markets, which includes Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives.
In this role, you will play a key part in Debtist's growth journey, identifying new business opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and driving sales across new markets.
At Asta Agency, we are partnering with Debtist in this recruitment process. The recruitment process is managed by Asta Agency, and you will be employed directly by Debtist.
About the role
As an SDR at Debtist, you will be a key player in establishing the Danish market. You will work with outbound sales and new business development, with the mission to identify and reach decision-makers at mid-sized and large companies. Your focus is on creating qualified business opportunities, and you will also play an active part in shaping how Debtist sells in Denmark.
Your responsibilities include:

Prospecting and contacting decision-makers via cold calling, email and LinkedIn

Qualifying potential customers and booking demos

Building and managing your own pipeline in CRM

Adapting sales messaging to the Danish market

Working in a structured way towards clear KPIs and delivering measurable results

There is also an opportunity to go into the role of Junior Account Executive, where, in addition to the responsibilities outlined above, you will take on greater responsibility for conducting customer demos, preparing quotes and commercial proposals, and driving sales opportunities forward through negotiations and closing deals.
Qualifications and personal qualities
We are looking for someone driven, curious and not afraid to take initiative. You are independent and comfortable taking ownership of your work, while remaining humble and attentive in your customer interactions. You build trust naturally and bring a hands-on, creative mindset to everything you do. You do not need extensive sales experience, but you need the right attitude and a genuine willingness to learn fast.
In addition, you have:

Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

Experience working independently in a target-driven environment, with a structured approach to managing daily activities and KPIs.

Experience in professional communication with customers or prospects, preferably within sales, customer service, or business development.

Experience with high-volume outbound outreach, including cold calling, lead generation, and consistent follow-up to achieve set targets.

Meriting experience:

Previous experience in B2B sales, outbound or an SDR role

Experience from a SaaS or tech company

Familiarity with CRM and digital sales tools

Knowledge of German

Additional information
Start: As soon as possible

Location: Stockholm, Sweden (possibility to work from Berlin)

Extent: Full-time

Salary: Upon agreement

 We apply ongoing selection in this process, which means the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore recommend that you apply as soon as possible!

jobs.occupation: Team Lead, Electrical & Electronics Systems - Automotive
jobs.description:
Lead the engineers who make vehicles work

Every switch you press and every wire behind the panel has to work, every time. As Team Lead, you will guide a small team of E/E engineers who deliver wiring, switch and in-vehicle electrical system solutions to automotive customers. You stay close to the technical work while you own delivery, quality and the growth of your team. You will collaborate across electrical architecture, body electronics, and interior and HMI teams, and with customers and suppliers.

What you will do

Lead a team of 3–6 engineers on E/E development and integration assignments for customer vehicle programs.
Define and review wiring strategies, grounding and fuse concepts, and component layout against safety and manufacturability requirements.
Drive the development and validation of electrical switches, driver controls and wiring harnesses, including supplier follow-up.
Own technical troubleshooting of hardware, software and wiring anomalies, from vehicle test to root cause.
Support system verification: requirements management, diagnostics (UDS, ISO 14229) and automated test routines.
Apply structured problem solving and statistics (Six Sigma) to quality, warranty and failure-mode topics.
Be the technical and delivery contact for customers, and plan staffing, competence growth and delivery quality.

What you bring

MSc or BSc in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or equivalent.
8+ years in automotive E/E product development, including wiring, switches, instrument clusters or climate controls.
Experience leading engineers or work packages, formally or technically.
Strong supplier and cross-functional collaboration, including commercial and cost-reduction topics.
Working knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and CAN/UDS.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Swedish language skills.

Working as a Consultant at Etteplan

As a senior consultant at Etteplan, you will work on exciting and complex assignments where your experience truly makes a difference. You combine the security of a stable employer with the opportunity to contribute to projects that are both technically challenging and span industries that impact people’s everyday lives and future. We see your experience as a key to finding smart, sustainable, and efficient solutions.

We offer an environment where you can continue to grow - whether you want to deepen your specialist expertise, lead projects, or act as an advisor. With us, you’ll meet both junior talents and colleagues with long experience, and together we drive innovative solutions that benefit both customers and society.

Application and Next Steps

You apply by uploading your CV and answering a few short questions related to the position. Selection and interviews are conducted continuously, so don’t hesitate to submit your application. The recruitment process begins with a phone interview and is followed by meetings with the responsible consulting manager and, if needed, additional colleagues. Our goal is to keep the process smooth so that together we can take the next step forward.

Do you feel that Etteplan is the right place for you? Submit your application today and become part of our team!

Etteplan is a leading technical consulting company shaping the industries of the future. With a dynamic and inclusive work culture, we offer exciting assignments, diverse customer relationships and an environment where your ambition can flourish. We are over 700 technology specialists in Sweden who are passionate about technology and people. Together, we shape the innovations and developments of the future within a global business environment. With us, there are many opportunities for those who want to grow and develop in a forward-looking organization.

Do you want to be part of a team that is developing tomorrow's businesses and organizations? At PwC, we strive to be proactive advisors that really make a difference in society. We see that experience and knowledge are invaluable assets, so it's crucial to us that you contribute with your expertise to promote PwC's development. Together, we create a meaningful and rewarding career for you.

Become part of PwC's audit operations

As an employee in audit, you work to identify risks, solve complex audit questions, analyze data and draw conclusions about the information presented by our customers. You get to work in inspiring and meaningful assignments where our work affects our customers' business operations, but also contributes to creating trust in society.

The digital development and increased demands for transparency contribute to the fact that the audit of the future will require more multifaceted competence than before, which also provides more opportunities for specialization. At PwC, working as an auditor can look very different and this means that you can create your own career path. You can choose to become a customer manager or immerse yourself in a specialist area such as data analysis, sustainability reporting, internal control or invest in a career as a leader.

Read more about our service areas within auditing

Who are you?

We are looking for you who have:

At least five years of experience working with auditing and/or Financial Reporting, Internal Controls and Compliance.
Experience from Big4
Experience in IFRS reporting, statutory audits and financial statement preparation.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

We attach great importance to your personal qualities and therefore believe that you:

Is service oriented and motivated by delivering results and meeting our customers' expectations.
Is adaptable, can read situations and adapt both behavior and communication in building qualitative and diversified relationships.
Acts with integrity by being straightforward and honest in communication and is easy to get others on board with
Has good analytical skills and is solution-oriented. You enjoy learning new things and are curious about digitization and new technology to be able to solve customers' needs.
Has interpersonal skills and the ability to create relationships and networks. These skills are needed to work well with our clients, but are of course also important for collaboration within our team.
Is structured, efficient and organized.

We will review applications continuously, and the position may be filled earlier than the application deadline.

CV

As a Supply Chain Planner in our team, you will report to the Planning Manager. You will work closely with suppliers, production sites, logistics centers, and internal stakeholders to balance product availability with inventory costs and obsolescence risk.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and translate data into clear recommendations and actions.
Experience driving process improvements and collaborating with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to improve supply performance.
Advanced Excel skills and practical experience using AI and other digital tools to analyze data and support decision-making.
You communicate effectively in Swedish and English with both internal and external stakeholders, locally and internationally.

Work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Be part of a culture that values continuous improvement.
Be part of a fast-growing company with the ability to adapt quickly and turn ideas into action.

About the Role
We are looking for a Data Engineer to develop, maintain and improve the data infrastructure and backend services supporting our RE:Flex platform.
The role involves working with real-time IoT data, cloud infrastructure, databases and data pipelines to ensure reliable data collection, processing, storage and delivery.
You will work closely with backend developers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers and other teams across the business, operations and finance. Alongside hands-on development, you will contribute to technical improvements, code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Data Engineering and Pipelines
Develop and maintain Python-based services for collecting and processing data from connected energy devices, including battery systems and meters.
Build and improve real-time and batch data pipelines using MQTT, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and other messaging technologies.
Integrate data from external APIs, energy market platforms and other relevant data sources.
Implement data validation, error handling, retry mechanisms and safe backfilling to improve data quality and reliability.
Develop and maintain data processing workflows, including aggregation and transformation of time-series data.

Backend Development and Cloud Infrastructure
Develop and maintain backend APIs and services for accessing real-time and historical platform data.
Work with databases and storage solutions such as BigQuery, TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, depending on application requirements.
Develop, deploy and maintain containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Contribute to cloud infrastructure improvements, primarily within Google Cloud Platform.
Support integrations between data services, backend applications and other platform components.

Data Quality, Monitoring and Reliability
Monitor data pipelines, database performance and service reliability using tools such as Grafana and cloud monitoring services.
Investigate data inconsistencies, missing records, processing failures and other production issues.
Improve data processing performance, scalability and operational stability.
Implement appropriate data quality checks, logging, monitoring and alerting.
Support incident investigation, troubleshooting and implementation of technical fixes.

Energy Market and Business Data
Support data processing and integration for energy market operations, including market prices, schedules, measurements and settlement information.
Develop and maintain data workflows used for operational reporting, revenue calculations and customer invoicing.
Work with market operations, finance and other business teams to understand data requirements and resolve discrepancies.
Help ensure data consistency and traceability across relevant systems and integrations.

Technical Collaboration and Documentation
Participate in technical planning, architecture discussions and code reviews.
Coordinate with backend, DevOps, machine learning and other engineering teams on data-related implementations.
Support onboarding and knowledge sharing with other engineers.
Maintain technical documentation, data flow descriptions and operational procedures.
Contribute to continuous improvements in development practices, deployment processes and platform reliability.

Required Qualifications
Relevant education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, backend development or a related software engineering role.
Strong programming skills in Python and good knowledge of SQL.
Experience developing data pipelines, backend services and REST APIs.
Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases and cloud-based data processing.
Familiarity with messaging systems, streaming data or asynchronous processing.
Practical experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure.
Understanding of software development practices, version control, testing and debugging.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.
Professional working proficiency in English.

Meriting Experience
Google Cloud Platform, particularly Pub/Sub, BigQuery and Cloud Storage.
MQTT, IoT telemetry or real-time data processing.
TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other time-series and NoSQL databases.
Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Dagster, Airflow or similar data orchestration tools.
Monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.
Experience with data reconciliation, reporting or invoicing integrations.
Knowledge of battery energy storage systems, energy flexibility services or Nordic electricity markets.
Experience supporting technical onboarding, documentation or cross-team coordination.

What We Offer
The opportunity to contribute to Sweden's energy transition through real-world energy technology solutions.
Hands-on experience working with real-time data, cloud infrastructure and distributed energy systems.
A collaborative engineering environment with opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and platform improvements.
The opportunity to work across data engineering, backend development and energy market applications.

jobs.occupation: EY-Parthenon Senior Consultant | Strategy & Execution - Deal Technology
jobs.description:
The opportunity
 
At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value - solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY's full spectrum of services, we have reimagined strategic consulting for a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.
 
EY-Parthenon is looking for Senior Consultants to join our Nordic Strategy & Execution team, working on Deal Technology where technology is an investment thesis, a value creation lever and a transformation enabler, not just transaction support. This is more than a delivery role: deal technology is a fast-growing market with increasing demand, and our Nordic team is expanding rapidly. You will grow with it, from building your expertise to contributing to our offering, while supporting clients on IT due diligence, carve-outs, integrations and technology-led value creation at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, private equity and corporate transactions.
 
 
Your key responsibilities
 
As a Senior Consultant, you will own defined workstreams within complex, time-critical engagements. Working with engagement managers, investors and M&A teams, you will turn technology, data and AI questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations that connect to transaction logic and business value creation.

Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a senior full-stack developer to join a cross-functional team responsible for developing and enhancing Marketing Automation solutions. The role has clear ownership of the development and maintenance of services, integrations, email templates, landing pages, and personalized content components. You will collaborate closely with platform owners and business stakeholders to deliver a consistent, accessible, user-friendly, and high-performing experience.
As a senior member of the team, you will provide technical guidance, share knowledge, and help improve engineering practices and solution design. Development will be driven by business requirements, non-functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain frontend and backend services supporting the Marketing Automation environment.
Create responsive and accessible email templates, landing pages, and personalized content blocks.
Design and implement integrations and APIs between the Marketing Automation platform and surrounding systems.
Develop and test SOAP and REST APIs, including opportunities for API test automation.
Use customer and campaign data to support personalization, segmentation, and relevant targeted communications.
Optimize application and interface performance while ensuring usability and accessibility.
Perform testing, troubleshooting, defect resolution, logging, and monitoring, and introduce test automation where appropriate.
Translate business requirements, non-functional requirements, and acceptance criteria into maintainable technical solutions.
Manage source code, continuous integration and delivery workflows, and backlog-related engineering activities.
Provide technical leadership, mentor colleagues, share expertise, and contribute to the continuous improvement of team practices and solutions.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Frontend: JavaScript ES6 or later, HTML5, CSS3, and React or Vue.js.
Backend and integration: Server-side JavaScript, system integrations, API design and implementation, REST, and SOAP.
Data: SQL, including writing and executing SQL scripts.
Engineering tools: Git, Webpack or equivalent build tooling, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and backlog management.
UX and design: Fundamental UX design knowledge and experience with Figma or an equivalent design tool.
Ways of working: Strong experience with Lean-Agile delivery methods; SAFe experience is preferred.
Advantageous platform experience: Adobe Campaign Classic v8 or another Marketing Automation platform, including campaign management, segmentation, personalization, content blocks, email templates, and landing pages.
Advantageous test automation: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Jest, as well as automated API testing.
Additional advantageous knowledge: System-level security requirements, server configuration, troubleshooting, logging, and monitoring.

Qualifications & Experience
The assignment requires 4–8 years of full-stack development experience covering both frontend and backend engineering. Candidates must have documented JavaScript experience and practical knowledge of React or Vue.js, together with a track record of delivering responsive, accessible, user-friendly, and performance-optimized interfaces. Experience designing integrations between Marketing Automation platforms and other systems is required, as is experience developing and testing SOAP and REST APIs.
Strong SQL knowledge, modern web development experience, source control proficiency, and familiarity with Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices are expected. Experience with Marketing Automation platforms, Adobe Campaign Classic v8, frontend or API test automation, system security, and operational troubleshooting is advantageous. Certifications in web development or Marketing Automation and previous experience in banking or financial services are also beneficial.
The successful consultant should be able to work independently while contributing effectively to a cross-functional team. The role requires a structured and proactive approach, strong analytical capability, an understanding of complex flows and dependencies, and the ability to communicate technical recommendations clearly. Senior-level technical leadership, constructive challenge of existing practices, and active knowledge sharing are important aspects of the assignment. Professional fluency in both Swedish and English is required.

We now want to employ a Payroll Administrator. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:
1. Job Purpose
The Payroll Administrator is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll administration for the company's employees in accordance with Swedish labour legislation, applicable collective bargaining agreements (Collective Agreements), company policies, and tax regulations.
The role involves managing the complete monthly payroll process, maintaining employee payroll records, handling salary-related inquiries, and coordinating with HR, Finance, external payroll providers, and relevant authorities.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Payroll Administration
Prepare, process, and verify monthly payroll for employees.
Ensure salaries are calculated accurately and paid on the agreed payment dates.
Process fixed salaries, hourly wages, overtime, additional allowances, bonuses, and other salary components.
Calculate and administer holiday pay (Semesterlön), holiday compensation (Semesterersättning), and vacation balances.
Process sick leave, parental leave, unpaid leave, and other absence-related salary adjustments.
Verify working hours, timesheets, attendance records, and approved overtime.
Handle salary corrections, retroactive payments, deductions, and final salary settlements.

B. Collective Agreement Compliance
Ensure payroll calculations comply with applicable Swedish Collective Agreements, including Unionen and Installatörsföretagen agreements, as applicable.
Apply relevant provisions concerning overtime, additional compensation, working hours, holiday entitlements, and other employment benefits.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of changes in collective agreements and Swedish employment legislation.
Support HR in payroll-related union inquiries and collective agreement compliance matters.

C. Employee Records and Documentation
Maintain accurate employee payroll records and personal data.
Register new employees and update employment-related payroll information.
Process changes in salary, bank details, tax information, and employment status.
Prepare payslips and respond to employee questions regarding salary calculations.
Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with GDPR and data protection requirements.

D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with HR and Finance departments regarding payroll matters.
Communicate with external payroll consultants, accounting firms, and relevant authorities when required.
Prepare payroll reports, salary summaries, and monthly payroll reconciliations.
Assist with budgeting, payroll cost analysis, and financial reporting.
Identify payroll discrepancies and recommend improvements to payroll procedures.

3. Qualifications and Requirements
Previous experience in payroll administration in Sweden.
Good knowledge of Swedish payroll regulations and employment legislation.
Understanding of Swedish Collective Agreements, particularly Unionen and Installatörsföretagen.
Knowledge of Swedish tax regulations and Skatteverket reporting requirements.
Experience with payroll systems and HR administration tools.
Good numerical, analytical, and organizational skills.
High attention to detail and ability to meet strict payroll deadlines.
Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

4. Language Requirements
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Good command of Swedish is highly desirable.
Turkish language skills are considered an advantage.

5. Personal Competencies
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
Excellent planning and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Proactive approach to identifying and resolving payroll discrepancies.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Payroll Administrator's performance will be evaluated based on:
Accuracy of monthly payroll processing.
Timely salary payments.
Compliance with Swedish legislation and collective agreements.
Timely submission of statutory payroll reports.
Number of payroll discrepancies and correction requests.
Timely resolution of employee payroll inquiries.
Accuracy and completeness of payroll documentation.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join the Machine Mechanics team within Production Systems Hardware, part of the Production Engineering & Technologies department at Axis in Lund. In this role, you will design robust, cost-efficient mechanical solutions for the unique test and production systems used to manufacture Axis products.
 
Who is your future team?
At Production Systems Hardware, we develop the hardware for the machines that manufacture Axis products. We take solutions from initial concept all the way to fully tested and verified production equipment.
 
The Machine Mechanics team consists of four dedicated mechanical engineers who specialize in developing mechanical parts for the production systems used on Axis production lines.
 
What you'll do here as Mechanical Design Engineer
In the Machine Mechanics team, you will design, develop and deliver high-quality, robust and cost-efficient mechanical solutions for Axis' unique test and production systems. You will work from concept to verified product in cross-functional projects. The role involves a wide range of interfaces and gives you the opportunity to build knowledge across different technology areas.
 
In this role, you will:
Design, develop and improve mechanical solutions using the Creo 3D CAD system and the Windchill PDM system
Take an active part in development projects, with a focus on simplicity, scalability, repeatability and quality, to create the best possible production setup for Axis products

 About the OpportunityWe are looking for an experienced Equipment / Manufacturing Engineer to support the development, industrialization, and ramp-up of advanced battery manufacturing operations. This role is ideal for professionals with strong expertise in manufacturing equipment, production technologies, industrial automation, and process implementation within a high-volume manufacturing environment.You will play a critical role in defining, installing, commissioning, and optimizing manufacturing equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient production. Working closely with suppliers and cross-functional teams, you will help establish world-class manufacturing capabilities for large-scale battery production.
  
 Key Responsibilities
  Define, install, commission, and optimize manufacturing equipment for battery production operations.
 Support equipment specification development, technical requirements, and procurement activities.
 Lead equipment acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, and performance validation.
 Drive equipment reliability, availability, and operational excellence throughout the production lifecycle.
 Collaborate with suppliers during equipment design, development, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and site acceptance testing (SAT).
 Support production ramp-up activities by ensuring equipment readiness and stable operational performance.
 Troubleshoot equipment-related issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
 Work closely with Process Engineering, Production, Quality, and Maintenance teams to improve equipment performance and manufacturing efficiency.
 Analyze equipment data to identify opportunities for optimization, increased uptime, and improved productivity.
 Develop and maintain equipment standards, technical documentation, maintenance requirements, and operating procedures.
 Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, throughput, and cost efficiency.
  
 
 Qualifications
  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
 Proven experience in equipment engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial automation, or production engineering within a manufacturing environment.
 Strong understanding of manufacturing equipment, industrial systems, and production technologies.
 Experience with equipment procurement, installation, commissioning, and validation.
 Knowledge of automation systems, machine controls, robotics, or advanced manufacturing technologies is highly desirable.
 Experience working with equipment suppliers and managing technical interfaces.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a structured engineering approach.
 Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, reliability engineering, or continuous improvement methodologies is an advantage.
 Experience from battery manufacturing, automotive, electronics, or other high-volume manufacturing industries is highly desirable.
 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  
Personal Attributes
  Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
 Strong technical and analytical capabilities.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams.
 Results-driven with a focus on quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.
 Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced industrial environment.
  
 
 What We Offer

 Involvement in large-scale industrialization and production ramp-up projects.
 Exposure to cutting-edge manufacturing technologies and equipment.
 Collaborative and innovative working environment.
 Professional growth and career development opportunities.
 The chance to help build world-class manufacturing operations that support a sustainable future.
  
 
 Join us and help establish the manufacturing equipment and production capabilities that will power the next generation of battery technology.

Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

We are looking for an Electronics Engineer to join the Electronics team within Production Systems Hardware at Axis in Lund. In this role, you will combine electronics and electrical design with hands-on engineering to develop the equipment used to manufacture Axis products.

Ready for an active job in Stockholm? Join MoveByBike!
Looking for a job where you can stay active, work independently and spend your days moving around Stockholm rather than sitting behind a desk?
MoveByBike is expanding our delivery operations and is looking for new team members to work as Cargo Bike Drivers, E-Bike Drivers and Bike Couriers.
We use modern electric cargo bikes (el-lastcyklar) to transport parcels, groceries, batteries and other goods throughout Stockholm. As part of our delivery team, you will help keep the city moving while contributing to a more sustainable transport system.
We are particularly interested in candidates who want to work full-time or take on several shifts each week. Part-time opportunities are also available.
What does a typical working day look like?
Your job is to collect, transport and deliver goods using one of our electric cargo bikes.
You will:

Ride an electric cargo bike through Stockholm.

Deliver parcels, food products and other goods to customers.

Follow planned delivery routes and use digital navigation tools.

Handle deliveries carefully and professionally.

Work with our dispatch team to complete your daily assignments.

Follow traffic regulations and safety procedures.

This is an active, physically demanding job that involves working outdoors in different weather conditions, including during the Swedish winter.
If you enjoy cycling, physical activity and taking responsibility for your work, this could be a great fit.
Who are we looking for?
You don't need previous experience as a delivery driver or bike courier. What matters most is your attitude, reliability and willingness to learn.
To join our team, you must:

Be at least 18 years old.

Speak and understand Swedish or English.

Be comfortable cycling in urban traffic.

Be physically capable of handling an active delivery job.

Be reliable, punctual and able to follow work schedules.

Be prepared to work outdoors throughout the year.

No driver's license is required.
Previous experience in food delivery, parcel distribution, courier services or similar logistics work is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Flexible shifts – full-time and part-time
We offer both full-time and part-time employment opportunities.
Our delivery operations run between 08:00 and 22:00, including evenings and weekends.
We are especially interested in people who can work regularly and take on multiple shifts each week.

Full-time availability is highly valued.

Part-time employees must be available for at least 2 shifts per week (approximately 10 hours).

Evening and weekend shifts are available.

Students and people looking for additional work are welcome to apply.

Let us know your availability when submitting your application.
Pay, employment and equipment
Experienced riders earn approximately 155 SEK per hour on average, including base salary, performance bonuses and evening/weekend supplements. Holiday pay is added on top.
Actual earnings depend on the applicable supplements and performance bonuses.
All our riders receive an employment contract.
You will also receive the equipment needed to perform your work:

Electric cargo bike / e-bike.

Work phone for communication and navigation.

Professional work clothing.

How to join MoveByBike
We aim to make our recruitment process straightforward and efficient.

Submit your application online and upload your CV.

Meet our recruitment team for an interview if your application meets our requirements.

Show your cycling skills during a practical riding test with our operations team.

Get started with your employment contract, introduction and onboarding training if selected.

We are actively recruiting for our Stockholm operations and encourage candidates who are available to start soon to apply.
Why choose MoveByBike?
At MoveByBike, you become part of a team working to transform how goods are delivered in cities.
You'll enjoy an active working environment, supportive colleagues, opportunities for regular work and the chance to contribute to cleaner urban logistics.
Whether you are an experienced bicycle courier or looking for your first delivery job, we would like to hear from you.
Apply now – become an E-Bike Driver or Cargo Bike Courier with MoveByBike in Stockholm!

We are looking for an Accountant to join our Finance team at Senior Material Europe in Sweden. In this role, you will work with daily accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting and audit support, contributing to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial processes.
This is a fixed-term position for 6 months (working on-site 4 days per week, approximately 30 hours per week) offering hands-on experience across a broad range of finance activities in an international industrial organisation.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As an Accountant, you will support the daily operations of our Finance department and contribute to reliable accounting, timely financial closings and effective financial reporting.
You will work closely with the Finance Manager and the wider Finance team, gaining exposure to different areas of accounting and financial management. The role combines routine accounting tasks with analytical work, budgeting and audit-related activities.
We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, organised and comfortable taking responsibility for their work. You should enjoy working with numbers, identifying discrepancies and ensuring that financial information is accurate and delivered on time.
Job Responsibilities

Handle daily invoice processing and accounting transactions.

Contribute to monthly and annual financial closings, ensuring deadlines are met.

Perform bank reconciliations, manual journal entries and accruals.

Assist in preparing the 2027 budget and analysing the 2026 budget.

Prepare and provide financial documentation and supporting materials for audits.

Review financial information, identify discrepancies and support accurate financial reporting.

Maintain organised accounting records and ensure that financial documentation is complete and up to date.

Support the Finance Manager and colleagues with other finance-related tasks as required.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.

Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

A structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to detail.

The ability to work independently, take responsibility and manage tasks according to deadlines.

Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems is currently experiencing strong growth and is looking to strengthen our Plant Design team with a Project Engineer. Review and verify engineering drawings to ensure quality and compliance.

Collaborate closely with customers, colleagues, and cross-functional teams such as Procurement and Production.
Work with engineering and business systems including Solid Edge and SAP.

Experience working in project-based environments.

Experience from industries such as industrial cooling, water and wastewater treatment, biogas, marine, oil and gas, or nuclear power is an asset.
A proactive and self-driven approach, with the ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a practical understanding of manufacturing and installation processes.

As Senior e-commerce Content Creator, you will take ownership of how the Edblad story is brought to life across e-commerce, with the website as your primary channel.

3+ years of relevant experience within e-commerce content, digital content, editorial content or a similar role
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills, with a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice

Experience using GA4 or similar tools to evaluate content performance and inform decisions

Experience working with content across different markets and audiences
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do
You will own the design of the radioactive waste management systems for SEALER, covering the liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams generated by the reactor over its life. This includes the systems that process, characterise, condition, package, and store waste, from the cover gas cleanup that handles activation products in the primary loop, to the treatment of contaminated liquids from maintenance operations, to the interfaces with spent fuel and decommissioning.
The lead-cooled fast reactor environment presents distinct waste challenges, solutions here need to combine solid nuclear waste engineering fundamentals with a proper understanding of the lead chemistry environment.
Define the functional and design requirements for SEALER's radioactive waste management systems, covering liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams.
Develop and maintain the design basis for cover gas cleanup, liquid radwaste treatment, and solid waste characterisation, packaging, and storage.
Lead trade-off studies on waste minimisation at source versus downstream treatment, and quantify the impact on plant footprint, cost, and dose.
Interface with the Nuclear and Safety and licensing teams on waste categorisation, disposal routes, and regulatory expectations in Europe (i.e. SSM) and in the US (NRC).
Define the scope of supplier work packages on waste system equipment, evaluate proposals, and steer their execution through qualification.
Coordinate with the Material and Lead Chemistry teams on activation products and the handling of lead-contaminated components.
Support decommissioning-oriented design choices during the concept and preliminary design phases.
Contribute to the waste-related sections of the plant safety case and licensing documentation.

Who you’ll get to work with
The Nuclear Waste System Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluid Systems Engineering. You will collaborate closely with the Nuclear and Safety, Material, Test and Validation, and Quality teams, as well as with external suppliers, research partners, and regulators. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

 
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
More than 5 years of professional experience in radioactive waste management, ideally in reactor design, waste treatment facility engineering, or spent fuel handling.
Degree in nuclear, chemical, environmental, or a closely related engineering discipline.
Working knowledge of the physical and chemical processes involved in liquid radwaste treatment (evaporation, ion exchange, filtration), gaseous waste cleanup (HEPA, adsorbers, delay beds), and solid waste conditioning (cementation, drum packaging).
Familiarity with nuclear waste categorisation (LLW, ILW, HLW) and disposal routes in at least one national regulatory framework.
Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue from concept through qualification.
Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software.
Fluent in English, spoken and written.
Fluency in Swedish is a plus.

Meritorious skills:
Experience with waste systems in Generation IV reactor programmes (LFR, SFR, MSR) or in research reactors with unusual coolants..
Experience interfacing with SSM (Sweden) or NRC (US) on waste-related submittals.
Prior work on commissioning or decommissioning of nuclear facilities.
Familiarity with activation calculations and source term evaluation.
Experience with nuclear waste transport, interim storage, or final disposal facilities.

Location 
This position is for our office in Stockholm.

Experience with test automation and scripting, preferably Python.
Strong hands-on experience with Linux and ROS bag.
A good understanding of embedded systems and hardware/software integration.
Fluency in English is required, while Swedish is an advantage.

Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
Your application

Hiring Manager: Abdulrahman Kayali, abdulrahman.kayali@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Winning Through Culture

Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as a Senior Manager Packaging Development & Industrialization! 
We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years. 
 
In the Nordic region, we are 1,600 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics. 
 
Role summary 
In this role, you will lead the development and industrialization of packaging solutions for the Oral product category, ensuring they are scalable, compliant, and ready for production. You will translate business needs, product requirements, and consumer expectations into smart, efficient packaging systems that work across the full product lifecycle, from new launches to continuous improvements of existing products. 
 
You will manage and develop a small team of packaging engineers while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and quality. The focus is on delivering packaging solutions that support innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence, while meeting regulatory standards and business targets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you combine technical expertise, project ownership, and people's development to drive results. 
 
Main accountabilities 
Lead packaging development and industrialization by driving the design, validation, and implementation of packaging solutions that are robust, scalable, and ready for production across the Oral portfolio 
Build and develop a high-performing team by coaching, setting clear goals, and creating growth opportunities to strengthen both technical expertise and leadership capabilities 
Translate business and product needs into practical solutions by balancing consumer expectations, product requirements, operational constraints, and regulatory standards to ensure high-quality packaging outcomes 
Drive innovation, productivity, and sustainability initiatives by developing new materials, improving existing solutions, and contributing to portfolio optimization and cost efficiency 
Ensure effective project delivery and prioritization by managing workflows, aligning with stakeholders, and maintaining clear visibility on progress, risks, and timelines 
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to implement material strategies, support supplier performance, and ensure seamless integration across procurement, manufacturing, and quality functions 

 
Who you are 
A strong leader with several years of people management experience and a proven ability to engage, coach, and develop teams 
More than 8 years of experience within packaging, materials, or industrialization, ideally from FMCG, pharma, or a related industry 
A university degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Packaging, or a related field
Comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across different functions and levels 
Action-oriented, structured, and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment 
Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, new technologies, and AI-driven ways of working 
Fluency in English is required. Swedish is considered a strong advantage 

 
 
What we offer 
Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can: 
 
Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore. 
Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong. 
Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs. 
Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress. 
Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

Are you a System Developer who enjoys turning business needs into smart, reliable solutions? At FM Mattsson, you’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to develop and improve business-critical systems, with a particular focus on our ERP platform, Infor M3.
 
The role
 
Digitalisation plays an important role in how FM Mattsson continues to evolve. Our systems and digital solutions are designed to support our operations and help us work more efficiently. As a System Developer, you will join our Digitalisation team and collaborate with teams across the organisation to turn business needs and ideas into effective technical solutions. Your role will span development, integrations and problem-solving, with a particular focus on our ERP system, M3. 
In this role, you will:
Develop, customise and maintain internal applications and solutions within M3 and our wider system landscape.
Develop and maintain integrations between M3 and other systems.
Design technical solutions and help establish shared technical standards and best practices.
Develop, test and quality-assure solutions, as well as troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Contribute to and lead development and digitalisation initiatives.
Collaborate with teams across the organisation, internal specialists and external partners, and coordinate external M3 consultants when needed.
Help improve processes and ways of working across the organisation.

 
What we’re looking for
 
We’re looking for someone who enjoys using technology to solve real business challenges and is eager to understand what users and the organisation actually need. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. As you’ll work with people across different parts of the organisation, strong communication and collaboration skills are important. 
We’re looking for someone with:
A university degree in software development, systems design or a related field.
Experience in software development and programming, preferably with Java, JavaScript and Angular or similar technologies.
Experience working with ERP systems or other business-critical systems.
A good understanding of databases, integrations and system architecture.
The ability to understand business needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English.

It is an advantage if you also have experience in:
Infor M3.
Integrations and automation.
The manufacturing industry.
AI-assisted software development or the use of AI tools in development.

 
Practical details
 
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
 
Employment type: Permanent position
 
Location: Mora, Sweden, or Odense, Denmark
 
Hiring Manager: Head of Digitalisation Benny Skoog (benny.skoog@fmmattssongroup.com)
 
Union representative (Unionen): Claes Frisk (+46 70 375 60 34)
 
Relocation support in Mora: Through Rekryteringslots Dalarna, we can offer support for accompanying partners relocating to the area. Read more at www.rekryteringslots.se
 
Application deadline: 29 November
 
About FM Mattsson Group
 
FM Mattsson Group develops, manufactures and sells taps and related products under the well-established brands FM Mattsson, Mora Armatur, Damixa, Hotbath, Aqualla and Bristan. Our vision is to be our customers’ first choice for bathrooms, kitchens and related areas. Our core values guide how we work together and how we engage with the world around us:
The customer comes first
We win together
I step forward

In 2025, FM Mattsson Group generated revenue of approximately SEK 2.0 billion and employed around 560 people across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, the Benelux region, the UK, Germany and Italy. We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US 
As a C&F Systems Specialist within our Global Construction & Facilities team, you will play a key role in developing the systems and ways of working that support our store portfolio and everyday C&F operations. 
In this role, you will be the link between our C&F business and our systems, turning operational needs into smart, scalable solutions. You will work across functions, teams and markets to make sure our systems enable efficient processes, reliable data and continuous improvement. 
If you enjoy combining business understanding, systems and people, and want to have a real impact on how we work globally, this could be the role for you. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As C&F Systems Specialist, you will take ownership of our C&F systems and connected platforms from a business perspective. You will work closely with colleagues across C&F as well as functions such as Retail Tech, IT and Security, together with external system partners. 
You will: 
Act as business expert and super user for C&F systems and connected platforms. 
Translate business and operational needs into clear system requirements, improvements and new functionalities. 
Drive and co-lead system developments, upgrades and integrations, including testing, validation and release readiness. 
Develop smarter and more scalable ways of working through automation, standardisation and continuous improvement. 
Maintain strong governance around workflows, data structures, configurations and user permissions. 
Support Facility Managers, Project Managers and vendors throughout the system lifecycle, including onboarding, training and expert support. 
Analyse how our systems and workflows are used to identify opportunities for improvement. 
Support the development of dashboards, KPIs and insights that enable better decision-making. 
Represent C&F in system steering groups and cross-functional initiatives. 
Benchmark best practices and bring forward ideas that improve our tools, processes and ways of working. 
Help ensure our systems support relevant compliance, audit, safety and data security requirements. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for someone who is passionate about connecting business needs with systems and technology. You enjoy understanding how things work today, challenging existing ways of working and finding practical solutions that make them better. 
You have a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. At the same time, you are a strong collaborator and communicator who is comfortable working with people across different functions and areas of expertise. 
You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic. You can move between details and the bigger picture and translate complex system topics into clear business language. 
To succeed in this role, we believe you have: 
Experience from system rollouts, upgrades, integrations and/or digital transformation projects. 
Experience working across different functions and stakeholder groups, for example IT, Security, Retail Tech, Finance or external service providers. 
A good understanding of Facility Management processes, such as maintenance workflows, assets, SLAs and vendor coordination. 
Experience working with business systems, workflows, roles and data. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities for improvement. 
Experience supporting change, developing guidance or training users and driving adoption. 
The ability to translate operational requirements into clear actions and system needs. 
A collaborative, solution-oriented approach and confidence in managing different stakeholder expectations. 
Experience with a CAFM system is highly relevant, Planon experience is considered an advantage. Experience from business development or a similar environment is also beneficial 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please apply by sending your CV in English as soon as possible. For internal candidates, please initiate a dialogue with your manager before applying. 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

Are you passionate about software development, engineering applications, and solving complex technical challenges? Join us as a Software Application Engineer and play a key role in developing innovative software solutions that make a real impact across the marine industry.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

Why join us

Start your career through development programs and mentorship from industry leaders.
Work on exciting projects that are shaping the future of the maritime industry.

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. Technologies for sustainable oceans

Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .
Would you like to develop and improve purification processes for complex proteins and help develop future medicines?
At Mpya Sci & Tech, we are looking for someone with solid experience in downstream process development and protein purification. You have a strong technical background, enjoy solving complex problems and like finding new solutions when existing methods are not enough.
As a consultant at Mpya Sci & Tech, you will have the opportunity to use your expertise in development projects at pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Your assignments may range from early-stage process development to optimization and scale-up ahead of manufacturing.
About the role
You will develop, optimize and troubleshoot purification processes for recombinant proteins and other biological molecules. This may involve developing new purification strategies, improving yield and product quality, or solving challenges related to aggregation, adsorption, instability and product loss.
Your work will include:
Developing and optimizing purification processes using chromatography and filtration.
Improving protein purity, stability, activity and yield.
Planning and evaluating experiments and analyzing results.
Troubleshooting processes and making them more robust, with future scale-up and GMP manufacturing in mind.

You will work closely with other specialists and contribute your expertise to developing reliable and practical process solutions.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with:
A relevant university degree in Life Science, preferably a PhD in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemical engineering or a related field.
Several years of experience in downstream process development and protein purification.
Hands-on experience with chromatography and filtration, such as ultrafiltration and diafiltration (UF/DF).
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment within the development or manufacturing of biological medicines.
Experience working with CMOs/CDMOs in process development or manufacturing.
The ability to drive development work independently, analyze results and solve complex technical problems.
Excellent written and spoken in Swedish and English.

Experience in purifying challenging proteins and enzymes, scaling up processes and process validation is an advantage. Experience with regulatory documentation for biological medicines is also beneficial.
You are analytical, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy solving technical challenges, take initiative and work well both independently and as part of a team.
How to apply
Interested in this role or curious about working as a consultant with us? Send us your application today! We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Application deadline: 23/11. If you have any questions, please contact Jasmin Khatibi  (jasmin.khatibi@mpyascitech.com, +46 76 163 63 00) or Johan Östman (johan.ostman@mpyascietch or +46 76 628 78 91)                                  .
Why Mpya Sci & Tech?
Mpya Sci & Tech was founded by people who love science and technology, for people who share that passion. Many of us have backgrounds in industry and consulting, so we know how important it is to find the right match, have support throughout your assignment and work for an employer who listens.
At Mpya, you can be yourself. Our office feels like a shared living room, and our culture is built on curiosity, openness and respect.
Read more at www.mpyascitech.com.
Does this sound like a role for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

Make It with Pride — Join Mondelēz International
At Mondelēz International, we empower people to snack right. We are one of the world's leading snack companies, home to iconic brands loved around the globe — including Milka, Oreo, Toblerone, and Marabou. Our purpose is to lead the future of snacking by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.
For our Upplands Väsby plant, home of Marabou, Daim, Oboy and pralines we are now looking for a Maintenance Engineer to join our Asset Reliability team and play a key role in driving equipment reliability, availability, and cost-effective maintenance across our site.
About the Role
As a Maintenance Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring equipment reliability and availability through strategic preventive and predictive maintenance, aligned with our IL6S (Integrated Lean 6 Sigma) strategy. Working closely with PM Planners, Maintenance Technicians, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and the QA department, you will develop and improve our maintenance processes — with the ultimate goal of zero breakdowns and cost-efficient maintenance.
What You'll Do
Maintenance Strategy & Planning — Develop, implement, and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance plans. Lead the IL6S PM Pillar development and ensure strategy quality and compliance.
Reliability Analysis & RCA — Lead root cause analyses (RCA) and reliability studies to identify and eliminate recurring equipment failures. Conduct Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses and feed insights into the CAPEX roadmap.
Competence Development — Drive training and capability building within the maintenance team and among Line Technical Leads in preventive maintenance methodology, Progressive Maintenance (PM) methods, and SAP PM usage.
Continuous Improvement & Projects — Actively lead and participate in improvement projects, systematically eliminate operational disruptions, and contribute to the continuous development of the maintenance function.
Project Management — Drive maintenance-related projects and act as requirements owner in investment projects related to maintainability and maintenance safety.
Spare Parts Management — Optimize spare parts handling, ensure inventory accuracy, and drive efficient use of resources.
KPI Tracking & Analysis — Compile, analyze, and report maintenance KPIs including MTBB (Mean Time Between Breakdowns), equipment reliability, and % TBM/CBM completion.
Calibration Ownership — Own and continuously develop the calibration program in collaboration with the Quality department.
Cost Management — Analyze and follow up on maintenance costs — including the balance between reactive and preventive maintenance — to identify improvement opportunities and ensure cost efficiency.
Quality Assurance — Ensure all maintenance work meets quality requirements per GMP standards and owns the maintenance routines that describe how work is performed.

What You'll Bring
Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent experience)
Proven experience in maintenance engineering within a manufacturing environment, preferably FMCG
Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance strategies
Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability methodologies and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses.
Familiarity with IL6S / TPM / World Class Manufacturing principles
Strong analytical skills and experience working with maintenance KPIs
Project management experience
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Fluent in Swedish and English

What We Offer
A key role in Asset Reliability organization at a world-class manufacturing site
The opportunity to shape and drive the maintenance strategy with real impact on operational performance
A collaborative environment where you work closely with PM Planners, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and QA
Development opportunities within Mondelēz International's global network
Competitive compensation and benefits package

Art association and social activities.

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. The ILL operates the brightest neutron source in the world and hosts over 2000 visits by scientists per year, who come to carry out world-class research.
Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.

Your tasks:
In this context, you will:
- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.
- Coordinate the work of ILL services involved in these activities.
- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.
- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.
-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.
-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.
-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.
-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.
-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.
-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.
-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.
-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.
- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.

What we offer:
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. Represent business needs and the user perspective in CAB, Global CAB and other relevant decision-making forums.

Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer and internal capability development, working with ITSM stakeholders on lifecycle management.
Act as a technical advisor to internal IT functions and relevant service and decision owners.

Recommend additional analysis, conditions, postponement or escalation when decision material or risk management is insufficient.

This means that your customers will primarily be found within the food industry, pharma, manufacturing sector, and transportation and logistics industry. The products you will work with are related to inspection, measurement, and weighing processes. The overall purpose of your role is to ensure that our products are installed, calibrated, and maintained correctly. 
Customer communication and documentation of completed work are important parts of the role. Onboarding and continuous training are also included. 
Key Responsibilities:
Installation, troubleshooting, repairs, calibration, and preventive maintenance of Mettler Toledo products and instruments 
Administration within the CRM system 
Ensuring a high level of customer service 
Active collaboration with colleagues such as service technicians, planners, and sales representatives 
Participation in training sessions and meetings organized by Mettler Toledo 
Contributing to and upholding Mettler Toledo's corporate values and code of conduct

What You Need to Succeed
To succeed in this role, you are curious, service-minded, and technically inclined. 
You are solution-oriented, flexible, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and quality, you consistently deliver effective solutions and excellent service. 
Qualifications: 
Technical background in electrical engineering, automation, or mechanics 
Experience troubleshooting technical equipment and strong knowledge of electronics 
General IT proficiency, including experience working with PCs and Microsoft Office 
Well-organized, service-oriented, positive, and flexible regarding working hours and travel 
Valid Category B driver's license and enjoys being on the road 
Strong administrative skills 
Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Our Offer to You
In addition to great colleagues and a varied, meaningful job, we offer excellent development opportunities and regular training courses. Service training is typically conducted in Switzerland and Germany, and on-the-job training alongside experienced colleagues is also provided regularly.   
Benefits at Mettler Toledo Sweden: 
Company car  
Wellness allowance (fitness benefit)  
Edenred lunch benefit  
Monthly reimbursement for home office expenses  
Access to the Benifex benefits portal (including exclusive company discounts for personal use)  
Opportunity to apply for a First Card corporate credit card  
Occupational pension plan (ITP1/ITP2)  
Collective bargaining agreement (Technology Industries Agreement)  
Computer glasses/protective eyewear when needed, as well as a free eye examination (for permanent employees)  

For traveling service technicians, specific compensation rules apply for travel time and overtime. Further details will be provided during the recruitment process. 
Additional Information: 
﻿The recruitment process includes occupational psychology assessments through Alva Labs as well as a background check. 
About Mettler Toledo
METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries. For more information, please visit www.mt.com.
