Job description:We are now looking for a Senior Legal Counsel IP to join our IP Legal Team in Volvo Group IP. 
 Who are we, your new colleagues?  
 Volvo Group IP handles intellectual property matters for the complete Volvo Group – which includes not only Volvo Trucks but also e.g. Volvo Buses, Volvo Penta, Volvo Construction Equipment and autonomous solutions – in a business-integrated, strategic setup with a proactive approach. Volvo Group IP is part of the Truck Technology & Industrial (TTI) division’s Legal & Volvo Group IP function, where we work close to technology and business to enable innovation and protect value.
 Volvo Group IP takes care of the complete life cycle of trademarks, designs and patents, supporting and advising in strategic partnerships, licensing and other complex IP related agreements, driving enforcement and defense matters and handling IP risk assessments. 
  What is our offer to you?  
 As Senior Legal Counsel – Intellectual Property (IP), you will play a key role in protecting and leveraging Volvo Group’s intellectual property while enabling innovation and supporting business priorities across the organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across Volvo’s global operations, providing strategic legal advice and practical solutions in complex IP matters. 
 Combining legal expertise with a strong business perspective, you will help navigate challenging situations, strengthen partnerships and develop the processes and ways of working needed to manage IP effectively in a changing technology landscape. 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
   
Innovation and technology: Support R&D and engineering teams on IP matters related to new technologies, product development and emerging areas such as electrification, software and connectivity. 
 
    
IP risk management: Assess and manages IP risks, including patent infringement, freedom-to-operate questions and potential disputes, working with internal experts and external legal partners as needed. 
 
    
Commercial agreements: Provide IP expertise in negotiations and contract drafting involving technology collaborations, licensing, joint development, complex supplier relations and other strategic partnerships where IP is at the core of the matter. 
 
    
Litigation and enforcement: Manage and support IP disputes, litigation and enforcement matters, working with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel to protect Volvo Group’s rights and interests across the globe. 
 
    
IP awareness and collaboration: Build strong relationships across the organization, helping colleagues understand IP implications and incorporate IP considerations into their everyday work. 
 
    
Continuous improvements: Identify opportunities to strengthen Volvo Group's IP processes, ways of working and ability to capture value from innovation. 
 
  
You will also act as an ambassador for IP both within Volvo Group, and to the wider community and you will protect the Volvo Group brand by supporting our global IP enforcement strategy, taking decisive action against counterfeits, and safeguarding customers, products, and our reputation. This role is located in Gothenburg, Sweden, where also the full IP Legal team and the leadership team is located.   
 Who are you? Are we a perfect match? 
 You bring hands-on IP expertise. You are a true collaborator—low prestige, high trust—who gets things done and helps your team when needed. You thrive in a fast-moving environment, embrace change and new challenges, and you spot what needs to happen next. You combine a can-do mindset with sound judgement, and you are proactive and autonomous, with a strong sense of ownership.  
 We also believe you have: 
   
Master of Laws or equivalent legal qualification. 
 
    
7+ years’ experience in IP (in-house and/or private practice), covering a broad mix of advisory, transactional and contentious matters. 
 
    
Established expertise across key IP areas (patents, trademarks and designs), including enforcement/defense, licensing/strategic agreements and IP risk management. 
 
    
Experience leading complex IP disputes or high-stakes negotiations in an international environment is considered a strong merit. 
 
    
Strong business acumen.   
 
    
Strong digital proficiency and a willingness to embrace new and more efficient ways of working.  
 
    
Experience from automotive/industrial technology is a plus. 
 
    
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 
    
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to partner with engineering and senior leaders across a global organization.

The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – Expert
Integro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | Sweden
Help shape the future of sustainable powertrain technology
Integro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.
This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.
Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.
About the assignment
You will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).
You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.
Key responsibilities
Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.

Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.

Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.

Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.

Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.

Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.

Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.

Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.

Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.

Required qualifications and experience
We are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.
You should have:
An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.

Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.

Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.

Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.

Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.

Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.

Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.

Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.

Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.

Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.

You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.
Meritorious experience
The following would be particularly valuable:
Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.

Experience with physics-inspired AI/ML, physics-informed learning, hybrid modelling, virtual sensing, anomaly detection, or data-driven control.

Applying AI/ML to improve engineering workflows, software development, testing, or calibration.

Knowledge of software-defined vehicle architectures, AUTOSAR Adaptive, or RTOS-based solutions.

Experience in heavy-duty powertrain development, calibration, verification tools, or engineering methods.

Contributions to technical roadmaps, patents, scientific publications, or engineering competence development.

Interested in this opportunity?
If you have the expertise to advance embedded engine control and sustainable powertrain technology, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience, highlighting your expertise in embedded software architecture, SI ICE control, model-based development, ECU calibration, and automation.
Please also include your availability and any experience with hydrogen engines or physics-inspired AI/ML.
Apply through Integro Consulting to discuss the assignment and how you can contribute to this exciting development programme.

Job description: 
 Thesis Scope & Problem Statement 
This thesis project is intended for two Master's students working together.
 The central focus of this Master's thesis is to design, implement, and evaluate a confidence-aware adaptiverification architecture within the existing annotation tool. Instead of applying the same review process every detection or scene, the system will use confidence signals to select an appropriate depth of humverification. This is a software engineering thesis focused on how to structure, integrate, test, and evaluathat adaptive behavior, with particular attention to maintainability, traceability, fallback behavior, andeffective human oversight. Existing AI models provide the application context; developing new perceptimodels is not the primary objective.
 Research Objectives & Tasks
  
 The work may include:
  Design and integrate a modular architecture with explicit interfaces for confidence providerverification policies, decision logging, and annotator feedbac
 Implement confidence-provider components that expose calibrated or normalized signals, such model confidence, model agreement, source model, and object class frequency, through a comminterface.
 Implement and compare interchangeable threshold-based and learned decision policies for routingcases to light review, full review, or a second review. Automatic acceptance will be considered onlywhere permitted by safety policy, with low-confidence, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical casrouted to human review.
 Integrate attention cues into the annotation interface and record the signals, policy version, selectedreview mode, and human outcome for each routing decision.
 Develop automated tests for routing decisions, component interfaces, and fallback behavior.
 Benchmark the adaptive architecture against existing manual, sequential, and parallel workflousing annotation correctness, recall on safety-critical classes, error catch rates, task completion time,routing overhead, and human intervention.
 Evaluate maintainability and testability through change scenarios, such as adding a confidenprovider or replacing a decision policy.
 Conduct a counterbalanced user study to investigate verification behavior, cognitive workload, trucalibration, and susceptibility to automation bias.
  
Depending on feasibility and measurable added value, the work may also explore out-of-distributiondetection or vision-language-model-derived scene complexity as additional confidence signals. The coevaluation will use fixed policies during controlled experiments; online adaptation is an optional extension.
 Who Are We? 
You will join the Verification & Validation (V&V) Virtual Driver team at V.A.S., focused on ensuring tintegrity of the software stack for autonomous decision-making and control. The team brings togetherdevelopers with varied backgrounds and seniority, all centered around robust V&V practices. Theenvironment is friendly and helpful, with both in-office development and in-vehicle testing.
 Who Are You? 
You are a final-year Master's student in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, withstrong interest in software architecture, software quality, and building maintainable systems. You arecomfortable programming in Python and interested in extending and evaluating an existing softwareplatform in an industrial setting.
 You should have a foundation in modular software design, interface design, automated testing, and versioncontrol, together with an interest in empirical software engineering. You should be motivated to comparedesign alternatives and connect architectural decisions with measurable effects on correctnesperformance, maintainability, and testability.
 Familiarity with AI-assisted systems, machine learning, computer vision, or human-computer interaction isadvantageous, but prior specialization in machine learning or object detection is not required. An interest inlearning enough about model confidence and human verification to make sound software design decisis important.
 Why Join Us? 
This thesis offers an opportunity to apply software engineering methods to a concrete industrial challengdesigning an adaptive human-AI workflow that is maintainable, testable, and auditable. You will build on existing annotation platform and prior thesis results, taking the work from architectural design throughimplementation and empirical evaluation.
 You will:
  Gain hands-on experience in architectural design, component integration, automated testing, andevaluation of an industrial software system.
 Investigate how confidence signals can guide human attention while preserving traceability ahuman oversight.
 Measure architectural trade-offs across annotation correctness, performance, maintainabilittestability, and human effort.
 Collaborate with engineers working on the validation of autonomous transport solutions.
  
 
 You will gain practical experience in designing and evaluating human-AI systems in a safety-critical context.We look forward to receiving your application letter, academic transcript, and CV in English.
  
 Preferred start date:  January 2027Application deadline: 15 November 2026   
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

We are looking for a Process Assistant Engineer to join our Sweden factory and support the daily management, optimisation and continuous improvement of our separator coating processes.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. The manufacturing process consists of four main process steps, where precision, stability and quality are essential.
Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As a Process Assistant Engineer, you will support the daily operation and continuous improvement of our slurry, coating and slitting processes. You will work with production and process data, assist in troubleshooting and process validation, and contribute to improving process stability, product quality and production efficiency.
The role is hands-on and cross-functional, giving you the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams while developing your technical and analytical skills in a modern manufacturing environment.
Job Responsibilities
Assist in the daily maintenance and optimisation of separator coating processes, including slurry, coating and slitting parameters and other key process conditions.

Provide technical support to Production and assist in troubleshooting issues related to process parameters, materials and other process abnormalities.

Collect, organise and analyse production data and key process parameters, identify abnormal trends and support continuous process improvement.

Assist in process validation and DOE trials, evaluate the impact of parameters on process and product performance, and support optimisation of the process window.

Participate in internal and customer quality investigations using methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram and FTA.

Assist in developing PDCA actions and verifying their effectiveness.

Support new product trials, new slurry and raw material validation, and process condition verification.

Follow up on trial production and analyse relevant process and quality data.

Work with Equipment Engineers to analyse how different equipment functions affect product quality and support equipment and process improvements.

Assist in preparing and maintaining SOPs, process parameter sheets, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports and other process-related documentation.

Cooperate with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams to resolve production issues, improve process stability and continuously improve product quality.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree in engineering, chemistry, materials science, manufacturing or another relevant field.

At least 1 year of relevant industrial or manufacturing experience.

A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.

An interest in process development, production technology and continuous improvement.

Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions.

The ability to analyse data, identify trends and support fact-based technical decisions.

A hands-on approach and the ability to work in a production environment.

Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, in an international working environment.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience from coating, slitting, slurry preparation or other continuous manufacturing processes.

Experience with process validation, DOE or statistical process analysis.

Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, FTA or PDCA.

Experience working with production, quality or process data.

Experience from the battery, automotive, chemical, materials or other advanced manufacturing industries.

Familiarity with technical documentation, SOPs and process specifications.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where process engineering plays an important role in ensuring stable production, high product quality and continuous improvement.
The role offers hands-on experience with advanced manufacturing processes and the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams.
You will have the opportunity to develop your technical and analytical skills while contributing to the optimisation of processes that support the production of separator film for the next generation of lithium-ion batteries.
We value responsibility, collaboration, continuous learning and straightforward communication. Different perspectives are important to us, and we encourage an open and respectful working environment.

Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
We are looking for a Program Manager to support the execution of strategic initiatives across RaySearch’s Corporate Development & Strategy organization. Join us in driving cross-functional programs that help shape the future direction of RaySearch and contribute to improved cancer care worldwide.
About the job
In this role, you will help ensure that strategic initiatives are executed effectively and deliver the intended business value. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization, bringing structure, coordination, and momentum to cross-functional programs and projects.
You will coordinate activities across multiple teams, track deliverables, manage dependencies, and ensure that key initiatives continue to move forward according to plan. Acting as a central point of coordination, you will help align stakeholders, facilitate decision-making, and provide visibility into progress, risks, and priorities.
Working closely with the Director of Corporate Development & Strategy, you will support the execution of some of RaySearch’s most important strategic initiatives. The role offers broad exposure to company-wide strategic priorities and provides the opportunity to collaborate with senior stakeholders across the organization.
You will be part of the Corporate Development & Strategy department and report to the Director of the department.
Your main tasks
Coordinate and support the execution of strategic programs and initiatives across the organization.
Maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and action tracking.
Facilitate collaboration between stakeholders from different functions and departments.
Monitor progress, identify risks and dependencies, and support issue resolution.
Prepare program updates, presentations, and decision-making material for management.
Follow up on commitments, deliverables, and agreed actions to ensure execution.
Help establish effective ways of working, governance structures, and reporting processes for strategic initiatives.
Support the planning, coordination, and follow-up of workshops, meetings, and strategic projects.

Your profile
We believe you have experience coordinating complex projects, programs, or cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
To succeed in this role, you are highly structured, proactive, and skilled at creating clarity in situations with multiple stakeholders and moving priorities. You enjoy driving things forward and have a natural ability to build relationships and coordinate efforts across functions.
We also believe that you have:
Relevant higher education such as Engineering, Business Administration, International Business, Finance/Economics, Marketing
At least two years of experience in project, program, operations, strategy, business development, or a similar field.
Strong organizational and coordination skills.
Experience managing multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating complex organizational environments.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Our Culture
At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.
Our Offer
We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

What you'll do:
CERN's scientific mission relies on the exchange of knowledge, technologies and equipment across borders. Ensuring that these exchanges meet export-control requirements is essential to managing risks and enabling responsible research.

To support a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach to export-control compliance, CERN is establishing an internal compliance programme, centred on a new CERN Export Control Compliance Office.

As Export Control Compliance Lead, you will establish and lead the Export Control Compliance Office, developing the governance, policies and processes needed to embed this programme across the Organization.

Working within the Resilience team in OSI-ICS, you will conduct classifications, screenings, due diligence reviews, compliance assessments and export-control evaluations. You will provide expert advice to CERN Management on export-control and related regulatory risks, and work closely with legal, technical and operational experts to ensure effective implementation of export-control requirements.

This is an opportunity to shape a new compliance function at the intersection of science, advanced technology and international regulation.

Your responsibilities:
- Establish and lead CERN's Export Control Compliance Office, developing and implementing the governance framework, policies, processes, guidance, tools and training needed to support a consistent, proportionate and risk-based approach to export-control compliance across the Organization.
- Act as CERN's central focal point for export-control compliance matters, advising personnel, promoting awareness, conducting classifications, screenings, end-user and end-use reviews, compliance assessments, determinations and other due diligence activities, and coordinating inputs as required.
- Support and monitor the operational implementation of export-control requirements and decisions, including the management of export authorisations and associated compliance measures; act as principal adviser and secretariat to the Export Control Compliance Committee and coordinate departmental export-control liaison officers.
- Serve as CERN's contact point on export-control matters with relevant national authorities, external advisers and peer organisations, and maintain an effective external network within the export-control compliance community, particularly in the research sector.
- Maintain authoritative records of export-control compliance assessments, determinations, authorisations, policies, procedures and supporting documentation, including registers of technologies, activities, institutions and persons subject to screening, due diligence or export-control requirements.
- Monitor the effectiveness of CERN's export-control compliance arrangements, identify emerging risks, issues and trends, support the management of incidents, and provide reporting, escalation and recommendations for their continual improvement.
- Carry out such other tasks as may be required to deliver an effective export-control compliance programme.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience working in export controls within regulated sectors such as aerospace, defence, manufacturing, energy, research or higher education.
- Strong knowledge of export-control and dual-use regulatory frameworks; familiarity with one or more of the U.S., EU, Swiss and/or UK export-control regimes is an advantage.
- Demonstrated experience establishing, implementing or maturing compliance programmes, governance arrangements and internal controls.
- Demonstrated experience conducting compliance assessments, due diligence activities, export-control evaluations, export licensing or other regulatory-compliance processes.
- Strong interpersonal and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, administrative, legal and external stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, drafting and documentation skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, procedures and compliance measures.
- Sound judgement and the ability to assess complex compliance matters, weigh competing considerations and formulate clear, evidence-based recommendations and compliance determinations.
- Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of International Relations, Engineering, Law, Compliance, Economics, Business or a related field. A recognised qualification or certification in export control or compliance would be an advantage.

- Develops organisational strategy by anticipating future trends and taking a long term view of issues that impact CERN and its environment.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

What will you do?
As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Rebtel, you will lead the engineers behind our iOS and Android apps, combining hands-on native mobile development with coaching and team leadership. Your daily work will focus on building high-quality mobile experiences, driving technical excellence, and helping engineers grow in their craft. You will also champion the effective use of AI-assisted development to improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering standards and ownership.
This is not a management-only role. You will write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help solve difficult technical problems while taking responsibility for the team's development and delivery. Your impact will come from both what you build and how you help others grow.
Areas of ownership:

Coach and develop engineers through regular one-to-ones, clear feedback and career development. Help people strengthen their technical judgment, grow their skills and take greater ownership.

Stay hands-on with native development. Write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help investigate challenging bugs and performance issues using native platform tools.

Help the team use AI effectively. Lead by example with AI-assisted development tools, share practical approaches and coach engineers to critically evaluate outputs while maintaining code quality, security and ownership.

Drive native app excellence. Set high standards for performance, stability, accessibility and user experience across iOS and Android. Guide technical decisions, architecture, testing and release practices.

Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Product, Design and Backend Engineering to turn customer needs into clear priorities, deliver valuable features and balance short-term goals with long-term app quality.

Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Hire and develop great engineers, set clear expectations and create an environment where people take initiative, solve problems and take pride in what they deliver.

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. English is our working language, but you'll hear many different languages in our Stockholm office.

A strong track record as a native mobile engineer, with production iOS or Android apps you have personally designed, built and shipped.

Deep hands-on expertise in native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) or Android development (Kotlin/Java). You understand native architecture, UI, app lifecycle, concurrency, performance and debugging, and are comfortable contributing production code today. You can guide technical decisions across both platforms, although equal expertise in both is not required. Experience limited to React Native or other cross-platform frameworks does not meet this requirement.

Experience leading and developing engineers, including coaching, giving feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance. You know how to stay technically involved without taking over.

Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools. You understand where they add value, where they fall short and how to validate their output.

Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing quality, delivery and long-term maintainability.

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Are you ready to make an impact by solving real-world challenges and driving innovation in energy solutions? Join our talented team at Siemens Energy as a Structural Calculation Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the strength, durability, and reliability of our cutting-edge products. You will collaborate with designers daily, contributing to the development of energy solutions that meet the highest industry standards for both onshore and offshore projects. Imagine building and evaluating finite element models to assess static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures while driving efficiency through innovative scripting in Python and MATLAB. Your insights will be delivered through clear technical reports and presentations, making a significant impact on our internal and external stakeholders.
How You’ll Make an Impact
You will analyze and evaluate finite element models to assess the static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures.
Collaborate closely with a team of experienced engineers to develop cost-effective solutions tailored to our customers’ needs.
Create and maintain proprietary scripts in Python and MATLAB to streamline processes and innovate new methods of working.
Deliver clear and impactful results through technical reports and presentations for both internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring
You possess strong analytical skills and a natural talent for solving technical challenges.
As a team player, you stay organized and focused, ensuring timely and efficient project delivery.
You have experience with the Finite Element Method (FEM) and are skilled in creating simulation models.
Hands-on experience with tools like Abaqus, HyperWorks, Ansa, or Ansys is essential; knowledge of MATLAB and/or Python is a bonus!
You excel in communication and enjoy building strong relationships with both internal teams and customers.
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on structural analysis and strength, is required.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

About the Team
You will be part of a team of experienced calculation engineers in a fun and challenging environment, where inclusion and diversity are key pillars. The group is driven by solving challenging problems and staying at the forefront of developing new methods in the field of strength analysis.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: Master’s Thesis - Leveraging AI for Simulation Model Development
jobs.description:
Company Description
AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach. 

Job Description
Background
Discrete Event Simulation (DES) is widely used to analyze, design, and optimize complex industrial systems. Developing simulation models often requires considerable effort for data preparation, model construction, validation, experimentation, and documentation.
Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have created new opportunities to support simulation engineers throughout the modeling process. AI-based tools may assist with tasks such as interpreting requirements, generating model structures and components, supporting validation activities, automating repetitive tasks, and improving decision-making.
This thesis investigates how AI can be leveraged to improve efficiency, quality, and ease of simulation model development.
Objectives
The objective of this thesis is to investigate how Artificial Intelligence can support the development of simulation models and improve the productivity of simulation engineers.
Specific objectives may include:
· Identify simulation development activities that can benefit from AI support.
· Evaluate how AI can assist in transforming system requirements into simulation models.
· Investigate AI-supported approaches for model creation, verification, and validation.
· Explore opportunities to automate repetitive and time-consuming modeling tasks.
· Develop and evaluate one or more proof-of-concept solutions for AI-assisted simulation modeling.
· Assess the benefits, limitations, and practical applicability of AI-assisted modeling workflows.
Methods
· Literature Study: Review existing research on AI applications in simulation modeling and engineering.
· Modeling Workflow Analysis: Analyze simulation development workflows to identify opportunities for AI support.
· Use Case Definition: Define and evaluate AI use cases that support simulation model development and analysis.
· Concept Development: Design and prototype AI-assisted capabilities for simulation model development and analysis.
· Implementation: Develop one or more proof-of-concept solutions using relevant AI technologies and frameworks.
· Evaluation: Evaluate AI-assisted simulation solutions through practical case studies focusing on efficiency, quality, usability, and industrial value.
Deliverables
The expected deliverables should include well-documented paper and a demonstration for the simulation team, covering the following:
· AI-assisted proof-of-concept solution for simulation model development
· Demonstration case study
· Evaluation of AI's impact on simulation modeling efficiency and quality
· Best practices for applying AI in simulation projects
· Recommendations for future AI-assisted simulation workflows
Research Questions
The thesis should address some of the following questions:
1. How can AI support simulation engineers during simulation model development?
2. Which simulation modeling tasks are most suitable for AI assistance?
3. How can AI reduce the time and effort required to build simulation models?
4. Can AI improve model verification, validation, and debugging activities?
5. How can AI support the generation of model logic and simulation scenarios?
6. What limitations and risks exist when using AI to support simulation model development?
7. How does AI-assisted model development compare with traditional development approaches regarding efficiency, quality, and usability?
8. Which AI-enabled capabilities provide the greatest value in industrial simulation projects?

Qualifications
We are looking for 2 students with a background in one of the following master’s programs (or similar):
· Production engineering
· Systems, control and mechatronics
· Supply Chain Management
We believe that suitable students have completed one or more simulation courses with good grades and possess solid theoretical knowledge, practical experience and a strong interest in production systems and/or production logistics environments. Are you a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a particular interest in breast and melanoma surgery? 
Are you looking for an opportunity to develop further within specialised cancer surgery while working in a multidisciplinary and academically active environment?
We are currently recruiting a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a strong professional interest in breast and melanoma surgery for a permanent position at a major university hospital in southwestern Sweden.
The position offers the opportunity to combine specialised clinical work with multidisciplinary cancer care, professional development, teaching and research in a highly specialised hospital environment.
About the position
Your primary focus will be the care and surgical treatment of patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma.
The role includes both outpatient care and day surgery, and you will be involved in the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients.
The work is characterised by close multidisciplinary and multiprofessional collaboration, where surgeons work together with other specialists and healthcare professionals throughout the patient's treatment pathway.
Most of the work is carried out during daytime hours. Depending on your individual competence and previous experience, participation in general surgical on-call duties may also be included.
Breast and melanoma surgery
The position is particularly suited to a general surgeon who already has clinical experience within breast surgery, melanoma surgery or related oncological surgery and wishes to continue developing within this field.
You will work with patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma in a specialised surgical environment that combines clinical care with continuous development.
The broader surgical organisation also includes areas such as upper gastrointestinal surgery, endocrine and sarcoma surgery, as well as acute and trauma surgery.
A university hospital environment
The hospital offers an environment where specialised healthcare, education, clinical development and research are closely connected.
The breast and melanoma surgery field is research-intensive, and teaching and continuous development are natural parts of the position.
For a surgeon who wants to combine clinical expertise with continued academic and professional development, this provides an opportunity to build a long-term career within a large Swedish university hospital.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery who has a particular interest and relevant experience in breast and melanoma surgery.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary setting and are comfortable taking responsibility while contributing to the continued development of the department.
You value close collaboration with colleagues from different professions and specialties and have a patient-centred approach to your work.
Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has relevant clinical experience
Has experience and a strong professional interest in breast surgery, melanoma surgery and/or related oncological surgery
Is comfortable managing patients throughout different stages of the surgical care pathway
Enjoys working in multidisciplinary and multiprofessional teams
Has a strong sense of responsibility and an interest in clinical development
Has good communication and collaboration skills
Has good English language skills
Is strongly motivated to learn Swedish and establish a long-term career in Sweden

For candidates who do not yet speak Swedish, language training is provided as part of the recruitment process.
What the hospital offers
You will have the opportunity to:
Work within specialised breast and melanoma surgery
Develop your competence within surgical cancer care
Work with both outpatient consultations and surgical treatment
Become part of an established multidisciplinary cancer care environment
Participate in teaching and continuous clinical development
Work in a research-intensive university hospital environment
Collaborate with experienced specialists across different medical and surgical disciplines
Continue developing both clinically and academically

• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Interested?

Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM, and Metadata Management.

Experience with enterprise information modelling, ontologies, semantic architecture, or knowledge graphs.

Knowledge of semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL.

Why Join Multiply?
Work on challenging enterprise Data & Information Management and AI-readiness initiatives.

TL;DR: Lovable’s product-led growth motion has been core to its success. The product, the onboarding experience, and the messages we send are foundational to that motion. That makes the senior Growth Product Marketer one of the highest leverage roles on the marketing team and a strategic partner shaping how that business growth actually happens. 
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
8+ years of experience in product marketing, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing.
Experience at a high-growth tech company.
Direct experience with a PLG or self serve product, including ownership of the signup to paid to expansion motion.
Experience pulling and interpreting your own data from tools like Hex, Amplitude, and Looker, rather than relying on other teams for analysis.
A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail.

Nice to have
Experience with lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io, and analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Looker.
Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and growth metrics, including PQLs, activation rate, and feature adoption.
Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.
Experience scaling a self serve or PLG motion at a previous company.

Who you are
Analytically strong: you can read a dashboard, design an experiment, and determine whether it worked.
A clear, concise writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.
Experienced working directly with growth product and engineering teams, not just briefing them.
Comfortable managing multiple workstreams (tooling, experimentation, review cycles) without losing momentum.
Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.
Biased toward shipping and testing quickly over lengthy planning cycles.

What you’ll do
Set the strategy for how self serve users move through the journey from signup to activation to expansion, and decide where marketing has the most leverage to improve it.
Build and prioritize the lifecycle and experimentation roadmap: which tests get run, in what order, and why, based on where the data says users get stuck.
Partner closely with Product Growth and engineers, bringing your own analysis and point of view - not just as a marketing resource fulfilling requests, on which friction points matter most, what the lifecycle program should prioritize this quarter, and where a messaging change will outperform a product change, or vice versa.
Own lifecycle messaging strategy across email, in app surfaces, and push notifications, from signup through activation and expansion.

Represent the growth marketing perspective in Product Growth's planning, not just its execution.

jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. For over 50 years, our innovative solutions have developed and manufactured machines for electronics and display manufacturing. We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing. 
In this role, you will be part of our R&D team Metrology and Process Control Group (PMCD), which currently consists of 12 team members working within pattern design, metrology, cleanliness, and data analysis.
Work tasks
Technical Project Leadership
Lead technically demanding customer demonstrations and development activities from concept to implementation.
Coordinate cross-functional activities with production, quality, metrology, R&D, suppliers, and customers.
Drive technical decisions, manage priorities and risks, and ensure successful delivery.
Mentor colleagues and contribute to the development of engineering competence within PMCD.

Lithography Process Ownership
Own and continuously improve lithography processes to ensure process capability, stability, yield, and product quality.
Define and maintain process specifications, operating procedures, and engineering standards.
Lead root-cause investigations and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Advanced Process Control (APC)
Develop and implement APC strategies using statistical methods, SPC, DOE, and other data-driven approaches.
Analyze process and metrology data to identify sources of variation and define opportunities for improvement.
Define and monitor relevant process KPIs and drive improvements in process robustness and performance.

Process Development & Technology Innovation
Lead the development and qualification of new lithography processes, materials, and equipment.
Design and execute experiments to optimize processes and support technology development.
Translate research and emerging technologies into robust, scalable manufacturing solutions.

We are looking for
This is a role for you who enjoy combining scientific understanding with practical engineering to develop robust, data-driven solutions that create long-term value. You have a structured and analytical mindset and thrive in multidisciplinary environments. You are curious, proactive, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, technologies, and ways of working. As you will collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, customers, and stakeholders across the organization, you are a strong team player who enjoys building relationships, fostering collaboration, and leading technical discussions to achieve common goals.
On top of that, you have:
A Masters Degree or Ph.D. in Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Electronics, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
At least some years of industrial experience in semiconductor manufacturing, lithography, photomask manufacturing, or another advanced manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of process engineering, process characterization, and statistical data analysis.
Experience with DOE, root-cause analysis, and systematic problem-solving methodologies.
Experience leading technical projects or coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities.
Strong knowledge in English, both written and spoken.

We see it as a merit if you have:
Experience with APC, SPC, process monitoring, and metrology systems.
Experience qualifying new processes, materials, or equipment.
Knowledge of semiconductor, photomask, or display manufacturing technologies.
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, or other structured continuous improvement methodologies.
