China production and suppliers: Working directly with electronics manufacturers and suppliers in China, including supplier development, technical improvements, quality assurance and supplier audits.

Product cost and value engineering: Driving product cost analysis, cost control and value engineering throughout the product development and industrialization process.

Financial and operational planning: Contributing to financial analysis, budgeting, product costing and operational planning, including activities related to manufacturing operations in China.

Digitalization: Hands-on experience with digital transformation in manufacturing, including database development and management information systems.

Experience with ERP, PLM and PDM systems.
Experience from the LED lighting industry or a closely related electronics industry.

Employment: Full-time, permanent employment

Start date: By agreement

Application deadline: 23 November 2026
 
Application
Please submit your application and CV by email to info@aluwave.com no later than 23 November 2026.

The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description: Would you like to work at the centre of an international supply chain, coordinating orders, exports and transportation across global markets? Join us as an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator and take on a varied role where collaboration, accuracy and your ability to keep things moving make a real difference.   
Join our team 
 We are looking for an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator to join our Order Fulfillment team in Örebro.  
 Our Global/Regional Distribution Center in Ghent is a logistics provider within Epiroc Supply Chain in the Tools division. Our task is to manage and develop a high-quality and cost-effective supply chain for our customers, including distribution of spare parts and aftermarket products for our PSD and RGD divisions, as well as orders and delivery of rock drilling equipment. Goods are shipped from our third-party warehouse (3PL) in Ghent, and our primary goal is to help our Customer Centers succeed through high-quality deliveries on time.
 Your mission As an Order Fulfillment Export Coordinator, you will manage customer orders throughout the order fulfilment process and make sure that deliveries are prepared and shipped according to established schedules. You will coordinate several activities simultaneously and maintain close communication with both internal and external stakeholders. Each team member is primarily responsible for a number of Customer Centers (sales companies), and you will act as a logistics coordinator from order received to delivery, including invoicing and shipping of spare parts. 
 Your responsibilities will include: Managing customer orders and monitoring them throughout the fulfilment process. Ensuring that goods are shipped according to schedule. Handling export, invoicing and shipping of spare parts, from order received to delivery. Coordinating transport bookings across different modes of transportation. Ensuring that export documentation and customs clearance are completed correctly and on time. Would you like to help develop the next generation of birch forests? Join our research team and investigate how flowering and seed production can support faster progress in forest tree breeding.
Improved planting material contributes to productive and resilient forests. In silver birch, efficient breeding and reliable seed production depend on our ability to understand and influence flowering. Skogforsk is seeking a motivated PhD student to investigate these processes and develop methods that can be applied in breeding programmes and seed production.
The position is part of Phase II of Trees For Me, a centre of excellence focusing on fast-growing broadleaved trees for sustainable forests, materials and energy.

Research project and duties
The overall aim of this four-year PhD project is to improve our understanding of flowering in silver birch and develop practical methods to promote early and reliable flowering and seed production.
The project will investigate how environmental conditions and cultivation treatments influence flowering in young plants and older breeding material. Particular attention will be given to light conditions, plant development and genetic differences in flowering responses. The research will connect fundamental questions about reproductive development with practical challenges in birch breeding.
Earlier flowering could shorten the breeding cycle and help realise the benefits of genomic selection by allowing selected individuals to be crossed at a younger age. Improved control of flowering could also support more reliable seed production.
Your work will include:
Planning, establishing and managing experiments in controlled environments, greenhouses and, where relevant, the field.
Assessing growth, development, male and female flowering, and seed production and quality.
Analysing experimental data using statistical methods.
Publishing scientific papers and communicating results to researchers, breeders and other stakeholders.
Completing doctoral courses in forest genetics, breeding and related subjects.

The detailed research questions and experimental programme will be developed together with the supervisory team.

Trees For Me – Phase II
Trees For Me brings together universities, research institutes, industry and public-sector organisations to develop knowledge and solutions for the sustainable use of fast-growing broadleaved trees, including birch, poplar and aspen.
Within Phase II, this PhD project will contribute knowledge and methods to strengthen birch breeding and the supply of improved reproductive material. The student will participate in an interdisciplinary research environment and collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across the forest sector.

Research environment
The project is a collaboration between Skogforsk and the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Alnarp. The student will be employed by Skogforsk and based at the Ekebo research station in Svalöv, with doctoral enrolment at SLU.
You will join a team working with forest tree genetics, breeding and seed production. The position offers close contact with operational breeding, access to experimental facilities and breeding material, and opportunities for national and international collaboration.

Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated and curious candidate with a master’s degree in forestry, biology, plant science, genetics, environmental science or an equivalent subject relevant to the project.
You should have an interest in experimental research, plant development and the practical application of scientific results. Good communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English are essential.
The following qualifications are considered merits:
Knowledge of plant physiology, flowering biology, forest genetics or tree breeding.
Experience in establishing and managing plant experiments.
Experience in statistical analysis and programming in R or equivalent software.
Experience working with plants in greenhouses, controlled environments or field trials.

You should be able to work independently and collaboratively, organise your work carefully and take responsibility for practical experiments. A valid driving licence is required.
Applicants must meet SLU’s requirements for admission to doctoral studies.

Employment and application
Employment: Four-year, fixed-term employment as a PhD student at Skogforsk.
Location: Ekebo research station, Svalöv, Sweden.
Starting date: By agreement.
Application deadline: 6 December.
Your application should include:
A cover letter describing your motivation, relevant experience and research interests.
A CV.Degree certificates and transcripts.
Contact details for two referees.

Send your application to eva.persson@skogforsk.se, using the subject line “PhD application – birch”. Deadline for application is 6th of December.
For further information, please contact Mateusz Liziniewicz (mateusz.liziniewicz@skogforsk.se), Researcher, Skogforsk.

About Skogforsk
Skogforsk is the Swedish forestry research institute. Our vision is "World-class forestry for sustainable development." We develop and communicate knowledge, services, and products that contribute to the sustainable development of forestry for the benefit of society.
We operate at three locations: Uppsala, Sävar in Västerbotten, and Ekebo in Skåne. In total, we have approximately 160 employees.
At Ekebo, our research includes forest tree breeding, genetics and the production of improved planting material.

We are looking for a hands-on professional with research experience and leadership skills to lead operations at the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, as well as serve as a member of the management team for the entire Unit for Field-Based Forest Research. This position offers excellent opportunities for someone who enjoys a varied range of responsibilities, thrives on challenges, and wants to contribute to research on boreal forest production and forest ecosystems.
In 2024, the Unit revised its strategic operational plan through to 2030, resulting in a partially new organisation structure that has recently been implemented. In line with the Faculty’s ambition to broaden its activities, the Unit’s remit is also being gradually expanded. This calls for a cohesive and functional organisation across the Unit, structured around its four main areas of activity: long-term experiments, major research infrastructure, commissioned projects, and environmental monitoring and analysis.
About the position
You will be a member of the Unit’s management team. As manager of the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, you will have overall responsibility for operations within your area of responsibility (Svealand and southern Norrland), including financial and personnel management, as well as occupational health and safety matters. Your role is to ensure that activities at the experimental forests develop in a way that best supports field research, environmental monitoring, and education, while remaining within the allocated budget. Cooperation within SLU and engagement with the surrounding community are also ongoing aspects of the station managers responsibilities.
As the station manager, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure that ongoing forest field experiments are maintained and revised according to plan, using modern technology, and that new experiments are established today to address future research questions. You will be responsible for the content of metadata databases and the databases associated with them. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the Siljansfors team actively participates in the steering groups for the Unit’s various main areas of activity, and that the tasks agreed upon by these groups are implemented within your area of responsibility. An important part of the role involves receiving requests and, whenever possible, carrying them out. These may concern the establishment or revision of forest field experiments, environmental monitoring assignments, as well as teaching or outreach activities.
During the snow-free season, you will also participate in practical fieldwork, which involves spending considerable time outdoors and undertaking shorter periods of work-related travel. 
Your profile
Requirements:
Higher education in forestry, preferably supplemented by doctoral studies or other relevant experience in academic work, and a good understanding of the conditions and requirements of research
Extensive experience with practical fieldwork in forest environments
The ability to organise and structure work, and to act in an educational and diplomatic manner
A valid category B driver’s license
Good command of both Swedish and English

Desirable Qualifications:
Management experience, including personnel responsibility
Practical experience in forestry operations and forest inventory
Experience working with databases, GIS data, and related software
Familiar with methods and techniques for tree measurement and field data collection
Experience with meteorological instruments and data loggers

We place great importance on your personal qualities. Of particular importance is your ability to handle unexpected situations, for example when new tasks need to be undertaken at short notice. The position is based at the Siljansfors experimental forest office in central Mora, and at the field station in Siljansfors, 18 km southwest of Mora. SLU’s Faculty of Forest Sciences is located in Umeå.
Employment: Permanent, full-time position. SLU applies a probationary employment period.
About the employment: Your title will be Experiment Group Leader, with the additional responsibility of station manager. This responsibility will be transferred to you at a time agreed upon by you, the current station manager and the Unit Director.

The Electromechanics Design Department within Global Robotics R&D Technology consists of 16 engineers specializing in verification, mechanics, mechatronics, and electronics. jobs.occupation: Researcher in plant breeding, genomics, and sensory and nutritional quality
jobs.description:
Department of Plant Breeding
We are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a strong background in genetics, genomics and crop improvement
About the position
The position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.
The candidate will lead experimental and analytical work within the subject and collaborate with other researchers and students in the group as well as outside the organisation.
The work will include:
Analyse Genotyping by sequencing (GBS) data (quality control, read mapping and SNP calling)
Genome-wide association studies (GWAS)
Field evaluation and phenotyping of diverse germplasm
Data analysis, interpretation, and preparation of scientific publications within the subject
Participate in collaborative research activities and supervision of students
Apply for external research funding

Your profile
Qualification requirements
The following qualifications are required:
A PhD in plant genetics, plant breeding, agriculture, or a related field
Good understanding of the genetic basis of complex quantitative traits
Experience with GBS data and GWAS
Experience with nutritional quality traits in crops
Experience with metabolomic and ionomic profiling including the integration and analysis of multi-omics datasets
Experience with advanced statistical methods for analysing genetic and phenotypic data
Practical experience with field experiments, data collection and phenotyping
Good skills in the programming language R or a comparable language
Very good written and oral English skills

The candidate must be able to take a leading role in research development as well as to collaborate in research groups and have good overall communication skills.
Additional qualifications
The following qualifications are meritorious:
Experience in plant pathology and/or plant physiology
Machine learning, artificial intelligence or other data-driven approaches to biological datasets

Assessment criteria
Assessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Emphasis will be placed on documented experience in field phenotyping and analysis of genetic data.
The evaluation will also consider the applicant’s ability to conduct independent research, collaborate within a multidisciplinary research environment, and communicate scientific results through publications and presentations.
About us
The position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 
As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. 

About the job 
Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? 
With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together! 
 
We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. 
As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc. 
 
Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops. 
 
Key tasks and responsibilities: 
Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor 
FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: 

Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal 
 pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support. 
Hand calculations 
Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations 
Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others 
Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices 
DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT 
Review 3D designs and 2D drawings 
Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking 
Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1 

 
Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. 
You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. 
At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks. 
 
 
Who are you 
You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success. 
 
What you know 
We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. 
The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly. 
 
Requirements: 
Degree in Mechanical Engineering 
Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. 
Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity. 
Excellent communication skills in English 
 

 
For more information, please contact 
Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 
Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner

Our commitment to integrity 
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To succeed in this role 
Success in this position requires a combination of strong technical expertise, people leadership, and a global mindset. You are comfortable leading through change, building trust across teams, and balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment. You know how to motivate and develop engineering talent while ensuring disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer
You will become part of a global Mechanical Engineering Management Team supporting the Pulp, Energy and Circularity business area. The role offers extensive collaboration with engineering leaders, project execution teams, technology units, business units, and external engineering partners around the world. You will have the opportunity to influence both strategic development and operational excellence while leading a highly capable engineering team. 
We offer an inspiring and challenging position with international exposure and significant opportunities for personal and professional growth. You'll work in a collaborative, global environment where innovation, sustainability, and continuous learning are valued. Want to know more?

For positions with people leadership responsibilities in Sweden, delegated Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) responsibilities form an integral part of the role. Relevant information will be shared and discussed during the recruitment process.

When everything works together  
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Imagine joining our Mechanical Engineering team for Medium Gas Turbines, where your expertise will be vital in ensuring business continuity and supporting customer order engineering projects. In this role as a System Engineer, you will engage in advanced Mechanical System Design & Development, focusing on design of steel structures and installation solutions. You will tackle rigorous Technical Design creations in NX, Analysis & Problem Solving to optimize performance and efficiency, while also taking on Project Management & Other engineering disciplines. Mentorship responsibilities to guide processes and support junior team members. Your contribution will be essential in delivering comprehensive engineering solutions in customer order engineering projects. support from concept to execution.

How You’ll Make an Impact

●       Apply the full engineering design process to adapt designs to satisfy the customer needs

What You Bring

●       Professional experience in a mechanical engineering role, working with complex machinery or energy systems.
●       Strong understanding of applicable norms and standards in process and mechanical engineering, both EN and ASME. 
●       Proven experience managing engineering projects, preferably from a multicultural environment.
●       Experience with 3D CAD, preferably Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
●       Background within large industrial gas turbine engineering is a merit

●       Good communication in both Swedish and English is preferred.

About the Team 
You will be part of a dedicated Mechanical Engineering team focused on the design and development of medium gas turbines. Our team is committed to innovation and excellence, working collaboratively to ensure the stability and performance of mechanical systems. Our responsibilities are design of steel structures and installation solutions both in workshop assembly stage and site installation stage. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

We can offer you employment benefits such as reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

 
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. jobs.occupation: Radiographer – Daytime position in coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:
30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and beginning work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is:
31,100 SEK/month gross
The salary as an authorised radiographer may be individually determined depending on previous professional experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
Please submit:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates
Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

Interested?
If you are a qualified radiographer interested in building a long-term career and life in Sweden, we would be happy to hear from you.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Global R&D Manager Verification and Validation
jobs.description:
Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:This is a senior and independent leadership position with responsibility for establishing global verification and validation practices across Surface Mining Automation. You will have a unique opportunity to influence technology decisions, quality standards, and release readiness across a portfolio of strategic automation programs.
 At Epiroc, we're accelerating the transformation of mining through automation and digitalization. As our Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will play a key role in ensuring that our solutions are safe, predictable, compliant, and ready to deliver value for our customers around the world.
 Join our team
 You will be part of Surface Mining R&D Automation, a globally connected organization developing autonomous and software-defined mining solutions. Together with colleagues across R&D, Systems Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Release Management, we create innovative technologies that improve safety, productivity, and sustainability in mining operations.
 Your mission
 As Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will establish and lead a global approach to verification and validation, helping ensure the successful delivery of automation solutions across regions and programs.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Defining and continuously improving a global verification and validation strategy aligned with the V-model.
  Leading system- and machine-level verification activities across integrated automation solutions.
 Establishing clear release-readiness criteria, quality gates, and data-driven decision frameworks.
 Ensuring traceability from requirements to verification results, supported by robust documentation and compliance processes.
 Collaborating with engineering teams to identify risks early and improve solution quality from the start.
 Enabling scalable verification through reusable test methods, assets, and environments including HiL, SIL, and virtual testing.
 Supporting FAT/SAT activities and customer acceptance processes.
 Developing global V&V capabilities, common ways of working, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  
 
Profile description:Your Profile
 We are looking for a collaborative and experienced leader who combines systems thinking with a passion for quality and continuous improvement.
 You build trust through expertise, communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, and enjoy creating alignment across global teams.
 You are equally comfortable engaging with senior leaders on strategic priorities as working closely with engineers and technical specialists to drive execution and solve complex challenges.
 You have a leadership style that inspires confidence, builds engagement, and helps teams successfully navigate change in complex global organizations.
 With a strong quality mindset and a structured approach, you know how to establish new ways of working, gain stakeholder commitment, and drive sustainable improvements across teams and functions.
 You are comfortable making informed decisions based on data and evidence while supporting others in finding solutions to complex challenges.
 To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:
  Experience in system-level verification and validation within automation, embedded systems, control systems, software-intensive products, or system integration.
 Strong leadership experience in global or cross-functional environments, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders.
 Strong experience leading change management initiatives, including organizational, process, or technology transformations and driving adoption across global teams.The ability to communicate effectively at both strategic and operational levels, translating complex technical topics into clear business insights while building strong relationships with engineering teams.
 A strong focus on quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
 Knowledge of verification strategies, requirements traceability, system integration, release processes, and verification environments such as HiL, SIL, or simulation-based testing.
 Experience with customer acceptance activities, field-deployed automation, compliance, or functional safety is considered an advantage.
 A degree in Engineering or a related technical field. Advanced studies and leadership development experience are welcome.
 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
 Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.
  
Location and travel
 This position is based in Örebro, Sweden.
 For the right candidate, a flexible location within one of Epiroc's sites may be considered.
 International travel of up to 40% is expected.
 Application and contactsPlease send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 19th of November.
 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.
You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Jondal
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life between the fjord, mountains and glacier
Jondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
Design Engineer, Volvo Construction Equipment
Would you like to help develop the construction equipment of the future? Together, we create world leading products in the premium segment, with a focus on quality, safety and care for the environment. We are looking for Design Engineers to join the Exterior department at Volvo Construction Equipment in Braås. This position is located on-site in Braås outside Växjö.

Volvo CE in Braås, near Växjö, developes articulated haulers and wheel loaders and manufactures articulated haulers. Our development departments are constantly working on innovative solutions and designs for new products. All to ensure that we remain at the forefront of development and pushing limits, regarding new product and feature development, product improvements and aftermarket quality.

You will also take the lead on design-related topics and act as a point of contact for other departments. By driving collaboration, coordinating discussions and working across functions, you will help ensure that the team’s deliverables are completed successfully. Your work will focus on exterior components for wheel loaders and articulated haulers.

You are keen to learn and develop, both individually and as part of a team, and are willing to take the lead when needed. You are comfortable taking initiative and stepping forward when the situation calls for it. You communicate clearly and enjoy working across departmental boundaries, while taking responsibility for the team’s shared deliverables.

B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification
Experience in mechanical design
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both spoken and written
Experience with Creo or another 3D modelling tool

Construction equipment or heavy vehicles
Design of sheet metal, plastics or tubular components
FEM calculations
Lean and Agile ways of working

About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks
Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance

Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems
Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows

Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic

The opportunity
This is a broad digital leadership role with responsibility for the systems and capabilities that support Lindex entire retail network. You have the opportunity to influence both operational reliability and the future development of the retail area.
The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You lead a multidisciplinary organisation that includes digital leads, developers and managers.
About the role
As Head of Digital – Retail, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across the company’s retail network. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.
Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.
You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through collaboration across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.
The Head of Digital – Retail holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for the retail area.
Ensure stable operations and continuous improvement of point-of-sale systems, RFID solutions, the employee retail app and security gate systems.
Identify opportunities to improve retail processes, including pricing, product handling and the establishment of new retails.
Monitor system performance and lead effective incident management for business-critical retail solutions.
Coordinate digital requirements with Facilities and Properties to secure connectivity, fibre infrastructure and appropriate technical retail formats.
Balance operational stability, incremental improvements and the development of new digital capabilities.
Lead a team of developers, digital leads and managers.
Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Manegement Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.
Collaborate across the organization to align retail priorities with Lindex overall business, digital and technology direction.
Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.

About you
You understand the complexity of retail operations and recognise how even small changes in technology can have a significant operational impact. You combine curiosity about retail with sound judgement, structured prioritisation and the ability to turn business needs into workable digital solutions. You provide clarity across organisational boundaries and maintain a strong focus on stability, performance and continuous improvement.
To succeed in the role, you need:
A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.
Extensive leadership experience, including leading managers, employees or cross-functional teams.
Experience translating business strategy and operational needs into digital priorities, capabilities and execution.
Experience leading digital products, platforms, data, automation, agile delivery, objectives and key results, and backlog prioritisation.
Experience driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.
Strong communication skills and fluency in English.

It is an advantage if you have:
Experience from retail and a strong understanding of day-to-day retail operations.
Experience with point-of-sale systems, RFID technology, retail applications or other retail-related platforms.
Experience with monitoring, incident management and business-critical technical infrastructure.
Experience leading across reporting lines and building trust with business and digital stakeholders.
Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.

The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. International travel may be required.

jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Developing and enhancing product software, primarily in Java.
Implementing new features and contributing to the modernisation of existing solutions while ensuring compatibility with previous product versions.
Writing tests and verifying functionality on physical test systems across various computer and system configurations.
Handling customer support cases through analysis and troubleshooting.
Developing software for user interaction and generating executable programs for the system.
Collaborating with colleagues across different technical disciplines to understand problems, identify solutions, and ensure that changes work seamlessly across the entire system.
Contributing ideas and suggestions for improvement as part of an ongoing product development process, driven by customer feedback and technological advancements.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are curious and eager to understand how technology works as a whole. You take initiative, work independently and take ownership of your tasks, from initial analysis through to the delivery of a finished solution. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with others to achieve the best possible results. You are also adaptable, able to adjust when circumstances change, and thrive in a fast-paced development environment.
Furthermore, you have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
At least a few years of experience in software development, working with products that combine both hardware and software.
Good knowledge of Java or experience with another object-oriented programming language, such as C++.
Experience in software development in a Linux environment.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience in user interface development, preferably using frameworks such as React or similar.
Knowledge of agile development methodologies.

Location: Täby

AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.

Outpatient consultations and medical workups.

Care of hospitalized patients in the inpatient ward.

Emergency patients and emergency medicine.

Surgery and perioperative care.

On-call and evening shifts.

More advanced cases based on your competence and experience.

Who Are You?
We believe you are a veterinarian who:

Is a licensed veterinarian with several years of clinical experience.

Is confident in your professional role and able to work independently.

Has experience from multiple areas of small animal practice, such as outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency medicine, and/or surgery.

Enjoys a varied caseload and is motivated to broaden your clinical expertise.

Is confident in making clinical decisions and prioritizing when required.

Has a genuine interest in high-quality patient care and professional communication with pet owners.

Is a team player who enjoys collaborating with skilled and dedicated colleagues.

Is curious and wants to continue developing professionally, whether by deepening expertise in a specific area or maintaining a broad clinical role.

Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Experience in emergency medicine, surgery, or a specialist qualification in canine and feline medicine is considered an advantage.
Why Choose AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital?
At AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital, you will become part of a dedicated and highly competent team where collaboration, job satisfaction, and patient focus are at the heart of everything we do.
We are a well-equipped animal hospital with extensive expertise in areas such as surgery, anaesthesia, emergency care, and advanced diagnostics. This provides excellent opportunities for both variety and continued professional development.
What many of our employees appreciate most is the strong sense of community. Here, we support one another, share knowledge, and work together to provide the best possible care for our patients.
About AniCura Sweden
Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that offers outstanding opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation, and professional development.
With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with operations spanning the entire country and a strong local presence.
Our dedicated teams work together every day to provide the highest standard of care for every patient. Through a culture characterized by collaboration, continuous learning, and medical excellence, you will have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and truly make a difference.

Would you like to bring your dog to work? No problem. We have spacious facilities specifically designated for employees' dogs.
Would You Like to Join Our Team?
If you are an experienced veterinarian who values variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines, we would love to hear from you!

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? On behalf of our client – an innovative and publicly listed telecom pioneer in Kista – Academic Work is looking for an RF Test Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!
About the role
Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.
Develop, maintain, and execute automated RF test sequences and scripts using Python.  
Perform test and verification at module and system levels on proprietary hardware and electronics.  
Set up and operate automated test equipment (ATE) and RF lab instruments, including spectrum analyzers and signal generators.  
Build, commission, and optimize automated test rigs for both laboratory development and factory production.  
Conduct lab-based hardware troubleshooting and analysis down to board and component levels.  
Collaborate closely with software and radio engineers to expand test coverage and streamline test cycles.  
Support external manufacturing partners and travel to production sites (approx. 3–4 weeks/year) to deploy and verify test setups.  
Document test methods, procedures, and test results within Jira and Confluence.

We are looking for
An academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, Applied Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
At least 1 year of documented professional experience in Python programming for automation, scripting, or hardware test control - either from your education or previous work experience.
Practical hands-on experience working with RF test instrumentation (e.g., spectrum analyzers, signal generators) or Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Good technical understanding of cellular standards such as LTE (4G) and 5G NR.
Comfort working in Linux environments and performing hands-on lab work.
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in technical documentation and manufacturing communication.
This position requires that you hold a valid work permit or have the legal right to work in Sweden.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience reading electronic schematics and circuit diagrams.
Knowledge of database management and SQL.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Practical experience with hardware prototyping platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

About BM Showjumping AB
BM Showjumping AB is a professional equestrian business based in Skåne, Sweden, specialising in showjumping horses.
We are seeking an experienced, responsible and highly motivated Yard Manager to oversee the daily running of our equestrian facilities and the management, care and welfare of approximately 10–20 horses.
This is a key position within our business, combining practical horse management, stable operations, staff supervision and the organisation of our competition activities.
We are looking for someone who has substantial experience with competition horses, understands the demands of a professional showjumping environment and can take responsibility for maintaining the highest standards throughout the yard.
Main duties and responsibilities
1. Horse management and welfare
Taking overall responsibility for the daily care and management of 10–20 horses.
Organising feeding, watering, bedding, grooming and general horse care.
Monitoring the health, fitness, condition and welfare of each horse.
Arranging and coordinating veterinary, farrier and other specialist appointments.
Identifying potential health problems and ensuring appropriate action is taken.
Managing horse turnout, stable routines and individual care requirements.

2. Stable and yard management
Managing the day-to-day operation of the stable and equestrian facilities.
Maintaining clean, safe and well-organised stables, paddocks and working areas.
Managing feed, bedding, equipment and other supplies.
Organising daily work schedules and stable routines.
Overseeing routine maintenance and ensuring facilities are maintained to a high standard.

3. Staff supervision and organisation
Supervising and coordinating stable staff.
Allocating daily duties and monitoring the quality of work.
Ensuring staff follow established procedures for horse care and welfare.
Organising workloads around training, competitions and other operational requirements.
Maintaining a positive, professional and productive working environment.

4. Riding and competition preparation
Riding and exercising horses in accordance with their individual training requirements and ability.
Assisting with the preparation of horses for showjumping competitions.
Coordinating competition schedules and transport arrangements.
Ensuring horses are appropriately prepared and cared for before and after competitions.
Understanding the particular needs of competition horses and maintaining their fitness and wellbeing.

5. Administration and business operations
Maintaining daily records relating to horse care, health and stable activities.
Coordinating veterinary and farrier bookings.
Managing stock levels and ordering feed, bedding and supplies.
Assisting with scheduling, planning and general business administration.
Reporting operational issues and contributing to the efficient running of the business.

Experience and qualifications
Applicants must demonstrate:
Significant professional experience working with horses.
Previous experience managing or supervising an equestrian yard or stable.
Strong knowledge of horse health, welfare, feeding and stable management.
Experience with competition horses, preferably showjumping horses.
Practical riding experience and the ability to exercise horses appropriately.
Experience organising staff and managing daily operational responsibilities.
Good organisational, administrative and communication skills.
The ability to work independently and take responsibility for decisions.
A reliable, flexible and hardworking attitude.

A full driving licence is desirable. Experience driving horseboxes and transporting competition horses is an advantage.
Formal equestrian qualifications are desirable, although substantial relevant professional experience will also be considered.
Language requirements
Good spoken and written English is required.

Employment conditions
Full-time employment.
Gross monthly salary of SEK 34,470–38,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
Working hours agreed in the employment contract.
Holiday entitlement in accordance with Swedish legislation.
Employment-related insurance and occupational pension arrangements.
Accommodation may be available by separate agreement.
Working arrangements will reflect the requirements of a professional equestrian business, including reasonable weekend and competition-period responsibilities.

All employment conditions will comply with applicable Swedish employment legislation and the relevant collective agreement or established industry practice.
International applicants
BM Showjumping AB welcomes applications from experienced international candidates, including applicants from outside the EU/EEA who require a Swedish work permit.
The company is prepared to participate in the Swedish Migration Agency's employer-led work-permit application process for a suitable candidate.

Your current country of residence.

Your riding experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:

Job description: Legal Counsel, AB Volvo

jobs.occupation: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
Location:
Uppsala, Sweden
Form of employment:
Indefinite-term employment. We use 6 months probationary employment.
Scope:
100%

As agreed.

Please submit your application before deadline 7 December 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
 
Please include in your application: 
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Letter of intent
Copies of appropriate degree certificates
