RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch, a world leader in the field of software for advanced radiation therapy, is now looking for a Sales Operations Administrator to strengthen our international Sales team.
About the position
In this role, you will play a key part in our Sales organization, supporting efficient and well-structured sales operations across global markets. You will work closely with the sales process by supporting the end-to-end customer licensing lifecycle, helping ensure that our teams have the tools, data, and processes needed to succeed.
You will act as a key point of contact for our organization regarding license issuance, renewals, verifications, and compliance. Your goal is to ensure a smooth, accurate, and customer-focused experience while maintaining adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
As one of our CRM experts, you will be responsible for data integrity within our CRM system and guaranteeing that all licensing documentation remains accurate, complete, and fully compliant. By ensuring accurate insights and reliable system structures, you will support business decisions and contribute to the continued growth of RaySearch.
You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Sales, Service, R&D, and Quality departments in an international and dynamic environment.
Your main tasks:
Process customers’ license applications, renewals, upgrades, transfers, etc., in a timely and accurate manner
Be an expert of the licensing structure and provisioning at RaySearch
Work with data quality, structure and management of data in Salesforce
Follow up and monitor documentation about our customers
Submit information to RaySearch’s global sales network (direct sales and distribution network)

Your profile
To succeed in this role, you have strong communication and administrative skills combined with an analytical and structured mindset. You are a fast learner that understands complex concepts and ideas. You are detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to maintaining high-quality data and documentation.
You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, can manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines. An adaptable team member who readily supports the group through peak periods.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong customer-service orientation.
We would like to see that you have:
Relevant university degree or equivalent education
1-3 years experience in sales support, business operations, or CRM administration
Hands-on proficiency with CRM software platforms, specifically Salesforce
Advanced capabilities in Microsoft Office Suite
Very strong organizational and administrative skills
Excellent written and spoken skills in English and Swedish

Good knowledge in other languages are considered a merit. It is also an advantage (but not required) if you have experience from a software company, medical devices or healthcare industries.
Our Culture 
Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care. 
Our Offer 
At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package. 
Application 
Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

What you know

jobs.occupation: Data Architect - Global Data & Analytics Platform
jobs.description:
About the job
As a Data Architect, you will shape the future architecture of Alfa Laval's Global Data & Analytics Platform. You will work across business domains, source systems, data products and technical teams to create a connected, scalable and governed data landscape. Combining strategic architecture with hands-on data modelling, you will assess the current landscape, define the target architecture and help teams bridge the gap between the current and future states. 
 
Alfa Laval's global data landscape spans research and development, sales, service, operations, supply chain, finance, HR and sustainability, with data distributed across multiple source systems and structures. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise and solution architects, data product teams, developers and platform engineers to establish common standards, models and architectural principles. Your work will make enterprise data easier to find, understand, integrate and reuse, creating a scalable foundation for reporting, analytics, digital products and AI. 
 
Key responsibilities 
Define and drive a coherent data architecture for Alfa Laval's Global Data & Analytics Platform-creating one connected architectural direction across business domains, systems, products and value streams, including ERP, CRM and domain-specific solutions. 
Establish and promote common architectural principles, standards and guardrails for data modelling, governance, integration, interoperability, security, quality, scalability and reuse across the platform. 
Shape the target architecture and roadmap by assessing the current landscape, identifying gaps and dependencies, and defining practical steps towards a unified future state. 
Create and maintain consistent, reusable data models across business domains, supporting common definitions and enabling data to be used across multiple analytics and business use cases. 
Translate business requirements into enterprise-level data architecture, ensuring that data products and platform capabilities align with the overall architecture rather than creating isolated solutions. 
Work hands-on with architects, data engineers and developers to implement data models, integration patterns and shared platform capabilities. 
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to align priorities, explain architectural decisions, resolve trade-offs and build support across organizational boundaries. 
Collaborate with other architects and evaluate technologies to ensure the platform can support future analytics, AI and digital business needs. 

 
Who are you
You are a strategic and hands-on data architect who is comfortable working with ambiguity, navigating complex organizations and making decisions with incomplete information. You are pragmatic and structured, with a focus on implementable outcomes and long-term business value. Rather than creating isolated solutions, you are motivated by building reusable capabilities that can support the organization over time. You are curious and forward-looking, while remaining grounded in practical delivery. 
 
You build strong working relationships with business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable working with people at different levels and in different disciplines. You explain complex architectural topics clearly and practically, facilitate discussions, create alignment across organizational silos, and use communication and influencing skills to drive change. You are collaborative and approachable, while also being prepared to constructively challenge existing assumptions and approaches when this helps create better outcomes across a global, matrixed organization. 
 
What you know
To succeed in this role, you bring strong experience in data architecture and modelling, combined with the technical expertise needed to shape and implement scalable cloud-based data platforms. We believe you have: 
At least five years of experience in data architecture, enterprise data architecture, data platform architecture or a related senior data role. 
Proven experience designing and implementing modern cloud-based data and analytics architectures in enterprise environments, preferably using Microsoft Azure and Azure data services. 
Strong experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including translating business requirements into data architecture and implementable data models. 
Ability to balance platform standardization with domain autonomy, enabling reusable data products while supporting business-specific needs. 
Experience designing data integration, transformation and orchestration solutions, including enterprise integration patterns and cross-system data flows. 
Experience defining target architecture, architectural principles, standards and implementation roadmaps. 
Experience working with enterprise data platforms, data products, including data mesh or similar distributed data concepts. 
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, or similar tools. 
Experience with data governance, access models, data quality, metadata management and data security. 
Experience working across multiple business domains, products or value streams. 
Experience working with both technical delivery teams and senior business stakeholders. 
Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

 
It is considered an advantage if you have: 
Experience working across business domains such as ERP, CRM, supply chain, finance or manufacturing. 
Experience supporting analytics, machine learning or AI use cases. 
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure. 
Experience in a large, global and matrixed organization.

Company Description

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. 
 
Supply Chain Operations organization connects our customers with IKEA products in a simple, affordable, and sustainable way. We deliver excellent transport and logistic solutions today, tomorrow and over time by optimizing replenishment solutions, defining physical goods flow capacity needs, managing the goods flow, sourcing & developing transport & logistics capacities and leading & securing supply quality. 
Do you have a passion for developing business? Do you like handling different types of challenges and topics at the same time with various stakeholders both internal and external in a fast-pacing environment? Then this position might be something for you! 
Job Description

In Category Food Logistics Services, we source, procure, and operate cold chain transportation, warehousing and logistics services for IKEA Food. To support our growing business development agenda, we are currently looking for a Service Provider Operations Developer to join our Category Food Logistics Services Food team located in Älmhult! 
As a Service Provider Operations Developer, you will be responsible to secure and continuously improve our Service Provider's operational performance and maximize the optimization potential related to its operational costs - in close cooperation with business partners and relevant supply chain stakeholders. 
If you love the idea of joining a new business in Inter-IKEA, are not afraid to venture in the unknown and are motivated by co-creation and collaboration with a diverse range of stakeholders, then we would love to get to know you! 
As a Service Operations Developer, you will: 
Secure operational performance of the service provider as well as securing optimal usage of agreed capacity vs. planned/needed capacity 
Actively work with capacity forecasting, identify constraints and find optimal solutions which lead to securing needed capacity at lowest total cost. 
Support tenders & RFQs; contribute with local operational and market knowledge and details of service providers performance and operational capabilities  
Execute the operational tender request like out of tender purchase to secure the full coverage of transport needs for food daily operations. 
Contribute to development of working methods and other steering documents 
Monitor and secure execution of signed contracts and agreed terms & conditions. Perform compliance/spot checks at service providers to verify compliance with given parameters, such as quality of equipment, safety and security, etc. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this position we believe that you are: 
Experienced in working with Logistics or Supply Chain in an international organisation for at least 2 years 
Knowledgeable in specific aspects related to transportation and warehousing and main factors impacting operational performance 
Self-driven and analytical with a love for following up as well as comfortable with engaging and driving through our operational agenda with various stakeholders 
Proficient in working with Excel, including performing analysis and putting together reports 
M3 experience will be a plus experience 
Fluent in English, both verbal and in writing 

 
If you on top of this are inspired by IKEA’s values and our mission to provide a better everyday life for the many people as well as interested in working in one of the most dynamic areas in logistics, we would love to talk to you!  
Additional information

Get ready to assemble something new! We are currently looking for a new Quality Specialist to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 17th of November, 2026. 
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group. 
At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs. At IKEA we’re all on the same project. 
If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

jobs.occupation: Grants Officer for the Africa Region
jobs.description:
About the Tenure Facility
The Tenure Facility is the first and only international financial mechanism exclusively focused on securing land and forest rights for Indigenous Peoples and local communities worldwide. Recognizing and upholding these rights represents one of the most impactful opportunities for fostering sustainable rural development, achieving global climate goals, and mitigating local conflicts in a cost-effective manner.
Through grants and technical assistance, the Tenure Facility empowers Indigenous Peoples and local communities by strengthening their capacity to implement land and forest tenure reforms. Additionally, it supports governments in testing and scaling innovative approaches to land rights recognition, ensuring practical solutions to administrative and legal challenges.
Overview of the Position
The Grants Officer reports to the Chief Operating Officer and forms part of the Operations Team. The Grants Officer plays a key role in the implementation of the Tenure Facility’s grant-making and grant supervision processes. He or she will be responsible for administering the grant processes of the Tenure Facility’s projects and for ensuring that Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and project partners operate within existing policies, guidelines, and procedures.
While the position falls under the Operations Team, given its strong programmatic focus, the Grants Officer is expected to work in close coordination with the Program Officers and the Finance Unit. The position may involve in-country visits to project partners.
Overarching Responsibilities
Contribute to establishing the Tenure Facility as a highly credible and respected foundation among international development institutions and donors.
Generate mutual trust and respect with Indigenous Peoples and local communities and their cultures, with full awareness of the intricacies of relationships among them and their allies and supporters.
Contribute to a collaborative and resilient internal working culture that supports sustained progress toward the Tenure Facility’s strategic goals and objectives.

Specific Responsibilities
The main responsibilities include:
Ensure that data related to grants and grantees in the Project Management System (Roots) is complete and meets Tenure Facility standards.
Work with Program Officers to provide prompt and sensitive responses to all unsolicited requests for funding and record related information.
Track the progress of project preparation, implementation, disbursement, reporting, and closure in Roots, and prepare related reports for management, donors, communications, and other stakeholders.
Coordinate the procurement of consultants and programme-related services, assist in preparing consultant contracts, ensure compliance with foundation regulations, and handle related queries, invoices, and payments.
Draft grant management documents, such as grant agreements, extensions, and amendments, for review by Program Officers and Financial Controllers, and manage related correspondence with grantees.
Review grant concept notes, proposals, risk registers, quality assurance reviews, and grant agreements to ensure they are complete and aligned with Tenure Facility policies.
Ensure the timely submission and approval of grantee reports by tracking and monitoring their status and sending reminders to grantees.
Shepherd grants and contracts through the review and approval process.
Assist with grant payment schedules, disbursements, and monitoring grant balances in coordination with Financial Controllers.
Assist with programme-related travel preparations and ensure reports are created and registered in TF systems.
Train new programme staff on grants and contracts processes and the use of the Project Management System (Roots).
Advise Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and grantees on policies and procedures related to grant management.
Work to enhance and improve grants management processes and increase efficiency.
Undertake special projects as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements
University degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in international development, law, business or public administration, social sciences, natural resource management, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an asset.
Minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in grants management, programme operations or administration, or project management, preferably with a foundation, international NGO, donor agency, or similar organisation.
Experience working with partners in Africa, and with Indigenous Peoples and local communities, is a strong asset.
Experience with grants management or similar information systems; familiarity with NGO Online (DigiPING) is an asset.
Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required.
Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish would be considered an asset.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly, including to project sites and partner organisations in Africa, sometimes in remote locations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multicultural, geographically distributed team, with cultural sensitivity and respect for Indigenous Peoples and local communities.

Terms of Employment
Permanent full-time position, starting 7 January 2027, with a six months' probationary period.
Location: Kungsholmen, Stockholm.
Collective agreement, pension and insurance: Almega Tjänstemannaavtalet.
Salary by agreement.

 
The Tenure Facility promotes a balanced, diverse workforce, a strength that helps us better understand and address our partners' needs, and we continually strive to improve our gender balance.

Nederman - The Clean Air Company  Founded by Philip Nederman in 1944, Nederman is now one of the world's leading companies supplying products and services in the environmental technology sector focusing on industrial air filtration. Our products and solutions are contributing to reducing the environmental effects of industrial processes, creating safe and clean working environments and boosting production efficiency, mainly within industries such as woodworking, metalworking, composite machining, food processing, vehicle service and emergency stations, laboratories and dentists. Nederman's offering encompasses everything from the design stage to installation, commissioning and service. Sales are carried out via sales offices and distributors in over 50 countries and development and production in own manufacturing and assembly units in 12 countries on five continents. Nederman Group, with headquarters in Helsingborg, Sweden is listed on Nasdaq OMX, Stockholm and has about 2500 employees.
Do you want to be the one who sets the direction for automation across an entire product portfolio? At Nederman, you get to work with technical innovation at a high level, in a dynamic team of skilled colleagues, all sharing the same goal - shaping the future of clean air. We do more than product development. We create solutions that truly make an impact, driven by knowledge and passion. 
The global Operational Technology Center (OTC) at Nederman is dedicated to advancing cross-product platform solutions that bridge the gap between traditional industrial equipment and modern digital technologies. Our focus lies in developing new ways of controlling our equipment to improve performance, reduce costs, and reduce their environmental footprint. Data is systematically collected through our fleet of connected devices, aiding our ongoing development initiatives, and delivering valuable insights. Empowered by cutting-edge AI technologies, we seamlessly provide these insights to our customers through user-friendly web and mobile applications. Robust, well-designed automation is the foundation all of this is built on. With a substantial and growing client base, we are committed to a rapid digital expansion.
The objective is to build highly integrated digital platforms to create products and solutions that only Nederman – The Clean Air Company can offer. We are now looking for a Senior Automation Lead to be the organization's primary automation expert and help shape what comes next.
About the roleAs Senior Automation Lead, you will be the technical leader and strategic driver for automation at Nederman's Operational Technology Center (OTC). You will shape the future of our control systems and automation platforms, ensuring robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions across our product portfolio. As the organization's foremost automation expert, you will provide technical direction, establish engineering standards, and guide key architectural decisions. A significant part of your role will be fostering technical excellence within the automation team through mentoring, coaching, and knowledge sharing. You will help build a strong automation capability that supports current product development and future innovation. While your primary focus will be automation and control systems, you will work closely with colleagues in software development, electronics, product management, and other engineering teams to ensure successful integration and alignment across solutions. This is a technical leadership role without formal personnel responsibility based on-site in Helsingborg.
Profile and experience
To be successful in this role you need
At least 8 years of experience in industrial automation, control systems, or Operational Technology, with several years in a senior technical role.
Deep expertise in industrial automation and control systems, including automation architecture, PLC-based control systems, industrial communication, HMI solutions, functional safety, and the development of robust, scalable automation platforms.
Being comfortable making architectural decisions and balancing immediate product needs with long-term technical strategy.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English
Swedish citizenship. The position is security-classified and requires security vetting, including a background check.

Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing engineering direction and working with stakeholders and requirements is highly valued. Experience with Schneider EAE or IEC 61499 is an advantage but not required.
We are looking for someone passionate about automation and engineering excellence. You are curious, pragmatic, and energized by solving challenging technical problems while continuously improving products and ways of working. With a deep technical knowledge and strong collaboration skills, you bring structure, credibility, and a long-term perspective while remaining hands-on when needed. With a natural ability to lead through expertise and influence you truly enjoy developing people, sharing knowledge, and creating an environment where engineers can grow and perform at their best.
Apply today In this recruitment process Nederman collaborates with Mpya Sci & Tech. For questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Recruitment Consultant Christian Billberg on 0731-489 875. We review applications on a rolling basis so do not hesitate to apply via www.mpyascitech.com as soon as possible, as the position may be filled before the final application date.

 Who we are and what we believe in

jobs.occupation: 5G RAN System Engineer / Baseband System Developer
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
TECHLA is now looking for an experienced system profile within 5G RAN/Baseband for an exciting consulting assignment in Gothenburg. This role is a great fit for someone with a strong technical interest in radio systems, communication theory, signal processing and the development of functionality in modern mobile networks.
About the role
In this role, you will work with system development within 5G RAN, focusing on developing, analyzing and improving the performance of baseband-related functionality. The work may include areas such as radio resource management, scheduling, link adaptation, time-critical communication, antenna control and optimization of 5G network performance.
You will work closely with development, design and test teams and be involved throughout the development chain, from early ideas, analysis and specification to implementation, verification and deployment of new features.
Examples of responsibilities:
Design and specification of algorithms within RAN/Baseband
 Systemization and requirements breakdown for new base station features
 Analysis and optimization of 5G network performance
 Work related to radio resources, scheduling, link adaptation and antenna control
 Support to design and test teams throughout the development process
 Analysis of fault reports and technical issues on system level
 Contribute to the development of new features from early concept to customer-facing product environments

We believe you have
Experience from 5G RAN, Baseband or similar telecom systems
 Good understanding of 3GPP-based communication systems, such as 3G, 4G/LTE and 5G NR
 Experience from the lower layers of the protocol stack, such as L1/L2, PHY or MAC
 Knowledge within communication theory, signal processing or radio algorithms
 Experience from system work, algorithm design, technical analysis or performance optimization
 The ability to understand complex technical problems and drive them forward
 Good English skills, both spoken and written

It is meritorious if you have
Previous experience from Ericsson, Combitech or another RAN/Baseband-related environment
 Experience with scheduling, link adaptation, RRM, MIMO, beamforming or antenna control
 Experience with Python, C, MATLAB or similar tools for analysis, simulation or performance evaluation
 A Master of Science or Ph.D. within Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Telecom, Communication Technology or a similar field
 Experience using AI tools in technical development work
 Swedish language skills

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Home cleaners to Freska Nacka! / Hemstädare till Freska Nacka!

Company description:
At Epiroc, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our vision is clear: we aim to accelerate the transformation of mining towards a greener and more sustainable industry. In this role, you’ll get the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art mobile machines, electric drivetrains, and control systems that are moving towards higher degrees of automation and sophistication. 
Job description:Are you ready to shape the future of mining equipment systems in a rapidly evolving industry? Join our dynamic team as a System Engineer and play a crucial role in optimizing the performance, reliability, and efficiency of the complete machine system integrated into our products. 
Join our team 
Our aspiration is to produce the world’s greenest machines using the world’s greenest materials. We are leading the charge towards a more sustainable future through battery-electric, zero-emission mining equipment. Are you ready to be part of this journey? Join our fantastic team of engineers and play a pivotal role in advancing mining technology while pushing boundaries on performance, reliability, and efficiency. 
Your mission 
Your mission as a system engineer is to develop and adapt our machine systems in terms of hardware, system architecture, and functionality to fulfill requirements regarding e.g., performance, availability, and safety. Drive concept development from ideation through requirements decomposition and specification, including trade-off studies, to design, implement, and execute verification and validation of the technical solution, ensuring an efficient and traceable end-to-end development loop. 
You will primarily work in project form with new product development projects, product maintenance, technology development, and customer orders. You will have close contact with other departments in Örebro, for example service, purchasing and marketing, as well as contact with customers and suppliers around the world. Furthermore, you will contribute to the building of modularized solutions, process improvement, and team competence assets. 
Your profile 
You have a university degree in a relevant area. We believe you have professional experience within system engineering or other highly qualified engineering background. You are used to bringing ideas from concept to serial production and are familiar with requirement management tools such as Doors or Polarion or similar. You have proven experience in modularization and systems engineering practices such as MBSE (Model based system engineering), and hands-on experience with Matlab tools and Hopsan. You also have a solid understanding of software, including control systems and system architectures, as well as CAN communication protocols (J1939, CAN Open). Knowledge of software development and electrical systems, and experience with CAD, simulation, and other software tools are considered a plus. 
To enjoy the work you are self-propelled, responsible, and your work is effectively planned to meet deadlines with the right quality. You have a structured and analytical approach, enjoy combining theory and practice, and strive to get the job done to our customers' satisfaction. Furthermore, you have good interpersonal skills, enjoy teamwork, and thrive in a collaborative environment where communication is key. Technical project management experience or R&D leadership experience is a plus. Since your work includes many local and global contacts, it is required that English skills (verbal and written) are fluent and that you understand Swedish. 
Life at Epiroc 
By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be a part of a group of skilled and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. We work in a global environment with 120 different nationalities! 
In addition to the fact that we have a culture that is characterized by development combined with having a good balance between work and leisure, there are some things that makes us a little extra proud to work at Epiroc:   
Global career opportunities, Epiroc University, for your own competence development, Community involvement, benefits package, which amongst other things include flexible working hours and bonus. 
Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility to partly work from home, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual conditions.  
Location and travel 
This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. 
Application and contact 
We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible by creating an account in our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. The last day to apply for this position is November 22nd 2026. 
Hiring manager: Xi Yang, Group Manager R&D,  
For questions about the recruitment process or application please contact recruitment specialist: 
Maria Roseen, +46702590507, maria.x.roseen@external.epiroc.com,  
 
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.description:
Company Description
At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “9 to 5” you, because life is all about balance.

competitive salary packages, collective agreements with unions, occupational pension, and other attractive benefits, such as wellness contribution, smart work, flexible working hours, Gym & Yoga classes at site.
Let’s not forget the sincere “thank you” for our employees’ contribution. Our success is your success. Let’s celebrate together.
At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. Let ‘s strike a balance.
At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.       
Job Description
About the Role
Are you passionate about sustainable technology and modern software engineering? Join our cross-functional team in developing the next generation of energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions. In this role, you will help design, implement, and optimize intelligent control and regulation algorithms for state-of-the-art heat pumps, directly contributing to the global energy transition.

Your contribution
Shape the future: Develop control and regulation functions for our latest heat pumps, actively driving forward innovative algorithms for energy-efficient, resource-saving heating and cooling systems.
Take a holistic approach: Guide software functions throughout their full lifecycle—from requirements gathering and concept simulation through to implementation and verification across multiple testing levels (MIL, SIL, HIL).
Realize model-based software: Design and optimize model-based software functions in Matlab/Simulink for the closed-loop control of thermodynamic and hydraulic systems.
Implement software: Apply modern software development practices and text-based languages (e.g., C/C++), utilizing modern engineering and AI-assisted tools to advance embedded software modules.
Validate & test: Commission and test application software on cutting-edge heat pump test benches, supporting rapid prototyping and real-world system validation.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work in an international, agile environment, collaborating closely with experts across software, electronics, HMI, hydraulics, and thermodynamics.

Qualifications
What You Bring
Education: Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Mechatronics, Control Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical engineering background).
Core Competencies:
Solid foundational understanding of control engineering, mechatronic systems, or thermodynamic processes.
Practical experience in software development—either through model-based development (Matlab/Simulink) or text-based embedded programming (C/C++).
Working familiarity with software testing or simulation concepts (e.g., MIL, SIL, or HIL).
Languages: Working proficiency / business fluency in English (written and spoken).
Mindset: Solution-oriented mindset, strong curiosity for clean energy technologies, and an eagerness to learn and grow within an international team.

Nice to Have
Several years of dedicated industry experience in embedded software or controls engineering.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, or hydraulic systems.
Experience with bus protocols and communication interfaces (e.g., CAN, LIN, Modbus, MQTT).
Familiarity with agile development practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and modern CI/CD tooling (e.g., Git, Jira, Jenkins).

Additional Information
What We Offer
Impactful Mission: Play an active role in decarbonization and sustainable climate technologies.
Flexible Working: Flexible working hours and hybrid work options for an optimal work-life balance.
Continuous Growth: Access to cutting-edge development tools, AI tooling, and tailored technical/language training opportunities.
Collaborative Culture: An open, appreciative, and international team environment with state-of-the-art laboratory and test bench facilities.

Quintus Technologies is looking for a Forwarder to join our logistics team in Västerås.
Here, you will work with international project logistics, coordinating shipments of advanced high-pressure systems to customers around the world. Our equipment often requires carefully planned transport solutions, detailed documentation and close collaboration between several parties.
You will become part of a collaborative logistics team where you have the opportunity to take responsibility, develop your expertise and contribute to successful deliveries worldwide.
About the role
As a Forwarder at Quintus Technologies, you will be responsible for planning and coordinating international shipments, with a particular focus on project logistics and customs-related matters.
You will work closely with project managers, production, purchasing, external freight partners and customs authorities to find suitable transport solutions, ensure compliance with customs regulations and secure efficient, accurate and timely deliveries.
Customs management will be a key focus area of the role, where you will take an active part in developing customs procedures, handling customs-related documentation and staying up to date with international trade regulations.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Requesting, evaluating and comparing transport quotations and selecting suitable freight forwarders.
Preparing and managing shipping documentation, packing lists and product labels.
Handling Letters of Credit (L/C) and ensuring that the required shipping documentation is accurate and complete.
Managing customs documentation, import shipments and relevant import/export requirements.
Maintaining accurate shipping records and updating information in relevant systems.
Coordinating external warehousing and storage solutions when needed.
Taking greater ownership of customs-related matters, proactively developing customs procedures and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

Who are you?
We believe you are someone who enjoys working with logistics and takes pride in making sure that everything is handled correctly.
You are structured, thorough and service-minded, with a natural ability to keep track of details and deadlines. You enjoy coordinating different activities, communicating with people and finding solutions when unexpected challenges arise.
You are comfortable taking responsibility for your work and understand the importance of accuracy, particularly when dealing with international shipping documentation and customs requirements.
As a colleague, you are approachable, collaborative and proactive. You enjoy being part of a team while also having the confidence to work independently.
We believe you have:
Education in logistics, freight forwarding or international trade, preferably from a vocational college, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge of international transportation, shipping documentation and logistics processes.
Good understanding of customs procedures and import/export requirements.
An interest in international trade, transportation and logistics.
Good communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

Experience in freight forwarding, project logistics, Letters of Credit (L/C) or ERP systems is highly valuable.
Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the right mindset, a willingness to learn and the ability to take responsibility for complex logistics activities.
Why join Quintus Technologies?
At Quintus, you will work with logistics that go beyond everyday transportation.
Our advanced high-pressure systems are delivered to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical technology. Each project brings its own requirements, challenges and opportunities to find smart solutions.
You will join a forwarding team of four people and work closely with colleagues across the organization. Here, collaboration and knowledge-sharing are important, and you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in an international environment.
Quintus combines advanced technology and a global customer base with a welcoming, down-to-earth and family-oriented culture.
If you enjoy variety, responsibility and international collaboration, this could be a great next step in your career.
Location
The position is based in Västerås, Sweden.
About Quintus Technologies
Quintus Technologies specializes in the design, manufacturing, installation and support of high-pressure systems for sheet metal forming, advanced materials densification for high-quality industrial components as well as high pressure processing for food and beverage to deactivate the bacteria.
Headquartered in Västerås, Sweden, and represented in 45 countries worldwide. Quintus is the world leader in high-pressure technology, having delivered more than 1,900 systems globally to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical implants.
Learn more about us at: www.quintustechnologies.com (http://www.quintustechnologies.com)

Applications are accepted until November 15 and can be submitted at www.norenlindholm.se (http://www.norenlindholm.se) or by clicking the button below. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to send in your application.
We look forward to receiving your application!
All applications will be treated confidentially.

jobs.occupation: Software Developer  Cloud & Backend  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy building cloud solutions that have a real connection to physical products? Are you a backend developer who likes taking ownership beyond writing code, from shaping a solution to running it in production?
You will join Common Services, a distributed team with members in Sweden and India. We are part of Digital Solutions, around 110 colleagues who develop and operate the digital services that accompany Husqvarna’s physical products. Together, we build and maintain the shared services and platforms used across Husqvarna’s digital ecosystem.
We work with end-to-end ownership: we build it, we run it. That means you will be involved not only in development, but also in how our solutions perform and evolve over time.
Role Description
Every connected Husqvarna product runs software that must be released, traced and updated throughout its lifetime. Your main focus will be Embedded Software Lifecycle Management (ESLM, the system that gets the right software to the right products, safely and at scale. In this role, you will:
-         Develop and maintain backend and cloud-based services.
-         Build and run the services that release software and firmware to connected products.
-         Build and maintain tools that help developers troubleshoot connected products.
-         Work closely with colleagues to understand needs, gather requirements and turn them into scalable solutions.
-         Contribute to technical decisions and help shape future solutions and roadmaps. as ESLM grows in scope.
-         Take ownership of what you build throughout its lifecycle.
You don’t need to know everything from day one. You will have the opportunity to grow your knowledge within DevOps, connectivity and IoT, including areas such as Device Shadow, LwM2M and device configuration. Our technology landscape includes: 
 TypeScript/JavaScript • Node.js • AWS • REST APIs • CI/CD • React • Java 
On AWS, we work with services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS/MySQL, SSM Parameter Store and CloudFormation. Our solutions are built on cloud-native principles using serverless technologies and containers.
Your profile
You enjoy working together with others while taking ownership of your work. You are curious, pragmatic and keen to learn, and you care about building solutions that are reliable and useful. Just as importantly, you are happy to share what you know and learn from the people around you.
We believe you have at least 2 years of professional software development experience and a strong interest in backend and cloud development. We would especially like to see experience with:
-         Backend development using TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js.
-         REST APIs and event-driven applications.
-         AWS and cloud-native development.
-         CI/CD and modern development practices.
-         Working with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
-         Professional communication in English, as you will work in an international environment.
Experience with Java, React, AI-assisted development tools, embedded software, IoT or messaging technologies such as AMQP and queues is a plus, but not a requirement.
Location
 Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
Your application
 Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:
Hiring Manager: Magnus Sannerud, magnus.sannerud@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.
Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.
Winning Through Culture 
 We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities. 
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on. 
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 
Learn more about our culture here.

Summary: The Pharmacovigilance Specialist for the Nordics is responsible for: in collaboration with the Pharmacovigilance Manager, to maintain an efficient local Pharmacovigilance system in the Nordic countries meeting the European and national regulations and in compliance with the Baxter Pharmacovigilance procedures. To ensure appropriate contacts with the other organizations not limited to country Regulatory Affairs, Country Quality Assurance, Business Units and with HCP and Competent authorities (MPA, FIMEA, DMA, NOMA, IMA). To work closely with the PV team based in UK according to the cluster model.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, or a related healthcare/pharmaceutical role.
Fluent in Danish, Swedish, and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a regulated environment.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

Full list of responsibilities
The PV Specialist is accountable and responsible for the following activities:

1. ADR Reporting:
·To collect, document, follow-up all local AEs and other pharmacovigilance information (e.g. pregnancy, medication error, lack of efficacy) from all sources according to SOPs
·To transmit all reports to GPS (Global Patient Safety) in a timely manner
·To make all efforts to answer the queries of the GPS organization and to use the specific follow-up questionnaires
·To answer the safety questions from the Health Care Professionals with the support of the cluster PV Manager, PV Director and the GPS organization, and Medical affairs if necessary
·To close and archive ADR reports according to SOPs

2. Clinical trials activities:
·If stated in the protocol, to process the SAEs and transmit them to the GPS according to SOPs.
3. Audits and inspections
·To act as local PV representative during inspections and audits, actively participating to the inspection/audit during interview sessions and providing document requests
·In coordination with the cluster PV Manager, EU-QPPV office and GPS, to investigate and provide/ support responses to inspection and audit findings, and implement Corrective and
Preventive actions
4. Agreements with third parties
·To collaborate with agreement owners, country QA and with the EMEA PV agreements team to ensure that any relevant Agreement with Third Party include appropriate PV clause or full SDEA
·To support the EMEA PV Agreement team in the implementation of local PSPs/MRPs, in collaboration with the initiator
·To notify safety signals to third party (distributor or PV supplier) in country/cluster as per procedure
·To perform reconciliation of Adverse Events with third party/PV Service Supplier
5. Other local PV activities
·To be involved in the communication on PV topics with national Competent Authorities, and supports answers preparation in cooperation with cluster PV Manager, GPS and Eu QPPV
·To perform surveillance activities for any new potential safety information (e.g. similar AEs reported in a cluster of reports or multiple cases for one batch received in a short time frame) and escalate as per procedures
·To alert the cluster PV Manager about any safety related issues without delay
·To prepare highlights as needed and represent PV at Nordic Quality Review Meeting (QMR)
·To be aware of required local risk minimization activities
·To perform local literature review, including assessment of local journals for screening, as described in SOP
·According to the process established at EU level, to validate the comparative table prepared by RA to put CCDS/CCSI/RSI and the local SPC in conformity
6. Regulatory intelligence
·Local regulatory intelligence: To regularly screen the websites of Competent Authorities in The Nordic countries for safety signals, Pharmacovigilance newsletters, regulations, etc
·To inform Pharmacovigilance Manager, EU QPPV and GPS on relevant changes concerning National regulations
7. Training:
·To perform trainings as required and keep up to date personal training records.
·To provide appropriate training on PV to new employees, partners and vendors
·To keep up to date records of the internal Pharmacovigilance trainings made to Baxter employees, partners or vendors
·To assist in onboarding and training of new team members
8. Procedures:
·To create, issue, implement and update local Pharmacovigilance related procedures as needed, in collaboration with the cluster PV team and Manager.
·To implement global Pharmacovigilance SOPs.
9. Compliance:
·To closely monitor local compliance and ensure all efforts are made to achieve high compliance rates.
·To open process errors according to SOPs and help in the resolution of noncompliance Reports
10. Activities related to associated countries in the Cluster:
·To collaborate closely with the UK Team members on above activities and provide any relevant information or support according to the cluster model

Opportunities to contribute to high-impact research.
Exposure to a wide range of complex cases at a world-class teaching hospital
A collaborative and innovative learning environment
Competitive salary – approx. €4500/month plus compensation for late surgeries

About the Fellowship
Karolinska University Hospital, one of the world’s leading medical centers, ranked 4th best hospital globally and 13th in terms of innovation, is offering an exciting Microsurgery Fellowship. Our department is renowned for cutting-edge work and innovation in reconstructive microsurgery, with a strong commitment to excellence in patient care, research, and education.
Our department performs microsurgical reconstructions for a broad spectrum of patients, including those with cancer, trauma, and transgender individuals. We perform 120–150 free tissue transfers annually and a large number of pedicled flaps every week. Our work is carried out in close collaboration with several medical disciplines at both a Level 1 trauma center and a comprehensive cancer center, with regular multidisciplinary conferences
This fellowship provides advanced training in a wide range of reconstructive microsurgical procedures, including but not limited to:
Free flap reconstruction for head and neck reconstruction
Breast reconstruction
Trauma-related reconstructive surgery
Sarcoma reconstruction
Advanced burn reconstruction
Gender-affirming surgery – phalloplasty
Lymphatic microsurgery

As a fellow, you will work closely with our expert surgeons, gaining hands-on experience in both elective and emergency microsurgical procedures. You will be involved in all aspects of patient care, from preoperative planning to postoperative management. The fellowship also includes opportunities for clinical research.
Number of fellowships offered: 2 with separate starting dates
Planned start of fellowship: Mid-August/early September 2027, or March 2028
Duration: 6 months
Key Responsibilities
Assist and actively participate in advanced microsurgical procedures under supervision
Participate in preoperative and postoperative patient care
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including surgeons, oncologists, and radiologists
Conduct research and contribute to ongoing clinical studies in microsurgery
Present cases and participate in weekly departmental meetings and seminars
Contribute to the training of plastic surgery residents and those rotating from other fields.

Requirements
Board certification or eligibility in Plastic Surgery (or equivalent)
Experience in microsurgery is preferred; however, training will be provided. Please include a description of your microsurgical experience
Documented interest in education, such as mentoring younger colleagues or medical students
Strong interest in both academic and clinical work
Fluency in English (Swedish is an advantage but not required)

How to apply
Interested candidates should submit the following:
A detailed CV
A personal statement outlining your interest in microsurgery and career goals
Two letters of recommendation from academic or clinical mentors

Bring your life
Do you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and using simulations to influence product development before physical testing begins?
At Thule, we develop products that inspire an active life. In this role, you will use advanced structural simulations to help shape product design, improve performance, and ensure our products meet high standards of safety, quality, and durability. 
If you are motivated by combining engineering expertise with analytical problem-solving in a collaborative product development environment, this could be the opportunity for you.
 
What you'll do at Thule
As a Structural Analyst, you will work closely with engineers and project teams throughout the product development process. Through advanced structural simulations, you will help build knowledge around product behaviour and provide insights that support engineering decisions from concept through verification.
A key part of the role is promoting a simulation-driven development approach. By generating early insights into product performance, you will help teams optimize designs, reduce development risks, and make informed decisions before physical testing begins.
You will take ownership of the simulation strategy for assigned projects, planning and executing simulation activities in line with project objectives and timelines. You will follow up on simulation results and compare them with physical verification and validation testing to continuously improve the correlation between virtual and real-world performance.
You will also contribute to the development and continuous improvement of our simulation environment, helping strengthen simulation capabilities, methods, and ways of working across the organization.
 
What you bring
To be successful in this role, we believe you have experience working with structural analysis, simulation, or engineering calculations within product development. You are comfortable translating technical data into actionable insights and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges through a structured and analytical approach.
You have a solid understanding of engineering principles, simulation methodologies, and product development processes. Experience working with LS-DYNA and ANSA is highly valued, as these tools are key parts of our simulation environment. Experience with verification and validation activities, including the relationship between virtual and physical testing, is also an advantage.
As a person, you are self-driven, proactive, and collaborative, with a strong ability to take initiative and move work forward. You communicate technical insights effectively, enjoy working across functions, and are motivated by solving complex challenges, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. To succeed in this role, you are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Why you should join Thule
At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business.
We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun.
 
Hiring Process
Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on Thule Career Site. Last day for applying is November 15, 2026.
Please make sure not to wait until the last application date to show your interest, as interviews are held continuously throughout the process and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail.
For questions, please contact the Talent Acquisition Partner responsible, Oscar Persson, at oscar.persson@thule.com.
We look forward to hearing from you!
Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto Bring your life — and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability — we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories Sport & Cargo Carriers (roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car), Active with Kids & Dogs (car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport), RV Products (awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and Bags & Mounts (backpacks, luggage and performance mounts).
Thule Group has about 3,000 employees at nine production facilities and 35 sales offices worldwide. The Group’s products are sold in 138 markets and in 2025, sales amounted to SEK 10,4 billion.
www.thulegroup.com

Help Shape the Future of Sustainable Ingredients

At Lantmännen Biorefineries, we develop sustainable ingredients from oats, wheat, and peas that help shape the future of food and biobased solutions. As a Product Developer, you will lead product and process innovation projects across our portfolio of grain- and pulse-based ingredients. From laboratory and pilot trials to full-scale production, you will apply your technical expertise to develop products, optimize processes, and bring new solutions to market. This position is based in either Lidköping or Kimstad.

This is what you will do

You will drive the development of new food ingredient products and contribute to process improvements through hands-on experimentation, data-driven decision-making, and close collaboration across the organization.

Your responsibilities include:

Leading product and process development projects from ideation to industrial implementation.
Developing and optimizing products and process technologies to improve quality, efficiency, sustainability, and business value of the ingredients.
Designing, planning, and conducting laboratory, pilot-scale, and production-scale trials.
Establishing, conducting, and training sensory panels to support product evaluation and development.
Analyzing technical data and translating findings into recommendations and actionable decisions.
Supporting the scale-up and industrialization of new products and process innovations.
Creating and maintaining product specifications, technical documentation and development reports.
Building expert knowledge in assigned products, raw materials and processing technologies.
Identifying and evaluating new technologies, raw materials, and innovation opportunities.
Collaborating with suppliers, research institutes, universities, and other external partners to strengthen our innovation capabilities.
Presenting project results, recommendations, and business cases to stakeholders and management.
Ensuring compliance with food safety, quality, regulatory, and sustainability requirements.

This is what you need to succeed

You have:

Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Process Engineering, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in product and process development within food ingredients, ingredient manufacturing, starch and grain processing, or a related industry.
Experience leading R&D projects, planning development activities, and driving projects from concept to implementation.
Strong understanding of process technology, manufacturing operations, and scale-up from laboratory to industrial production.
Experience designing and conducting sensory evaluations.
Strong analytical skills and experience interpreting technical and experimental data.
Knowledge of quality systems and regulatory requirements.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in English. Swedish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

You are:

You combine strong technical expertise with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement. Curious and analytical by nature, you enjoy understanding how raw materials, products, and manufacturing processes interact to create value. You thrive on solving complex challenges and can balance scientific rigor with practical execution. Whether working in the laboratory, pilot plant, production environment, or project team, you take a structured approach and maintain a clear focus on delivering results. You are collaborative and confident working across functions and disciplines. You build strong relationships, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and drive projects forward through expertise, influence, and teamwork.

What we offer you

At Lantmännen, sustainability, innovation, and long-term thinking are at the heart of everything we do. We offer the opportunity to work with industry-leading grain- and pulse-based ingredients, contribute to the future of food and biobased solutions, and grow within an international group that continuously invests in innovation, technology, and people development.

Together, we reimagine the world of grain. That is how we make it matter, from field to fork.

Sounds interesting?

We hope so! You can apply for the position online by attaching your CV or LinkedIn profile. To ensure a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we ask you to answer a number of screening questions as part of your application instead of submitting a cover letter.

The recruitment process includes assessments and competency-based interviews. For the final candidate, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted.

This position is based in either Lidköping or Kimstad.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Lantmännen is an agricultural cooperative and Northern Europe’s leader in agriculture, bioenergy and food products. Owned by 17,000 Swedish farmers, Lantmännen has more than 10,000 employees, operations in over 20 countries and an annual turnover of SEK 60 billion. With grain at the heart of the operations, Lantmännen refine arable land resources to make farming thrive. Some of Lantmännen’s best-known food brands are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, GoGreen, FINN CRISP, Schulstad and Vaasan. The company is founded on the knowledge and values acquired through generations of farmers. By engaging in research, development and operations throughout the value chain, Lantmännen takes responsibility from field to fork.

Lantmännen Biorefineries is the only large scale producer and supplier of grain-based fuel ethanol in Sweden and is owned by Lantmännen. The company offers attractive, profitable and sustainable protein, ethanol and carbon dioxide products that are produc

What we do
We are passionate believers in the power of education to transform people’s lives. We help students finding, applying to and enrolling in the right study program. Our multi-sided platforms help over 100 million prospective students every year find their ideal match among thousands of partner institutions, across a global network of hundreds of student websites.
It is a complicated and diverse problem space. We work hard to understand the needs of each student and each institution, and use technology and data to recommend the best matches for both.

About the role
Our Data & Insights squad builds the data products that Keystone runs on. These include analytics and reporting tools that help education providers measure and improve their recruitment performance, a shared data platform and business KPIs for leadership, and AI-supported tools for creating and publishing program and institution content.
You will decide what that engineering team builds and in which order. You will turn the strategic direction set by management into a roadmap the squad can deliver.
The role starts as Product Owner and is designed to grow. The aim is for you to become a full Product Manager from around month 9, owning a product area outright.
What you will do
Own one prioritised backlog across all Data & Insights products, refined weekly with the Engineering Manager and readable by anyone.
Take each product owner’s outcomes into quarterly planning and leave with a plan the engineering team has sized and agreed.
Decide on priority conflicts between stakeholders during the quarter and keep a decision log with the reason and owner for every pause, trade-off and change.
Write clear acceptance criteria for every epic and decide whether delivered work meets them. Communicate releases to stakeholders.
Manage product risks, such as scope, priority and dependencies on other business areas, and make priority decisions on blockers quickly.
Run a regular sync with the product owners that ends with the order of work written down.
Keep the squad’s roadmap and OKRs up to date and visible to leadership.
Track adoption, usage and performance of the data products, and iterate based on what you learn.
Gather feedback from customers and internal users to shape what comes next.

What success looks like
First 30 days
The backlog is in one place and ordered, and you take part in the squad ceremonies to keep work moving forward.

By month 6
The squad hits its delivery targets, with most work delivered on time against the quarterly plan and little scope change after it is locked.
You write the squad’s quarterly objectives rather than collecting them.

From month 9
You own adoption and outcome metrics for at least one product, likely the shared data platform.
You step into the Product Manager role for that area.

What you bring
2+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or similar, working daily with engineers on a shared backlog.
Data literacy: you can write a SQL query, read a web analytics or data warehouse result, and tell when a metric looks wrong.
Experience serving several stakeholders who each believe they come first and saying no to some of them in a way they accept.
A structured, precise way of writing requirements and prioritising.
Strong communication skills: you manage stakeholders with confidence, and you can talk to developers and translate business needs into clear technical requirements, and technical trade-offs back into plain language for the business.
Clear written and spoken English. Most decisions here travel by Jira, Confluence and email.

It is a plus if you have a background in B2B data products, analytics tools or edtech, experience with dashboarding tools (for example Looker, Tableau or Power BI), experience with CRM migrations, or familiarity with AI-based content tools.
Where you will work
This is a hybrid role in Stockholm or Sheffield. Hybrid means you work from home and from the office every week, and we expect you to be in the office at least two days per week.
Why join us?
Take ownership of data products that directly impact customers and internal teams.
A clear path from Product Owner to Product Manager.
Work in a small, focused team with high visibility and responsibility.
Join a mission-driven, international company with hybrid working.

What is the team like?
You will be part of the Product team, working day to day with our in-house engineering team, within a larger product and tech team of 20+ engineers, product managers and designers from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
Collaborative, ambitious and driven best describes us. You will join a strong team with great chemistry, who are passionate about what they do and always go the extra mile. Read more about us at https://www.keg.com/

By combining data-driven strategic support with hands-on project execution, you will help turn business needs into scalable digital and operational improvements, supporting compliance with future emissions legislation while improving customer uptime and sustainability.

 Translate needs, requirements, or findings into actionable improvements and deliverables.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams and a wide range of stakeholders.
