jobs.occupation: Wist Last & Buss i Kiruna söker Tekniker
jobs.description:
Efterfrågan från våra kunder ökar och vi behöver stärka upp vårt team med fler medarbetare. Vi söker därför tekniker till vår anläggning i Kiruna! 
Vi är en flexibel och okomplicerad arbetsgivare som månar om din trygghet, utveckling och kan erbjuda varierande arbetstider utifrån vad som passar dig samt eventuellt boende. I över 90 år har vi säkerställt bästa möjliga service till våra kunder. 
Som tekniker hos oss arbetar du med allt från service till kvalificerade felsökningar, diagnos samt reparation på Volvo Lastbilar och släpfordon. Vi söker dig som har ett intresse för fordon! Kanske har du arbetat som mekaniker tidigare eller har ett stort intresse för att skruva i fordon på fritiden? Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och din vilja att utvecklas.
Vad kan vi på Wist Last & Buss erbjuda dig?
Wist Last & Buss ingår i AB Persson Invest som är en familjeägd koncern med anor från 1932. Alla vi som arbetar inom koncernen Persson Invest får vid goda resultat i koncernen ta del av vinsten genom vår vinstandelsstiftelse Årsringen. Vi har också möjlighet att hyra en nyproducerad lägenhet i Åre och en stuga i Hemavan. Utöver detta har vi självklart tjänstepension, personalvårdsförmåner och rabatter hos våra egna bolag. Bli en av oss du också!
Anställning
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning. Kontakta oss gärna så resonerar vi om hur din framtid hos oss på Wist skulle kunna se ut. Kontakta vår Servicemarknadschef Hans Ranta på telefonnummer 0980-39 84 52 eller via hans.ranta@wistlastbuss.com 
Vi genomför bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidat.
Välkommen till oss på Wist Last & Buss!Vi ser fram emot att tillsammans med dig fortsätta att utveckla Nordens största fristående återförsäljare av Volvo lastbilar och bussar.
 
In English:
The demand from our customers is increasing, and we need to strengthen our team with more employees. We are therefore looking for technicians for our facility in Kiruna!
We are a flexible and uncomplicated employer who cares about your security and development, and we can offer varying working hours based on what suits you, as well as potential accommodation. For over 90 years, we have ensured the best possible service for our customers.
As a technician with us, you will work with everything from service to qualified troubleshooting, diagnostics, and repair on Volvo Trucks and trailers. We are looking for someone with an interest in vehicles! Perhaps you have worked as a mechanic before or have a strong interest in working on vehicles in your spare time? We place great importance on personal qualities and your willingness to develop.
What can we at Wist Last & Buss offer you?
Wist Last & Buss is part of AB Persson Invest, a family-owned group with roots dating back to 1932. All of us who work within the Persson Invest group get to share in the profits through our profit-sharing foundation Årsringen, based on good results within the group. We also have the opportunity to rent a newly built apartment in Åre and a cabin in Hemavan. In addition, we of course offer occupational pension, employee benefits, and discounts with our own companies. Become one of us too!
Employment
The position is a permanent employment. Feel free to contact us, and we can discuss what your future with us at Wist could look like. Contact our Service Manager Hans Ranta at phone number 0980-39 84 52 or via hans.ranta@wistlastbuss.com.
We conduct a background check on the final candidate
Welcome to us at Wist Last & Buss! We look forward to continuing to develop the largest independent Volvo truck and bus dealer in the Nordic region, together with you.
Wist strävar efter jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.
Wist Last & Buss är Nordens största fristående återförsäljare av Volvo lastbilar och bussar och består av två bolag. Wist Last & Buss AB i Sverige med 20 anläggningar från Kiruna i norr till Köping i söder och Wist Last & Buss AS i Norge med 14 anläggningar från Mo i Rana i norr till Volda i söder. Bolagen omsätter ca 3,8 miljarder kronor och har ca 660 medarbetare. Från årsskiftet 2025 presenterar vi även Volvo och Renault lastbilar och bussar på sju anläggningar i Finland genom bolaget Wetteri Power OY. Wist Last & Buss ingår i AB Persson Invest som är en familjeägd koncern med anor från 1932 med verksamheter inom bilhandel, träförädling, skogs- och fastighetsförvaltning samt förnybar energi. Koncernen har sitt säte i Östersund och omsätter cirka 8,4 miljarder och har cirka 1 500 medarbetare. För mer information se www.perssoninvest.se och www.wistlastbuss.se.

A Snapshot of Your Day
You will be part of an open-minded team of 19 engineers where cooperation, supporting and developing each other, is a matter of course. As we have a lot of interfaces, you will have many contacts both internally and externally. There are great opportunities to delve into pipe design and / or calculation or to choose to become good at a more general level and perhaps in the future take on a role as a coordinating resource for other pipe design / calculation resources in our development projects.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Design pipe systems and produce manufacturing data in NX, as well as associated technical documentation
Participate in development and maintenance work / projects regarding product standards, technical solutions and functions and contribute to the technical solutions being / becoming cost-effective and quality assured
Collaborate with procurement and sub suppliers to develop good technical solutions, solve generic issues including root cause analyzes, finalize/update technical documentation
Responsible for installation questions in our order projects by working in the 3D tool NX
Together with the entire project team, make sure to carry out the design work according to the current schedule.
Create, review and update investigations / documentation within your technical area.
You will have a large network of contacts throughout the organization
Collaborate with the customer order department and sales department within your technical area.

What You Bring
MSc or BSc in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent knowledge or experience.
Good knowledge in common norms and standards applicable for process and mechanical engineering and design, specifically PED and ASME.
Experience in pipe design as well as performing and evaluating piping stress calculations is meritorious.
Good English language skills are required. Swedish language skills are meritorious.
You thrive in a changing environment with many challenges and like to work in a multicultural environment
You have a strong interest in technology and learn new things.
You have a very good ability to work in a team, you are structured, driven, take initiative and can prioritize and organize your work in an effective way.
You try to find solutions and feel an ownership of your tasks

About the Team
The team you will be part of consists of 19 people from all around the world and different backgrounds. We strive to support each other and build a strong technical knowledge within the team. There is always someone to discuss solutions and ideas with within the team before presenting the final scope. An internal mentorship program is set up to take care of new team members.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 305673 not later than 2026-11-12
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.
We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Engineer - Test Facilities, Automation & Electrical Systems
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Maintenance Engineer – Test Facilities, Automation & Electrical Systems
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Maintenance Engineer for a challenging consulting assignment with an internationally renowned client in advanced engineering, testing, and research & development.
Are you passionate about maintenance engineering, electrical systems, automation, and troubleshooting complex technical equipment? This opportunity allows you to take responsibility for the reliability and performance of advanced test facilities used for research, development, testing, and verification.
We’re looking for a technically strong professional who can combine hands-on maintenance expertise with maintenance planning, continuous improvement, supplier coordination, and lifecycle management of equipment.
🎯 About the Role
As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will plan, coordinate, and improve preventive and corrective maintenance across a variety of systems within an advanced R&D test facility containing multiple test cells.
You will work with electrical and automation equipment, test rigs, measurement systems, and supporting infrastructure. In addition to daily maintenance activities, you will contribute to larger technical projects, develop maintenance procedures, coordinate external service providers, and support cost optimization and equipment reliability.
This is a senior role that requires independent problem-solving, technical judgement, and the ability to manage complex maintenance activities with limited supervision.
🔧 Key Responsibilities
Plan and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance across test facility equipment and systems.
Troubleshoot faults and perform maintenance activities on technical equipment used in testing and verification.
Maintain and improve the reliability, availability, and performance of test infrastructure.
Develop, review, and maintain maintenance procedures, routines, and work instructions within the maintenance management system.
Coordinate maintenance activities involving dynamometer systems, drive systems, battery simulators, PLCs, conditioning systems, camera systems, automation I/O systems, and test measurement equipment.
Participate in larger engineering projects, equipment upgrades, and facility modification projects.
Manage technical documentation, equipment calibration, data collection, and lifecycle analysis of electrical equipment.
Read and interpret flow diagrams, electrical drawings, technical manuals, and equipment documentation.
Plan and coordinate external service personnel and subcontractors.
Manage spare-parts requirements, service contracts, and maintenance-related purchasing.
Contribute to maintenance budgets, cost optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities.
Support equipment selection and technical evaluations when new equipment or systems are required.
Coach and support colleagues and contribute to the development of maintenance practices and technical competence.

✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Typically more than 5 years of relevant maintenance engineering experience.
Experience planning, coordinating, monitoring, and improving maintenance operations.
Practical experience using maintenance management software or maintenance systems.
Strong technical understanding of electrical equipment, automation systems, and industrial or test facility infrastructure.
Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, flow diagrams, equipment manuals, and technical specifications.
Experience with troubleshooting, fault analysis, preventive maintenance, and corrective maintenance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a hands-on approach to technical challenges.
Ability to coordinate service providers, manage maintenance activities, and work independently.
Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

⭐ Meritorious Experience
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be an advantage:
Maintenance and troubleshooting of equipment in test facilities, laboratories, or R&D environments.
Maintenance of production equipment or other technically complex industrial installations.
Dynamometer systems, test rigs, battery simulators, drive systems, or electrical test equipment.
PLC-based automation, instrumentation, measurement systems, and test infrastructure.
Equipment calibration, lifecycle analysis, and technical documentation.
Maintenance planning, service contract management, spare-parts optimization, and budget follow-up.
Participation in equipment installation, upgrades, or facility modification projects.

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You are a structured and proactive maintenance engineer who enjoys investigating technical problems and finding reliable, cost-effective solutions.
You combine a strong interest in technology with practical maintenance experience and an understanding of how equipment reliability affects testing, development, and production activities.
You are comfortable taking ownership of complex maintenance tasks, coordinating external service providers, and improving established procedures. You also communicate effectively, collaborate with different technical teams, and take a continuous-improvement approach to your work.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?

As an Investment Associate at H&M Group's New Growth & Ventures, you will help identify, evaluate, and support investments in the companies shaping the future of fashion and customer experience. You will work across the full investment lifecycle, from sourcing and due diligence to portfolio support, combining rigorous financial analysis with an outward-facing, relationship-driven approach.
This role has two equally important sides. Out in the ecosystem, you will have a visible and active presence at startup events, industry meetups and gatherings across the world, building relationships with founders and investors and turning new connections into promising leads. At your desk, you will dig into company financials, analyze market trends, build models, and turn complex information into clear investment recommendations.
Key responsibilities include:
Analyze company financials, business models, and unit economics to assess investment opportunities
Build financial models and valuations, and support due diligence processes through reviewing and analyzing investment documentation and agreements
Prepare investment recommendations, business cases, and presentations for investment committee meetings
Represent New Growth & Ventures at startup events, conferences and industry gatherings both in Sweden and globally
Build and maintain a strong network of founders, investors, accelerators, and industry stakeholders
Proactively source new investment opportunities and manage a pipeline of leads

You are just as comfortable working through a set of financial statements as you are walking into a room full of new people. jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Have you been considering a career change but have not yet found the right opportunity?
Are you looking for a position where you can work across a broad range of surgery, take responsibility, and at the same time enjoy a healthy work-life balance? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery to join a smaller acute care hospital located on a Nordic island in a unique setting. Here, you will have the opportunity to work broadly within surgery and become an important part of a close-knit clinical team.

The surgical department offers a broad scope of practice and is not divided into narrow subspecialty sections. This means you will work with a varied patient population and have the opportunity to use a wide range of your surgical skills.
The work includes gastrointestinal surgery, gallbladder and hernia surgery, colorectal surgery, proctology, endoscopy and acute surgery. Both open and laparoscopic surgery are performed.
Endoscopy is a natural part of the surgical practice and includes both gastroscopy and colonoscopy.
Working at a smaller acute care hospital means that the working day can vary considerably. You should therefore enjoy a broad surgical role and feel confident assessing and managing a range of surgical conditions.
Close collaboration and a supportive team
As a surgeon, you will become an important part of a smaller team where colleagues work closely together and support one another. Collegial support and guidance are available when needed.
We are not looking for someone who is expected to know everything. What matters is that you have broad surgical competence, sound clinical judgement, and the confidence to recognise when you may need support or wish to further develop your skills in a particular area.
The smaller hospital setting also gives you the opportunity to contribute your experience and play an active role in the continued development of the department.
Work-life balance
The position is located in a unique Nordic island environment, surrounded by the sea, archipelago and nature. It offers an attractive alternative for those seeking a different lifestyle from what is often associated with working at a large regional or university hospital.
For those who value both a professionally rewarding career and time for family, leisure and recovery, the location offers an attractive combination.
Qualifications
We are looking for a specialist who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has broad surgical competence and experience
Has experience in gastrointestinal and acute surgery
Has experience in endoscopy, particularly gastroscopy
Is comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Has good collaboration skills and a patient-centred approach
Is flexible and appreciates the variety that comes with working at a smaller acute care hospital
Has good English language skills
Has a strong motivation to learn Swedish. Language training is provided.

Experience in additional areas of surgery is considered an advantage.
Who are you?
You are a Specialist in General Surgery who appreciates the breadth of the specialty and enjoys working in a smaller clinical environment where collaboration, flexibility and responsibility are a natural part of everyday work.
You are confident in your professional role, collaborative and open-minded. You value being part of a close-knit team where colleagues support one another and where your experience and expertise can make a meaningful contribution to both the department and its patients.

OFCI Manager - Data Center Projects
📍 Location: Stockholm, Sweden
🏢 Department: PMO (Project Management Office)
🚀 Experience Level: Intermediate to Senior
We're looking for an OFCI Manager to join our PMO team in Stockholm and play a central role in delivering large-scale data center projects across Sweden.
In this role, you'll lead the planning, coordination, and installation readiness of Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment, ensuring critical infrastructure is delivered and installed safely, efficiently, and on schedule. Working closely with clients, suppliers, logistics partners, and construction teams, you'll help drive successful project delivery from procurement through commissioning and handover.
This position is based in Stockholm, with occasional travel to project sites as required.
What You'll Do
As OFCI Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that owner-supplied equipment arrives where it needs to be, when it needs to be there, and is ready for installation without impacting project delivery.
Your responsibilities will include:
Owning and maintaining the OFCI schedule, aligning equipment deliveries with construction, commissioning, and handover milestones
 

Coordinating between client procurement teams, equipment vendors, logistics partners, and installation contractors
 

Managing the OFCI register, including purchase orders, lead times, delivery schedules, storage plans, and installation status
 

Planning equipment receiving, inspections, and damage/shortage reporting processes
 

Defining installation scopes and managing interfaces between owners, suppliers, and contractors

TL;DR: Most companies treat documentation as a help centre. At Lovable it's part of the product. Millions of people learn to build software from our docs, and so do the AI agents working for them: the Lovable agent suggests pages, coding tools read them, and our assistants answer from them. You'll be our second technical writer, with product areas of your own from the start and a seat at every launch, and you'll help work out something nobody has fully worked out yet: what documentation should be when its readers are people and agents, and the product changes every day.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.
We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
You've spent 3+ years documenting software products, and you can show us pages that get a reader to the outcome without re-reading.
You already write with AI: for research, drafting and checking, not just polish. You know what it gets wrong and you catch it.
You test what you document. You'd rather try the feature and read the source than take someone's word for it, and when something's broken or confusing, you say so.
You're at home in docs-as-code: Git, Markdown and pull requests.
You ask engineers and PMs specific questions, and when documenting a feature shows it won't make sense to users, you raise it early, with reasons.

Preferred:
You've shipped docs weekly at a startup or scale-up, finding out what changed yourself.
You've written for AI readers, or you're curious about it.
You have UX writing or content design experience, or an interest in it.
You can read code well enough to check how a feature actually behaves; writing code is not required.

What you'll do
Drive, don't wait. Features land every day, and bigger launches several times a month. You find out what's shipping before anyone tells you, and the docs are ready the day it ships.
Own it end to end. Work a feature out from the code and the product, write the page, verify it in Lovable, ship it, and keep it true as the product moves.
Care about the reader more than the feature. Our docs come with data: what people can't find, what the assistant couldn't answer, what support hears. You use it to decide what to write next.
Make the product better, not just explain it. Documenting a feature means using it end to end. You'll find the confusing label or the broken step and get it fixed before launch.
Write for three readers on one page. The non-technical builder, the developer, and the AI agent working on their behalf.
Build something that outlasts the week. AI drafts a lot of our pages. The human work is judgement: what a feature needs, what the engineer didn't mention, and the checks that keep hundreds of pages correct.

Where you'll start:
Enterprise. Identity and access, governance, audit, data residency: the pages a security team reads before they sign.
The developer surface. Take our API and MCP references from correct to complete.
Your first launch. Own the docs for one in your first weeks, from working group to launch day.
Your first automation. Pick one check we still do by hand and make it run on its own.

About your application
Please submit your application and your writing samples in English using the form below. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do
We're seeking a Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer to join our Nuclear Engineering & Safety team, working from Stockholm or Oskarshamn. In this role, you will work on experiments with the aim of validating thermal-hydraulics system codes for use in the design and safety analysis of our lead-cooled fast reactors.

More specifically, you will
Coordinate, specify and analyze experiments to be run in our ARTS (Advanced Reactor Testing Site) facility in Oskarshamn.
Act as a technical lead for engineers and technicians working on both the experiments and the simulation codes.
Contribute to our validation program for thermal hydraulics system codes and associated methodologies.
Stay current with advances in thermal hydraulics, computational methods, and regulatory requirements.

Who you’ll get to work with
The thermal-hydraulics validation engineer sits in the Nuclear Engineering & Safety team within Blykalla, and reports to the manager of Nuclear Engineering & Safety. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and our company. You can choose to work from any of our offices in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (at Simpevarp). In case of work from the Stockholm office, frequent (monthly) travel to the ARTS site is expected.
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
Master's degree in physics, engineering or a related field
Hands-on experience in designing, commissioning, and performing thermal-hydraulic experiments, including instrumentation and data analysis
Familiarity with building validation envelopes for system codes used in nuclear safety analysis such as BISON (BWR), TRACE, RELAP, APROS or similar as well as for CFD tools
Solid understanding of the physics and phenomena involved in thermal hydraulics simulations
A structured way of working, together with excellent problem-solving and technical writing skills
Fluency in English, spoken and written

Meritorious skills:
Working experience in safety analysis of PWR, BWR or advanced reactors
Working experience from liquid metal applications
Experience in supporting nuclear licensing activities or in regulatory interaction
Fluency in Swedish, spoken and written

If you are not sure that you are 100% qualified, but are up to the challenge, we encourage you to apply.
Location 
This position is for our office in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (Simpevarp)
So, what do you think?
Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.
We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!

Reference & Background Checks
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.
Salary Range: SEK 57 000 - 95 000 / month, depending on experience and qualifications.
We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.
We do not accept applications via email. 
We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies. 
Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

About the Role:

As a Senior Systems Administrator & IT Security Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and securing our organization's IT infrastructure and systems. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the stability, availability, and integrity of our technology environment while implementing and maintaining robust security measures to protect against cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Your expertise in system administration and IT security will be essential in safeguarding our data, networks, and assets against unauthorized access, breaches, and attacks.
Essential Job Responsibilities:
Design, deploy, and maintain server infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage systems, and network devices, to support the company's business operations.
Perform system administration tasks such as system configuration, software installation, patch management, and user account management, ensuring the security and availability of systems and services.
Monitor system performance, analyze system logs, and implement proactive measures to optimize system resources, improve efficiency, and prevent downtime.
Implement and maintain security controls and measures to protect against cyber threats, including malware, ransomware, phishing attacks, and unauthorized access.
Conduct security assessments, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and address security vulnerabilities and weaknesses in systems, networks, and applications.
Develop and enforce IT security policies, procedures, and standards to ensure compliance with industry regulations and best practices, such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and GDPR.
Configure and manage security tools and technologies, such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), endpoint protection, and security information and event management (SIEM) systems.
Respond to security incidents and breaches in a timely manner, conducting incident investigations, forensics analysis, and remediation activities to minimize impact and prevent recurrence.
Provide security awareness training and guidance to employees, educating them on security best practices, policies, and procedures to promote a culture of security awareness and compliance.
Stay updated on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security trends, and proactively recommend and implement security enhancements and countermeasures to mitigate risks and vulnerabilities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and execute IT projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, and security enhancements, ensuring alignment with security requirements and objectives.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior systems administrators and IT staff, sharing knowledge and expertise in system administration and IT security practices.

Required Skills & Experience:
6+ years of experience in Windows Server Administration.
3–4 years of dedicated experience in VMware administration.
Proven expertise in Hyper-V and High Availability Clustering.
Strong proficiency in PowerShell scripting for task automation.
Familiarity with the ITIL framework and formal change management processes.
Knowledge of backup and recovery technologies (such as Veeam, Zerto, etc.).
Experience working with enterprise storage solutions (SAN/NAS).
Fluency in Swedish (C1) & Intermediate English (B1/B2) is a must (French is bonus, but not required)

VMware Certified Professional (VCP)

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Finance Lead to join a fast-scaling AI company backed by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and AWS, and to grow with it.
About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP). Everything we build follows Privacy by Design.
The role
This is not a traditional accounting position. Half the job is making the financial foundation work exceptionally well: payroll, bookkeeping, tax, payments, reporting, and administration, together with our founders and external advisers. The other half is commercial: working with the founders on pricing, business models, cost structures, and where the company puts its money.
One day you might be running payroll and closing the month. The next, you could be modeling the economics of deploying our platform across hundreds of customer sites, finding a European innovation grant, or helping the CEO evaluate a new commercial opportunity.
What you will work on
• Bookkeeping, reconciliations, and monthly and annual closing in Fortnox.
• Payroll, benefits, reimbursements, VAT, and tax, together with our auditors and banks.
• Invoicing, supplier payments, accounts payable and receivable, and corporate cards (Mynt).
• Filings with Bolagsverket and Skatteverket, board materials, minutes, and shareholder documentation.
• Budgets, forecasts, cash flow and runway models, and reporting for leadership, the board, and investors.
• Unit economics across cloud, AI inference, hardware, and deployment, and the margins they produce.
• Grants and non-dilutive funding from Swedish and European programmes.

jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As a Sales Advisor at H&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.
You will:
Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.
Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.
Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well-stocked, organized, and inviting.
Support with opening and closing of the store.
Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with…
Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.

And people who are…
Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.
Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.
Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.
Flexible and action oriented.

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
 All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. 
In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
This is a temporary position offering 8 hours per week for 3 months, with start in November or by agreement. The role is based in Kungens Kurva and you should be available to work during store opening hours. Language skills in Swedish or English are required.
We have an ongoing selection, so the position may be filled before the application deadline, so send in your application today! The last application date is 21/10.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
* Store roles assessment: 
To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group. Please look out for an email in your inbox/junk email from MAKI. 
After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application. 
For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice. 
** We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

About Taigatech
We solve some of the most important problems in industry with AI and computer vision. With our connection to the latest research and academia, we take world-leading research in AI and computer vision and turn it into impactful solutions that help the wood industry increase yield, availability, and productivity.
Technology is reshaping our world. We believe the forest and wood products have an important role to play in a sustainable future, and AI is how the industry gets there.
We are a growing team in a comfortable office in central Gothenburg, working closely with many of the leading names in wood processing. Our systems run in production at sawmills and pulp mills in Sweden and abroad. There's no better time to join our journey than now.
Why this role exists
Our systems create value the moment their output reaches the customer's control system — a correction, a signal, something the line can act on.
What determines the results are a handful of decisions made early and made well: which signal, where it lands, what the line does with it, and how it behaves when something unexpected happens. Get those right and the implementation is small and quick.
Today that judgement is distributed between our own team and the automation partners we work with on each installation. We want someone to decide what the interface should look like, judge whether it came out right, decide when a sensor or other component needs replacing, and if the signal belongs on a different fieldbus.
That's the person we're hiring. You don't replace our automation partners. You become the one who leads them.
What you'll do
The role is both technical and leadership, and the balance shifts from project to project.
Own the machine-side interface. You decide how our system talks to the customer's PLC. Signals, timing, handshakes, watchdog, fail-safe behaviour. You write the functional description the work is built from.
Lead our automation partners. Sometimes that means writing the code snippet yourself. Sometimes it means explaining what needs doing and reviewing that it came out right. You decide which.
Make the technical decisions on the customer's plant. Upgrading a component for better results, or moving to a different fieldbus, is yours to propose and drive. The implementation itself normally goes to a partner.
Be the customer's main contact through the project — scope, timeline, status, time and cost reporting. You take over from sales and carry the delivery home.
Clear the path. OT network access, change control, and the dialogue with the site's automation and IT departments, so the installation can be done quickly and safely.
Work closely with our ML and vision engineers. Translate what the process needs into what the model has to output, and the model's limits back into what we can promise.
Make it repeatable. A reusable interface specification, a commissioning checklist, and a growing network of automation partners to deliver alongside.
Who you are
You need experience, but we don't care how many years you have behind you. We care about what you've done.
You have programmed PLCs in live production, on at least one major platform — Siemens TIA/S7, Beckhoff, ABB, Mitsubishi, Codesys or equivalent
You have hands-on experience of industrial networks: Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, OPC UA or equivalent.
You have extended control systems you did not write with retrofits onto existing, running equipment
You have written functional descriptions that someone else built from
You have stood on site during commissioning, with production running and someone waiting
Drives the project forward by keeping people accountable, asking the right questions, and pushing decisions when it matters — even when that means a difficult conversation.
Swedish and English, and you sometimes travel to sites
Bonus
Sawmill, pulp and paper, or other heavy process industry
Vision systems, sensors or measurement equipment
Experience on the supplier side, responsible for subcontractors
Machinery directive and risk assessment on modified lines
Python and basic data analysis
What we offer
You'll be our first dedicated automation hire. You set the delivery process, and it becomes the standard we scale on. As delivery volume grows, the function gets built around you.
You'll work directly with the founders, with our ML engineers and with the mills themselves. Office in Gothenburg.
We review applications on a rolling basis.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
The position
Cambio delivers value to our customers both in the form of products and services. To support one of our largest and most business-critical customer environments, we are looking for a System Engineer with a passion for automation, operations, and continuous improvement. 
As a System Engineer, you will play a key role in application operations, driving automation across installation, configuration, upgrades, validation, and the ongoing management of business-critical application environments. You will also be responsible for implementing DevOps best practices and collaborating with development teams to improve the software delivery process. 
You will work with designing and continuously improving the services we provide to the organization. The role focuses on building, operating, and evolving automation solutions and our application. You will use systems such as Git and Ansible Automation Platform as part of your daily work, collaborating closely with our IT Operations organization and delivery organization. A strong emphasis is placed on using Ansible to design and run automations in highly critical environments. You will also have the opportunity to work with modern tooling to drive innovation, reliability, and efficiency across the organization. 
Since much of the work is performed within the customer's infrastructure, you will need to balance established requirements with opportunities to challenge and improve existing ways of working.

We offer:

The opportunity to work with business-critical healthcare systems that make a real difference in society. Your work will help ensure the stability and reliability of solutions used across many of Sweden's healthcare regions, supporting healthcare professionals in delivering efficient and safe patient care.

Join a passionate and highly skilled team working with modern technologies, automation, and business-critical systems. Collaboration is at the core of how we work, and you will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge and help each other succeed.

Great opportunities for growth and development. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues and work with large-scale, complex environments, giving you the opportunity to continuously deepen your technical expertise and broaden your skill set.

 About you
We believe that you are a proactive and solution-oriented team player who enjoys collaborating with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders to solve challenges and drive improvements. You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly, and build strong relationships based on trust and collaboration.
You are structured and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of quality. With a curious mindset and a desire to continuously learn, you enjoy sharing knowledge, improving ways of working, and contributing to a positive team culture.
At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values. 
Requirements 

Strong experience in designing, building, and maintaining infrastructure automation solutions, for example using Ansible or similar automation platforms.

Proficiency in automation and tooling through scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python

Experience working with Windows environments from an operations and automation perspective. Experience with Linux environments is considered a plus.

Experience delivering and operating automation in highly critical or sensitive environments

Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, and Prometheus.

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English. 

It's a bonus if you have 

Experience with OpenSearch or similar log frameworks

Knowledge of certificates, PKI, and secure communication principles.

Experience with Java application server frameworks, such as JBoss and Tomcat.

Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.

Understanding of networking concepts, including firewalls and load balancing.

Additional information: 
Place of employment: Linköping or Stockholm 
Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Job Scope
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.
The Instrument Technician is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and compliance of all process instrumentation and measurement systems throughout the manufacturing facility. The technician serves as the technical expert for process control instrumentation, analytical equipment, and measurement devices, ensuring regulatory compliance and optimal process control. They act as the primary resource for instrumentation troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement of measurement systems, guaranteeing that all critical process parameters are accurately monitored and controlled to maintain product quality and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)
·      Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections.
·      Perform risk analysis and participate in risk assessments according to established routines.
·      Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time.
·      Troubleshoot and resolve production line issues (mechanical, electrical, automation, process) and completing validation runs of production to confirm the effectiveness of work.
·      Support production teams with first-line problem solving, process optimization, equipment setup and escalation of unresolved technical issues.
·      Perform corrective and preventive maintenance on production equipment (electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic).
·      Install, maintain, and repair equipment, wiring, and systems (mechanical assemblies, electrical systems).
·      Inspect equipment for wear, vibrations, lubrication, or electrical faults and escalate to one level above the need for repair if necessary.
·      Define and manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability.
·      Read and update technical documentation including (but not limited to): diagrams, blueprints, troubleshooting guidelines, checklists and work instructions.
·      Train newly onboarded team members and colleagues in technical and safety procedures.
·      Participate in continuous improvement projects focused on safety, reliability, quality, maintainability and production efficiency.
·      Ensure all work complies with safety standards and regulatory requirements.
·      Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for repairs, troubleshooting, and escalation.
·      Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process.
·      Perform equipment and instrumentation commissioning, startup verification, calibration verification and validation runs following maintenance or modification activities.
·      Participate in structured root cause analysis activities for equipment failures, process deviations and quality issues.
·      Collaborate with Quality, Engineering and Maintenance teams to resolve technical issues and improve operational performance.
·      Ensure equipment readiness and availability prior to production startup through inspections, calibration checks and preventive maintenance activities.
·      Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business, including but not limited to running the line, completing 5S, cleaning activities & quality sampling.
 
Requirements
Educational background and previous experience required for the role
Qualifications and Experience
·      Technical/industrial background in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Control Systems, or related field.
·      3+ years previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).
·      Vocational education within Instrumentation Technology, Industrial/Electrical Gymnasium, or equivalent.
·      Certified Calibration Technician (CCT) certification or equivalent is a plus. Six Sigma White or Yellow Belt certification is also advantageous.
·      Experience with calibration management software (EG:Beamx) and CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems).
·      Experience troubleshooting transmitters, analyzers, control valves, flow meters, pressure sensors, and temperature devices.
·      Experienced in continuous improvement and root cause analysis.

Specific skills & Knowledge 
·      Proficiency with precision test equipment including multimeters, calibrators, pressure standards, temperature baths, and signal generators.
·      Knowledge of ISO 17025 calibration standards and regulatory compliance requirements.
·      Ability to read and interpret technical documentation including P&IDs, loop diagrams, instrument data sheets, and manufacturer manuals.
·      Basic IT literacy (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with calibration databases or LIMS systems.
·      Understanding of process control principles, loop tuning, and instrumentation optimization for efficient manufacturing operations.
·      Administrative competence, including experience with ERP systems, work orders and incident reporting.
·      Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment.
·      Ability to document technical problems concisely.
·      Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.
·      This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs.

Silex Microsystems is looking for a passionate and driven Group Manager to lead one of our Product Development teams. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who’s willing to take the next step in their leadership career while working at the cutting edge of MEMS technology.
The Team 
The Product Development team picks up where the Sales team leaves off, collaborating closely with clients to transform innovative ideas into tangible products ready for production. Our mission is to ensure that we meet client expectations in the proof of concept and prototype production phase. With approximately 50 team members, including Product Managers, CAD Engineers, and Process Design Engineers, our team closely collaborates and exchanges expertise. 
The role
As Group Manager, you will build and lead a team of ambitious Product Managers at various seniority levels, with the ambition of growing the team to five to six members over time. At the same time, you will drive the development and launch of new products within key customer programs.
In the beginning of the role, you will also work as a Senior Product Manager, allowing you to stay close to the product and customer needs while establishing and developing the team.
A key part of your mission will be to ensure that the team thrives — both in terms of professional growth and in delivering high-quality, customer-focused results. You will be responsible for resource planning, supporting team members in their day-to-day work, and ensuring alignment with departmental goals, processes, and priorities.
You will also play a central role in the success of the team’s development programs, taking ownership of team performance, customer satisfaction, technical excellence and long-term profitability. As the first line of escalation, you’ll provide hands-on technical support when projects need extra attention, ensuring timely and effective resolutions.
Key Responsibilities

Lead and coach a team with direct-reporting engineers within Product Development.

Manage resource planning, goal setting, and prioritization.

Support team members both technically and commercially in their programs and ensure delivery excellence.

Drive professional development and foster a strong team culture.

Represent your team in internal forums and customer discussions.

Act as first escalation point for customer program challenges.

Time Allocation (Typical Monthly Distribution)

50% – Supporting the team’s customer programs.

30% – Leading your own customer programs.

20% – People management, planning, and team development.

Who You Are
You are an experienced leader with a strong background in project or program management and a passion for people development. You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and enjoy working close to both customers and technology.
To be successful in this role, we believe you have:

5+ years of experience in project management, program management, or similar areas.

Solid experience in customer-facing roles, with a proven track record of building long-term client relationships.

Experience within MEMS integration and/or product development in a related industry.

Formal leadership experience in a similar context.

A Master’s degree in Engineering in a related technical field.

Strong ability to support and guide individuals based on their unique needs.

A strategic mindset and the ability to prioritize effectively in a complex environment.

Has strong communication skills in spoken and written English, Swedish is considered a big plus.

Why Join Silex?
At Silex, you’ll be part of one of the world’s leading MEMS foundries. Our technology enables innovation in a wide range of industries — from medical and automotive to telecommunications and consumer electronics. We offer a dynamic workplace with short decision paths, a diverse team of top talent, and exciting growth opportunities. Work-life balance matters at Silex, and we want our people to thrive in their careers as well as in life outside of work.
About the recruitment process  
We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile, and answer a few questions. 
Our recruitment process is designed to ensure a fair and objective assessment. If you progress through the full process, you will start with a digital interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners, followed by a personality and logical ability test. Next, you will meet with our VP of Product Development together with a Talent Acquisition Partner for an in-person interview, and finally with a Group Manager and our COO for final interviews. Before an offer, we also conduct reference checks, a background check, and a drug test. Randomized alcohol- and drug testing is conducted for all of our employees during the employment.

The Opportunity

Grethe Westvig, Manager Order Management HVDC Service

Experience working with SAP S/4HANA is required.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple activities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships and effectively collaborate with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders across the organization.
A proactive and structured approach, with a natural sense of ownership and accountability.
Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong drive for continuous development, with a willingness to embrace new challenges, broaden skills, and contribute to improvements.

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.
Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.
Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?
EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.
In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
The Role
As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.
Your responsibilities will include:
Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
Working in close cooperations with order management team
 Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.
The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.
Is this you?
To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.
In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.
Do you want to know more?

Do you want to join the technological revolution? Tendium is looking for an ambitious individual in a customer-facing role, ready for the next step in their career! 
About Tendium
Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it here.
The Job
As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve success using our platform. You'll work closely with existing customers in the SME segment to secure renewals and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. This position offers a blend of relationship building and technical support, making sure our customers get the most out of our product.
You’ll be part of our sales team, collaborating with marketing, sales, and product teams. We are looking for someone who is comfortable with both hands-on customer support and proactively identifying growth opportunities.
As a Customer Success Manager at Tendium, your main focus will be to:

Onboard, build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their goals, challenges, and pain points.

Develop and execute a customer success plan to help customers achieve their desired outcomes and business goals.

Provide ongoing support and guidance to customers using our platform.

Monitor and analyse customer usage and provide recommendations to improve the adoption and usage of our platform.

Engage with customers to ensure that they renew their subscriptions for our platform.

Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and work with the sales team to close deals.

Be the voice of the customer and provide feedback to our product and engineering teams to improve our platform.

Collaborate with the marketing team to create customer case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase the success of our customers.

Resolve customer issues and ensure customer satisfaction.

Measure and report on customer success metrics, such as retention rate, customer satisfaction score (CSAT), and net promoter score (NPS).

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone with experience in a customer success or customer-facing role within the tech or SaaS sector. To excel in this role, we believe you are entrepreneurial, proactive, and skilled at taking initiative and managing your own projects. As a key point of contact for our customers, strong communication and relationship-building abilities are essential.
Since you will be working at a leading SaaS company, it's crucial that you can quickly adapt to and stay ahead of the ongoing technical evolution of our product.
You Have:

Experience in a customer facing role within the SaaS/tech sector.

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously.

Familiarity with AI technologies and an ability to adapt to new technologies.

Strong organisational skills with a keen attention to detail.

Proficient in Swedish and in English

Experience can come from either a business, sales, customer-facing, operational, or procurement-related background.

Bonus (but not mandatory) if you have:

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

Experience in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Experience and/or knowledge of public procurement processes.

Fluency in Norwegian or any additional European language is a plus.

Application
We look forward to your application. We recruit on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible. Successful candidates will initially be invited to an initial interview where you will have the opportunity to meet the team. 
Please find additional information on our recruitment process here.
To make this process even more efficient, feel free to sign in to your Connect profile and add your references at any stage.
If you’re ready to make an impact and grow with us, we want to hear from you.
_______________________
Equality and inclusion statement 
At Tendium, we value and celebrate diversity. We’re building a workplace where everyone feels that they belong, where your voice is heard, and your experiences are respected. Different perspectives fuel our creativity and drive innovation, and we’re always looking for people who can bring something new to the team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, we’d love to hear from you.
Let’s shape the future together.

Join Telavox as an Engineering Manager
At Telavox, we’re looking for an Engineering Manager who is comfortable leading inside a fast-moving organisation, someone who can hold a team steady while priorities shift and knows how to introduce just enough structure to make a team faster, not slower. You’ll combine leading people with strong engineering judgement, and you’ll care as much about how reliably your team ships as about how quickly they move.
If you enjoy working with people, leading through change, and empowering teams to do their best work, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
About the job
As an Engineering Manager at Telavox, you’ll lead our Telephony Team, responsible for developing people, strengthening team performance, and aligning engineering efforts with business and product goals.
The Telephony Team works on core telephony capabilities and collaborates closely with other engineering and product teams. You’ll help shape effective processes and ways of working, manage dependencies, and ensure clear technical contracts and interfaces between teams.
You’ll work closely with engineers, Product, and other stakeholders, contributing to technical discussions and architectural decisions while ensuring the team delivers scalable and sustainable solutions.
Your day-to-day work will include:
• Leading, coaching, and developing the Telephony Team, supporting growth, performance, and well-being
• Establishing effective processes and ways of working, adding structure where needed and removing it where it isn’t
• Creating clarity when priorities shift and translating business needs into clear plans
• Partnering with Product on priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes; delivering a highly scalable and competitive telephony platform
• Collaborating with other Engineering Managers and teams on dependencies, technical contracts, and interfaces
• Contributing to technical and architectural decisions and ensuring long-term scalability, availability, and maintainability
• Contributing to hiring and building a strong, inclusive, and diverse engineering team in a collaborative and high-performing environment
• Helping shape the broader engineering strategy, technical direction, and culture across engineering teams
About you
You’re a confident engineering leader who is comfortable with ambiguity, able to create clarity, and interested in understanding the bigger picture. As the leader of the Telephony Team, you’ll work across a broad technical landscape, from core telephony to cloud, software architecture, and operations. You don’t need to be an expert in every area, but you have solid technical understanding, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
You may come from a Senior or Lead Engineer background and stay close enough to technology to make sound decisions around architecture, quality, reliability, and trade-offs.
Key skills and experience we’re looking for:
• Proven experience leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, or similar
• Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, and developing individuals
• Experience creating effective processes, ways of working, and structures that help teams perform
• Comfortable with ambiguity and able to turn changing priorities into clear direction
• Solid technical understanding and curiosity across different technologies and domains
• Experience working with production software where reliability, quality, and maintainability matter
• Ability to connect engineering decisions to product and business priorities, and challenge constructively when needed
• Passion for building a healthy, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
Good-to-have skills:
• Good understanding of telephony concepts such as SIP, RTP, and related technologies
• Experience from a SaaS or B2B environment
• Familiarity with cloud architecture, event-driven systems, and DevOps practices
• Interest in using AI tooling to improve engineering ways of working
At Telavox, you’ll have the opportunity to grow as a leader, shape how we build software, and be part of a company that values both impact and having fun along the way.
Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.
