jobs.occupation: Systems Architect to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of advanced products? Then you might be the person we’re looking for!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
We Offer
A strategic role where you will have a significant influence on the direction of our world-leading Jet Printing product.

A Vision Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, reverse-engineering, and maintaining machine vision and optical inspection systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving cameras, lighting configurations, and image processing algorithms, supporting both legacy production line re-commissioning and new vision system installations. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with PLCs, SCADA, and upper-level MES platforms to enable inline defect traceability, dimensional inspection, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production. 

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead vision system integration and optical calibration during equipment commissioning and line re-starts (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop and reverse-engineer the vision inspection systems to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory, as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on machine vision, optics, and quality inspection gates. 
Code review and test of suppliers' vision software and algorithmic work within the projects to validate specified defect detection thresholds (Gauge R&R) and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper-level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor, with a minimum of approximately 25% of working hours spent on-site. Depending on project needs (such as line re-commissioning), there may be periods where up to 100% of working hours are required on the shop floor. 
Develop and maintain machine vision and image processing programming standards. 
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 
Bachelors Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with industrial camera systems, optical components, and lighting techniques, including the selection, configuration, and calibration of camera hardware for manufacturing inspection and process control applications 
Experience in the design, configuration, and deployment of machine vision systems including cameras, lighting, and vision software platforms such as Cognex, Halcon, or equivalent, with experience integrating vision outputs into PLC, SCADA, and MES environments via OPC connectivity. 
Experience developing and optimising image processing pipelines and vision algorithms for applications such as defect detection, pattern recognition, and dimensional verification, with familiarity with industrial communication protocols for vision system integration. 
Experience in writing technical documentation including inspection requirement specifications, algorithm validation reports, vision system configuration records, functional design, UML, test cases, and test records. 
Experience with image processing software and programming tools relevant to industrial vision applications, such as Python, C++, OpenCV, or equivalent vision libraries, with the ability to develop, test, and optimise vision algorithms for real-time manufacturing environments 
Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

The role

Coordinating application and admissions process for the BSc programs, ensuring an efficient, accurate and applicant-focused process.

Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!
Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.
What you’ll do
You will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.
Beyond that, your work will include:

Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.

Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.

AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.

Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.
You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.
What you bring
A solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.
You're comfortable with:

Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it

Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended

Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running

Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences

Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need to

You look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.
Why Coretura?
We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.
The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.
If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.
Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!
Last application date: 4th of December 2026.
Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.

jobs.occupation: Post-doc position at the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness at SSE
jobs.description:
About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research area
Wellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.
A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.
The role
The postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.
The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. 
Your profile
The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. 
Qualifications
PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.
A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals
Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs
Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python
Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network
Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular science

Meritorious
Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text
Development of open research software or openly shared models
Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics 

How to apply: 
Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application: 
A curriculum vitae 
A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings). 
Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5) 
Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts 
Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. 

We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.
For further questions on the positions, please contact Assistant professor and Executive Director Fredrik Lange at fredrik.lange@hhs.se

Our mission is to enable our DevOps teams to focus on building great applications by providing a shared internal developer platform, tools, templates and ways of working that simplify the entire software development lifecycle. Today, we support more than 20 teams across all three divisions, combining hands-on engineering with coaching, training and technical enablement.

Ultimately, our goal is simple: remove complexity, create great developer experiences and enable teams to deliver secure, high-quality software faster.

Role Description
As a Cloud Architect in CORE Platform, you will help shape the AWS foundation that our DevOps teams build on. Instead of every team solving the same cloud challenges themselves, we create reusable patterns, guardrails and infrastructure-as-code that make it easier to build, deploy and operate software securely and efficiently.

You will combine hands-on cloud engineering with architecture and enablement, designing and operating shared AWS capabilities while working closely with the teams that use them. Their challenges and feedback become input for better automation, self-service and reusable solutions across the organization.

Together with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Product and Security, you will help develop a coherent platform where reliability and security are built in from the start. You will also run Game Days, including sessions together with AWS, and use those learnings to continuously strengthen the platform.

Looking ahead, we are preparing for AI agents to become platform users alongside developers. You will have the opportunity to help shape the cloud patterns and secure environments that make that possible, while influencing how Husqvarna’s use of AWS evolves. What you will do:
Design and build reusable AWS patterns, templates and guardrails as code.
Ensure our cloud capabilities are reliable, secure and performant.
Improve automation and self-service based on the needs of our DevOps teams.
Run Game Days and turn learnings into concrete improvements.
Evolve our cloud patterns as AWS, technology and user needs change.
Coach and mentor engineers across teams.

Your profile
Beyond your technical expertise, you have a customer-focused mindset and genuinely care about creating solutions that teams find useful and want to adopt. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable exploring new technologies and unfamiliar challenges. As a senior colleague, you enjoy sharing your knowledge, coaching others and helping people grow.

You are also curious about how AI is changing software development, while taking a balanced and practical view of where it creates real value. Most importantly, you are a collaborative and humble team player who brings a positive attitude, a sense of humour and a willingness to succeed together. You have:
 
5+ years of professional experience working with cloud technologies, with deep knowledge of AWS.
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and designing and running containerized applications in AWS.
Experience building highly available, reliable cloud solutions and the ability to explain the trade-offs behind your architectural decisions.
Experience with container services such as ECS and/or Kubernetes platforms such as EKS.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. We are looking for one to two professors of Statistics for permanent positions at the School of Business.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Statistics.
Background
Örebro University is seeking one to two professors of Statistics to strengthen and expand our research. Research in the Department of Statistics is mainly focused on Bayesian Statistics with applications in Economics and Finance, as well as Survey Methodology. Formally, and based on a close collaboration, the Departments of Statistics and Economics constitutes a joint research environment with cross-disciplinary research groups in wellbeing and health economics; entrepreneurship, globalization and institutions; macro- and financial econometrics (MAFE) and statistics (stat@oru). In addition, the department benefits from a close collaboration with Statistics Sweden. We are looking for candidates whose expertise can, in particular, strengthen the MAFE and stat@oru groups, and who can also take on a leadership role.
Education in the Department of Statistics spans the bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral levels. In addition to the Bachelor’s Programme in Statistics, courses are offered in, among others, the Programme for Business and Economics. At the master’s level, a two-year study programme in statistics is offered which has been awarded the ‘European Master in Official Statistics’ (EMOS) label by Eurostat. The department also offers courses in the Master’s Programme in Economics and Econometrics, and the Master’s Programme in Finance.
In addition to Statistics and Economics, Örebro University School of Business hosts the departments of Business Administration and Informatics. The Business School is accredited by AACSB, the largest accreditation body and network for business schools globally – an achievement accomplished only by five per cent of the world’s 16,000 business schools.
Duties and responsibilities
As a rule, a professor at Örebro University spends the bulk of their working hours on research. They are also expected to work actively to bring in external research grants to the subject, take overall responsibility for its research activities, and monitor developments within the subject field internationally. A professor is expected to be involved at all three levels of higher education and to communicate and collaborate around their own and the department’s research activities.
A professor is moreover expected, within the scope of their employment, to make themselves available for executive and administrative assignments at the university.
The professorships are aimed at strengthening the research in Statistics. We particularly welcome candidates whose research focuses on Bayesian Statistics, Econometrics, Time Series Analysis and/or Survey Statistics. We are seeking individuals with the vision and potential to drive the development in the subject. As two professors are being recruited, the aim is for the appointments to have complementary research profiles and, taken together, to strengthen the breadth of Statistics at Örebro University across the areas listed above.
Qualifications and assessment criteria
To see the job advertisement in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/
Information
These positions are permanent and full-time. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.
For more information about the position, contact Erik Löfmarck (Head of School) at +462019301029 or email: erik.lofmarck@oru.se.
At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.
Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.
Örebro University aims to improve the gender balance among professors and especially encourages female candidates to apply.
Application
The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure. For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:
Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
Teaching portfolio (as instructed in https://www.oru.se/globalassets/inforum-en/key_documents/human-resources/template-for-teaching-portfolio.pdf)
Research portfolio
Publication list
Relevant scientific publications (maximum of 10 and in full-text format)
Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed. More information for applicants will be found on our career site: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/

Are you a Python programmer? Are you driven by system-level challenges? Join the Software Test Solutions at Westermo as a Software Developer!
Are you our next Software Developer?
Software Test Solutions develops our in-house test framework, which is used to test our products, and plays a critical role in ensuring product quality and reliability. Many teams rely on the accuracy of our test results, which makes our work essential for validating our products against their specifications.
We are looking for a software developer who thrives in an agile environment and wants to be part of a team that builds and maintains this framework and its tools. The framework is used for system-level testing of our products in network solutions, running on dedicated test systems.
Our department is made up of two teams: the Test Framework team (the role described here), which schedules and runs tests, processes the test results and maintains the test systems, and the Test Developer team, which develops and maintains tests for our operating system WeOS. We promote close collaboration between the two teams, so your work won't necessarily stay limited to the framework – there's plenty of room to explore and contribute across both.
In your role, you will be:

Programming primarily in Python (and Go), working with tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Analysing test results and troubleshooting and refining the framework to keep it reliable.

Maintaining and developing the test systems, with the devices under test, that the framework relies on.

Extending the framework to support new WeOS functionality.

Developing the next generation of our test framework to meet future demands on scalability, including virtual testing, and reduced complexity for end users.

Working with both front-end and back-end development of the web interfaces for configuration and visualization of test results.

We think about automation in everything we do, and we are always trying out new technologies that help us meet current and future demands. We use Jira for planning and tracking work, and keep improving our Agile methods. AI is also a natural part of our daily software work, and we are exploring how to put it to even better use.
So, who are we looking for?
You have an academic background in computer science or similar, and you’re motivated by solving real problems with smart solutions. We value teamwork, and hope you do, too. You enjoy both technical development and team collaboration, and you share your knowledge just as readily as you ask for help. You are curious and innovative, comfortable in an agile environment, and like to try, test, and learn with colleagues.
Further, we want you to be:

Experienced in Python development and eager to deepen your skills.

Comfortable working in a Linux environment.

Familiar with software engineering tools such as source code management, CI/CD, containers, and web development (front-end and/or back-end).

Interested in networking technologies.

Fluent in English and Swedish.

Oh, and don't worry, if you're not an expert in all the things described – you'll learn.
In return, we offer: You will be working at the forefront of technology in a friendly, open culture where you get the opportunity to learn from skilled colleagues every day. A mature and caring leadership in a flat organization. Through our collective bargain agreement you will be covered in terms of insurance, pension and other benefits. The Combat Systems Engineering department is responsible for Systems of Systems architecture, verification and integration. It is also responsible for overarching Cyber Security. As Head of CS Engineering, you will have overall responsibility for a department consisting of highly skilled and senior specialists. You will lead a line organisation of seven managers, who in turn manage teams within:
Systems of systems integration
Combat system to ship integration
Architecture and requirements
Cyber security
Acceptance & verification
Commissioning

Your main task will be to initiate and drive a transformation journey for our CS Engineering department. Today, we have many parallel projects and a strong delivery focus. In that context we need to further harmonise our ways of working and strive for efficiency on a global scale. Your mission is to develop and strengthen common ways of working across the organisation, driving greater reuse, harmonised processes, methods and tools from a CS/LSI perspective. You will build cyber security competence with a holistic lifecycle focus, increase ownership within the line organisation, and improve onboarding and knowledge sharing to help new employees become productive faster while reducing dependency on key individuals.

Set the direction for the CS Engineering department and translate strategy into clear goals, priorities and concrete actions.

Act as a bridge between projects and line organisation, balancing operational delivery with long-term capability development.

Contribute actively to the engineering management team, including strategic planning, resource balancing and competence development.

A structured and analytical working style, with the ability to see the big picture and at the same time understand operational challenges.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, both spoken and written. Knowledge of Swedish, Finnish or German is an advantage but not a requirement.

jobs.occupation: Academic Advisor to the Stockholm School of Economics
jobs.description:
The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.
We are looking for an Academic Advisor to join our Guidance and Wellbeing Office (GWO). As an Academic Advisor at SSE, you will work closely with students across our Bachelor and Master programs, providing guidance and support throughout their studies. 
The GWO team consists of two Academic Advisors and one Student Wellbeing Counsellor. Together, the team provides a first point of contact for students who need support related to their studies, their individual educational needs, or challenges that may affect their ability to study. The team also coordinates support for students with specific educational needs. 
As an Academic Advisor, you will: 
Provide individual guidance to students on study-related matters, helping them navigate challenges and make informed decisions about their studies. 
Meet students with a wide range of needs and circumstances and help identify appropriate forms of support. 
Coordinate support for students with specific educational needs and work with relevant colleagues to ensure appropriate arrangements. 
Work closely with the Student Wellbeing Counsellor and the other Academic Advisor to provide coordinated support to students. 
Guide students to other relevant functions or professional support when their needs fall outside the scope of academic advising. 
Collaborate with faculty and other colleagues across SSE on student-related matters. 
Contribute to developing routines, information and ways of working within GWO 
Participate in preventive and student-focused initiatives aimed at creating good conditions for students to succeed in their studies. 

What we offer you
At SSE, you’ll join a small, close-knit GWO team and work across a lively academic community. The role combines one-to-one work with students and collaboration with faculty and colleagues throughout the School. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how GWO supports students, develop its ways of working and contribute to initiatives that strengthen the study experience. It’s a varied role with room to take initiative, build strong working relationships and be part of students’ academic journeys.
About you
You are an attentive, confident communicator who can build trust while maintaining clear professional boundaries. You are comfortable meeting students with varied needs, including in challenging or sensitive situations.
You listen with care, ask thoughtful questions and can work out what kind of guidance or support may be most useful. You are calm and practical when situations are complex, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise. You are also ready to contribute to initiatives that strengthen students’ wellbeing and study experience.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:

A Bachelor’s degree in Study and Career Guidance (Swedish: Studie- och yrkesvägledarexamen).

Experience in student support, academic advising, counselling, education or another role involving professional guidance and individual support.

Spoken and written Swedish and English.

Meritorious

Knowledge of educational support for students with disabilities or other specific educational needs.

Experience using Nais and Ladok.

Experience working in higher education.

Other:
This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in Stockholm and start date is according to agreement.
We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. 
We look forward to receiving your application.
About the Stockholm School of Economics
The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.
Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.
SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.
SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

Be a part of the next big thing
Do you thrive on tackling complex challenges? Are you passionate about creating impactful solutions that drive commerce forward? Are you someone who believes in encouraging and elevating those around you?
About Kustom
Kustom was born in 2024 in Stockholm, Sweden, when Klarna Checkout became so successful it earned a life of its own. Since then, we’ve grown into one of Europe’s leading checkout solutions, with a team of more than 100 people all driven by the same mission: giving every business the checkout it deserves.
We believe the best solutions aren't built in isolation. Kustom gives merchants the freedom to shape their own checkout by connecting to a growing network of 100+ partners. We handle the complexity behind the scenes, making sure every shopper enjoys the best possible experience. That way, growth happens freely, without compromises or closed loops.
Today, Kustom serves more than 24,000 merchants across 170 markets and has converted more than 25 million shoppers.
The role
As Legal Counsel, you'll be responsible for Kustom's day-to-day commercial legal work, from merchant and partner agreements and complex negotiations to automating our legal processes. As a trusted internal advisor, you'll lead your matters independently, from first draft to signature.
Commercial work is the core of the role, but it doesn't stop there. You'll also take part in larger projects including M&A and post-acquisition integration and product legal projects covering, among other things, data privacy, payments and consumer legislation.
You'll work in a fast-paced environment where Legal is a key enabler of growth. We use AI as a tool to work efficiently, so we can spend our time where legal judgment matters most. We focus on the risks that are material to the business, and build processes that let standard agreements be signed without legal involvement.
You'll be part of a small legal team in Stockholm and report to the Head of Legal.
Things you’ll be doing
Commercial contracting. Draft, review and negotiate merchant, partner and vendor agreements, from standard terms to bespoke deals with larger counterparties. Your counterparties range from merchants to platform and e-commerce partners, payment service providers, banks and technology vendors.
Advise the business. Be the first point of contact for the commercial organisation and a pragmatic sparring partner to the product, operations, risk and finance teams. Give clear advice fast and if needed negotiate directly with counterparties and their lawyers.
Scale legal with AI. Develop how we use AI in our legal work, and improve templates, playbooks and approval flows so straightforward agreements move without legal involvement.
M&A and integration. Work on M&A together with the Head of Legal, including the legal side of post-acquisition integration, covering everything from contract migration to merchant and partner transitions.
Product legal projects. Work with the product team on larger legal projects, such as data privacy, payments legislation and consumer law.
Corporate and company law. Support on company law matters across the group, including board and shareholder matters and corporate housekeeping.

Skills and experience you’ll need
A Swedish law degree (jur.kand. or juristexamen).
Around three years of experience, either from a top-tier business law firm with a focus on commercial contracts and/or M&A and corporate law or in-house experience from fintech, payments or e-commerce.
A track record of owning negotiations end to end and drafting high-quality agreements.
Hands-on experience of using AI tools in your legal work.
Fluent in Swedish and English, spoken and written.
Experience of data privacy, payments regulation or consumer credit legislation is a plus.

We believe you’ll thrive in this role if you
Take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be told what to do.
Enjoy a high pace and stay structured when many matters compete for your time.
Are commercially minded and know how to balance legal risk against business priorities.
Like working close to the business and can make complex questions simple.
Are always looking for smarter ways of working and see AI as a natural part of how legal work gets done.

Benefits
Secure your future with a competitive pension package, including both national and occupational pension contributions.
Comprehensive health coverage with extensive health insurance, long-term illness protection, and flexible salary exchange options.
Invest in your wellbeing with an annual wellness allowance of 3,000 SEK to spend on the activities that keep you healthy and energized.
More time to enjoy life with an extra day off when major holidays, such as Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, fall on a weekend.

A place to grow
At Kustom, you won’t just be another face in the crowd. This is a place where we elevate each other and celebrate success as a team. We believe in our ability to create excellence - and have fun doing it!

Does this sound like the place for you?

Looking for the next step in your payroll career within a global organization? 
Our colleague is retiring, and we are now looking for a new team member to join our payroll team in Karlstad. This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a global organization where people are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will take ownership of complex payroll processes, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and play a key role in delivering payroll services and an excellent employee experience. You will work with payroll administration, time and attendance processes, compliance, reporting, and process development while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the business. If you enjoy combining payroll expertise with problem-solving and continuous improvement, this could be the next step in your career.
Your responsibilities 
You will manage payroll administration processes for operations across Sweden, Norway, and Denmark, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.  
You will perform payroll corrections, reconciliations, and reporting related to vacation balances, compensatory time, accounting transactions, tax reporting, and pension processes. 
You will own time and attendance administration, including schedule management and absence-related processes.  
You will support employees, managers, authorities, and external stakeholders by handling payroll-related inquiries through our case management system.  
You will contribute to process improvements, participate in year-end payroll activities, and help develop payroll policies, routines, and training initiatives.  

Expectations for you 
You have at least three years of experience working with payroll administration and complex payroll calculations. 
You have strong knowledge of payroll legislation, employment law, taxation, and payroll compliance requirements. 
You are experienced in payroll systems, and experience from Agda PS is considered an advantage. 
You have excellent analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and a structured approach to your work. 
You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.  

Payroll certification is considered a merit. 
To succeed in this role 
Success in this role requires solid payroll expertise, a thorough understanding of payroll legislation, and the ability to manage complex payroll processes with a high degree of accuracy. You are proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders. You stay up to date with changes in regulations and continuously look for ways to improve processes and service quality. 
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles - practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer 
You will join a dedicated payroll team responsible for delivering high-quality payroll and time management services while ensuring compliance and a positive employee experience. The team plays an important role in supporting employees and managers, driving process improvements, and maintaining efficient payroll operations across multiple countries.
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development. We encourage internal mobility and support continuous competence development to help our people grow throughout their careers.

As a Competence Development Specialist, you will be part of a global competence development team and play a key role in shaping the skills and expertise of colleagues and partners worldwide. 
 
Your job is to deliver comprehensive product and application training sessions focused on Hygienic Heat Exchangers for the food and pharmaceutical industries. You will facilitate both on-site and hands-on training at global product training hubs, with sessions typically lasting two to five days.

Support the development and delivery of training, engaging with process and project engineers as well as field service professionals. 
Collaborate with regional product and application teams, acting as a "train the trainer" to ensure consistent and effective knowledge transfer across regions.

Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously without dropping the ball.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Engineer - System and Software | Scania Special Vehicles
jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
Role Summary
We are looking for an Embedded Engineer who enjoys technical challenges, hands-on development, and working across different vehicle systems. 
Scania Special Vehicles develops customer-specific solutions that go beyond our standard product offering. Within the System and Software group, we develop and integrate functions and systems for both defence and civilian vehicles. 
Our work is close to the product. We combine a prototyping mindset with production readiness, finding pragmatic solutions, testing them in vehicles and rigs, and ensuring they are robust enough for production and customer use. 
 
Our projects cover a broad range of vehicle systems, including: 

Defence: PHEV based on BEV3, navigation systems, tactical functions, Protected Cab, onboard diagnostics, and Central Tire Inflation Systems. 

Civilian: Scania Longline, BEV for mining, Super Heavy Haulage, City Door, and mixed suspension solutions. 

 
Job Responsibilities
As an Embedded Engineer, you will work across the complete development chain, from customer needs and requirements to system development, software implementation, integration, and verification. 
 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Developing and integrating embedded functions and vehicle systems.
Investigating existing systems and identifying pragmatic technical solutions.
Prototyping, testing, troubleshooting, and verifying solutions in vehicles and test rigs.
Adapting existing systems to meet customer-specific requirements.
Managing system change requests and coordinating necessary technical changes.
Taking solutions from initial concepts and prototypes to production-ready implementation.
Collaborating with different development teams and stakeholders across Scania. 

 
Our projects vary in size and technical content, and we often work on several in parallel. You should therefore enjoy a high and variable pace, short development loops, and the opportunity to work across different technical areas. 
 
Who You Are
We are looking for a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work and finding solutions to technical challenges. 
You take ownership of your assignments, work well with others, and are comfortable investigating problems independently. You have a hands-on engineering mindset and enjoy seeing your solutions come to life in vehicles and test rigs. 
We believe you have:
A master's degree in mechatronics, physics, computer science, or another relevant engineering field.
Experience in embedded software and/or system development.
Experience in vehicle functions, electronics, or system integration.
Knowledge of CAN communication.
A hands-on approach to development and problem solving.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Good English skills, both written and spoken. 

 
It is an advantage if you have experience with: 
Scania development processes and systems.
Scania vehicle architecture.
Vehicle diagnostics.
Electrification and electric vehicle systems. 

 
You do not need to be an expert in every vehicle system. What matters most is your technical curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to take responsibility for finding a way forward. 
 
This Is Us
System and Software is part of Scania Special Vehicles. We work with customer-specific solutions that require flexibility, broad technical knowledge, and close cooperation across Scania. 
Our work combines technical investigations, hands-on development, and production-oriented engineering. We value practical solutions, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
The variety of projects provides opportunities to develop your competence across different vehicle systems while contributing directly to vehicles delivered to our customers. 
In the System and Software group, we work closely together and support one another while also fostering independent thinking and technical depth. You'll find our group to be technically driven, customer-focused, and collaborative—where everyone has a voice and a real opportunity to shape both what we do and how we do it. 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje
 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-21. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mascarenhas Murilo, murilo.mascarenhas@scania.com, Head of System and Software 

 
We look forward to your application!

About the job
Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? 
With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!
 
We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer you will create solutions through selection of standard components and detailed engineering combined. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc., and they are delivered as equipment packages or skid solutions. 

Work involves both new development and standardization of solutions to bring down lead time on customer projects. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Manager, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, Workshops and customers.

Key tasks and responsibilities:
Use P&ID + mass balance to design process solutions in Autodesk Inventor
Selection of standard components matching process needs
3D pipe routing using Inventor Piping/Sovelia
Detailed Engineering of skid solutions, including fabrication documentation
DFM in collaboration with workshop
FAT, piping line walk and SAT
Standardization of 3D design templates using skeleton and iLogic
Review 3D designs and 2D drawings
Review technical specifications from customers and develop technical deviation lists.
Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking
Agile project execution using MS DevOps
Ensure that the quality management system is followed

 
Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning are part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. 

You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work!
At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.
Joining Alfa Laval means being part of a flat, open, and inclusive culture that values collaboration and empowers employees. The company supports continuous learning and career development, fostering a strong growth mindset. As an established yet nimble global organization with 300+ locations and a long heritage of innovation, Alfa Laval offers both stability and autonomy often found in smaller firms. You will also gain meaningful cross-cultural exposure by working with international teams on impactful projects.
 
Who are you
You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.
What you know
We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in project execution within the wastewater, fluid handling, or a related processing industry.

Requirements:
 
Degree in mechanical engineering.
Strong understanding of P&ID, piping, and detailed engineering.

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
 
Shaping tomorrow’s technology
At Function & Software Defined Vehicles (FSDV), we shape tomorrow’s technology by delivering sustainable, innovative, and data-driven solutions that improve safety, efficiency, and performance throughout the vehicle life cycle. We support the Volvo Group engineering community with advanced platforms, tools, methods, and architectures that enable continuous innovation and deliver customer value throughout a vehicle's lifetime.
 
We are Product Lead, Test & Release, a part of Vehicle Software Factory
We are a true global organization located in: Bangalore, Curitiba, Gothenburg, Greensboro, and Lyon. We plan, test, and release the integration and verification of the full Embedded system product, hardware, and software.
Electrification and CO2 challenges are keeping us busy, just like the need for improved effectiveness and efficiency in our software release flow. As part of Vehicle Software Factory, we are working globally with all sites and with our colleagues in the other engineering departments.
 
What you will do
We are looking for a Group Manager for a team of highly skilled Software Testers.
Together with your team, you will take full responsibility for testing the complete embedded system delivery in all our different products. Your team will carry out testing on both proving grounds and public roads, ensuring world-class quality and features in Volvo trucks. You will play a central role in setting priorities, balancing urgent operational needs with long-term objectives, and ensuring that the team focuses on what matters most. Drawing on your experience and understanding of trucks and their applications, you will guide decisions and drive efficient, high-quality testing and delivery.
A key part of your role will be to lead, coach, and develop your team, strengthening their technical capabilities while fostering a culture of quality, precision, and continuous improvement. You will also heavily support your colleagues in the Vehicle Software Factory, as well as in other value streams within the development teams. We need you to play an active role in developing our Global Technology Area and shape our common vision of Vehicle Software Factory. Together we own and drive the test strategy for our deliveries.
 
Who are you?
We believe that the right mindset will make a difference in our organization. You are a confident and people-oriented leader who is comfortable leading through change and passionate about developing both people and ways of working. You see the bigger picture, keep a long-term perspective, and are curious about new technologies and opportunities that can move our area forward.
You understand that successful change is about people. You are perceptive, create involvement, and know how to build understanding and engagement around a common direction, while having the courage to challenge established ways of working and move things forward when needed.
You take accountability for driving progress both within and beyond your own organization. As an active member of the Product Lead, Test, and Release Management team, you contribute with ideas and perspectives, look for synergies across teams, and are comfortable challenging your peers, and being challenged in return. You balance long-term direction with short-term needs, make difficult decisions when required, and keep the overall business result in focus.
 
To succeed in this role, we believe that you have:
·      A university degree in Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
·      Proven experience in software testing within automotive or embedded systems.
·      Experience in testing complete system deliveries, preferably within an automotive context.
·      Good understanding of both manual and automated testing approaches.
·      Experience working in an agile development environment.
·      Leadership experience from line management, project management, or a similar leadership role.
·      Internal Volvo tools like SW Configurator, KOLA, JIRA/PILs, PROTOM, stand-alone logger tools, are considered a plus.
·      A valid truck driver's license.
·      Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
 
What can we offer?
You get an opportunity to work together with highly skilled colleagues in a fun, exciting, and dynamic environment. Our daily work is performed in an international environment, giving us the opportunity to interact with highly committed colleagues from different cultures. We trust the individual and act as a team, stay close to the product, and provide opportunities for professional and personal growth.
We strive for an inclusive culture that values the strength found in diversity. An inclusive team fosters creativity, innovation, and better solutions. Your ideas, experience, and perspective will contribute to making a difference.
 
Ready for the next move?
 
Location: The position is based in Lundby, Gothenburg, and requires frequent travel to Arendal and the Hällered/AstaZero test grounds in Sweden.

Mine Technical Service Aitik
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. 
Your opportunity
Help shape safe, predictable and cost-effective blasting at one of Sweden’s major open-pit mining operations. You will convert mine plans and field conditions into practical drill and blast designs, support execution in the pit, and use performance data to improve fragmentation, wall control, ore recovery and production flow.
Who you will work with
Mine Technical Service in Aitik includes specialist teams in geology, mine surveying, mine planning, drill and blast technology, geotechnics and geohydrology. We work closely with operations and other departments to create conditions for safe and efficient production
What you will do
As a Drill and Blast Specialist, you will be part of the team responsible for planning, preparing, following up and improving drilling and blasting activities. The role combines technical design and planning work with regular field presence. 
You will prepare practical drill and blast plans, support safe implementation in the field, follow up results and help improve the way we work. The role suits someone who understands mining operations, enjoys practical problem-solving and is interested in developing further within drill and blast.
Key responsibilities are:
·      Develop drill patterns, charging plans, initiation sequences and blast documentation for production, trim and wall-control blasting.
·      Prepare short-term drill and blast plans and schedules aligned with the approved mine plan, production priorities and geotechnical requirements.
·      Provide field support before, during and after blasting, including design mark-up, drill-hole and charging QA/QC, tie-in verification and blast-area risk controls.
·      Monitor drilling accuracy, hole condition, explosive loading and compliance with approved designs and standards.
·      Conduct post-blast inspections and reconcile planned versus actual results, including fragmentation, floor condition, toes, backbreak, dilution, ore loss, vibration and dig performance.
·      Maintain accurate blast records, charging sheets, design files, KPI data and reports, including powder factor, drill productivity, explosive consumption and blast performance.
·      Collaborate with geology, survey, mine planning, geotechnical and production teams to support ore recovery, stable pit walls and efficient loading, hauling and crushing.
·      Support investigations and corrective actions relating to drill and blast deviations, misfires, flyrock, excessive vibration or other blasting risks.
·      Coordinate technical matters with drilling contractors, explosives suppliers and technology providers, and contribute to trials and continuous-improvement projects.
What you bring
If you have experience of mining or a related operational environment and are interested in drill and blast, we encourage you to apply. We value practical site knowledge, a strong safety mindset and the motivation to develop within the role. Practical experience from drilling, blasting, charging, explosives or production work is highly valued, while technical qualifications or an engineering degree are considered an advantage.
