jobs.occupation: Wind- & Battery-Analyst / Intraday trader at Intraday Optimisation Nordic
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. 

Job Description

Do you want to help shape the future of energy, enable electrification and secure value creation in a changing and dynamic power market? Do you have a curious mind, enjoy working with complex challenges and have a passion for energy markets? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
The energy market is changing rapidly, increasing the need to continuously develop and automate our systems to stay competitive. We are now looking for the right person to strengthen our development capabilities and become a key part of one of our development teams.
Intraday Optimisation Nordic is a performance oriented department responsible for optimisation of Vattenfall’s Nordic portfolio of production and customer consumption on all intraday markets. Thus we have a key role for value creation and the realisation of Vattenfall’s strategy to lead the transition into a sustainable energy system by enabling further integration of renewable energy and new investments in fossil free power. The team is expected to be innovative, high performing and flexible – ready to cope with the rapidly changing dynamics of the European Power market.
The role as Wind & Battery Analyst / Intraday trader:
This is a hybrid role that combines part-time operational work at the Intraday trading-desk in our Nordic Dispatch Center with part-time analytical work in our Wind & Battery Optimisation team. In this role, you will contribute to the development of our optimisation processes, including wind forecasting, trading and optimisation strategies, ancillary service delivery, and the design of systems and tools for quantitative, data-driven decision support. IT and data are integral to all our operations, and you will gain hands-on experience with data analysis, advanced forecasting tools, and algorithmic trading.
Vattenfall’s Nordic Intraday-desk is responsible for optimisation of the Nordic Wind- & Battery-portfolio as well as Balance management and Intraday-trading for the majority of Vattenfall’s Nordic portfolios of both production and customer assets. Working at the intraday desk will give you a deep understanding about the fundamentals of the Nordic power market – the perfect introduction to our business. That knowledge will then be essential for any future analysis- or business development tasks, where we expect you to be creative, take own initiatives and think outside of the box when developing new solutions and trading strategies. IT and data are integral parts of all our processes and in this role you will be introduced to data analysis, advanced forecasting tools and algo-trading.
The hybrid role concept is standard practice within BU Assets and is highly appreciated by our employees. It offers a dynamic and stimulating work environment with diverse responsibilities, allowing you to apply insights from one area to another which creates valuable synergies.
 
Main tasks and responsibilities:
Operational work as Intraday trader in the Nordic dispatch center (scheduled work approximately 50%, which includes working early mornings, late evenings and some weekends)
Support our experts in continuous development of the optimisation of Vattenfall’s Nordic wind- & battery portfolio, including forecasting, optimisation- & trading strategies, algo-trading, ancillary service deliveries etc.
Challenge established solutions and initiate new business improvements

Qualifications

We are looking for a person with:
Relevant university degree in a quantitative or financial discipline, such as Engineering, IT, Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics or similar
Programming and data analysis skills, preferably in Python
Minimum 2–5 years of experience in the Nordic physical power market
Fluent Swedish and good command of English

You have a genuine interest in the Nordic physical power market and a strong business sense. You approach your work with a trader’s mindset and are comfortable adapting to changing circumstances while managing several activities simultaneously. You work in a structured way, communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with others in a fast-moving market environment.

Additional Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact recruiting manager Markus Bäck, +46 72 712 28 18. For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact recruiter Anders Nielsen +46700 786 840
Trade union representatives Trade union representatives: Simon Salomonsson (Unionen) and Sven Gunnar Gremlin (Akademikerna). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.
We welcome your application, no later than 22nd of November 2026. We only accept applications through our website. We do not require a cover letter as part of the application. You can apply quickly and easily by answering a few screening questions and attaching your CV.
 As we may conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
We look forward to receiving your application!
Since Vattenfall is part of the Swedish critical infrastructure many of our positions are security classed. If this position is security classed the final candidates can be subject to a security vetting process, according to the Swedish legislation.

At ASSA ABLOY you will contribute to the system and functional testing of ARX, a Scandinavian security system that combines software, servers, controllers, readers and physical security hardware in environments where quality, reliability, and performance are critical.
If you enjoy hands-on testing, improving automation, and working closely with developers and technical stakeholders, this role will likely resonate.
Why this role matters
For a security system, every part of the solution needs to work together reliably. As a System Test Engineer, you'll help ensure new features and system behaviour meet the standards expected by customers, while contributing to the quality of a solution that connects software with real-world security hardware.
The role
This is a hands-on testing role focused on ensuring that the complete ARX solution works as expected. You'll test new features, verify system behaviour, investigate defects and work across both software and hardware environments to help maintain a high level of quality and reliability.
You'll collaborate closely with developers, testers and other stakeholders, contributing to both manual and automated testing while developing deep product knowledge of a complex access control system used in real-world security environments. The role offers the opportunity to build expertise across software, hardware and automation while gaining a complete system perspective that few testing roles provide.
What you'll work on
Plan, prioritise and execute system and functional testing for new features and system behaviour
Run manual and automated tests across software and hardware-based test environments, including Client/Server architecture, Distributed Control Units, Readers and Motor-locks
Build, maintain and coordinate testing within hardware-based laboratory environments used to validate complete system functionality
Improve test automation, processes and methodologies using Python, Selenium and Robot Framework
Troubleshoot issues and defects, working closely with developers and other stakeholders
Perform functional, performance, stress and reliability testing across the complete system

What will help you succeed
Solid experience in system, software or integration testing
Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing, ideally with Python, Selenium and Robot Framework
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with developers and other stakeholders
A structured, analytical and proactive approach, with the curiosity to learn a complex product and the initiative to improve how things are done
Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have: Experience with hardware-based test environments, Java, Embedded C, access control or security products, and Swedish language skills.
Why ASSA ABLOY
Develop deep expertise in a complex security product while working across software, hardware and automation within a collaborative engineering environment.
Meaningful mission – Contribute to security technology that needs to perform reliably in real-world access environments
Innovation & scale – Work across software, hardware and automation within a global access solutions business
Autonomy & trust – Be trusted to investigate issues, drive testing activities and help ensure quality across the ARX platform
Growth & development – Expand your expertise across system testing, automation and complex integrated systems
Work–life balance – Combine hybrid working with regular access to the Stockholm lab in a collaborative Scandinavian work culture

Ready to strengthen the quality of a security product where reliability truly matters?
If you're an experienced test engineer who enjoys system testing, automation and technical problem-solving, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and help us create a safer and more open world.
We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. Just set up your profile and apply here. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner at lea.rein@assaabloy.com
Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.
We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. 
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

Hej Software Engineer! 
Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone? 
With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before. 
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area: “Product Engineering”, a part of Digital Engineering at Inter IKEA, Range. The Product Engineering Area is dedicated to ensuring an attractive, consistent, and efficient way of working for product development and our suppliers. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation for IKEA's product information, enabling its seamless use across the entire value chain. We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, and are looking for someone with strong communication and collaboration skills who can work effectively with colleagues across locations and seamlessly collaborate with our offshore team. 

Your new job 
We’re looking for a Software Engineer who wants to solve complex, real-world challenges and building digital products that make everyday work simpler and more effective. You will help shape the next generation of engineering platforms that enable effective collaboration between IKEA and suppliers around the globe. Through our modernized Supplier Collaboration Platform and Standard Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) initiatives, you will develop scalable solutions that simplify how product information is shared, managed, and governed across the value chain. You will report to a Software Engineering Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. 
On a typical day, you will: 
Help shape and evolve the modernized Supplier Collaboration Platform, enabling seamless collaboration between IKEA engineers and suppliers across the globe.  
Design, build, and maintain modern web applications, APIs, and cloud-native services using technologies such as React, .NET10 and Azure.  
Contribute to the Standard Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) initiative, helping create scalable, secure, and user-centric solutions that support the future of product development.  
Work across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and solution design to implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.  
Collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to solve complex challenges and deliver business value.  
Influence technical direction and contribute to architecture, design decisions, and engineering best practices.  
Foster a culture of collaboration, openness, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.  
Bring curiosity and fresh ideas that improve both our digital products and the way we work.  
Ensure high-quality, maintainable software through code reviews, automated testing, observability, and modern software engineering practices. 

 
What we’d like you to bring to the table 
This role as a Software Engineer requires you to: 
Have strong hands-on experience in .NET 10 backend development, combined with modern frontend development using React, with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.  
Be proficient in designing, building, and operating scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-native solutions.  
Have solid experience working with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud architectures.  
Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate business needs into robust technical solutions. 
Have good interpersonal skills: active listening, coaching and facilitation. 
Be an excellent communicator by communicating in a clear, structured and honest way – both with inhouse and offshore team and colleagues 
Have a deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this 

It’s a plus if you also: 
Have experience working with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, supplier collaboration platforms, or other enterprise solutions that support product development processes. 
Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services 
Have knowledge of RDBMS database technologies like Postgres DB, Oracle 
Have experience with Playwright for Frontend testing 
Are skilled in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React 

 
We welcome your application 
Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of November.  
This position is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.   
Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Hiring Manager prabu.sukumar@inter.ikea.com or the Recruiter monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com.  
At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.   
If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

jobs.occupation: Lead Engineer – Electrical and Control Systems
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
As a Lead Engineer within Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, you will play a key role in delivering modernization and upgrading projects for our global fleet of gas and steam turbines.
You will be responsible for the technical coordination of the electrical and control system scope throughout the project lifecycle, from sales support and engineering to commissioning and customer handover. Working closely with project managers, customers, suppliers, commissioning teams, and engineering specialists, you will ensure that the technical solution is clearly defined, coordinated, and successfully executed.
The role combines technical leadership, project execution, problem-solving, and customer interaction in an international environment. You will join a highly skilled and supportive team working with complex technical challenges, modern control systems, digitalization, and lifetime extension solutions for our installed fleet.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Lead and coordinate the electrical and control system scope in modernization and upgrading projects.
Develop a clear technical execution plan, define deliverables and interfaces, and drive activities from planning through commissioning.
Act as a key technical interface towards customers, project management, suppliers, commissioning teams, and internal engineering functions.
Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and ensure alignment between technical disciplines and project requirements.
Identify and manage technical risks, changed conditions, and complex engineering challenges throughout project execution.
Lead technical discussions and contribute to solutions that improve plant performance, reliability, availability, and sustainability.
Support modernization initiatives such as control system upgrades, system migrations, obsolescence management, digital solutions, and performance improvements.
Enable, motivate, and support project team members to achieve common goals and deliver successful project outcomes.
Contribute technical input to quotations and support the early definition of project scope, assumptions, and risks.

What You Bring
A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or equivalent relevant work experience.
Several years of experience in control system engineering, electrical engineering, commissioning, technical project leadership, or modernization projects.
Experience with industrial control systems such as Siemens Energy SPPA-T3000, PCS 7, PCS neo, DCS, PLC, or equivalent automation platforms is highly meritorious.
Experience from power generation, gas turbines, steam turbines, process industries, or other complex industrial environments is advantageous.
Experience from modernization, upgrade, migration, retrofit, or obsolescence management projects is considered a strong merit.
The ability to structure and drive technical work while managing several stakeholders and priorities.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to represent the technical scope in customer and project meetings.
A solution-oriented, responsible, flexible, and organized approach, combined with a strong desire to learn and develop.
A collaborative leadership style and an interest in enabling and supporting colleagues across functions and cultures.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

About the Team
You will be part of Siemens Energy’s Modifications & Upgrades organization, which delivers modernization, upgrade, and lifetime extension solutions for the installed fleet of gas and steam turbines.
Our work is performed in close collaboration with customers and colleagues across engineering, project management, sales, procurement, manufacturing, field service, and commissioning. We value technical curiosity, openness, teamwork, and continuous improvement, and we support each other in finding robust solutions to complex challenges.
Our Gas Services division provides service, modernization, digitalization, and decarbonization solutions for gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators.
What We Offer
A role with significant technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence projects from early definition to final delivery.
Work with advanced technology and challenging international projects in a collaborative environment.
Opportunities for professional development, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing within a skilled engineering community.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity

jobs.occupation: Registered nurses wanted for permanent positions in Agder, Southern Norway
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified nurse looking for a permanent position in Norway, with the opportunity to work in a nursing home or home care services?
On behalf of a municipality in Agder, Southern Norway, we are recruiting registered nurses for permanent positions within municipal healthcare services. These roles offer varied clinical responsibilities, independent nursing practice and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
You will work with patients who have different medical and care needs, contributing to safe, high-quality healthcare in a supportive professional environment.
The municipality is located approximately 30 minutes from the coastal town of Risør, surrounded by forests, lakes and beautiful countryside. Here, you can combine a rewarding nursing career with a quieter lifestyle and easy access to Norway’s southern coastline.
About the positions
The municipality provides a range of healthcare and care services, including nursing home care, short-term care, dementia care and home-based nursing services.
In the nursing home, you will care for patients who require round-the-clock nursing, treatment and medical follow-up. Your responsibilities may include general nursing care, dementia care and supporting patients with complex or long-term health conditions. The nursing home has long-term care units, short-term care beds and a dedicated unit for people living with dementia.
In home care services, you will provide nursing care and follow-up to patients living in their own homes or supported housing. You will carry out independent nursing assessments, provide medical treatment and help patients maintain their independence and quality of life.
In both settings, nurses work closely with healthcare assistants, doctors and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe and coordinated patient care.
Responsibilities
Your responsibilities may include:
Assessing, monitoring and evaluating patients’ health conditions
Administering medication and performing clinical procedures
Providing nursing care, treatment and follow-up for patients with acute and chronic conditions
Caring for elderly patients and people with dementia or complex healthcare needs
Collaborating with doctors, healthcare assistants and other healthcare professionals
Providing guidance and support to patients, relatives and colleagues
Maintaining accurate documentation in electronic patient record systems
Contributing to quality improvement and the development of healthcare services

Specific responsibilities will vary depending on the department and service. Further information about the workplace, duties, working hours and shift arrangements will be provided during the recruitment process.
Qualifications
EU/EEA citizenship and a valid nursing qualification and licence from an EU/EEA country
Norwegian nursing authorisation is required before starting work. We will guide you through the application process
Good English communication skills and motivation to learn Norwegian. Norwegian language training is provided
Good communication and teamwork skills
Ability to make independent nursing assessments and take clinical responsibility
Experience in nursing homes, elderly care or home care services is an advantage
A category B driving licence may be required, depending on the workplace
A satisfactory police certificate is required before starting work, in accordance with Norwegian regulations.

Who we are looking for
We are looking for dedicated and compassionate nurses who are confident in their clinical skills and comfortable taking responsibility for patient care.
You should enjoy working with patients who have different healthcare needs, communicate well with colleagues and contribute to a positive working environment.
We are particularly interested in candidates who are motivated to build a long-term nursing career in Norway and are open to relocating and settling in the municipality.
What we offer
Permanent nursing positions in nursing homes and home care services
Varied and meaningful clinical responsibilities
Collaboration with experienced healthcare professionals and opportunities for professional development
Salary and employment conditions to be agreed upon
Guidance through the Norwegian nursing authorisation process
Free online Norwegian language training with a dedicated private tutor.
Personal support from Dignus Medical throughout the recruitment process
Assistance with relocation and settling in Norway

Live and work in Southern Norway
Imagine living surrounded by forests and lakes, with plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors and Norway’s beautiful southern coastline just a short drive away.
The municipality is located in eastern Agder, approximately 30 minutes from Risør, a charming coastal town known for its traditional wooden houses, harbour and maritime atmosphere.
The surrounding area offers swimming spots, hiking trails, fishing lakes and forests where you can pick berries and mushrooms. During the summer, you can explore the archipelago, enjoy the cafés and restaurants along the waterfront in Risør or spend a day at one of the many beaches along the southern coast.
For those considering relocating with their families, the municipality offers kindergartens, schools and recreational activities for children. There is also a local shopping area with shops, restaurants and essential services.
Here, you can enjoy a peaceful countryside lifestyle while still having convenient access to coastal towns, everyday amenities and outdoor activities throughout the year.
Interested?
Contact us to learn more about the positions, the workplace and the recruitment process.
We look forward to hearing from you!

About the role
Great deliveries start with great teams. We’re looking for a People Partner who wants to help build both.
Based at Instabee’s HQ in Stockholm, you’ll partner with leaders across Customer Service and the other support functions within our Swedish organisation. From helping managers grow into confident leaders to shaping teams and making everyday people decisions, you’ll work close to the business and see the impact of what you do.
This is a broad, hands-on role with room to influence. You’ll move between longer-term priorities and the situations that need your attention today, bringing sound judgement, structure, and a practical approach to both.
Your future team
You’ll report directly to our Head of People Sweden and be part of the Swedish People team, alongside our Head of People and three People Partners supporting our operational organisation across Sweden. Together, you’ll share knowledge, tackle challenges, and develop how we work with People across the Swedish business. You’ll also be part of Instabee’s wider People & Culture team, collaborating with colleagues across our markets to exchange ideas, learn from each other, and bring shared People initiatives to life.
Some of the things you will do
Act as a trusted partner: Advise and challenge leaders, translating business needs into practical People initiatives.

Enable leadership: Coach managers in performance, feedback, team development, and everyday leadership.

Drive core People processes: Lead salary reviews, performance management, talent reviews, and engagement initiatives within your functions.

Lead change: Support workforce planning and organisational development, helping leaders and teams navigate new ways of working.

Manage employee relations: Guide leaders through employee matters, union dialogue, and negotiations in line with Swedish labour law and relevant collective agreements.

Strengthen the employee experience: Partner with Talent Acquisition and leaders on hiring, onboarding, and retention, while supporting a healthy and sustainable work environment.

What we’re looking for
You’re an experienced People professional who enjoys being close to the business. You can connect the bigger picture to a manager’s next decision, and you’re just as comfortable challenging a proposal as you are helping put it into practice.
You bring empathy, integrity, and the confidence to take a clear position. When priorities shift, you stay focused on what matters and help others move forward. You’re curious about how technology and data can improve the way we work, and you enjoy building solutions that people actually use.
We believe you bring:

At least 5 years of experience as a People Partner/HR Business Partner, independently supporting and advising leaders across a broad People agenda.

Strong practical knowledge of Swedish labour law and collective agreements, with experience independently managing complex employee relations matters and union negotiations.

Proven experience coaching and challenging managers, driving core People processes, and supporting organisational change.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence and judgement to influence decisions and balance business and employee needs.

A bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology, or a related field.

Fluency in Swedish and English.

What you’ll get
A role with real ownership, close access to business leaders, and the opportunity to shape how our Swedish organisation develops.
You’ll join a People team with colleagues to learn from, exchange ideas with, and tackle challenges alongside. There’s plenty to build and improve, and your ideas will have room to become action.
If you enjoy a quick pace, care about making leadership better, and want to see your work make a difference in a technology-enabled delivery business, we’d love to meet you.
Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:

🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.

👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.

🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!

⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.

Get to know us
Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.
This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

Job Description
Hej Software Engineer, 
Do you want to help shape the digital future of IKEA? 
With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to ask questions, share your ideas, learn from mistakes and grow together with others. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have opportunities to try things you haven’t done before, while contributing to digital solutions that support how IKEA brings products to life and creates a better everyday life for the many people. 
 
We are on a journey to modernize our landscape, and we are looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems together with others to join the Digital Product Area ‘Range Core - Requirements and Compliance’ within Technology at Inter IKEA, Range Operations. Here you will help develop digital solutions that support product development, manufacturing, suppliers and the movement of IKEA products through our global value chain.  
We believe good software is created by teams where people bring different perspectives, share knowledge, ask questions and learn together. You don’t need to know everything from day one. Curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to keep learning matter to us. 
We are growing our team in Malmö and looking for someone who enjoys working with people across different roles, teams, cultures and locations. 
Qualifications
Your new job 
We’re looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems and learning together with others. Your strengths might be in frontend or backend development, or somewhere in between. What matters to us is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in growing and contributing across the stack. 
You’ll join a cross-functional team building and maintaining digital products across the stack, from backend services, APIs, integrations and databases to web applications and user experiences. You’ll have opportunities to build on your strengths while developing your skills in other areas. Together, we experiment, share knowledge and continuously improve how we design, build, test and deliver software. 
Your work will have a global impact, helping co-workers, suppliers, and partners collaborate effectively and ensuring trusted IKEA products reach our customers. 
What we’d like you to bring to the table 
Experience building software solutions, with strengths in frontend, backend, or across the full stack.  
Experience with backend development using C#/.NET and REST APIs and/or frontend development using React, TypeScript or similar technologies.  
A good understanding of software design, data modelling, relational databases and building reliable, maintainable solutions.  
An ability to understand complex problems, break them down into manageable parts and work with others to find practical solutions. 
Experience with software testing and modern development practices, such as version control, continuous integration and automated delivery.  
Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure, GCP or AWS is valuable, but not essential.  
A collaborative mindset, curiosity and an interest in learning, sharing knowledge and improving together with your team.  
An interest in understanding the wider product and contributing beyond your main area of expertise. 

Additional Information
Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more! 
Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. 
Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career. 
We welcome your application 
Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 19th of November. Apply by submitting your CV. As part of the application process, you will be asked to answer a few screening questions. When answering the questions, please avoid relying on AI-generated responses.  
This position is based in Malmö, Sweden. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.  
Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter Monaka Perumal; monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com. 
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in Core Business Range and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB provided competence requirements are met for the role.

Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.
If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
Employment: Temporary, 12-24 months
Location: Boden
What you’ll do
Right now, we are looking for a Planner & Scheduler for our Planning & Scheduling team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support planning and scheduling activities for an assigned project area.
As Planner & Scheduler, you will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, Project Controls, EPCM partners, and contractors to maintain realistic and integrated schedules. You will help track progress, identify constraints and schedule risks, and provide reliable planning information to support project execution and decision-making.
Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

Develop, update, and maintain project schedules in line with project planning standards

Support the maintenance and integration of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for your assigned area

Review EPCM and contractor schedules and identify inconsistencies, missing logic, constraints, and potential impacts

Integrate schedule information from contractors, EPCM partners, and internal stakeholders

Monitor actual progress against planned activities and support schedule updates and forecasting

Analyze schedules to identify delays, trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities

Support mitigation and recovery planning when schedule challenges arise

Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, planning workshops, and weekly and monthly reporting

What you’ll bring
You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.
Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

3+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling or similar roles, preferably within industrial, construction, infrastructure, or EPCM projects

Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Project Controls, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good understanding of project planning and scheduling methodologies

Experience developing, updating, and analyzing project schedules

Understanding of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), schedule integration, progress measurement, and forecasting

Ability to review contractor and EPCM schedules and identify constraints, risks, and inconsistencies

Experience using relevant planning and scheduling tools

Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with fluency in English

Benefits at Stegra 
At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.
You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.
Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.
This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.
Our Boden Site
Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.
Boden Video

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
About the Role
As an Android Developer at the Operator Assistance department, you will be a part of a collaborative, enthusiastic team, developing intelligent safety systems that enable our operators to drive our machines safely in high-risk environments.
In our team we create innovative solutions where hardware, embedded software and deep learning come together to create our SmartView app. SmartView is our intelligent obstacle detection system that gives operators a 360° view of the machine’s surroundings. (More information on what you will work on: https://www.volvoce.com/sv-se/services/volvo-smart-view/ )
We work in an agile environment where the team collaborates to set direction, solve technical challenges, and continuously improve our solutions. In your role as an Android Developer, you will develop intuitive operator interfaces using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, integrate live camera feeds and machine data, and help bring AI-powered perception and safety alerts into our SmartView app. You will also troubleshoot and optimize the software to ensure reliable performance in demanding machine operating conditions.
If you are excited about making real difference in people’s lives and safety on your day-to-day work and seeing the impact of your innovative engineering, this job is for you!
Who are you?
You enjoy solving real-world problems through software development and are curious about how technology can make machines safer and smarter. You value collaboration, share ideas openly, and take ownership of your work.
You enjoy working in cross-functional teams, learning from others, and contributing to solutions in an international environment. You communicate effectively in English and are comfortable taking initiative, asking questions, and exploring new approaches to technical challenges.
Technical skills:
We are looking for someone with experience in Android development, particularly Kotlin and embedded systems. Experience with the following technologies is valuable:
Embedded Android development using Kotlin and C++
Android camera frameworks such as Camera2 or CameraX, or video streaming
CAN bus systems and machine data integration
CI/CD experience with pipelines
Working knowledge of the general mobile landscape, architectures, trends, and emerging technologies.
Edge AI frameworks knowledge, such as TensorFlow Lite or ONNX, particularly for vision or audio applications are an advantage
Knowledge in Sensor Fusion and Control Theory is an advantage

What’s in it for you?
This role is in our Eskilstuna site with our modern facilities, and you will be a part of our Technology Center, where you will have access to our exciting machines, have the opportunity to test what you develop and collaborate with all our stakeholders. At our Technology Center in Eskilstuna, you'll have opportunities to develop your technical expertise, explore new technologies, and grow your career within a large international organization.
In addition to technology and career opportunities, we offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, including flexible time, internal growth opportunities and compensation benefits such as Occupational pension – ITP (ITP1 & ITP2), profit sharing and company bonus. We value our employees’ well-being, work-life balance and having fun at work.
Ready for the next move?
If you are curious to explore how we put our words into actions, follow us on LinkedIn and volvogroup.com.
Last day to apply: 29th of November 2026
Location: Eskilstuna, Technology Center Headquarters, On-site
For questions about the position, please contact: Ceren Robinson, Head of Operator Assistance (ceren.robinson@volvo.com) or Olof Person, Talent Acquisition Partner(olof.person@volvo.com)
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.
We look forward to receiving your application!
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
Who we are and what we believe in 
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

Job Title: Financial Controller
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
 
 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
 
 
Role Summary
Do you enjoy combining financial expertise with collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement? As a Financial Controller within Group Reporting, you will have the opportunity to influence both the quality of Scania Group reporting and the way our finance processes develop over time.
You will be a trusted partner to finance teams around the world, helping them deliver accurate, timely, and compliant reporting. During the financial close, you will review and consolidate submissions, analyse outcomes, and resolve reporting issues together with the business. Between closings, you will have room to look ahead: improving processes, strengthening controls, developing reporting structures, and exploring how AI and automation can improve finance processes, decision support, and ways of working. This is a role where precision matters, but where curiosity, initiative, and the ability to bring people together are just as important.
 
Job Responsibilities
·      Review, validation, and consolidation of financial submissions from entities, ensuring accurate mappings, high data quality, and timely reporting in HFM.
·      Guide reporting entities through month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing, helping them interpret requirements and resolve issues in a practical and constructive way.
·      Turn complex financial information into clear insights through analytical reviews, variance analysis, and quality-assurance activities.
·      Share your expertise in IFRS, Group accounting policies, reporting instructions, financial models, and reporting systems through day-to-day support and training.
·      Drive improvements that make reporting simpler, more efficient, and more robust, including the responsible use of AI and automation, documentation, standards, internal controls, reporting structures, and master data.
·      Contribute to planning and forecast reporting, system governance, account mappings, change requests, finance transformation initiatives, and ad-hoc analysis.
 
Who You Are
You are someone who takes pride in delivering high-quality work and who enjoys making complicated topics easier for others to understand. You are analytical and attentive to detail, yet able to step back and see the bigger picture. Colleagues experience you as collaborative, dependable, and solution-oriented. You are comfortable taking ownership, asking the right questions, and turning identified issues into lasting improvements.

We believe you will bring:
·      A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
·      Several years of experience in financial controlling, Group reporting, consolidation, or audit, preferably in a large international organization.
·      Solid knowledge of IFRS, consolidated financial statements, Group accounting policies, and financial closing processes.
·      Hands-on experience with HFM or another consolidation or financial reporting system. 
·      Clear and confident communication skills in English, together with the ability to build trust across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.
·      An AI-oriented and improvement-driven mindset, with curiosity about how AI can be applied responsibly to simplify finance processes, strengthen quality, and create better insights. Previous experience with AI, automation, or finance transformation is a strong advantage.

This Is Us
 
You will join Group Reporting within Corporate Control at Scania’s head office in Södertälje. Our work connects local finance teams with Group-level reporting, which gives you broad exposure to Scania’s international operations and a strong professional network across the organization.
You will become part of a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared and new ideas are welcomed. The role offers a varied rhythm: focused teamwork during reporting periods and meaningful opportunities between closings to improve processes, controls, systems, and financial models, including identifying valuable and responsible applications of AI in finance. Your contribution will be visible in the reliability of our financial information and in how effectively we work together across the Group.

Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
 
Application
Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-13. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Group Manager, Fredrik Pasia, fredrik.pasia@scania.com

jobs.occupation: Product Manager MEKO Denmark  – Heavy Commercial Vehicles
jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Do you have a strong background in heavy commercial vehicles, spare parts or technical aftermarket operations? Are you interested in developing your career within product management while working in an international organization?
This could be an opportunity to take the next step.

MEKO is looking for a Product Manager to support the continued expansion of its Commercial Vehicle Division under its FTZ brand in Denmark.

You will contribute to the development of product groups within trucks, trailers and buses, combining your technical industry knowledge with practical product management and commercial coordination.

We welcome candidates from both Denmark and Southern Sweden. Previous experience as a Product Manager is valuable but not essential. What matters most is your understanding of commercial vehicles and the motivation to develop within a growing business.

Your responsibilities

As Product Manager, you will be part of MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division and work closely with the Danish FTZ Truck & Trailer organization.

You will support the development of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, helping ensure the right assortment, pricing and product information are available to meet customer needs and commercial objectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

•	Identifying and supporting new product launches and assortment development initiatives.
•	Preparing sourcing requirements and request-for-quotation material, as well as evaluating products together with colleagues in other MEKO markets.
•	Coordinating product introductions, replacements and phase-outs.
•	Managing product data and maintaining information in catalogues and PIM systems.
•	Monitoring competitor offerings and contributing to pricing and assortment decisions.
•	Following up on product performance, price levels, returns, obsolescence and opportunities for assortment improvements.
•	Providing technical product knowledge and supporting the sales organization in product-related matters.
•	Working with suppliers, category management, logistics and other internal stakeholders to maintain a competitive product offering.

The position combines day-to-day operational responsibilities with opportunities to participate in broader commercial and category management activities.

You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles in Denmark and colleagues within the wider MEKO CV organization. Strategic category direction and additional support are provided by the responsible Group Category Manager.

This is an individual contributor role without personnel responsibility.


Din Profil

Your profile

We are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical and practical side of the heavy commercial vehicle industry.

You might currently be working as a Spare Parts Specialist, Parts Manager, Technical Sales Representative, Product Specialist, Workshop Coordinator or Product Manager. Your current title is less important than your experience and knowledge.

A background from truck and trailer workshops, spare parts distribution, fleet maintenance, agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may be relevant.

We believe you bring:

•	Strong knowledge of commercial vehicles, components, spare parts and their applications.
•	Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work.
•	Good computer skills and the ability to work in a structured way with product information.
•	An interest in developing analytical, commercial and product management skills.
•	Initiative, curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with others.
•	Good communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.
It is advantageous if you also have:
•	Previous experience in product management, assortment development or technical purchasing.
•	Experience with Excel, ERP or PIM systems.
•	Experience analyzing product information, sales data or market developments.
•	Danish language skills or knowledge of other Nordic languages.
•	A post-secondary technical education.

Your understanding of trucks, trailers and heavy-duty components, combined with your motivation and willingness to learn, will be central to your success.


Om företaget

About MEKO

MEKO is Northern Europe's largest player in the automotive aftermarket, with approximately 600 stores, 20,000 workshop customers and 4,600 workshops across eight countries, operating through strong brands such as Mekonomen, MECA and FTZ.

The Group drives development in digitalization, AI and logistics, offering smart and sustainable solutions for vehicle service and spare parts. MEKO's vision is to enable mobility – today, tomorrow and in the future.
In Denmark, MEKO operates through FTZ, a well-established name in the Danish automotive aftermarket. The Commercial Vehicle Division is an expanding business area with a focus on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications.

As part of the team, you will work in a dynamic international environment with experienced technical and commercial colleagues, contributing to the development of a business with strong growth ambitions.

Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.


Kontaktuppgifter

Contact

In this recruitment, MEKO Danmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.

We look forward to your application!

Arbetsbeskrivning

FTZ | Rørup, Denmark

Join FTZ and help develop our growing Heavy Commercial Vehicles business
FTZ is looking for a Product Manager to strengthen our expanding Commercial Vehicle Division in Denmark. In this role, you will work with product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, including trucks, trailers and buses, and contribute to developing an attractive and competitive product offering for the Danish aftermarket.

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of commercial vehicles and their components, combined with an interest in product management and commercial development. Whether your background is in product management, spare parts, technical sales or workshop operations, your industry knowledge and motivation could make you the right person for this opportunity.

You will join a growing business area where you can make a real impact, working closely with experienced colleagues both locally and across the MEKO Group.

Your responsibilities

As Product Manager at FTZ, you will work within MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division, supporting the development and management of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles.
Based on sales and profitability objectives, you will collaborate with colleagues to ensure that the right product range, competitive pricing and accurate product information are in place, while maintaining close dialogue with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

•	Identifying, initiating and supporting projects for the launch of new products.
•	Preparing request-for-quotation material and product specifications for sourcing, and evaluating products in cooperation with colleagues across MEKO countries.
•	Managing product phase-in and phase-out activities.
•	Maintaining and administering product information in catalogues and PIM systems.
•	Monitoring competitors and supporting pricing activities.
•	Following up on product assortments, price levels, product performance and relevant actions related to obsolescence, returns and assortment changes.
•	Acting as a product expert within your areas and supporting the sales organization with technical knowledge.
•	Contributing to the development of an attractive and competitive product offering for customers.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining operational product management with opportunities to contribute to commercial development. You will have regular contact with suppliers, sales teams, product colleagues and logistics functions.

You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles and the Group Category Manager, who provides strategic category direction and support. The position does not include personnel management.


Din Profil

Your profile

Your understanding of Heavy Commercial Vehicles and their components is the most important qualification for this position.

We are looking for someone with relevant experience from trucks, trailers, buses or a closely related heavy-duty industry. You may currently work in product management, spare parts, technical sales, workshop operations, parts distribution or a similar role. Experience from agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may also be relevant.

To succeed in the role, we believe you have:

•	Solid practical knowledge of commercial vehicles, their components and applications.
•	Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work 
•	Good computer literacy and the willingness to work extensively with digital product information and systems.
•	A structured, service-minded and proactive approach to your work.
•	An interest in product development, assortment management and commercial opportunities.
•	Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and countries.
•	Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

The following qualifications are considered advantages rather than requirements:

•	Previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Specialist or Category Manager.
•	Experience with Excel, ERP systems such as AX or Enterprise, or Product Information Management (PIM).
•	Strong analytical skills and experience working with product or sales data.
•	Danish or other Nordic language skills.
•	Post-secondary technical education.

What matters is your technical understanding, your motivation and your willingness to develop your product management capabilities.


Om företaget

About FTZ

FTZ is one of Denmark's leading automotive aftermarket distributors, supplying spare parts, tools and solutions to professional workshops and automotive businesses.

As part of the MEKO Group, FTZ combines its strong position in Denmark with the expertise, purchasing capabilities and international network of one of Northern Europe's leading automotive aftermarket groups.

The Commercial Vehicle Division is a growing business area focused on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications. You will join an organization with strong technical and commercial competence, close cooperation across countries and opportunities to contribute to the continued expansion of the business.

MEKO operates across eight European countries through established brands, including FTZ, Mekonomen and MECA. The Group drives development in digitalization, logistics and sustainable mobility solutions, with a vision to enable mobility today, tomorrow and in the future.

Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.


Kontaktuppgifter

In this recruitment, FTZ Denmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.

We look forward to your application!

. Mips gives you the confidence to follow your passion. Whether you are training for fitness, riding to work, heading out on the mountain or playing team sports, our mission is leading the world to safer helmets. Mips specializes in helmet-based safety and is a world-leader in this area. Based on an ingredient brand business-model, Mips’ safety system is sold to the global helmet industry. The technology is based on over 25 years of research and development together with the Royal Institute of Technology and the Karolinska Institute, both located in Stockholm, Sweden. Mips’ headquarter with 84 employees engaged in research and development, sales, marketing and administration is in Stockholm, where its product and technology test facility also is located. The Mips share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Large Cap.  For more information: www.mipscorp.com 2025, Mips announced its acquisition of KOROYD, strengthening the company’s world-leading helmet safety technology portfolio with complementary technology. Recognizing the potential synergies between the two brands and their respective technologies, Mips and KOROYD will continue to operate separately under their respective leadership teams.  www.koroyd.com
As Mips grows across brands, markets and channels, digital is becoming a central driver of commercial value. We are now looking for a Digital Lead to own our digital agenda and turn it into one clear strategy, one operating model and a well-directed investment portfolio.
The roleYou set the direction for how digital creates commercial value across brands, markets and channels, you decide where the digital investment goes, and you lead the team and partners who deliver it. You are part of the marketing leadership team, with a group-level mandate across both Mips and Koroyd. Your mission is to build a unified digital strategy that bridges the gap between B2B ingredient branding and B2C consumer pull.
What you will do 
Set the digital strategy and roadmap. Define the multi-year strategy, anchored in company strategy and the commercial plan, and translate business objectives into priorities, targets and a prioritized portfolio of initiatives.
Own the digital ecosystem for Mips and Koroyd. Paid media, website, social media, SEO, ambassador and influencer marketing, and e-commerce campaigns. Set targets and KPIs per channel and decide on reallocation across the mix, while each brand keeps its own distinct presence and tone of voice.
Own the digital investment. Be responsible for the total digital investment across media, platforms, technology, agencies and resources. Set business cases and return requirements, propose the annual budget and own in-year reallocation, with a clear cost-efficiency and ROI focus.
Lead data, marketing technology and AI. Own the marketing technology stack and the data, measurement and attribution model behind all reporting and optimization. Set the AI agenda across search and generative engine optimization, AI-assisted shopping and product discovery across our digital ecosystem, and AI-driven content and campaign production.
Set governance and manage risk. Establish decision rights, standards and quality gates, and own digital risk and compliance together with Legal, including privacy, consent, accessibility and platform policy.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

What really drives our growth, and what should we do next? Help us find out.
Why does a customer turn down an offer that would save them money? Which product should we launch next? In what marketing channel should we scale spend? You’ll ask the right questions, find the answers, put a number on them and make sure we act.
If you want your analysis to shape where we grow, we should talk.
The foundation is built. Now it needs to grow.
Anyfin helps people pay less for the loans they already have. We only make an offer if we can lower someone's total cost. Since 2017 we've helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We're profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we're getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030.
Every one of those steps raises a question: which product, which market, which change to the customer journey makes the biggest difference? Growing well depends on answering them properly.
The team is small and intentionally so. We'd rather have fewer people who care about doing things properly and move fast because they trust each other. If you join, you won't disappear into a big org. You'll shape what we build and where we go next.
The actual job
You'll join our Commercial team within Growth and work across both business and product. One week you're digging into why customers drop off in the app. Next you're building the case for a new product or market.
You'll own the funnel. That covers web and app, from first visit to payout. You'll find where and why customers drop off, put a number on the opportunity and recommend what to fix first.
You'll come up with new bets. These could be new products, features, loyalty or cross-sell. You'll build the business case, test it and tell us whether it's worth pursuing.
You'll work out what brings customers back. That means understanding how customer value grows over time and what we can do to grow it.
You'll help shape decisions. You'll present clear recommendations to teams and management, helping them understand the opportunity, the trade-offs and what we should do next.
Analysis in an AI-native company
AI isn't a side tool here. It's built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models.
For an analyst, that means you can go further and faster than before. You can write queries, explore data and test hypotheses with tools like Claude at your side. It also means more answers that sound confident and might be wrong.
Part of this role is knowing the difference. We want someone who uses AI to go deeper, and who still questions the data, the assumptions and the AI-generated answer before drawing a conclusion.
The people
You'll work closely with people who enjoy getting into a problem and figuring out what to do about it. They're generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when they learn something new.
You'll have room to take initiative and people to think things through with. Some ideas will work, others won't. We try things, learn from the results and use that to make the next decision better.
This sounds like you if…
You have an MSc in engineering, business, finance or a similar quantitative field.
You have experience in product, growth or business analytics, ideally in a consumer business. You write strong SQL, and you know how to design an A/B test and how to tell when one is lying to you.
You can take an open question all the way to a clear recommendation. You connect product metrics to what actually happens for customers and to what it's worth for the business.
You're hungry and curious, and you want to own real problems rather than answer someone else's tickets.
We care more about what you can do, your judgment and your drive than a specific number of years. Experience in fintech or consumer lending is a plus, and so is Swedish, Finnish or German. Fluent English is required.
More than anything, you can tell us about an analysis that changed what a company did. Not just what you found, but what happened because of it.
A few practical notes
You’ll be based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm. We work from the office because we value the collaboration, shared learning and team spirit that come from spending time together.
We interview on a rolling basis and would love for you to join us as soon as possible. EU work authorisation is required.
Want to see your analysis turn into real improvements for our customers? We’d love to hear from you.

VisFlow transforms complex technical processes, system flows and operational knowledge into clear, visual and interconnected representations. The platform enables teams to understand, manage and scale advanced systems throughout their entire lifecycle — from development and deployment to operations and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity
We are now looking for experienced engineers within systems engineering, hardware integration, test infrastructure, lab environments, system integration, verification and qualification for advanced technical assignments in complex and security-critical environments.
You may work in the development of next-generation defence, electronic warfare, communication or other advanced technical systems, where prototypes, integration environments, reference systems and verification activities play a central role in bringing complex solutions from concept to qualified product.
These roles are suited for engineers who enjoy working close to the technology, combining structured engineering methods with hands-on problem-solving in multidisciplinary environments.

Current Focus Areas

As a HW Systems Engineer, you may be part of a subsystem team responsible for developing core components of advanced technical systems. Your focus will be systems engineering activities related to hardware integration, testing, verification and qualification.
You will work closely with design, test and system stakeholders, ensuring that insights from prototype testing and integration activities are fed back into design decisions, system requirements and verification plans.

Performing systems engineering activities, including requirements updates and test case definition
Supporting hardware prototype integration and hands-on testing
Troubleshooting hardware issues during integration and test phases
Capturing test results and technical feedback to refine design and system requirements
Supporting formal hardware verification and qualification activities
Collaborating with internal teams, suppliers and external stakeholders
Contributing to structured documentation, traceability and lifecycle governance

Supporting planning, preparation and execution of system integration and verification activities
Contributing to integration, verification and validation strategies
Ensuring strong configuration management, structure and traceability in test environments
Participating in integration, troubleshooting and technical problem-solving when needed
Developing methods, ways of working and technical solutions within test and verification
Collaborating with development teams, delivery projects and other technical functions
