MSc / Civil Engineering degree in Electronics, Engineering Physics, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field
Several years of experience within systems engineering, test, verification, system integration or hardware-focused product development
Experience with requirements management and systems engineering processes
Experience with hardware integration, testing or verification
Experience establishing, developing or maintaining lab environments, reference systems or test infrastructure
Good understanding of system design and system integration processes
Ability to work in both structured engineering processes and hands-on technical environments
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English

RF and microwave technologies
Hardware-near systems

Defence, aerospace or other security-critical systems
EMC, environmental testing or system qualification
Configuration management in complex system environments
Formal verification and validation
Technical leadership or coordination of technical teams

Requirements tools, test management tools or lifecycle management platforms

jobs.occupation: Gör teknik begriplig – Technical Writer/ Teknikinformatör på Saab Dynamics
jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera ditt teknikintresse med din förmåga att skriva tydligt och pedagogiskt? Hos Saab Dynamics i Boden får du skapa dokumentation som hjälper människor att använda och underhålla avancerade system på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på hur teknik fungerar och som tycker om att göra komplex information begriplig. Du kan vara en erfaren teknikinformatör eller ha en annan relevant bakgrund och vilja utvecklas inom teknisk dokumentation.
 
Din roll
Du tar fram teknisk dokumentation för digitala ledningsstödsystem som används av Försvarsmakten. Systemen omfattar bland annat datorer, nätverk och radio- och kommunikationsutrustning på olika typer av fordon, båtar och soldatsystem.
Din uppgift är att omvandla tekniskt underlag och kunskap från våra experter till tydliga manualer och instruktioner. Dokumentationen hjälper operatörer och tekniker att förstå, använda och underhålla systemen – och är en viktig del av den lösning vi levererar till kunden.
Du arbetar nära systemingenjörer, konstruktörer, projektledare, produktledare och användare. Du driver dina egna uppgifter och är samtidigt en del av ett team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är viktiga delar av vardagen.
 
Det här kommer du att arbeta med
Samla in och analysera tekniskt underlag i dialog med sakkunniga.
Strukturera och skriva användarmanualer, instruktioner och underhållsdokumentation.
Granska och kvalitetssäkra innehåll tillsammans med tekniska experter.
Anpassa informationen efter användarnas behov och förkunskaper.
Uppdatera dokumentationen när systemen utvecklas eller förändras.
Bidra till att förbättra våra arbetssätt, metoder och dokumentationsprocesser.

Vi producerar dokumentation på svenska och engelska i en XML-baserad miljö enligt S1000D, en internationell specifikation för strukturerad teknisk dokumentation.
 
Det här får du möjlighet till
Hos oss arbetar du nära både tekniken och människorna som kan den. Du får fördjupa din tekniska förståelse, utveckla din kompetens inom teknikinformation och vara med och påverka hur vi arbetar med dokumentation.
Framför allt får du skapa information som fyller en konkret funktion: att ge användarna rätt förutsättningar att lösa sina uppgifter. Ditt arbete bidrar till Saabs uppdrag att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen – Keeping People and Society Safe.
 
Din profil
Du har ett teknikintresse och en god förmåga att sätta dig in i hur produkter och system fungerar. Du skriver tydligt och strukturerat och tycker om att förklara sådant som andra kan uppleva som komplicerat.
Din bakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom teknisk dokumentation, ingenjörsarbete, teknisk utbildning, support eller service och underhåll. Du kan ha en relevant utbildning eller ha byggt upp motsvarande kunskaper genom arbete.
För att lyckas i rollen behöver du
Kunna uttrycka dig mycket väl på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
Kunna analysera och strukturera teknisk information.
Arbeta noggrant och vilja säkerställa att informationen är korrekt och användbar.
Trivas med att samarbeta och ställa frågor till personer med olika kompetenser.

Du behöver inte kunna våra system från början. Däremot vill vi att du är nyfiken, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och vill lära dig mer.
Erfarenheter som är meriterande
Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med något av följande, men det är inte ett krav:
Teknisk dokumentation, exempelvis användarmanualer eller underhållsinstruktioner.
S1000D eller Simplified Technical English, STE.
XML-baserade publiceringsmiljöer eller innehållshanteringssystem, CMS, exempelvis UPTIME.
Teknisk illustration eller bildbearbetning i Adobe Illustrator eller Photoshop.
Försvarsmakten, FMV eller dokumentation i verksamheter med höga krav på kvalitet och spårbarhet.

Vi välkomnar både dig som är i början av karriären och dig som har flera års relevant erfarenhet.
Placering och resor
Tjänsten är placerad i Boden. Resor förekommer i arbetet.
 
Befattningen kräver
Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassning kan, i förekommande fall, krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma.
 
Ansökan
Saab Dynamics har valt att samarbeta med AxÖ Consulting för denna rekrytering. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Per Nyqvist, Saab Dynamics, 073 – 446 86 38 eller rekryteringskonsult Maria Josefsson, AxÖ Consulting, 070 – 842 23 35.
Urvalsprocessen sker löpande och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas före ansökningstidens utgång, så ansök gärna så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag 25 november.
Ansökan endast via länk intill.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – här får du möjlighet att göra skillnad.
 
Vad du blir en del av

jobs.occupation: Gör teknik begriplig – Technical Writer/ Teknikinformatör på Saab Dynamics
jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera ditt teknikintresse med din förmåga att skriva tydligt och pedagogiskt? Hos Saab Dynamics i Boden får du skapa dokumentation som hjälper människor att använda och underhålla avancerade system på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på hur teknik fungerar och som tycker om att göra komplex information begriplig. Du kan vara en erfaren teknikinformatör eller ha en annan relevant bakgrund och vilja utvecklas inom teknisk dokumentation.
 
Din roll
Du tar fram teknisk dokumentation för digitala ledningsstödsystem som används av Försvarsmakten. Systemen omfattar bland annat datorer, nätverk och radio- och kommunikationsutrustning på olika typer av fordon, båtar och soldatsystem.
Din uppgift är att omvandla tekniskt underlag och kunskap från våra experter till tydliga manualer och instruktioner. Dokumentationen hjälper operatörer och tekniker att förstå, använda och underhålla systemen – och är en viktig del av den lösning vi levererar till kunden.
Du arbetar nära systemingenjörer, konstruktörer, projektledare, produktledare och användare. Du driver dina egna uppgifter och är samtidigt en del av ett team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är viktiga delar av vardagen.
 
Det här kommer du att arbeta med
Samla in och analysera tekniskt underlag i dialog med sakkunniga.
Strukturera och skriva användarmanualer, instruktioner och underhållsdokumentation.
Granska och kvalitetssäkra innehåll tillsammans med tekniska experter.
Anpassa informationen efter användarnas behov och förkunskaper.
Uppdatera dokumentationen när systemen utvecklas eller förändras.
Bidra till att förbättra våra arbetssätt, metoder och dokumentationsprocesser.

Vi producerar dokumentation på svenska och engelska i en XML-baserad miljö enligt S1000D, en internationell specifikation för strukturerad teknisk dokumentation.
 
Det här får du möjlighet till
Hos oss arbetar du nära både tekniken och människorna som kan den. Du får fördjupa din tekniska förståelse, utveckla din kompetens inom teknikinformation och vara med och påverka hur vi arbetar med dokumentation.
Framför allt får du skapa information som fyller en konkret funktion: att ge användarna rätt förutsättningar att lösa sina uppgifter. Ditt arbete bidrar till Saabs uppdrag att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen – Keeping People and Society Safe.
 
Din profil
Du har ett teknikintresse och en god förmåga att sätta dig in i hur produkter och system fungerar. Du skriver tydligt och strukturerat och tycker om att förklara sådant som andra kan uppleva som komplicerat.
Din bakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom teknisk dokumentation, ingenjörsarbete, teknisk utbildning, support eller service och underhåll. Du kan ha en relevant utbildning eller ha byggt upp motsvarande kunskaper genom arbete.
För att lyckas i rollen behöver du
Kunna uttrycka dig mycket väl på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
Kunna analysera och strukturera teknisk information.
Arbeta noggrant och vilja säkerställa att informationen är korrekt och användbar.
Trivas med att samarbeta och ställa frågor till personer med olika kompetenser.

Du behöver inte kunna våra system från början. Däremot vill vi att du är nyfiken, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och vill lära dig mer.
Erfarenheter som är meriterande
Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med något av följande, men det är inte ett krav:
Teknisk dokumentation, exempelvis användarmanualer eller underhållsinstruktioner.
S1000D eller Simplified Technical English, STE.
XML-baserade publiceringsmiljöer eller innehållshanteringssystem, CMS, exempelvis UPTIME.
Teknisk illustration eller bildbearbetning i Adobe Illustrator eller Photoshop.
Försvarsmakten, FMV eller dokumentation i verksamheter med höga krav på kvalitet och spårbarhet.

Vi välkomnar både dig som är i början av karriären och dig som har flera års relevant erfarenhet.
Placering och resor
Tjänsten är placerad i Boden. Resor förekommer i arbetet.
 
Befattningen kräver
Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassning kan, i förekommande fall, krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma.
 
Ansökan
Saab Dynamics har valt att samarbeta med AxÖ Consulting för denna rekrytering. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Per Nyqvist, Saab Dynamics, 073 – 446 86 38 eller rekryteringskonsult Maria Josefsson, AxÖ Consulting, 070 – 842 23 35.

Ansökan endast via länk intill.

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Engineer – Alloy Design and Materials Performance
jobs.description:
Advancing specialty steel through research and innovation 
From metallurgical research to real-world applicationsDeveloping specialty steel for demanding applications requires a deep understanding of materials, a curiosity to investigate complex problems and the ability to turn scientific findings into practical solutions. At Ovako, this also means working with customers to understand their challenges and exploring how steel can help them develop new products, improve performance and bring new ideas to life. 
As a leading European producer of specialty steel, Ovako combines more than 300 years of industrial expertise with modern technology and a strong commitment to sustainability. As part of Nippon Steel, the company also benefits from an international network of metallurgical knowledge. 
Ovako is looking for a Senior R&D Engineer with expertise in alloy design and materials performance to strengthen its R&D organisation in Hofors, Sweden. 
This role offers the opportunity to combine advanced metallurgical research with customer-driven industrial development. You will investigate how steel composition and processing influence material properties, develop new alloy concepts and tackle complex challenges arising from real applications. Working closely with customers and sales, you will help translate specific performance requirements into material solutions, gaining insight into a range of industries and seeing how your research contributes to customers’ development journeys. 
About the roleAs a Senior R&D Engineer, you will drive research activities in alloy design, steel development and materials performance, combining computational modelling, experimental investigations and collaboration with external research partners. 
Approximately 60% of your time will be dedicated to customer projects. You will investigate material behaviour, assess application requirements and develop steel solutions to meet demanding performance needs. The challenges will vary across applications and industries, giving you the opportunity to apply your scientific expertise to a broad range of practical problems. You will also support product development at Ovako’s production mills, helping connect customer requirements, material performance and industrial processes. 
Collaboration with universities and research institutes is an important part of the role, alongside participation in nationally and internationally funded research projects. You will have opportunities to expand your technical network through research partnerships, conferences and occasional travel to research institutes and other Ovako sites in Europe. 
Your responsibilities 
Developing new steel grades and alloy concepts, from composition to processing route 
Computational alloy design using Thermo-Calc and related tools 
Planning and evaluating corrosion testing data and hydrogen embrittlement investigations 
Driving nationally and internationally funded research projects and consortia 
Collaborating with universities and institutes, including supervision of students 
Supporting sales and customers with qualified answers on material behaviour and selection 
Identifying new research directions that strengthen Ovako's product portfolio and long-term competitiveness 

The position is placed in Hofors, Sweden, with possibilities to work 2 days a week from home.  
Your profileYou are a scientifically driven metallurgist or materials scientist who enjoys exploring the mechanisms behind material behaviour and applying research to complex industrial challenges. You are motivated by understanding why materials behave the way they do and using that knowledge to develop solutions to problems without obvious answers. 
We are looking for someone with: 
A PhD in metallurgy or materials science, with a strong focus on steels and metallic materials. 
At least three years of research experience after your PhD, gained at a university, company R&D centre or research institute. 
Documented expertise in steel alloy design, including hands-on experience with Thermo-Calc. 
Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to explain complex technical findings to different audiences, including customers. 

You should also have experience in nationally or internationally funded research collaborations. 
Meritorious experience:Experience from research or development projects related to corrosion of metallic materials and hydrogen embrittlement of steels is considered an advantage, as these topics represent important current and future challenges within several of Ovako’s research collaborations and customer-driven development projects. 
Who are you?You are curious, analytical and persistent in your approach to research. You enjoy challenging established assumptions, investigating mechanisms and building the evidence needed to understand complex materials problems. 
You combine scientific rigour with a collaborative mindset. You communicate clearly, share knowledge and work effectively with colleagues, customers, production teams and external research partners. 
Ovako's core values are Innovative, Skilled and Responsible. The company looks for people who demonstrate these values through their expertise, curiosity and commitment to continuous improvement. 
Why Ovako?At Ovako, you will work with advanced specialty steel in an environment where scientific research meets real industrial challenges. You will collaborate with experienced specialists, customers, universities and research institutes, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and contribute to the development of future steel solutions. 
As part of Nippon Steel, you will also benefit from an international network of metallurgical knowledge and research collaboration. 
Application and information
This recruitment is managed by AxÖ Consulting on behalf of Ovako. If you have any questions please contact the responsible recruitment consultants for this process:
Emma Domare emma.domare@axoconsulting.se
Fiddelie Nyvall fiddelie.nyvall@axoconsulting.se

Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.
If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
What you'll do
Right now, we are looking for a Process Engineer – Direct Reduction for our Green Iron Operations. The team is responsible for optimizing process performance, supporting safe and stable operations, and driving continuous improvements across our hydrogen production and direct reduction plants.
Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very few silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

Provide day-to-day process engineering support to ensure safe, stable, and efficient plant operations.

Monitor plant performance, troubleshoot process upsets, and lead root cause analyses to improve reliability and operational excellence.

Optimize process performance through process modelling, heat and mass balances, debottlenecking, and energy efficiency initiatives.

Support direct reduction operations during commissioning, start-ups, shutdowns, and operational changes.

Review and develop engineering documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, SOPs, and process control strategies.

Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, and OEM partners to improve process performance and implement engineering solutions.

Drive continuous improvement projects, monitor production KPIs, and prepare technical reports to support data-driven decision-making.

Promote safe operations by supporting process safety activities, hydrogen safety standards, PTW/LOTO compliance, and technical training.

What you'll bring
You're curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You're not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking—and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.
Specific to this role, we'd like to see that you bring:

A degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.

Solid process engineering experience from an operating, commercial-scale Direct Reduction plant.

Experience supporting commissioning, start-ups, process optimization, or operational improvements in an industrial setting.

A strong understanding of process engineering fundamentals, with the ability to analyse complex systems and turn insights into practical solutions.

Experience with hydrogen production is a plus. Curiosity about the hydrogen process and a willingness to learn are important.

Confidence working across disciplines and collaborating with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Engineering, and external partners to achieve shared goals.

A proactive, structured, and safety-first approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.

Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Benefits at Stegra 
At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.
You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.
Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.
This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.
Our Boden Site
Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.
Boden Video

The department's activities are conducted at two main locations: Natrium on Medicinaregatan 7B in Gothenburg, and the Kristineberg Marine Research Station in Fiskebäckskil. The current position is located at the premises in Gothenburg, which is where Herbarium GB is situated. The latter hosts more than one million specimens from around the world (~60% imaged; ~28% with digitized metadata) and forms part of a global network of almost 4,000 herbaria.
Subject area 
Botany, specializing in vascular plant systematics.
Subject area description 
Vascular plant systematics is the scientific study of the diversity, evolutionary relationships, and taxonomy of vascular plants. In the 21st century, systematics is a highly integrative discipline, one that engages a diversity of data types and methodologies, and has strong connections to evolutionary biology, ecology, and conservation biology. For this position we seek a plant systematist having competence in the tools of modern systematics, a strong interest in natural history collections, and whose research makes first-hand use of material housed in such collections.
 
Duties 
This associate senior lectureship initially comprises 60% research and teaching in botany and 40% curation of the vascular plant collections at Herbarium GB. The curation component comprises contribution to strategic development of the collections, basic curation, and curation-related research.
Teaching and research tasks include:
Development of and engagement with a sustained, substantive, and productive research program focusing on vascular plants. A significant component of the research should be collections-based, making use of herbarium material.
Building and leading a research group, including applying for external research funding and publishing in high-quality scientific journals.
Teaching topics in plant taxonomy, systematics, and related subjects at undergraduate and graduate levels. This includes lecturing, coordination of practical exercises, course leadership, and project supervision.
Supervising doctoral students.
Participation in the development and renewal of teaching, in both content and form.
Development of collaborations with other research groups at University of Gothenburg and with researchers at other institutions. The department is especially keen to strengthen its collaboration with the Gothenburg Botanical Garden, with respect to research, teaching, and collection management.
Participation in and development of societal collaboration projects.

Curation tasks include:
Participation in the development of strategic goals and drafting of grant applications for Herbarium GB.
Curation and development of the vascular plant collections in Herbarium GB.
Execution and publication of research relating to or arising from curation activities.
Promoting integration of Herbarium GB into university- and botanic garden-based teaching, research, and community activities.
Support of digitization and database cataloguing in line with international standards for specimen data.
Support of visiting researchers and promoting collaboration with national and international institutions.

 
Eligibility 
Eligibility for employment as an associate senior lecturer is regulated by the Higher Education Ordinance and the University of Gothenburg's employment regulations.
To be eligible for appointment as an associate senior lecturer, the applicant must have been awarded a PhD or has the corresponding research expertise. Primary consideration should be given to a person who has been awarded a PhD or achieved the equivalent expertise within seven years of the deadline for application for employment as an associate senior lecturer. However, a person who has been awarded a PhD or achieved equivalent expertise at an earlier date may also be considered if there are exceptional circumstances. Exceptional circumstances are sick leave, parental leave, or other similar circumstances. 
Ability to teach in English is a requirement.
Assessment criteria 
The assessment criteria for appointment as associate senior lecturer are governed by the Higher Education Ordinance and the Appointments Procedure for Teachers at the University of Gothenburg. We seek candidates who have demonstrated the ability to independently initiate, develop, and conduct high-quality research within the subject area of the position. For appointment as an associate senior lecturer at the Faculty of Science and Technology, academic and teaching qualifications must be adequate in relation to the subject content and job description of the advertised position.
For this position, emphasis is placed on research qualifications and expertise, particularly in herbarium specimen-based research, with curation skills considered to be of similar importance. The assessment categories of collaboration with the wider community and management and administrative expertise are considered advantageous.
The assessment of research and curation skills includes
Proficiency in vascular plant systematics, taxonomy, and nomenclature, as evidenced by publications and participation in scientific conferences.
Experience of herbarium curation and/or collections-based taxonomic research.
Advanced knowledge of modern techniques in taxonomy and systematics, including phylogenetic and phylogenomic tools.
A clear vision of the future role and operation of herbaria, and thoughts on the priority actions required to realize that vision.
Experience of herbarium digitization, georeferencing, and/or database development.
Knowledge of the Northern Eurasian and/or Eurasian floras, specifically floristics and regional plant identification.

Personal qualities such as initiative, organization skills, pedagogical insight, and communication skills will also be taken into consideration..
Employment 
Type of employment: Fixed-term employment for five years
Extent: Full-time (100%)
Location: Gothenburg
Starting date: By agreement

The School of Medical Sciences at Örebro University is seeking a postdoctoral researcher in Biomedicine (Molecular Virology and mRNA Vaccine Development) for a fixed-term appointment.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Biomedicine.
Background
The School of Medical Sciences at Örebro University is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join the Cellular and Molecular Virology research group.
The position is part of the research project "Development of novel mRNA-based TBE vaccines", funded by the Knowledge Foundation (KK-stiftelsen). The project focuses on the development and evaluation of novel mRNA-based vaccines against tick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV).
The research builds on extensive expertise in the molecular biology of tick-borne flaviviruses, viral reverse genetics, virus–host interactions and vaccine development. The project is conducted in close collaboration with academic and industrial partners.
Duties and responsibilities
The appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is intended to enable persons who have recently been awarded their doctoral degree to consolidate and further develop their research skills.
The successful candidate will conduct experimental research focusing on the molecular biology of tick-borne flaviviruses and the development of novel mRNA-based vaccines against tick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV).
The work will include molecular cloning, viral reverse genetics, infectious cDNA clones, site-directed mutagenesis, and the generation and characterization of recombinant flaviviruses. Particular emphasis will be placed on investigating viral replication, virus–host interactions, and the molecular determinants of viral pathogenicity.
The researcher will also contribute to the design and evaluation of vaccine candidates using cell-based assays, in vivo animal models, neutralization assays, and relevant immunological methods. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with other researchers and industrial partners. The position also involves analysis of experimental data, preparation of scientific publications, and presentation of research findings.
Qualifications
To be eligible for appointment as a postdoctoral researcher, applicants must hold a doctoral degree, or an equivalent foreign degree, in a subject relevant to the position, such as molecular virology, virology, molecular biology or biomedicine.
Applicants who are in the final stages of their doctoral studies and expect to complete their PhD before the employment decision are also encouraged to apply. The doctoral degree must be completed no later than the time of the employment decision.
Priority will be given to applicants who have obtained their doctoral degree no more than three years before the application deadline, in accordance with the applicable postdoctoral employment agreement. Exceptions may apply under special circumstances.
The applicant may not previously have held a position as a postdoctoral researcher for more than one year in the same subject and at the same higher education institution. The position is for a term of at least 2 years initially but may be extended for a further 1 year. If the person during the period of employment has been on parental leave, the period of employment is to be extended by the corresponding number of days. The period of employment may also be extended in the event of absence due to illness.
Assessment criteria
To see the job advertisement in its entirety, visit https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260286.
Information
The position is a full-time (100%) fixed-term appointment for two years, preferably starting in January 2027. The appointment may be extended for up to one additional year, if required to fulfil the purpose of the appointment, subject to available funding and applicable regulations. Salary is determined individually based on qualifications and experience.
For further information about the position, please contact Professor Magnus Johansson, School of Medical Sciences, Örebro University, e-mail: magnus.johansson@oru.se.
At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.
Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.
Application
Applications are submitted online via Örebro University's recruitment system.
A complete application should include the following documents:
A cover letter, describing your research interests, relevant experience, and motivation for applying for the position.
A curriculum vitae (CV), including relevant research experience, scientific publications, and contact details for at least two references.
A description of scientific qualifications and research achievements.
Copies of relevant degree certificates or, for applicants who have not yet completed their doctoral degree, documentation confirming the expected date of completion.
Relevant scientific publications (maximum of ten, submitted in full text).

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian or Danish can be considered.
For more information about the application process, please visit Örebro University's website: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/
The application deadline is November 19, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application!
We decline any contact with advertisers or recruitment agencies in the recruitment process.
As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), Örebro University is required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

jobs.occupation: Electronics Engineer to Hardware Department at Westermo
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop robust electronics used in mission-critical applications? Join Westermo's Hardware Department and as our new Electronics Engineer!
Are you passionate about electronics design and looking for a role where you can follow your work from idea to finished product?
At Westermo, we develop and manufacture industrial data communication solutions used in critical infrastructure worldwide. As an Electronics Engineer, you will be part of our Hardware Department, developing the robust, high-quality products that have made Westermo a trusted global supplier.

Are you our next Electronics Engineer?
You will join our Hardware Department and become part of a team of eight Electronics Engineers. We work across the entire product life cycle, from requirements and design to production and customer value.
One of Westermo's strengths is our close connection between development and manufacturing. Thanks to our own production facilities, you will work closely with production and gain valuable insight into how design decisions impact quality, manufacturability, and long-term product performance.
This is a hands-on electronics design role where you will work with schematic design, component selection, PCB development, simulation, prototyping and hardware verification, taking responsibility from requirements through design and verification to serial production.
You will work closely with project managers, production engineers, test engineers, mechanical designers, type testing specialists, and sourcing teams to develop products known for their robustness, reliability, and quality.

Responsibilities

Design and develop electronics for robust industrial communication products

Develop schematics, select components and support PCB layout and hardware integration

Work with areas such as high-speed digital design, signal integrity, power integrity and EMC

Use simulation and laboratory measurements as part of the design and verification process

Perform prototype bring-up, testing, troubleshooting, verification and validation

Drive hardware development from requirements specification to serial production

Contribute to design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test activities

Collaborate closely with software, mechanical design, production engineering, test engineering, product compliance and sourcingIn this role, you will use tools like Siemens Xpedition Enterprise, HyperLynx simulation tools and professional laboratory measurement equipment.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving technical challenges, and has the drive to move work forward. You want to work hands on with electrical design, and you appreciate working together with colleagues from different parts of the organisation.
You work well independently while also valuing collaboration and knowledge sharing. As a person, you are proactive, curious, and motivated by delivering high-quality solutions together with others.

Requirements

Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or similar

Experience in electronics hardware design

Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Proficient in Swedish, both written and spoken

Meritorious

Experience developing industrial products or products used in demanding environments

Experience in design for manufacturing (DFM) and design for test (DFT)

Experience working closely with production

In return, we offer:
You will be working at the forefront of technology in a friendly, open culture where we you get the opportunity to learn from skilled colleagues every day. A mature and caring leadership in a flat organization. Through our collective bargain agreement, you will be covered in terms of insurance, pension, and other benefits. We like to have fun together and we regularly enjoy sports and other social activities as a team. We believe that magic happens when people meet. We are a learning organization, and we truly love to try new things, think outside the box and be innovative together!
Basic information:

Location: Kopparlunden, Västerås

Job type: Full time

Employment contract: Permanent

For questions about the role, please contact Recruiting Manager Mikael Lindeborg; mikael.lindeborg@westermo.com or Recruiter Elin Sandell; elin.sandell@westermo.com

About Westermo:
Welcome to a rapidly growing international company, thriving at the forefront of cutting-edge technology. Westermo develops and manufactures advanced devices for industrial data communication, used in mission critical installations and harsh industrial environments. The very robust and secure communication networks built with our products provide high value for our customers.
We are passionate about taking advantage of the growth opportunities in our market. The work environment is very dynamic. Our people are dedicated and loyal, which create a fantastic team spirit. Everyone is expected to take initiative and our flat organization creates efficiency and provides opportunities for those who are closest to the task of solving it. We are devoted to delivering the best industrial network solutions. At Westermo you will have a clear impact on the results of your area of responsibility.
Westermo is a leading supplier of Industrial Data Communications equipment to the World market. Sales are conducted through our own offices in key markets in Europe, North America, Australia and Asia, as well as through distributors and OEM customers worldwide. Development and manufacturing take place in Sweden, Ireland Germany, India and Switzerland. Westermo was founded in 1975 and has today more than 580 employees with a turnover around 1,4 BSEK. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beijer Electronics AB, listed on the stock exchange.

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. 
 
Do you want to secure critical industrial operations where cyber security directly impacts safety, production, and sustainability?
As a Cyber Security Engineer at Boliden, you will design and implement robust security solutions, reduce vulnerabilities, and safeguard both IT and OT environments. You will help ensure that production-critical systems are resilient, reliable, and built for the future.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Your opportunity
In this role, you will lead engineering- and architecture-driven risk reduction across complex IT and OT environments, with ownership of the vulnerability management capability and its evolution across tools, processes, and architecture.
You will translate threat and vulnerability insights into architectural patterns, hardening strategies, and risk-based remediation roadmaps. Working closely with IT, OT, and business stakeholders, you will influence decisions and ensure security is embedded by design across initiatives and projects.
As a key partner in cross-functional delivery, you will help steer initiatives from a security engineering perspective—balancing technical depth, pragmatism, and scalability—while collaborating with adjacent functions such as incident response, SOC, and threat intelligence.

Who you will work with
You will report to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and play a key role within Boliden’s Group-wide security function, contributing to safeguarding our operations, people, and sustainable future through robust IT and information security.
The position is preferably based in Stockholm or in Boliden but can also be located at any of our operational sites. Regular travel to sites will be required, along with occasional visits to other Boliden locations. 

What you will do
Own and continuously develop the organization’s vulnerability management capability, including tools, processes, and architecture.
Identify, assess, and manage vulnerabilities across IT and OT environments, driving risk-based and sustainable remediation.
Define and guide secure architectures, standards, and security-by-design principles across solutions and projects. 
Provide hands-on technical support and act as a trusted advisor in security design, configuration, and issue resolution. 
Lead and coordinate patching and remediation efforts, ensuring compliance and reducing long-term risk exposure.
Track, report, and improve security posture through KPIs, risk insights, and continuous maturity development.

What you bring
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across IT, OT, and business functions.
Strong engineering mindset, with the ability to design scalable, secure, and practical solutions.
Solid understanding of IT/OT architectures, security controls, and modern attack methodologies.
Ability to translate risk into clear technical decisions and architectural improvements.
Analytical and solution-oriented, with a structured approach and strong problem-solving capability.
Continuous learning mindset, with a proactive approach to emerging threats and technologies
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
Fluent English, both written and spoken; Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, or Portuguese is an advantage.
A valid EU Category B driving licence, as the role involves regular travel to our sites.

Why work with us
At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!
At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.
Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager, David Govier, David.govier@boliden.com.
Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Pernilla Åkerblom, Pernilla.Akerblom@boliden.com, +46 73-023 69 61.
For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09. 
 
We welcome your application no later than November 18, 2026
As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks will be included in the recruitment process. 
If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
We are looking for a Business Development Manager - Medical Oncology to help define and drive RaySearch's expansion into the Medical Oncology market.
This is a unique opportunity to join RaySearch at an early stage of a new strategic growth initiative beyond our traditional radiation oncology business. You will play a key role in helping shape our strategy, evaluate market opportunities, developing commercialization and go-to-market approaches, and supporting the the introduction of future solutions within Medical Oncology.
As part of the Corporate Development & Strategy organization, you will collaborate closely with research & development, Sales, Strategic Partnerships, and Executive Management to assess market needs, build customer relationships, and identify opportunities that strengthen RaySearch's position in the market.
The role reports to the Head of Corporate Development & Strategy. While Stockholm is listed as the primary location, we are open to considering candidates based in other locations.
About the job
In this global role, you will analyze the medical oncology market and work to identify and assist in executing new commercial growth opportunities. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Strategy Managers, and Strategic Partnership Managers to develop and drive targeted initiatives that drive market entry and accelerate adoption in this new segment.
You will translate strategic direction into concrete market activities, ensuring strong alignment between product positioning, customer needs, and commercial execution.
Your main tasks
Lead market intelligence activities to develop a comprehensive understanding of the Medical Oncology landscape, including market dynamics, customer needs, competitive positioning, treatment pathways, reimbursement models, and emerging trends
Identify and evaluate growth opportunities, unmet needs, and strategic market segments within Medical Oncology
Develop and execute market development and commercialization strategies for future Medical Oncology solutions
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders including Medical Oncologists, Oncology Nurses, Hospital Administrators, Cancer Centers, Professional Societies, and Industry Partners
Assess emerging clinical evidence, technology trends, and evolving standards of care to identify opportunities for innovation and growth in alignment with the overall RaySearch ecosystem.
Support customer discovery activities to ensure future solutions address meaningful clinical and operational challenges
Conduct market assessments, competitive analysis, and business case development to support strategic decision-making
Support the development and execution of go-to-market strategies for future product launches
Identify and assess strategic partnership opportunities that support growth objectives
Monitor competitive developments, market access considerations, and industry trends relevant to Medical Oncology

Your Profile
You are commercially minded, strategically driven, and passionate about improving cancer care.
You bring a strong understanding of the Medical Oncology environment, ideally having worked within a chemotherapy department or have experience in medical oncology workflow tools. You enjoy working in situations where there is ambiguity, and you are comfortable helping define strategy, build relationships, and create new opportunities from the ground up.
You are equally comfortable engaging with clinicians, healthcare leaders, and business stakeholders, and you have the ability to translate market insights into actionable business recommendations.
Experience & Skills
BSc or MSc in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Nursing, Pharmacy, Medicine, Business, Medical Technology
A minimum of 5 years of clinical experience within Medical Oncology, Oncology Nursing, or a related oncology specialty
A minimum of 2 years of experience in business development, strategic marketing, product management, commercial strategy, market development, or a related function
Strong understanding of Medical Oncology treatment pathways, clinical workflows, and healthcare systems
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Experience working in international and cross-functional environments
Excellent command of English

Our Culture 
At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide. 
Our Offer 
We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package. 
Application 
Please apply for the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

jobs.occupation: Director Research Programs & Consortia  Medical Imaging
jobs.description:
Are you a business-minded research professional with deep expertise in medical imaging who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment?
Do you enjoy combining scientific and technical expertise with commercial understanding, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?
Collective Minds is looking for a Director, Research Programs & Consortia to drive our portfolio of public and private research collaborations. This is a broad, hands-on role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact in a growing international healthtech company.
About Collective Minds
Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.
About the role
As Director, Research Programs & Consortia, you will take responsibility for our portfolio of more than 10 public and private research consortia, which are a key part of Collective Minds' strategy and ongoing delivery.
Working alongside CROs, biotech and medtech companies, pharmaceutical partners, academic hospitals and research organizations, these collaborations span medical imaging, big data, analytics, and AI modeling and validation across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.
Within these projects, Collective Minds acts as a data manager and platform provider, bringing deep expertise in medical imaging to support complex research collaborations.
You will be responsible for successful project delivery, reporting and project close-outs, while coordinating project and research managers across our customer delivery organization. You will act as a playing coach andpersonally manage selected research consortia and contribute scientific and technical expertise when needed.
This is a broad, hands-on role where you will combine scientific expertise with commercial understanding, set priorities and drive results through collaboration. You will ensure projects are delivered efficiently, within agreed scope and with a clear focus on quality and business value.
Your main responsibilities:
Drive the research project portfolio, ensuring successful delivery within agreed budgets, timelines, scope and commitments.
Coordinate project and research managers, aligning priorities, following up on progress and ensuring accountability across projects.
Personally manage selected research consortia, including scientific, technical and operational activities.
Provide scientific and technical guidance across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.
Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
Manage budgets, project scope and stakeholder expectations, balancing scientific objectives with commercial priorities.
Ensure accurate reporting to customers, funders and partners, including grant deliverables and efficient project close-outs.
Collaborate with clinical and technical operations teams to plan capacity, resolve challenges and continuously improve project delivery.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a scientifically experienced and business-minded professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with a strong track record of delivering complex research projects.
You are analytical, pragmatic and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, making decisions and finding effective solutions without adding unnecessary complexity.
You communicate clearly, build trust with internal and external stakeholders and know how to balance scientific quality with business priorities and efficient execution.
We believe you have:
A strong scientific background in life sciences, medical sciences, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.
Experience from a commercial life sciences, medtech, biotech, pharma, CRO or healthtech environment, including scientific and academic collaborations.
Proven experience managing complex research programs or consortia, including budgets, timelines, scope, reporting and project close-outs.
Hands-on experience with research consortia, work package delivery, grant writing, grant execution and funding-related reporting.
Strong technical skills, including scientific programming, analytical tools and data-driven research workflows.
The ability to assess complex scientific and technical requirements, make informed decisions and contribute to technical implementations when needed.
Commercial awareness and the ability to balance scientific objectives with budgets, resources and project commitments.
Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive results across teams and external partners.
A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt quickly and take initiative.

We are now looking for a QC Specialist Microbiology to join our Quality Control team in Uppsala. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced microbiology professional who wants to combine scientific expertise with strategic impact in a highly regulated environment.
In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert within microbiology, providing scientific guidance and technical leadership across Quality Control and Manufacturing Operations. You will play a key role in ensuring product quality, patient safety and regulatory compliance while contributing to the continuous improvement of microbiological processes, contamination control strategies and laboratory operations.
Through your expertise, you will help strengthen our quality culture and support the delivery of products that make a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
Your team
You will join a team of approximately 14 colleagues united by a strong commitment to quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. The team combines deep expertise with a collaborative mindset, creating an environment where knowledge is openly shared, challenges are solved together and everyone contributes to common goals.
There is a strong sense of teamwork, mutual respect and accountability within the group. Open communication, a willingness to support one another and a shared ambition to succeed create a positive working environment where people are encouraged to grow, contribute and perform at their best.
 
Your mission
As QC Specialist Microbiology, you will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) within microbiology, providing scientific expertise, technical guidance and support across Quality Control, Manufacturing and Technical Operations.
You will ensure that microbiological control strategies and sterilization processes remain scientifically sound, compliant and fit for purpose. You will identify and mitigate quality risks, support complex investigations and drive continuous improvements that strengthen quality, compliance and operational performance.
Working independently with a high degree of ownership, you will represent the QC function in cross-functional projects, audits, inspections and regulatory activities while acting as a trusted partner to key stakeholders across the organization.
 
Key Responsibilities
· Act as the microbiology subject matter expert (SME), providing scientific guidance, technical support and expertise within the sterilization processes
· Perform, review and approve microbiological analyses while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, quality standards and regulatory expectations. 
· Lead and or support deviation investigations, root cause analyses, CAPAs, change controls and quality risk assessments. 
· Drive continuous improvement initiatives and enhance microbiological laboratory processes, procedures and documentation. 
· Represent QC Microbiology in cross-functional projects, audits, inspections and regulatory activities. 
· Support validation, qualification and verification activities related to microbiological methods, equipment and processes. 
· Contribute to a collaborative, compliant and high-performing quality culture.
 
Your profile
You are a scientifically driven microbiology professional who combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative and solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy acting as a trusted advisor and are comfortable communicating complex scientific concepts to a broad range of stakeholders. You have experience navigating regulated environments and applying scientific judgement, quality risk management and regulatory requirements to support business decisions.
As a person, you are analytical, proactive and structured. You thrive in an environment where you can influence, improve and take ownership of complex activities while building strong relationships across functions.
 
Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.
5-8 years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or another highly regulated industry.
Strong experience in Quality Control Microbiology or a related quality function.
Proven knowledge of GMP requirements and microbiological quality systems.
Experience leading investigations, deviation management and change control activities.
Experience conducting risk assessments and applying Quality Risk Management principles.
Experience supporting audits, inspections and regulatory compliance activities.
Ability to communicate scientific concepts clearly and professionally to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Preferred Experience
Experience with steam sterilization, Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) and dehydrogenization processes.
Experience representing QC in cross-functional projects and improvement initiatives.
Experience coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to colleagues and stakeholders.
Knowledge of Lean, Yellow Belt methodologies or other structured continuous improvement tools.
Experience with QC result approval and release activities.

 
Location and information 
This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

They say, “it’s not rocket science.” We disagree.
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.  
With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more. 
SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. 
We are now looking for an AWS DevOps Engineer who will build and improve the infrastructure and deployment workflows that support our systems. Working across AWS and on-premises environments, you will help developers deliver software reliably, strengthen security through automated controls and make our systems easier to operate and monitor. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving practical problems through automation and takes ownership of system reliability. You work well across IT and development teams, share your knowledge and look for ways to make everyday operations better.
You bring:
At least three years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments.
Practical experience with infrastructure as code, using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in cloud or on-premises environments.
Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience with Ansible or similar configuration management tools, scripting in Python or Bash, and DevOps practices is an advantage.
Swedish citizenship is required for this role.

You will work closely with developers, architects and IT colleagues to improve how we build, deploy and manage our environments.

Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation, and automate configuration with Ansible.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based systems and applications.
Automate deployments and environment provisioning to improve consistency and reduce manual work.
Manage containerized workloads in Amazon EKS and on-premises Kubernetes environments.
Develop monitoring and observability across cloud and on-premises resources using Grafana and application performance monitoring tools.
Investigate operational incidents and improve reliability through testing, automation and lessons learned.
Build security policies and automated guardrails into infrastructure and deployment workflows.
Manage software artefacts and container images using Amazon ECR and JFrog, supporting a secure software supply chain.
Contribute to solution design, quality assurance and clear documentation of infrastructure and processes for internal use and audits.

 
BENEFITS
We offer you 
A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry. 
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development. 
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.  

You will work with colleagues across engineering and IT, develop your skills across cloud and on-premises environments, and contribute to how we build and operate our systems.
 Additional benefits 
In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.  
Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year. 
Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.  
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program. 
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams. 
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance. 

 
LOCATION
This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in Solna Strand. 
 
NEXT STEP
If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. 
Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role. 
 
WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE
SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. 
With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions. 
We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in aerosol emissions from streams
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Ecology and Management  
Scientific background
Atmospheric aerosols are microscopic particles that influence weather and climate, contribute to biogeochemical cycling, and facilitate the dispersal of organisms. Aquatic systems can release aerosols into the atmosphere through processes such as bubble bursting, which have been studied extensively in oceans. However, whether and how these processes operate in streams remains poorly understood.
Streams differ from oceans in their hydrodynamics and water chemistry, potentially affecting how particles are captured by bubbles and potentially transferred to the atmosphere. Recent observations suggest that streams contain ice-nucleating particles that could become airborne, raising the possibility that boreal streams represent an overlooked source of atmospheric aerosols. The magnitude of these emissions, the mechanisms driving them, and the environmental factors controlling them remain largely unknown
About the position  
The postdoctoral researcher will investigate the hypothesis that streams emit aerosols to the atmosphere and identify the mechanisms and environmental conditions governing these emissions. A central task will be to develop a flux chamber to capture aerosols emitted from stream surfaces and quantify aerosol fluxes using online particle counters and air filtration for laboratory measurements of ice-nucleating particles. The chamber is planned to be deployed in both controlled experiments and field studies in natural boreal streams. The job also includes water sampling and measurements of physicochemical water and bubble properties.
The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to experimental design, data collection and analysis, manuscript preparation, scientific publication, and other forms of research communication. The position will be supervised by Associate Professor Marcus Klaus.
The successful candidate will be expected to work independently while collaborating closely with other members of the research team and external partners. The research environment will provide opportunities to develop scientific expertise, establish collaborations, and strengthen the candidate's professional development and academic career prospects.
Your profile
We are seeking a motivated and dedicated researcher with expertise at the interface of aquatic and atmospheric sciences and a strong interest in air–water exchange processes. Applicants must hold a PhD in atmospheric sciences, aquatic sciences, physics, environmental engineering, or a related discipline. 
The applicant must have demonstrated experience in measurements of aerosols, suspended particles and/or air-water mass exchange (particles or gases) and experience conducting laboratory and/or fieldwork in aquatic and/or atmospheric systems. A track record of scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed journals is also required, as are excellent written and spoken English skills.  
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:
Air filtration, aerosol sampling, and particle counting
Droplet freezing assays
Bubble and/or turbulence characterization
Programming and data analysis using tools such as R or MATLAB
Engineering, instrument development, or practical skills relevant to designing and constructing the flux chamber  

In addition to scientific qualifications, emphasis will be placed on personal suitability, including scientific curiosity, initiative, the ability to work independently, and a constructive and collaborative approach to teamwork. 
As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.
About us  
The title will be employed at The Department of Forest Ecology and Management. The department includes about 120 people of which 9 are professors. Our mission is to advance the understanding of forest ecosystems and how these should be managed today and in the future.

The portfolio includes the well-known brands Nordsjö, Sadolin and Cuprinol. 
 
 
Are you driven by creating smarter, more sustainable industrial operations? Join us on a two-year fixed-term contract in a key role where you will lead energy improvement initiatives, influence site performance and turn ambitious sustainability goals into measurable business results.
 
 
What can AkzoNobel offer you?
At AkzoNobel you are met by a warm and welcoming atmosphere. We work together with a focus on innovation and sustainability, to be the leader in our industry. Diversity enriches our workplaces, and we work actively together with our employees to make them thrive and develop. We work strategically to become a better employer. This has resulted in that we have been appointed one of Sweden's Career Company 2026. We offer you an international working environment where you take on rewarding and challenging tasks that broaden your horizon and develop you in your role. You will work with competent and like-minded colleagues who share your attitude and enthusiasm. Welcome!
 
 
About the role 
As Projects Manager – Energy, you will play a central role in driving the energy agenda at our Malmö site forward. Working across production areas, buildings and utilities, you will identify opportunities, lead improvement initiatives and ensure that energy-saving projects are successfully implemented and followed up.
This is a broad and business-critical role where you combine technical expertise with project leadership and stakeholder management. You will collaborate closely with functions such as Engineering, Maintenance, Production, HSE and Procurement, while also acting as an important counterpart towards external contractors and facility management partners.

The position offers a great opportunity to make a visible impact by improving operational efficiency, reducing energy consumption and supporting long-term sustainability targets in a modern industrial environment.
 
Key responsibilities: 
• Lead and execute the Malmö Site Energy Roadmap
• Drive energy efficiency projects from concept to implementation• Identify and prioritize opportunities for energy and cost savings
• Monitor energy performance, KPIs and metering systems
• Develop business cases, project scopes and implementation plans
• Coordinate energy-related activities across the site
• Optimize HVAC, BMS, ventilation and utility performance
• Challenge and coordinate facility management and external contractors
• Support shutdown and non-production energy reduction initiatives
• Follow up, verify and report realized savings and project results
 
This is a full-time position on a two-year fixed-term contract, based in Arlöv, just outside Malmö. You will report to the Project Manager Lead.
 
 
Who are you?
We are looking for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with hands-on project execution. You are comfortable working in a dynamic industrial environment where collaboration, initiative and continuous improvement are key to success.
 

You have the ability to build strong relationships across different functions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. At the same time, you are confident in challenging existing ways of working and driving improvements that create long-term value for the business.
 

To succeed in this role, you should have a structured approach, strong problem-solving skills and a genuine interest in energy efficiency and sustainable operations.
 
 
Key qualifications: 
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or another relevant Engineering field
• Experience in industrial energy management and/or energy efficiency projects• Project management experience within industrial or manufacturing environments
• Knowledge of industrial utilities, energy systems and energy monitoring
• Experience working with HVAC/BMS and related optimization activities
• Ability to develop technical and financial business cases
• Strong stakeholder and contractor management skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English
 
Meritorious / preferred: 
• Experience with ISO 50001• Previous experience as an Energy Engineer or Industrial Energy Manager
• Experience with energy KPI and metering systems
• Background in CAPEX/OPEX project delivery
• Experience implementing energy-saving initiatives in industrial environments
