Comply and implement activities in accordance with the rules of laws and regulations relating to environmental protection, safety at work and fire protection, and internal EHS or Sustainability standards and procedures. 

 What are we looking for? 
At least five years of hands-on experience working independently with Swedish payroll, with a strong understanding of payroll processes, controls and statutory requirements.  
A strong compliance and control mindset. You are structured, thorough and understand that accuracy, confidentiality and adherence to requirements always come first.  
Good knowledge of Swedish payroll legislation and collective agreements, ideally with experience of both white-collar and blue-collar payroll.  
Experience with payroll and HR systems. Previous experience with Kontek Lön, Kontek HRM and/or SAP SuccessFactors is considered an advantage.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with good technical understanding and the ability to identify root causes and resolve payroll or system-related issues.  
Comfortable working in a changing environment, with the flexibility and curiosity to move from hands-on payroll processing towards payroll coordination, governance and broader HR responsibilities.  
Strong stakeholder and communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll-related matters clearly and professionally to employees, managers and other stakeholders.  
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken. 

 What we offer you?
We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes

WHY JOIN BAT?
In BAT Sweden we strive to create a smokeless reality on a day-to-day basis. If you wonder how we are getting there, please take a look at the OMNI report – a comprehensive study done to analyse the current market trends in tobacco harm reduction.
We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.
Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.
We see the career breaks as opportunities not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).
Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

Job Description
Do you have experience in chemical product regulatory compliance and enjoy turning complex legislation into practical solutions? Are you motivated by applying your regulatory experience across global markets and helping the business bring compliant products to our customers? Then this could be the opportunity for you!  

WHAT YOU'LL DO  
We are now looking for a Product Compliance Specialist with a strong regulatory background and experience in chemical products (e.g. scented candles, room scents, glue). In this role, you will be part of the Product Compliance team and focus on chemical compliance as well as product labelling requirements. 
The Product Compliance department brings together specialists across different areas of product compliance and safety. We are responsible for setting requirements and routines for all products sold by the H&M group, in line with legislation and product safety. We research and find regulatory information concerning product safety and legal requirements in new, as well as established markets, and for new products. By supporting several parts of our business with our expertise, we contribute to the overall customer experience. 
In this role you will have a broad end-to-end responsibility, securing requirements connected to product, ingredients, labelling and product reporting. The main responsibilities will include:  
Monitor legislation for chemical products on existing selling markets and ensure that H&M Group’s internal requirements and routines are up to date 
Research requirements for chemical products to enable expansion, for new markets and new products 
Secure compliance with REACH and REACH-like regulations, e.g. EU REACH, UK REACH, KKDIK; investigate legal requirements on existing- and expansion markets, secure that internal routines for formulated products are up to date and implemented in production, follow-up on quantities and certificates 
Manage mandatory product reporting and notification requirements in designated markets, ensuring timely and accurate submissions to meet critical regulatory deadlines 
Monitor and interpret regulatory requirements for product and online labelling of chemical products, assess their impact on the business, and translate them into clear compliance requirements and guidance. Transform complex regulatory requirements into user-friendly information and guidelines in order to enable compliance. 
Support global authority inspections, audits, and regulatory inquiries by coordinating responses and providing the required information.  
Collaborate with, support and train colleagues and other stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are understood and effectively implemented. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We're looking for someone who combines a relevant academic background with hands-on experience from relevant industry and/or working within a regulatory authority. You're comfortable navigating complex regulatory requirements and can translate your expertise into clear, practical guidance for the business. You enjoy taking ownership of your area of expertise while collaborating with different stakeholders and making complex regulatory information accessible to others. 
 
We are looking for a person with... 
A degree in chemistry, toxicology, or similar field 
At least two years' experience working with chemical product regulatory compliance 
Hands-on experience working with CLP and REACH regulations  
Knowledge of the Biocidal Products Regulation is considered an advantage 
Experience working with regulatory requirements for chemical consumer products such as candles, room scents or similar product categories is a strong plus  
Strong communication skills in English (Swedish is considered an advantage)  

And a person who is... 
Driven, adaptable and comfortable applying your expertise to different business needs  
Able to take ownership and work independently while being a strong team player 
Skilled at making complex information simple and accessible, always with the business and customer in mind 
Business and customer-focused, with the ability to balance regulatory requirements with business needs 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
This is a full-time permanent position based from our Head Office in Stockholm, reporting to the Group Manager for Compliance. If you feel that your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please send your resume in English at your earliest opportunity. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis.  

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
An example of our benefits: 
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET). 
H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
We look forward to receiving your application! 
*H&M Group is committed to creating a Diverse & Inclusive environment and we are actively looking for qualified candidates irrespective of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability or age

As Mips grows across markets, channels and audiences, the brand is becoming a central driver of commercial value. We are now looking for a Global Brand Lead to take ownership of the brand on a global level and turn it into one clear strategy, one strong brand team and one consistent expression in every market and every channel.
The roleYou set the strategic direction for the Mips brand, you lead the global brand team that delivers it, and you drive brand awareness across both B2B and B2C audiences. You are part of the marketing leadership team and the connecting point between brand strategy and commercial execution. This is a highly cross-functional role: you work with the rest of Marketing, Product and Sales so the brand is expressed consistently and effectively. Your mission is to build a brand that is trusted by the manufacturers who put Mips in their helmets and preferred by the people who wear them. 
What you will do
Own the global brand strategy. Develop and own positioning, brand platform, narrative and visual identity, and translate them into clear priorities and targets for the brand team.
Lead and develop the global brand team. Lead, coach and develop a team of an Art director, a graphic designer, a content creator and a product marketer, and set clear priorities.
Lead the creative and content function. Own the brand and creative platform, brief and empower the Art director to drive the creative expression, and make sure design, content and campaign production deliver against the brand strategy. Own the global content strategy and plan across channels, and prioritize production capacity against business needs.
Build awareness and preference. Grow brand awareness and preference among B2B customers and B2C end consumers, adapting the message to each audience without diluting the brand, and turn strategy into campaigns, activations and go-to-market plans together with the team.
Connect brand and product marketing. Make sure product positioning, messaging and launch narratives are aligned with the brand across B2B and B2C, and partner with Trade marketing, PR and Digital to deliver a consistent brand experience across all touchpoints.
Measure and sharpen. Define and follow up on brand KPIs: awareness, consideration, preference and brand equity. Use the insights to sharpen the strategy and present results to senior leadership.
Be the guardian of the brand. Govern the brand guidelines, approve key assets and support partners and customers in using the brand correctly.
Manage budget and partners. Own the global brand budget and the relationships with external agency partners.

Who you are
You have at least 7+ years of experience in international brand management, head of brand or head of marketing with brand lead, ideally from a similar type of passion driven context.
You have experience of leading a brand team of specialists, including creative and content roles such as designers, content creators and product marketers, with strong people leadership and coaching skills.
You write sharp briefs and know how to work with senior creatives.
You have worked in both B2B and B2C environments and understand how brand building differs between them.
You are strategic: you move from insight and analysis to a clear brand strategy, and then make it actionable.
You have documented experience of building brand awareness and measuring its effect.
You are a strong collaborator who thrives in a cross-functional, matrixed and international organization, with excellent stakeholder management skills and comfort presenting to senior leadership.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is a strong advantage.

Why Mips? Mips has built a strong position in safety, with a technology trusted by leading brands around the world. Cycling represents around 70% of our sales, while sport, motorcycle and new categories offer exciting opportunities for growth. Europe is a key focus, with Germany as a priority market. Now is the time to build the next chapter of MIPS. If you want a role where you can shape a global brand, build a team and see your ideas come to life across markets, this could be your next challenge.

jobs.occupation: Small Animal Veterinarian, Specialist in Animal Reproduction
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian and are a board-certified specialist, or have equivalent qualifications, in animal reproduction? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian and reproduction specialist at UDS, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination (AI).
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. You are a Diplomate and a specialist in animal reproduction, with a subspecialty in small animal reproduction (or have equivalent qualifications). We would like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. 
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
Location:
Uppsala, Sweden
Form of employment:
Indefinite-term employment. We use 6 months probationary employment.
Scope:
100%
Start date:
As agreed. 
Application:
Please submit your application before deadline 7 December 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
Please include in your application: 
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Letter of intent
Copies of appropriate degree certificates

Union representatives:
https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Unit Manager - Identity & Access Management
jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
As Unit Manager for Identity & Access Management (IAM), you will lead one of H&M Group’s most critical cyber security capabilities and play a key role in strengthening the organisation’s security, resilience and ability to deliver on its strategic ambitions. 
As a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team reporting to the CISO, you will share accountability for the overall cyber security strategy, priorities and long-term development of the Cyber Security function. Working closely with leaders across business, technology and cyber security, you will help shape outcomes that balance business objectives, security needs and risk management across H&M Group. 
You will provide strategic leadership for H&M Group’s global IAM capability through an established leadership team spanning the end-to-end identity lifecycle. Through your leadership, you will drive the continued evolution of IAM, ensuring the capability remains effective, scalable and aligned with the future needs of the business. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the strategic direction, maturity and long-term development of H&M Group’s Identity & Access Management capability, defining and evolving the IAM strategy, roadmap and operating model in alignment with business, technology and cyber security objectives. 
Contribute as a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team to the overall cyber security strategy, priorities, operating model and long-term capability development. 
Build strong partnerships with business, technology and cyber security stakeholders to drive alignment, influence decisions and enable strategic outcomes. 
Drive organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, capability development and succession planning within the IAM function. 
Ensure effective management of IAM-related risks, controls, regulatory obligations and strategic initiatives. 
Lead budgeting, resource and investment planning, vendor strategy and prioritisation to support delivery of IAM and cyber security objectives. 
Foster a high-performing, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on continuous improvement, innovation and business value. 

WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with:
8+ years of people management experience in cyber security, IAM or a closely related field. 
Proven experience leading an enterprise-scale IAM capability end to end in a global organisation, spanning governance, risk and compliance, architecture, engineering, delivery and operations. 
Proven experience leading through managers and developing high-performing leadership teams, with full ownership of a multidisciplinary organisation and its outcomes. 
Experience as a member of a senior cyber security, technology or enterprise leadership team, contributing to shared strategy, priorities, investment decisions and organisational outcomes beyond the individual’s own area of responsibility. 
Experience defining and executing enterprise IAM strategies, roadmaps, operating models and large-scale transformation, including organisational change across functional and organisational boundaries. 
Strong knowledge of IAM capabilities and technologies, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorisation and privileged access management, as well as enterprise IGA platforms such as Saviynt, SailPoint or similar. 
Strong knowledge of IAM-related risks, controls, policies, regulatory requirements and audit expectations. 
Experience managing significant budgets, investments, resources, sourcing arrangements and external partners, including leading negotiations with strategic vendors. 
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with proven experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders, clearly communicating strategic direction and translating complex IAM, cyber security and risk topics into business implications, priorities and decisions. 
Sound judgement and decision-making capability in complex, uncertain and risk-sensitive situations. 
Relevant certifications in IAM, cyber security or risk management are considered beneficial. 

Additional Information
This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English.
Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation 
At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age. 
Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building. 
Our Offer 
At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future. 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET.

Are you ready to bring your innovative perspective and creative skills to ASAA ABLOY Business Segment Pedestrian (BSP) within the ASSA ABLOY Entrance Systems? Join our team in Landskrona, Sweden and enjoy a collaborative culture that empowers you to build a career you can be proud of.
What would you do as our Product Owner Revolving Doors.
As Product Owner for our Revolving Door product range, you assume full technical ownership of a comprehensive and established product line. Coordinating a multidisciplinary R&D team spanning hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineering, you will set priorities, drive alignment with portfolio priorities, and create the conditions in which engineers can perform and grow at their best.
 This position is well suited to a technically grounded person who combines hands-on engineering insight with the ability to coach a team, manage complexity, and drive results with discipline and clarity.
The role reports to Head of Security Entrance Control and Revolving Doors, and works closely with senior stakeholders across product management, manufacturing, quality, and global ASSA ABLOY divisions to drive innovation, performance, and long-term business impact.
You would also:
Oversee and develop a multidisciplinary R&D team — provide clear direction and hands-on management of hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineers; foster a culture of technical excellence, structured problem-solving, and continuous professional development, while coaching the team toward stronger resolution-making and greater ownership.
Own the full product development lifecycle — drive concept, validation, industrialisation, and ongoing lifecycle improvements, while ensuring consistent adherence to applicable safety and quality standards, including ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL.
Define and execute the R&D strategy — establish the product roadmap, ensure alignment with broader portfolio and business targets, manage R&D resources, budgets, and timelines, and embed sustainability principles across all stages of product development.
Drive innovation and the adoption of emerging technologies — identify opportunities to enhance product performance and design, stimulate creative thinking within the team, and evaluate the application of IoT, connectivity, AI, and other forward-looking technologies across the product range.
Represent the product externally and manage key stakeholder relationships — act as a credible technical ambassador in customer meetings, trade shows, and industry forums, while maintaining strong internal alignment with segment management, commercial product managers, and factory teams.

The skills and experience you need
We are looking for someone who has:
Engineering foundation — a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with a solid background in R&D for electromechanical products gained through hands-on engineering, product development, or early-career coordination roles.
Product lifecycle expertise — demonstrated experience managing the full development lifecycle, from concept and validation through to industrialisation and continuous improvement, with a strong understanding of systems, spare parts, and lifecycle stewardship.
Technical guidance skills— proven ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, with the capacity to set direction, manage priorities, and drive delivery across hardware, firmware, and mechanical disciplines.
Compliance and quality awareness — familiarity with relevant safety and quality standards such as ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL, and a structured approach to process optimisation and regulatory adherence.
Domain knowledge and technology acumen — familiarity with revolving doors, door mechanics, drive systems, sensors, or embedded control units is a strong advantage. We equally welcome candidates who bring technical curiosity, analytical strength, and the motivation to grow into a product ownership role. An interest in emerging technologies such as IoT, connectivity, and AI is highly valued.

 
You are a natural leader who guides with clarity and purpose — someone who inspires confidence in a team not through authority alone, but through genuine engagement, consistent follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves when it matters. You think in possibilities, approaching technical tasks with creativity and a structured mind, always looking for smarter ways forward.
You are customer-centric by nature, with a keen sense of how engineering decisions translate into real-world impact — both for end users and for the business. You balance technical depth with pragmatic judgement, knowing when to dive into the details and when to step back and see the bigger picture. Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish is essential. Additional languages are a welcome advantage.
Above all, you act with integrity. You take ownership of your work and your team's outcomes, bring a safety-conscious mindset to every resolution, and hold yourself accountable to the highest standards — commercially, technically, and as a supervisor of people.
 
What we offer
We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:
 
Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills
A competitive salary and incentive schemes

 
We review applications regularly, so don’t wait
 
We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here.
 
To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Mona Yusefi Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at mona.yusefi@assaabloy.com.
 
Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening will need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subjected to a background screening. The performance of the background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.
 
 
Let’s create a safer and more open world - together!
 
To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com

Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 
As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. 
 
About the job 

As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own! 
 
The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development. 

 You will act as: 
HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov. 
HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council 
HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization. 
Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team. 
The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas. 
 

Operational responsibilities:
Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy. 
Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics. 
Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies. 
Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services 
Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development. 
Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils. 
 

Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson. 
 
Who you are 
You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. 
You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization. 
 
Requirements: 
Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance. 

In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements. 
Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines. 
Good ability to work in HR systems 
Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents. 
Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer. 
Driving license. 

We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! 
 
While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. 

We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games. 
 
As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.
