jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral fellow in Structural studies of mitochondrial DNA replication
jobs.description:
This postdoctoral position is part of a research project funded by a Wallenberg Scholar grant. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary team with expertise in molecular biology, biochemistry and structural biology. The project aims to understand the molecular mechanisms that govern mitochondrial DNA replication and gene expression, and how defects in these processes contribute to human disease.
 
Subject area 
Structural studies of mitochondrial DNA replication
 
Subject area description 
Mitochondrial DNA replication is essential for maintaining mtDNA integrity and stability and thereby for normal mitochondrial function and cellular energy production. Defects in the replication process can lead to mtDNA depletion or deletions and cause mitochondrial disease.
Our research aims to understand the molecular mechanisms that govern replication of human mtDNA. We combine structural biology, in vitro biochemistry and cell biology to investigate how the mitochondrial DNA replication machinery is organized and regulated. A particular focus is on structural and functional studies of the protein complexes involved in mtDNA replication and on understanding how disease-associated mutations affect these processes.
 
Job assignments
In this project, In this project, the postdoctoral researcher will carry out structural and functional studies of protein and protein-DNA complexes involved in mitochondrial DNA replication. A central aim will be to determine structures of replication complexes using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and use these structures to understand how the proteins interact and regulate mtDNA replication at the molecular level.
The work will include preparation and biochemical characterization of protein complexes, cryo-EM sample preparation and grid optimization, as well as processing and structural analysis of cryo-EM data. Structural findings will be combined with in vitro biochemical analyses to test mechanistic models and investigate how disease-associated mutations affect the function of the replication machinery.
The postdoctoral researcher is expected to drive the project independently while working closely with other members of the research group and our collaborators.
 
Eligibility 
The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.
To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.
In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area. 
 
Assessment criteria 
We are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a doctoral degree in structural biology, biochemistry, molecular biology or a related field.
Documented experience in structural studies of proteins or macromolecular complexes using cryo-electron microscopy is required. Experience in protein purification and protein biochemistry is also required.
Experience in single-particle cryo-EM, including sample preparation, grid optimization, data processing and structural analysis, is particularly meritorious. Experience in structural studies of protein-DNA complexes is a strong advantage. Knowledge of mitochondrial systems and experience in cloning, mutagenesis, protein expression, cell culture and in vitro biochemical analyses are considered merits.
Great emphasis will be placed on scientific skills and the ability to independently plan, carry out and analyse research. The work involves close collaboration both within and outside the research group, making good teamwork and communication skills important. The candidate is expected to have strong scientific curiosity and the ability to work both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team.
Excellent spoken and written English is required, as the research group operates in an international environment.
 
Regulations for the evaluation of qualifications for academic positions are given in Chapter 4, Section 3 - 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance.
 
Employment 
The employment is full time and temporary, two years with the possibility of one year's extension, with placement at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.
 
Contact information 
Please contact: Maria Falkenberg, Professor, e-mail: maria.falkenberg@medkem.gu.se.
 
Unions 
Union representatives at the University of Gothenburg can be found here: https://www.gu.se/en/work-at-the-university-of-gothenburg/how-to-apply-for-a-position#collective-agreement-and-union-representatives
 
 
Application 
Submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. It is your responsibility to ensure that the application is complete as per the vacancy notice, and that the University receives it by the final application deadline.  
The application should contain:
 
- A cover letter giving a brief description of previous research experience, and a motivation to why you are applying
 
- A CV including a list of publications
 
- Contact details of two references
 
- Proof of completed PhD
 
Applications must be received by: 2026-10-02.
 
Information for International Applicants 
Choosing a career in a foreign country is a big step. Thus, to give you a general idea of what we and Gothenburg have to offer in terms of benefits and life in general for you and your family/spouse/partner please visit:

As Platform Product Manager, you will treat the platform as a product, with developers as your customers. You will stay close to our DevOps teams, understand their needs and use feedback and data to shape priorities, set goals and build a roadmap focused on outcomes rather than output.

Working closely with domain leads and platform engineers, you will help ensure CORE Platform feels like one coherent developer experience rather than a collection of tools. You will connect technical platform development with the wider needs of Husqvarna Group, helping us invest where we can create the greatest value for both developers and the business.

Looking ahead, we are also preparing for AI agents to become platform users alongside developers. You will help shape what this means for the platform and how it influences our future priorities. What you will do:

Shape the platform strategy and roadmap based on user needs, business priorities and measurable outcomes.
Work closely with developers to understand their needs, test ideas early and create effective feedback loops.
Translate developer and business needs into clear platform priorities.
Define and follow up on goals and metrics around adoption, developer experience and platform value.
Work with domain leads and platform engineers to create a consistent and coherent platform experience.
Continuously evaluate whether the platform is solving the right problems and be ready to evolve, start or stop initiatives based on data and feedback.
Connect platform development to the wider business context and ensure investments create meaningful value for Husqvarna Group.

Your profile
Beyond your experience, you are genuinely curious about your users and approach product development with an outcome-focused and adaptable mindset. You understand that a platform is never finished and are comfortable changing direction as user needs, business priorities and technology evolve.
 
You see the bigger picture and can balance the needs of developers with the value we want to create for the business. You are confident in setting priorities and saying no when needed, while being able to clearly explain the reasoning behind your decisions, regardless of who you are speaking with.
 
You are also curious about the opportunities AI brings to software development, while maintaining a pragmatic view of where it creates real value. Most importantly, you are a humble and collaborative team player who enjoys working with others, brings a sense of humour and cares about succeeding together. We believe you bring:

5+ years of experience working in or closely with software engineering.
A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and DevOps, including how software is built, deployed and operated.
Experience in product management, ideally within a technical or internal product environment.
A strong product mindset, with the ability to translate user and business needs into priorities and measurable outcomes.
Experience defining and using metrics to understand adoption, user experience and the value a product delivers.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

 
Experience from Platform Engineering, working with platforms as products, or familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, is a plus.
 
Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Mathias von Knorring, mathias.von.knorring@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
 
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

 
Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 

Learn more about our culture here.

Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
The role 
This is a horizontal role: rather than owning one surface, you set the multi-year product strategy for how Truecaller uses data and decisioning to grow revenue across all of them - Ads, Premium, Business Messaging, and Growth - and decide where the leverage goes next. You will guide the product managers who own individual surfaces, take the strategy to the executive team and win the decisions it needs, and lead through expertise and credibility rather than a reporting line. Expect to spend as much time with commercial and product leadership as with the engineers and data scientists building the systems.
What you'll do
● Set the multi-year product strategy for Revenue Intelligence - one direction across Ads, Premium, Business Messaging and Growth, grounded in user behaviour, revenue data and where the ad and subscription markets are heading.
●  Take that strategy to the executive team and win the decisions it needs - investment, sequencing and what we stop doing.
● Own initiatives that cut across surfaces and platforms - bringing ad-grade targeting to Premium, or a single user-signal layer every surface reads from - and drive the structural calls that affect more than one function.
● Take on problems nobody has framed yet - a new revenue surface, a regulatory shift, a new market - and turn them into a plan with owners, metrics and a decision date.
● Set the bar for measurement: every Revenue Intelligence launch ships with an agreed success metric, a holdout and a clear ship/kill rule.
● Act as advisor to the Revenue Intelligence squads and to the Product Areas that consume them, and coach the product managers around you through reviews, critiques and career guidance.
What you bring in
● 12+ years of product management experience, including several years setting strategy across multiple product areas at Principal level or equivalent.
● Deep expertise in consumer monetization at scale - ad ranking and auctions, targeting, recommendations, subscription conversion, or ML-driven decisioning.
● A track record of influencing executive decisions with well-researched recommendations, and of delivering results across teams you do not manage.
● Fluency with data and experimentation: you write your own SQL, design experiments, and can tell a real causal lift from noise.
● Comfort with the technical substance - retrieval vs. ranking, exploration vs. exploitation, online vs. offline metrics - enough to steer architecture and platform decisions.
● Experience mentoring product managers and raising the craft of a product team.
● Clear, concise writing - your strategy documents carry executive decisions on their own.
It would be great if you also have
● Experience with the India digital advertising market - advertisers, agencies, programmatic demand and DSPs.
● Working knowledge of privacy rules that shape targeting, such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act.
● Product ownership of a data or ML platform used by several product teams.
● Experience shipping AI- or LLM-based product features.

What we offer: 
We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from: 
A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:
Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you. 
Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/
Sounds like a great opportunity?
We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
We only accept applications in English.

Job ID: 6765
Would you like to take a central role in shaping Nordea’s credit risk modelling landscape and add real business value for Nordea? Then this opportunity is for you. 
We are looking for a Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our IRB modelling functions and drive the design, enhancement, and implementation of credit risk models across the organisation. The role combines advanced modelling, practical implementation of the models in our IT infrastructure and a sound understanding of banking. You need to enjoy working with large datasets, solve problems and find new and innovative solutions.
About our team
Meet the Risk Models Methodology & IRB models team. Our role is to develop and maintain models under IRB, and support other functions in the value chain. We strive to develop models that help business in their decisions and comply with relevant regulatory environment across multiple countries.
Our team adds value by accurately estimating the IRB risk parameters for Nordea’s customers. As a Quantitative Risk Analyst you will play a valuable role in developing, maintaining and using models which accurately estimate Nordea customers’ credit risk and anchor these firmly in the business lines.
Given the nature of our data and regulatory requirements, we use advanced modelling techniques and big data technology. In addition to using leading techniques for modelling and data, the team’s role is general risk governance within credit risk modelling and methodology, including management of models, model implementation, data quality, documentation and model use.
Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
Main responsibilities in this role:
Develop technical tools that can be used for model development and other analysis, using tools such as Python.
Work on a subset of model lifecycle related activities like: data pipeline, data quality work, development, documentation, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, requirement setting, and user acceptance tests within credit and impairment models.
Contribute to methodological standards, modelling tools, coding practices, and continuous improvement of the modelling framework.
Drive projects within the IRB Models, and manage stakeholder relationships in the Risk, IT and Business organisations.
Present & justify analyses, results, and their implications to stakeholders, either through periodic activities or through ad-hoc requests.
Provide technical guidance, review the work of other modellers, and support setting modelling strategy and priorities.
Stay informed on regulatory developments and industry practices.

You’ll join an international team with a variety of backgrounds and skills. We work closely with other teams across the bank which provides you with excellent opportunities for personal and professional development. Our working language is English.
The role is based in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Warsaw. Flexible working conditions with respect to working from premises / from home apply according to the Nordea rules of working at least 60% from the office.
Who you are
This is the right role for you if you are:
Curious, enjoy learning and are excited about brining your ideas to the table.Take ownership of the task but enjoy collaboration with others.
Confident in advanced quantitative modelling and eager to challenge ideas constructively.
Communicate complex statistical or methodological concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Enjoy working with large datasets and navigate well in tools used to analyse them.
Work well in a dynamic environment with varying workload.
Are keen to find solutions and not only raise concerns.
Able to think big picture but know that the devil is in the details. You are good at judging which details require extra attention.
Committed to deliver high-quality work.
Interested in coding and development of technical tools.

Your background and skills include:
A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field, for instance economics, engineering, business, mathematics, science, statistics, finance, or similar.
Interest or hands-on experience working with data & modelling and conducting complex data analysis in financial services.
revious experience with large volumes of data and programming. We use mainly Python / SQL.
Interest in understanding of regulatory requirements related to IRB, IFRS9 and stress testing and different modelling techniques.

Seniority [Assistant/Regular/Senior/Lead] of the role and remuneration will depend on the level of the candidate’s experience in the relevant fields.
What we offer
People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. 
If this sounds like you, get in touch!
We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. 
We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. 
We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. 
For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
Role Summary
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden 
TRATON Group R&D is driving the transformation toward smarter, safer, and more sustainable transport systems. Within the Systems Engineering organization, the Performance, Data & Analytics unit supports development through data, analytics and performance insights across our brands.
As part of this journey, the EE Analytics agile team will continue to develop and maintain its own reporting and analytics products, while also building more reusable data and platform capabilities. We are looking for a senior Data Architect to help guide this work and shape the architecture, data models and integration patterns that make E/E engineering data trusted, understandable and reusable.
This role combines a broad architectural perspective with practical technical work. You will help us make sound choices as the direction takes shape, working with data engineers, analysts and stakeholders across R&D. The resulting capabilities will support the team’s reporting and analytics, wider engineering needs, and AI-enabled applications where appropriate. The role itself remains focused on data architecture and engineering.
Job Responsibilities
As a Data Architect, you will: 
Shape and evolve the architecture for E/E engineering data, balancing current reporting and analytics needs with opportunities to develop reusable data capabilities.
Design and review data models, shared definitions and integration patterns for relevant engineering data sources.
Guide data engineering practices for data quality, lineage, traceability and ownership, in collaboration with the relevant system and platform owners.
Work with analysts and stakeholders to ensure the data architecture supports reliable reporting, KPIs, performance insights and other agreed engineering needs.
Identify opportunities to make data products and pipelines reusable, including for AI-enabled use cases, and collaborate with AI Enablement where relevant.
Provide architectural guidance to data engineers and analysts, and contribute hands-on through design reviews, prototypes or technical problem-solving.
Collaborate with product owners, engineering stakeholders, and data platform and governance teams across R&D.

 
Who You Are
You are an experienced data professional with strong architectural thinking and a solid technical foundation. You can connect the detail of data models and integrations with the broader needs of an engineering organization. You are comfortable helping shape a direction while also working through practical technical choices and trade-offs.
We believe you have:
Experience in data engineering, analytics or modern data platforms, with architectural or technical leadership responsibility.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, semantic layers and integration patterns.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as AWS, Snowflake or similar platforms.
Experience working with data from multiple systems or in software development or engineering environments.
A structured approach to data quality, traceability, ownership and governance.
The ability to explain architectural choices and their trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

It is a strong plus if you bring:
Experience with data products, federated data models or reusable data capabilities.
Knowledge of embedded systems, automotive or systems engineering.
Experience working across organizational or domain boundaries.
Interest in how trusted engineering data can support AI-enabled applications.

You bring a collaborative, pragmatic approach and are comfortable working through open questions with others. You do not need to tick every box; if the role feels like a natural next step, we encourage you to apply.
Experience in the automotive industry is an advantage but not required. Fluency in English is necessary; Swedish is not a must.
We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
This Is Us
EE Analytics is an international, collaborative agile team within the Performance, Data & Analytics unit. We develop and maintain reporting and analytics products that support engineering decisions across TRATON Group R&D.
Our work also includes shaping reusable data capabilities that can serve wider engineering needs and new digital use cases. We collaborate across brands and disciplines, and value openness, curiosity, knowledge sharing and practical improvement in our everyday work.
TRATON Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.  
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-24. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
We look forward to your application!  
This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D.

Job ID: 7252
 
Counterparty Credit Risk Model Developer [Senior/Lead Quantitative Risk Analyst] (permanent position)
 
We are looking for a quantitative model developer with an interest in derivatives, risk modelling and practical implementation.
 
About our team
 
Meet the Counterparty Credit Risk Models team. The role combines mathematical finance, Python development and an understanding of trading and regulatory requirements. We welcome candidates with experience in counterparty credit risk or XVA, as well as those with relevant experience in derivatives pricing, quantitative risk or derivative trading.
 
Our team develops and maintains Nordea’s counterparty credit risk exposure models, including the Internal Model Method (IMM). Our work covers the full model lifecycle: interpreting requirements, developing methodologies, sourcing and analysing data, implementing models and supporting validation and regulatory approval.
 
You will work with experienced quantitative colleagues in a friendly and supportive team and collaborate with trading, technology, model validation and risk management. We share expertise across projects, while giving each team member responsibility for taking their work forward.
 
Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 
 
What you’ll be doing
 
Main responsibilities in this role:
Develop and improve counterparty credit risk models, combining sound methodology with practical implementation.
Investigate derivatives pricing and exposure behaviour, and assess the implications of modelling choices for trading portfolios and risk measures.
Source, reconcile and analyse trade and market data from front-office and other internal systems.
Develop production implementations in Python, alongside tools for impact assessment, testing and ongoing model monitoring.
Interpret relevant regulatory requirements and translate them into proportionate modelling and implementation choices.
Write clear model documentation, analyses and decision memos for technical reviewers, senior stakeholders and regulatory submissions.
Take model developments through validation and internal approval processes, explaining your choices and addressing challenge constructively.

 
Who you are
 
This is the right role for you if:
You take ownership of your work and can move a project forward, including when requirements, data or implementation options are not straightforward. You work independently and you are able to collaborate, share and draw on the expertise of your colleagues.
You combine analytical depth with practical judgement. You can explain complex topics clearly, make well-supported recommendations and discuss trade-offs with stakeholders who bring different perspectives and priorities.

 
Your background and skills include:
A degree in a relevant quantitative discipline, such as mathematical finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or econometrics.
Relevant experience in a quantitative role involving derivatives, pricing or financial risk.
A sound understanding of derivatives pricing and risk.
Practical programming experience in Python and an interest in developing reliable production code.
The ability to write clear, structured technical reports and memos, and communicate effectively in English.
Experience with counterparty credit risk, IMM, CVA or XVA is particularly relevant. Familiarity with banking regulation and model validation or approval processes is also an advantage.

You do not need to have worked with every aspect of the role. We value a strong foundation in derivatives and quantitative development, together with the ability and motivation to build broader expertise.
 
What we offer
 
People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
 
A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
 
Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
 
Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
 
If this sounds like you, get in touch!
 
Next steps
 
Submit your application no later than 23/11/2026.
 
We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
 
We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
 
We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
 
We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
 
We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
 
If you are an external consultant interested in this role and wish to apply please contact the hiring people leader for separate instruction on how to apply.
 
For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Welcome to HARALD PIHL – where metals meet people, and curiosity meets craftsmanship.
We're a family-owned company with over 110 years of history, but our mindset is anything but old-fashioned.
Here, professionalism goes hand in hand with warmth, teamwork, and a healthy dose of positive energy.
We believe in being curious, solution-oriented, and honest in everything we do – and we're proud of the culture we build together, across borders, roles, and locations.
If you enjoy taking responsibility, making things better than they were yesterday, and being part of a company that truly cares about both results and people, you might feel right at home with us.
About the role
We are looking for an Area Sales Manager to strengthen HARALD PIHL's presence and continue developing our business in the Polish market.
This is a fully remote position. We therefore welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in Poland. The role involves regular travel to customers, prospects, and industry events across the country.
In this role, you will take ownership of developing sales within your market, working with both existing customers and new business opportunities. A key part of your mission will be to actively identify and develop new customers, promote our products, and build long-term relationships with customers and partners. 
You will work with titanium, nickel-based alloys, and other specialty metals for demanding applications, combining commercial sales with technical understanding and a strong focus on customer needs.
This is a role for someone who enjoys being close to the market. You will spend time visiting customers, identifying new opportunities, preparing, and following up quotations, negotiating, and turning opportunities into orders. 
You will be responsible for your own sales budget and expected to actively contribute to growing our position in Poland.
While Poland will be your primary market, experience and business relationships in Hungary, Slovakia or other neighboring markets are highly valuable. 
You will be part of our international sales organization and work closely with colleagues in inside sales and other functions. 
What you'll do
Your responsibilities will include, among others:
Take ownership of sales development in the Polish market, including responsibility for your sales budget
Build and develop long-term relationships with existing customers while actively creating new business opportunities
Manage the full sales process, from customer enquiries and quotations to negotiation and order placement
Advise customers on materials, applications and suitable product solutions
Visit customers and prospects regularly across Poland to understand their needs and identify opportunities for future business
Represent HARALD PIHL at trade fairs, customer meetings and relevant industry events
Work closely with inside sales and colleagues across Purchasing, Operations and our international sales organisation
Monitor market developments, customer needs and competitor activity to identify opportunities for growth
Maintain relevant customer, opportunity and sales information in our CRM and ERP systems

As our business continues to grow, the role may evolve with additional responsibilities and development opportunities over time.
Who we're looking for
You are a commercially driven sales professional with a strong understanding of metals, specialty alloys or closely related technical materials. You enjoy combining technical knowledge with commercial thinking and are confident discussing customer requirements, applications and material solutions.
You are motivated by developing business, building strong customer relationships and opening new doors. At the same time, you are comfortable taking ownership of your market and planning your activities independently in a remote environment.
Being close to the customer comes naturally to you. You enjoy spending time in the market, understanding applications and requirements, and turning that knowledge into long-term business opportunities.
Required experience & knowledge
Several years of B2B sales experience within metals, specialty alloys or closely related technical materials
Proven experience developing new customers and business opportunities 
Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills 
Experience managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and quotation to negotiation and order 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 
Experience working with CRM and ERP systems 
Fluent Polish and English, both written and spoken
A valid driver's license and willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings

Nice to have
Experience from the metals, manufacturing, or aerospace industry
Experience with titanium, nickel-based alloys or other special metals 
Previous experience selling metals within the Polish market
An existing network within relevant industrial sectors 
Experience or business relationships in neighbouring Central European markets
Technical or commercial education
Experience with Monitor ERP

Personal competencies
We believe how you work is just as important as what you know. For this role, we value that you are:
Relationship-oriented - you naturally build trust and develop long-term relationships with customers and colleagues
Results-oriented - you are motivated by developing your market, creating opportunities, and turning activity into tangible business results
Collaborative - you share information, work closely with others, and see teamwork as an important part of delivering great results
What it's like to work with us
At HARALD PIHL, you'll join a company where people genuinely enjoy working together.
We combine the agility of a local organization with the opportunities of an international business. You'll have significant freedom and responsibility in your role, while also benefiting from the support of experienced colleagues and a strong team culture.
We offer a collaborative and down-to-earth environment where ideas are welcomed, initiatives are encouraged and long-term relationships matter.
Most importantly, you'll become part of a company with deep expertise, a strong reputation in the market and a genuine commitment to both customers and employees.
If you're commercially driven, enjoy building markets and relationships, and want to take ownership of growing HARALD PIHL's business in Poland, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Head of Data & Analytics - Troax AB
jobs.description:
Head of Data & Analytics
Do you want to build the foundation for how data is governed, managed and used across a global organization? Troax is strengthening its global IT organization and establishing Data & Analytics as a core enterprise capability. We are now looking for a Head of Data & Analytics who wants to take a key role in this transformation and help enable a more data-driven Troax.
The position has a global scope and is primarily based in Jönköping, with the possibility of being based at another Troax office in Sweden.

Linus, VP of IT, shares what it’s like to work at Troax.
"What makes this an exciting time to join Troax is that we are building and developing several important capabilities within IT. There is a real opportunity to come in, take ownership and help shape both the direction and how we work going forward. At the same time, you are close to the business and can see how your work contributes to a global industrial company with a clear purpose and products that create real value for customers.
For me, a good working environment is built on clarity, trust and open dialogue. I want people to feel involved, understand the bigger picture and have the freedom to take responsibility and influence how we work. If you enjoy building something new, collaborating across an international organization and seeing tangible progress from your work, Troax offers a very exciting environment.”

About the role
This is a newly established position with a Group-wide perspective and significant opportunity to influence. You will be given the mandate to build the Data & Analytics capability from the ground up, creating the structures, governance and common data foundation needed to make critical information trusted, accessible and useful across the organization.
You will work across the organization, bringing together business, IT, data owners and external partners, while collaborating closely with specialists in areas such as Architecture, AI & Automation, Enterprise Integrations and Business Applications.
Key responsibilities:
Define and drive the Data & Analytics strategy and roadmap.
Establish Data Governance, data ownership and data quality across the Group.
Develop Troax’s approach to Master Data Management and establish and develop a common Data Foundation.
Create a coherent global approach to BI, analytics and reporting.
Ensure that critical data is trusted, accessible and useful to the business.
Establish principles, standards and governance for data management.
Build and coordinate a virtual data organization with relevant data owners and specialists.
Coordinate internal capabilities and set requirements for external partners.
Enable the business to develop relevant analytics and reporting based on a common and reliable data foundation.

Meet Ellen, Global Item Master Lead.
"What I really appreciate about working at Troax is the combination of being part of a global company while still having short decision-making paths and a lot of individual responsibility. There is a lot happening within the company, and with the digital transformation ahead there are great opportunities to influence how we work and how things are developed going forward.
The culture is very open and helpful, and it is easy to connect with colleagues across departments and countries. You quickly gain a broad understanding of the business and how different parts of the organization are connected. For someone who enjoys taking initiative, building new ways of working and seeing the actual impact of what you do, Troax is a place where you are given the mandate to make a real difference."
Your profile
We are looking for a senior profile with experience in building or developing Data & Analytics, Data Governance or Data Enablement. Your background could be in data management, data governance, master data, BI and analytics, enterprise architecture or related areas where business and IT development meet.
You understand how to move from strategy to execution. While you are comfortable defining roadmaps, principles and standards, you are equally prepared to take an active and pragmatic role in establishing the capability. Experience from an international organization, manufacturing environment, acquisition-driven business or an organization with fragmented processes and systems is an advantage.
As a person, you are self-driven, structured and comfortable taking ownership in an environment where everything is not yet established. You have the ability to create clarity and bring different stakeholders together around a common direction. You communicate confidently with both business and technical stakeholders and combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic approach to implementation.
Strong understanding of data strategy, Data Governance, data ownership and data quality.
Knowledge of Master Data Management and Data Foundation principles.
Good understanding of BI, analytics and reporting.
Experience defining target states, principles, standards and roadmaps.
Very good command of English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

jobs.occupation: Head of Enterprise Integrations - Troax AB
jobs.description:
Head of Enterprise Integrations
Do you want to shape how systems, applications and data connect across a global organization? Troax is strengthening its global IT organization and establishing Enterprise Integration as a core capability. We are now looking for a Head of Enterprise Integrations who wants to take a key role in this transformation and build the integration capability that will support Troax’s continued development.
The position has a global scope and is primarily based in Jönköping, with the possibility of being based at another Troax office in Sweden. 

Linus, VP of IT, shares what it’s like to work at Troax
"What makes this an exciting time to join Troax is that we are building and developing several important capabilities within IT. There is a real opportunity to come in, take ownership and help shape both the direction and how we work going forward. At the same time, you are close to the business and can see how your work contributes to a global industrial company with a clear purpose and products that create real value for customers.
For me, a good working environment is built on clarity, trust and open dialogue. I want people to feel involved, understand the bigger picture and have the freedom to take responsibility and influence how we work. If you enjoy building something new, collaborating across an international organization and seeing tangible progress from your work, Troax offers a very exciting environment.”
About the role
You will be given the mandate to shape the integration landscape from the ground up, creating the structures, standards and technical foundation needed to connect applications, platforms, data and external partners across the organization.
Your mission is to establish a scalable, secure and governed approach to integration across Troax. You will define the vision, strategy and roadmap while building the structures and standards needed for a modern integration landscape. An important part of the role will be to establish and own a common integration platform and create clear principles for how integrations are developed, monitored, documented and managed throughout their lifecycle.
You will work across business and IT, collaborating closely with system and process owners, regional IT, external partners and specialists within areas such as Architecture, Data, AI & Automation and Business Applications.
Key responsibilities:
Define and drive the Enterprise Integration vision, strategy and roadmap.
Establish and own a Group-wide integration platform.
Establish principles, standards, reusable patterns and governance for integration development.
Develop lifecycle management, documentation, monitoring, support and follow-up.
Ensure scalable, secure, robust and traceable integrations.
Coordinate internal capabilities and external integration and development partners.
Contribute to the future sourcing model for integration capabilities.
Support larger business transformation and system initiatives across the Group.

Meet Elin, Software Developer at Troax.
"What I really enjoy about working at Troax is the people and the atmosphere. There is a lot of knowledge and competence here, but at the same time the environment is very open, friendly and down-to-earth. You can be in the middle of a serious discussion about a complex system and still have room for laughter and a relaxed conversation.
I also really appreciate how close you are to the actual business. For me, the connection between software development and the physical factory was something that stood out from the beginning. There is a real sense of potential here, with many opportunities to improve, develop and make a difference. And perhaps most importantly, it is simply a workplace where I genuinely enjoy spending time with my colleagues.”
Your profile
We are looking for a senior profile with experience in establishing or developing integration capabilities. Your background could be within integration architecture, enterprise architecture, platform ownership, IT leadership or technical delivery.
As a person, you are self-driven and structured with a strong sense of ownership. You communicate confidently with both technical and business stakeholders and have the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and accessible way. You enjoy collaborating with others but are equally comfortable making decisions and driving your area forward.
We believe you bring:
Experience establishing or developing Enterprise Integration in a larger or complex organization.
Strong understanding of integration architecture and integration platforms.
Experience with API management, application and system integration and information flows.
Knowledge of integration patterns, monitoring, documentation, security and lifecycle management.
Ability to define target states, principles, standards and roadmaps.
Experience coordinating and setting requirements for external technology partners.
The ability to combine strategic responsibility with operational execution.
Very good command of English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

About Troax Group
At Troax Group, we believe that safety makes progress possible. We help businesses protect people, property and processes through a broad portfolio of industrial safety solutions and services. From machine guarding and warehouse safety to data centre protection, active safety, risk assessments and expert services, we work with our customers to understand their challenges and create safer, more productive environments. The final phase of a delivery is where our technology truly proves itself. Installation at the shipyard, commissioning, HAT and SAT, final acceptance, and the warranty period are critical stages in ensuring that the vessel performs as promised. They are also the moments that shape the customer’s lasting impression of our delivery.
To strengthen our focus on this critical phase, we are now establishing a new Commissioning & Warranty function and are looking for two individuals to join the team who want to help shape it from the start. In this role, you will take operational responsibility for the delivery through its most decisive stage, where engineering is transformed into real-world performance and customer value.
What you will be doing
As Responsible for Commissioning & Warranty, you are operationally responsible for a delivery from formal project handover, after FAT and delivery of the equipment, until the customer is transferred to standard Aftermarket support. You will plan, coordinate, and drive the delivery forward through arrival inspection, installation support, commissioning, HAT and SAT, customer acceptance, the warranty period, and ultimately formal warranty closure. Your mission is clear: keep everything moving until we leave behind vessels that perform as promised and customers who trust us to deliver again.
Throughout this journey, you will be the customer’s primary operational point of contact, providing continuity, direction, and clear ownership from one phase to the next. Internally, you will be the connecting force between our technical, operational, and supporting functions, bringing the right people together, aligning priorities, and ensuring that the delivery continues to move forward.
In practice, you will:
Take over the delivery from the Project Manager and make sure nothing falls between the two of you: scope, open points, documentation and warranty terms.
Coordinate field service resources and spare parts, and collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), technical support and suppliers to secure competence and availability against plan;
Ensure arrival inspection at site is completed and drive transport damage and shortages to resolution.
Support installation towards the shipyard, then plan and run commissioning, HAT and SAT until acceptance is obtained.
Act as operational owner of warranty cases, from registration and technical assessment to liability determination and resolution, including claim handling and supplier recovery.
Handle customer disputes and negotiate practical, commercially sound settlements within your mandate.
Keep scope boundaries, documentation, cost exposure and status visible and feed lessons learned back into engineering, production and service.

You work within a clear mandate. Decisions on prioritization, technical resolution paths, resourcing, warranty assessment and settlements within your delegated authority are yours to make. The Project Manager remains accountable for the overall project, and the genuinely large questions are escalated but you are expected to solve, not to forward.
We think you should have
You have led projects before and know what it takes to keep stakeholders aligned when schedules are under pressure. You are comfortable being the main point of contact for customers and enjoy balancing technical, commercial and operational perspectives to move a project forward.
We believe you have several years of experience in project management, commissioning management, or aftermarket/service management, preferably within the marine, offshore, energy, or other capital equipment industries. You hold a technical degree or have gained equivalent knowledge through practical experience. You have worked closely with shipyards, customers and suppliers, handling deviations, claims and commercial discussions, and you possess a solid technical understanding that allows you to actively participate in discussions with engineers and service technicians, form your own view of technical challenges, and contribute to finding solutions.
You are comfortable working across multiple IT systems simultaneously, such as ERP platforms, case and claim management systems, documentation tools and reporting solutions. You also have a good understanding of contracts, warranty terms and the commercial impact of technical decisions. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required, while Swedish is considered an advantage. The role also involves occasional travel to shipyards, vessels and customer sites as needed, although travel is not the primary focus of the position.
Just as important as your experience is the way you work. You are structured and proactive, with a natural ability to bring tasks to completion rather than letting them drift. You remain calm and professional in challenging situations, focusing on finding solutions and building strong relationships. You communicate clearly with people from different cultures, backgrounds and levels of an organization, and you take ownership of your responsibilities without waiting to be directed.
Why join us
A role with real influence. Commissioning and warranty is where our promises to the customer are tested. We are building a clearer, more structured and more customer-focused way of working around it and you will help us shape it. Your work strengthens the transition between New Sales, Project Management and the Aftermarket organization, with better quality, stronger documentation, reduced cost leakage and stronger customer relationships as the result.
A global and technologically advanced environment. World-leading products for vessel propulsion, experienced colleagues and international customers. You will work closely with Project Management, Technical Support, Field Service, Engineering, our Product Centers and the regional Global Customer Support organizations, and build a cross-functional network across the business that few other roles give you.
Breadth, and room to grow. Few positions combine technology, coordination, customer dialogue, business understanding and continuous improvement the way this one does. It sits in a stable global organization with a strong culture of innovation, and offers good development opportunities in whichever direction you want to take next.
We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.

Security Clearance is required for this position.
Kongsberg Maritime - a global leader in maritime technology.

Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.

 Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.
 

Key job responsibilities
 You will also be involved in:
 o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
 o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.
 o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.
 o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.
 o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.
 o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.
 
 In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!

A day in the life
Day to day activities for this role include; 
 o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center. 
 o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained. 
 o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works. 
 o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties. 
 o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover. 
 o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development. 
 o Event response and drill participation. 

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Basic Qualifications
- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience
- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Strong English verbal and written communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in data center engineering

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.occupation: Professional Home Cleaner at HomeWork® AB
jobs.description:
SVENSKA NEDAN / SWEDISH BELOW
Professional Home Cleaner at HomeWork® AB
HomeWork® AB is one of Sweden's largest home cleaning companies, with clients in Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, and Lund. We have focused exclusively on home cleaning since 2007, that is, for more than 19 years.
As a professional home cleaner with HomeWork, you clean the homes of regular clients on a weekly, biweekly, or four-weekly basis. You normally have two clients a day, sometimes three, but never more. The clients stay the same over time, so they become your clients, who know you and trust you.
We're looking for employees who are motivated and genuinely skilled in home cleaning: who know their materials and methods, work meticulously and efficiently, stay organized, and have an eye for detail. Strong communication, service-mindedness, and a sense of responsibility are also important. If you have previous professional cleaning experience it’s an advantage, but not a requirement.
Since we only recruit people who want home cleaning to be their profession, we ask that you work at least 25% of full-time, that is, 10 hours per week.
In return, we offer a genuinely stable job, friendly clients, and an administration that is well-organized and helpful for you.
We also offer better employment terms than many other cleaning companies:
• Higher salary than in collective agreements
• Full-time work if you want to work full-time
• Compensation for travel by car or public transportation
• Work phone with free calls and free internet
• Bonus program for referrals to new clients and cleaners
• Healthcare/fitness subsidy
• Up to six weeks of vacation per year
The salary is 4% higher than in collective agreements, which currently means 161,87 SEK/h plus 12% vacation salary, for a total of 181,29 SEK/h.
If you're unfamiliar with the salary system in Sweden, it's worth noting that we, like all Swedish employers, also pay social fees of 31,42% on top of your salary. That includes your pension fee of 10,21%, which the Swedish state pays out to you when you retire, whether you then still live in Sweden or not.
To apply, you should:
1. Be motivated and skilled in home cleaning
2. Be reliable, friendly, and service-minded
3. Speak good Swedish or English (Please note that Swedish is NOT a requirement)
4. Hold a residence or work permit in Sweden
5. Plan to work with us at least 25% of full-time for at least 12 months
6. Be willing to show an extract from the Swedish criminal record register (Belastningsregistret)
Please note that having a driver’s license is NOT a requirement.
To learn more and apply online in less than three minutes, please visit homework.se/apply. We confirm, read, and reply to every single application.
We look forward to hearing from you.
Lön
161,87 SEK/h plus 12% vacation salary, that is, 181,29 SEK/h, plus other compensation listed above

Vänligen notera att ha ett körkort INTE är ett krav.
